- What `prylar` and `fenor` find also comes home to room 107 (feature 38, §10.25): the gadgets on its
  shelf, the fins in a pile by Stig's bed (`collect` calls `dressRoom107`).
- Per pickup: +250 pta, `hud.showCollect('<span class="pryl-icon"></span> Oles prylar <b>n/7</b>')`
  and Ole's radio line (prylar) / squeak + splash (fenor) / the `pling` and a golden sparkle, the
  toaster kept with its label (brodrostar) / no pay of its own, the chime and a sparkle at the counter
  after the clerk's 100 pta in the exchange (vaskor, §10.52). 7/7 (6/6): `bonus` pta + `complete` radio.
- Collectibles exist on the island only; the big-map legend comes from `game.mapLegend()`:
  `M stänger · ! uppdrag · ● Oles prylar n/7 · ● Hajfenor n/7 · ● G17-brödrostar n/7 · ● Borttappade väskor n/6 · Gags n/2`
  (flight: `M stänger · ! uppdrag`). The Gags row (feature 47, §10.32) counts the gags played at
  least once (`game.gags.count`/`total`); it has no dot, as gags have no map marker.
- Minimap markers within 45 m: types `pryl` (orange dot), `fena` (blue dot), `rost` (a chrome
  block with two golden slices; only while no mission runs, `idle`) and `vaska` (a blue suitcase with
  its handle and a white label; `idle`, and not one on Stig's head: a `held` collectible has none),
  drawn by hud.js.

### 10.2 Currency: pesetas

- `game.coins` **is pesetas**. A coin pickup is worth **25 pta** (`coin.value = 25`). HUD:
  `1 250 pta` (thin-space thousands).
- Fixed coins: island ≤ 260 (sidewalk lines 26×7, arcs on bygge ramps, dunes, Kasbah stairs,
  lighthouse roof, dream-plane wing), cabin ≤ 30. The pool stays 500 (bursts recycle).
- Prop bursts: `def.coins` coins. Wreck bursts: 8 coins.
- **Sinks**: ¡MULTA! 20 % of the purse, 250–1500 (§7.2) · PANIK −50 · porter bribe −500 · donkey −200 · grisfest −800 ·
  julafton −100 · hittelön −25.
- **No soft locks** — `game.pay(n)`: if `coins ≥ n` deduct; else Ole pays (radio `ole`
  "Jeg spanderer!" [N] + toast `Ole betalade ${n} pta.` [N]) and nothing is deducted. Fines and
  the panic fee are **not** paid by Ole (they just floor at 0).
- **Free-roam pay**: Robban pays 25–100 pta for each Berra carried home (§10.6).
- **Free-roam spending** (feature 34, §10.23): SunTrip-butiken's four wares at the sign's price plus
  their add-ons: the hat 225 (100 + 25 + 25 + 25 + 50) on the Trapp Trull account, 75 now and two
  instalments of 75 later; the sunglasses 275; the dotted shirt 350; the nose guard 50 (0 + the fuel
  surcharge). The purse must hold what is paid now (`addCoins`; Ole does not pay); an instalment
  waits until it holds 75.
- **The phone** (feature 80, §10.43): 25 pta a car called from booth 2 at Centro Nórdico, through
  `game.pay` (Ole pays when the purse is short); a hang-up or a full car park costs nothing.
  waits until it holds 75. A cup of Swedish coffee at BAR PISCINA after friskoteket, 40 pta (the
  purse must hold it), gives a 30 s faster sprint; Fru Storch pays 50 pta for the cup brought to her
  (feature 84, §10.44).
- **The market's awnings** (feature 92, §10.46): 26 fixed coins on the trail from the second ¡SALTA!
  shade to the souvenir stand's roof (650 pta) and, after asnan, 4 on the roof (100 pta), placed with
  `minY` 2.5: the magnet takes them only from the awnings' height, never from the ground or a car.
- Big-map flavour sign at Centro Nórdico (`cita`): `CAMBIO · 1 KR = 17 PTA`.

### 10.3 Unlocks (`UNLOCKS`, content/island.js; generic `game.unlock(name)`, Phase 0)

```js
UNLOCKS = {
  grisbil: { car: { type: 'grisbil', name: 'grisbil', at: 'flamencoDrive', dx: 4, dz: 0 },
             toast: 'Upplåst: <b>Grisbilen</b> – parkerad vid Hotell Flamenco. Den luktar.' },   // [N]
  samba:   { tune: 'samba', toast: 'Upplåst: <b>Musik: samba</b> i pausmenyn' },                 // [N] P1
  bodega:  { hook: 'bodegaLit', label: ['Pepes Bodega', 'bodega'],
             home: { berra: ['bodega', -1.5, 0.5], robban: ['bodega', 1.5, 0.5], angerud: null,
                     lasse: ['flamencoPool', -3.4, 2.8], fruStorch: ['flamencoPool', 0.6, 2.6],          // feature 8, §10.13
                     affe: ['flamencoPool', 4.6, 2.4], gabbe: ['flamencoPool', 6.0, 1.2] },
             outfit: { lasse: 'jul' },                                                              // feature 8
             chatter: { berra: ['Robban! Jag hittade Pepes Bodega!' /* [F*] */], robban: ['Pepes Bodega. Glöm aldrig det, du.' /* [F*] */],
                        herrStorch: ['Lite film.' /* [F*](t) */, 'Locket är av nu, ska du veta.' /* [N] */],   // feature 6
                        gabbe: ['Natturen går klockan nio!' /* [N] */, 'God fortsättning! Natturen går som vanligt.' /* [N] */],
                        hittegods: ['Inga fler väskor, señor? ¡Feliz Navidad!' /* [N] */] },              // feature 39, §10.28
             witness: { text: 'Linsskyddet är av – nu finns det bevis!', evidence: true },          // [N] feature 6, §7.2
             toast: 'Pepes Bodega har öppnat – på baksidan av hotellet.' },                        // [N]
  glid:    { toast: 'Upplåst: <b>Jag kan flyga</b> – håll J i luften' },                          // [N] feature 3
};
```
`witness` (feature 6, §10.11) is merged over `METERS.skandal.witnessToast` on the island
(`applyUnlock` sets `game.witnessOverride`): after the end the lens cap is off, so an offence near
Herr Storch counts (§7.2). The same unlock is his "after the end" in `game.film` (`after: 'bodega'`).
`glid` (feature 3, §10.7) carries only the toast: the glide comes with `bodega`, and `game.glide`
unlocks `glid` the first time he is in the air in free roam after it, so the toast shows then, once.
`bodega` also puts the suitcase, the plastic giraffe and the SPORT-KNÄCKE pack in room 107 (feature
38, §10.25): `unlock` and `applySaveToWorld` call `dressRoom107`, so it needs no `hook` of its own.
`sjuPoang` (feature 35, §10.26) carries only Siv's `chatter` ("Sju poäng till Giraffen. Mer än
pizza-racern!") and its toast: `game.solkram` unlocks it as the scene of the first 7 for the sun
cream ends.
Feature 39 (§10.28): `bodega.chatter` also gives Gabbe "Natturen går klockan nio!" and "God
fortsättning! Natturen går som vanligt." [N] and the lost-and-found man "Inga fler väskor, señor?
¡Feliz Navidad!" [N], whose CHATTER the end made stale (the grisfest bus from SunTrip; "Hammarby…?"
for a bag he has handed back).
A name not in `UNLOCKS` is only added to `game.unlocked` (saved with it): the glide keeps its
once-ever marker `glidPlask` (Lasse's pool line has been said) there, the sun cream `solkramFilm`
(the film's pair has been said, §10.26).
`home` overrides the island HOMES entry (main.js `homeOverrides`); a `null` home hides the NPC
(`key in homeOverrides`, Phase 3 r2: a falsy override used to be ignored). `chatter` (Phase 3 r2,
main.js `chatterOverrides`) replaces that NPC's free-roam CHATTER on the island. Both are applied
by `applyUnlock`, so a loaded save gets them too. `outfit` (feature 8, §10.13; main.js
`outfitOverrides`) is merged over the island's `LEVEL_OUTFITS` set by `applyOutfits`, so it is worn
from the next forced placement (`placeNpcs(true)`: the runner's `complete()`, the end card, a load):
after the end Lasse keeps his Santa outfit. The toast shows on the first unlock only;
`game.unlock(name, { holdToast: true })` (Phase 3 r3) applies and saves the unlock but returns the
toast (or null) instead of showing it, for the runner to show after the end card (§9.4 item 8).
P2: `guardiaJeep` (buyable Land Rover that halves SKANDAL gain). Feature 51 (§10.34) is a variant
with the opposite effect, and the buyable jeep stays P2: `grisbil` also leaves `guardia1` at the Casa
Cuartel open between missions, a loan that brings the Guardia. `game.jeep` reads
`unlocked.has('grisbil')` (so a save from before the feature has it too) and adds its own toast, "Vid
Guardia Civils kasern står en jeep olåst…" [N], after the grisbil's the first time (not for a loaded
save); the grisbil's toast is unchanged.

### 10.4 Outfits

Player: `arlanda` (mission 1) → `kostym` (from mission 1's outro, flight, island until buss17) →
`hawaii` (buss17 outro cue; persisted) → `rio` (the end card; after the end also room 107's
wardrobe). NPC outfits by home set from
`LEVEL_OUTFITS` via `levelDef.outfits(g)` (gate set only while `missions.index === 0`, §4.2), on the
island with an unlock's `outfit` merged over it (`outfitOverrides`: `lasse` `jul` after the end,
§10.3), and by cue (`ole` `gris` on grisfest stage 5's `startCue`, `lasse` `jul` in julafton). In free
roam between buss17 and the bodega `berra` and `robban` wear `stekt` (their island looks, lobster red)
while they lie asleep by Flamenco's pool (feature 32, §10.22; back to their own look the moment it
ends). Cut fallback: no swaps.
**SunTrip-butiken's layer** (feature 34, §10.23): what he bought there and wears (`shop.worn`) is a
look shallow-merged over his outfit by `setPlayerOutfit` (`shop.dress(def, name)`): the hat, the
sunglasses (`glasses` off), the dotted shirt (the suit's parts off) and the nose guard, over `kostym`
or `hawaii` alike. Only on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, never over `rio`: a mission
start takes it off (buss17's change to `hawaii` and every cutscene see his own outfit), the runner
going idle puts it back on; in a car it waits until he is on foot. `player.outfit` stays the
outfit's name.
**Free roam and missions** (feature 67, §10.36): on the island `islandOutfit` is his free-roam
outfit. Room 107's wardrobe sets it between missions (`kostym`, `arlanda`, `hawaii` after buss17,
`rio` after the end; saved as `outfit`), and buss17's outro cue sets `hawaii` (persisted, as before).
What he wears on the island is `islandWear()` (main.js): `islandOutfit` with `missions.state ===
'idle'`, else the story's outfit, `kostym` up to index 5 and `hawaii` after it. So a mission never
sees his pick: missions 7–13, their scenes and their checks see the shirt as before.
**The wardrobe's suit** (feature 36, §7.2): in free roam, during a pursuit, Stig changes from the
hawaii shirt into `kostym` in room 107's wardrobe and back again there, with `persist: false`:
`player.outfit` is `kostym`, `islandOutfit` and the save keep `hawaii`, so a reload has the shirt on.
A mission start puts the story's outfit on before the talk (`runner.begin`: on the island, when
`player.outfit !== islandWear()`; the forced placement below runs only when a mission ends), and the
runner going idle puts `islandOutfit` back.
**Re-application (review fix 1):** `placeNpcs(true)` re-applies the home set's outfits
(`applyOutfits`) whenever the runner is not in `outro`, so the gate → flight set follows
`missions.index` without a level change, a cue outfit lasts through its mission's outro and reverts
when the runner goes idle (or on fail; a checkpoint retry re-applies `startCue`/`doneCue` outfits,
so put a mid-mission NPC outfit on a stage `startCue`, not on a dialogue line). The player on the
island wears `islandWear()` (his free-roam outfit between missions, the story's in one); in the flight
level the set's `stig` wins.

### 10.5 Save

Key **`charter-and-run-v1`** (localStorage):

```js
{ v: 1, mission: index, coins, collected: { prylar: [ids], fenor: [ids], brodrostar: [ids], vaskor: [ids] },
  unlocked: ['grisbil', ...], outfit: 'kostym' | 'arlanda' | 'hawaii' | 'rio', tune: 'sol' | 'samba',
  records: { simhopp: n, eslov: s, solkram: n, stunts: { planka: m, gula: m, garage: m }, stork: true,
             gatlopp: { won: 0..3, sex: true }, eslovSkidor: s, fiske: { fisk: n, sko: n, fena: n, knacke: n },
             kikare: ['flotte', 'fena', …], packhus: n, volley: { won: n, lost: n },
             kort: { next: 0..2, bra: n, kort: n } },
  shop: { owned: ['hatt', 'glas', 'skjorta', 'nasa'], off: [ids], trapp: 0..2, trappT: s, bag: bool },
  gags: ['kamera', 'viking'] }
```

`load()` clamps `mission ≤ MISSIONS.length`; `?mission=N` overrides; `?fresh` skips loading.
`outfit` is his free-roam outfit on the island (§10.4): room 107's wardrobe saves it at once (feature
67, §10.36); a save from before holds `kostym` or `hawaii`, as the story had them.
`collected` holds every set in `COLLECTIBLES` (feature 33: saved and read set by set, so a v1 save
from before `brodrostar` loads with none of it, still `v: 1`; so does one from before `vaskor`, feature 116); `applySaveToWorld` marks a `keep`
set's collected ones (the toasters' labels) and removes the others'.
Saved on mission complete, collectible pickup, level transition, and every 30 s. The free-roam
Berra job (§10.6) is not saved. `unlocked` also holds the glide's `glid` (its toast shown) and the
marker `glidPlask` (Lasse's pool line said; saved at once), §10.7. `records` holds the free-roam
bests (`game.records`; a missing key is no record yet): `simhopp`, the diving judges' best total,
saved at once when beaten (feature 4, §10.8); `eslov`, Eslövloppet's best time in seconds (two
decimals), saved at once with a win that beats it (feature 7, §10.12); `eslovSkidor`, Eslövrundan's
best time on the skis in seconds (two decimals), saved at once with any finished run that beats it
(feature 71, §10.39; the skis themselves are never saved); `solkram`, the sun cream's
best points (5–7), saved at once when beaten (feature 35, §10.26), whose once-ever marker
`solkramFilm` is in `unlocked`; `stunts`, the named car jumps' best distances in metres (one
decimal), saved at once with a new record (feature 40, §10.27; a jump with none is not yet passed);
`stork`, true once Fru Storch has corrected Stig by the stork on the beach, saved at once (feature
43, §10.31); `gatlopp` { won: 0–3 (José's street races won, in order), sex: true once the sisters
have given the six }, saved at once with a win and with the six (feature 69, §10.38); `fiske` { fisk,
sko, fena, knacke }, the catches at the pier's end by kind (the FÅNGST card), saved at once with every
catch (feature 107, §10.45); `kikare`, the ids of the binoculars' targets found, in the order found (a fin
already taken goes in at the next look), saved at once with every find (feature 108, §10.48); `packhus`,
the most boxes filled in one shift at the packing shed's belt, saved at once when beaten (feature 109,
§10.49); `volley` { won, lost }, the beach volleyball matches won and lost against Berra and Robban, saved
at once at a match's end (feature 111, §10.50); `kort` { next, bra, kort }, the spot where the next tourist
couple waits (0 the lighthouse, 1 the dunes, 2 LA MEDINA), the good pictures and all pictures taken for
the couples, saved when a couple walks off (feature 110, §10.51); `guagua`, the guagua rides whose talk
was heard through (the film's football talk plays until one has), saved at once (feature 112, §10.53). `shop`
(feature 34, §10.23):
SunTrip-butiken's purchases (`owned`), the ones taken off at the counter (`off`), the Trapp Trull
account's instalments still to pay (`trapp`) and its free-roam seconds towards the next (`trappT`,
whole), and the beach bag taken (`bag`); saved at once with every purchase, change and instalment; a
save without it is nothing bought. `gags` (feature 47, §10.32): the ids of the gags played at least
once (`game.gags.saveData()`), saved at once with the first play of each; a save without it is none
played, and an unknown id is dropped on load. The free-roam clock (§10.10) is not saved: every
session's island starts at 15:00. Herr Storch's stills (feature 6, §10.11) have their own key,
**`charter-and-run-film-v1`**: a JSON array of up to 8 `data:image/jpeg` URLs (320×180, quality
0.75, about 10–15 kB each), written when a still is kept, read at start unless `?fresh`, and
removed with the save by `resetSave` (`film.forget()`). The v1 save is unchanged.

### 10.6 Bärra hem Berra (free roam; feature 2, 2026-10-14)

`game/berraJob.js` (`BerraJob`, owned by Game as `berraJob`), config `BERRA_JOB` in
content/island.js. The film's "Bärra hem Berra" as a repeatable side job: Berra naps somewhere in
town, Robban asks, Stig carries him home to the Flamenco reception on foot.

- **When.** On the island with `missions.state === 'idle'` and `missions.index >= fromIndex` (12:
  after the grisfest). Otherwise nothing, and any other state (a mission's intro, run, fail screen
  or outro) sends Berra and Robban home at once (`placeNpc` to their HOMES or `homeOverrides` spot,
  `busy = false`, un-posed); a carry or a drop is called off and the nap waits at the same spot. No
  mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes. The grisfest's evening (feature
  21, §10.18) does the same while it is on (`active` false): the two dance there.
- **The nap.** `spots` in turn, the bench first: `berraBank` (its `bank` prop, south of the plaza
  fountain, 84 m from the desk) and `berraSolstol` (a `solstol` by the SunTrip pool, about 70 m;
  while the job is `active` no bather lies on it, feature 32, §10.22).
  The first nap as soon as it is allowed, the next `napSecs` = 150 s after a delivery. Nobody sees
  it happen: the spot and both men's current places are each more than `clearR` = 50 m from the
  player (placeNpcs' rule), or more than 15 m off and outside the camera's frustum. The prop is
  revived; Robban is `placeNpc`d at `spot.robban` [dx, dz, yaw]; Berra goes `seated` with `slump`
  (the passed-out pose), his hips at `spot.seat` [dx, dz, y], turned `spot.yaw` from the landmark
  and leaning back `spot.lean` about the hips (root rotation order `YXZ`; the lounger −0.75, along
  its backrest), re-applied every frame. Both are `busy`. A smashed bench or lounger: he slides off
  (`fling`) and sleeps on in the sand (`down`, its timer held). Within `snoreR` = 35 m he says his
  `sleep` lines in turn every 4.5 s: "…zzz" [N], and on the lounger "Det är ju fan vad solen tar
  här nere, Robban." [F*] in his sleep. Robban waves Stig over (`berraJob.waving`, main.js keeps
  the giver's 9 m rule) and turns to him; Berra is posed (`berraJob.posed`: no wave, turn or
  chatter, as a mission's `idleAnim`). Minimap: a `friend` dot on Berra (not edge-clamped). A
  forced `placeNpcs` by someone else un-poses them, and the nap starts over when unseen.
- **The ask.** An interactable at Robban (r 2.6, `promptTalk`): `cinematic(robban, stig)`,
  `dialog(ask)`: robban "Kan du hjälpa mig bära hem Berra?" [F*], stig "Vilket snack! "Bärra hem
  Berra!"" [F*] (both relocated from Tonga Tonga). Then the lift, and Stig and the camera turn to
  the guide (`routeAim` to the desk), as a timed stage does after a dialogue.
- **The carry**, as the grisfest's (kinds/flight.js `carry`): Berra `seated` across the shoulders,
  `player.anim.carryOver`, `game.carrying = { who: 'berra', job: 'berra' }`, `game.speedCap =
  walkSpeed` = 3.2 (no sprint). Objective card `title` "Bärra hem Berra" [F*] / `carryText` "Bär
  Berra till receptionen på Hotell Flamenco – gå, spring inte!" [N]; target `to` =
  `flamencoRecepcion` (beacon, guide arrow, minimap star); `snore` "…zzz" [N] every 6 s. Untimed:
  about 26 s from the bench on calibrate's walker (never sprinting). Robban walks Stig's trail (a
  point every 0.5 m, the way a body got through): main.js `fixedStep` takes an NPC's wish from
  `npc.steer(h)` (m/s; his is up to 4.6); he stops 3 m short and turns to Stig, and more than 24 m
  behind he is put 4 m back on the trail. **No mission talk while carrying** (main.js
  `nearestInteractable`: the giver's talk needs `!game.carrying`): julafton's Ole stands 20 m from
  the desk, and `runner.begin()` resets neither `carrying` nor `speedCap` (the carry would follow
  Stig into the mission and keep him out of its car).
- **Drops** (no fail, no fee of their own): sprint held while moving for `sprintSecs` = 0.25 s; R
  (`bumpedT`); Stig flung or down (a car, a fall); a bust (`frozenT`). The carry state goes, Berra
  `fling`s off the shoulders (forwards when Stig ran, with Stig's velocity when he was hit) and lies
  `down`, its timer held (he never gets up by himself); `drops++`; Robban says "Nej, skärpning nu,
  Berra, annars får vi ena jävla problem här." [F*] (relocated from the plane) and walks to 1.3 m
  from him. Card `liftText` "Du tappade Berra! Lyft upp honom igen." [N]; the target is Berra as a
  `follow` target (arrow and minimap dot, no beacon: 2 m from Stig it stood in the chase eye). E at
  Berra (r 1.9, `liftPrompt` "<b>E</b> Lyft upp Berra" [N]) lifts him again.
- **The desk.** On foot within `radius` = 2.2 m of `to`: the carry state goes, Berra wakes (`slump`
  off); `placeNpc` Berra, Robban and Stig at `scene` ([dx, dz, yaw] from `to`) and
  `cutTo(scene.cam)`, the grisfest outro's shot of the desk (`recepcionCam`, 7.5 m, 2.0 m), with the
  porter behind them (the reception's queue, §10.37, steps aside at this cut); `dialog`: berra "Var jag med där? Hade jag kul?" [F*] (relocated from the
  bodega outro), robban `thanks` "Tack ska du ha. Här är en hundring." [N] or, after a drop,
  `thanksDocked` "Här är {n} pesetas. Avdrag för tappningarna." [N], the line's cue `{ coins: pay,
  sfx: 'coin' }` with pay = max(`minPay` 25, `pay` 100 − `perDrop` 25 × drops); then the toast
  `paidToast` "Robban betalade {n} pta." [N]. Both go free (`busy = false`, awake, chattering):
  `placeNpcs` takes them home once the player is 50 m away (after the end Berra's home is the
  bodega, 25 m off). The next spot `napSecs` later.
- Session state only (not saved): a reload starts with the bench. Lines, numbers and spots live in
  `BERRA_JOB`; scenario `berra` (§16.4).

### 10.7 Jag kan flyga – the glide (free roam; feature 3, 2026-10-14)

`game/glide.js` (`Glide`, owned by Game as `glide`), config `GLIDE` in content/island.js. Levander's
exercise as a move: Stig holds J in the air, spreads his arms and drifts down, stiff and slow, the
mantra in his bubble. The reward for the fear-of-flying arc; [N] (§1.6), the dream (`dromplan`) and
the end on the pool deck are the film's.

- **When.** `glide.allowed()`: on the island with `game.unlocked.has('bodega')` (only julafton gives
  it), `missions.state === 'idle'`, on foot (`!playerCar`), `!carrying` (the Berra job), not in a
  dialogue, a bust freeze (`frozenT`) or a PANIK, no `mantraMode`, `player.state === 'normal'`.
  Every fixed step re-checks it: a glide stops (arms down, a plain fall) when it goes false (a
  giver's talk in the air, a car, a bust). No mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration
  pool changes: story and calibrate run with `?fresh`, and the unlock comes at the story's end.
- **The press** (main.js `handleOneShots`): J pressed in the air more than `minAir` = 0.8 m above
  the floor (the stomp's rule) goes to `glide.press()`; when allowed it opens the tap window and the
  stomp waits, else `game.stomp()` at once (unchanged before the unlock, in missions, in a car).
  In `glide.step` (fixedStep, before the player's step): J released within `tap` = 0.18 s of real
  time → `game.stomp()` on the release (the old stomp, `vy = −18`, `stomping`); held past it → the
  glide; a landing first → nothing. Only an air press starts the window: J held from the ground (a
  kick) does not glide.
- **The glide**, while J is held and in the air. Heading `yaw` = his facing at the start; with a
  movement key held it turns towards the camera-relative direction (on foot's mapping) at up to
  `turn` = 1.4 rad/s, none held: straight on. His wish is the heading × `speed` = 5 m/s; `accel` =
  20 m/s² is added towards it before his step (on top of the step's own 14 m/s² air control:
  from rest to 5 m/s in about 0.15 s). The fall: before the step `vy` is raised to at least
  `GRAV·h − sink` (the step's gravity then leaves exactly −`sink` = −2.4 m/s), at most `GRAV + brake`
  (`brake` = 30 m/s²) a second past gravity, so a late glide eases in. Rising (a jump, a double
  jump, a trampoline) is untouched: a double jump stays available and the glide rides it up.
  `player.anim.wings` + `glide` (arms out, legs together, tipped 0.28 forward, a leaf's rock) and
  `anim.bank` (leans up to 0.22 into a turn); `game.stomping` is cleared; `audio.glide()`. The
  mantra auto-bubble `S.mantraLine` [F] every `sayEvery` = 2.5 s while no other bubble is up (as
  the mantra's). Measured (scenario `glide`): from the dream plane's left wing (top 3.0) jump +
  double jump peak at 5.7 m and glide 11.8–11.9 m in 2.4 s; from Flamenco's diving board (the bounce
  pad) bounce + double jump peak at 7.1 m and glide 14.6 m in 3.0 s, over the pool into the
  shallow end (x ≈ 0). A toy, not a way to travel.
- **Walls in the way** (after the step): a hit is his speed after the step under 0.6 × what it would
  have been (`blocked`; no steering then). The heading holds, so he slides round a palm trunk
  and on; dead head-on (under 0.3 m/s left) a `deflect` = 1.5 m/s nudge sideways, on the side he was
  already slipping to. His headway along the heading, averaged over `stuckSecs` = 0.6 s, under
  `headway` = 0.3 × `speed` after the first 0.6 s (a wall, a corner): he lets go and drops (a plain
  fall). The dream plane's wingtip palm (coast.js, local (−24, −2)), straight ahead off the
  wingtip: round the trunk in about 0.1 s of contact, on past it. The hangar's flat side head-on:
  about 0.6 s against it, then he drops. Palm fronds, as ever, are not solid.
- **The landing** (after the step, `onGround` while gliding; `onLand` is only for falls over 6
  m/s): arms down; on a `water` floor (looked up directly, §6.4) `fx.splash(x, z, 28, 4.5)` and
  `audio.splash()`, else `fx.dust` (9) and `audio.thud()`; then `player.tumble(1.0, 0.45)`
  (§14.6): a forward roll over his head onto his back in 0.45 s, carried on about 0.8 m by his
  momentum (never off an edge), lying until 1.0 s, then up (state `down` meanwhile: no input, no
  talk). Up again, a dazed shake of the head for `dazeSecs` = 0.9 s (`anim.look`). No fall damage,
  no text about falling (§1.2); a trampoline under him bounces him instead (no landing).
- **Lines.** The unlock's toast `UNLOCKS.glid` "Upplåst: <b>Jag kan flyga</b> – håll J i luften"
  [N] the first time he is in the air in free roam (more than `minAir` up) after julafton; once
  ever (§10.3). Landing in a `pool` (the hotel and lot pools, §6.4) the first time ever: Lasse on
  the radio, "Från fjärde våningen? Ner i poolen? Ring kliniken." [F*] (his phone call in the film,
  research-plot.md:292; only "ring kliniken" was used before, island.js:231 and the fins' first
  line, so this is its third and only once: the marker `glidPlask` in the saved unlocks). Not
  when the diving tower's first dive has said the line this session (feature 24, §10.20:
  `tower.radioSaid`); then the marker stays unset and a later session's first pool landing says it.
  `glide.radioSaid` is the session's own, which the tower reads in turn. Ole
  within `oleR` = 18 m after `oleAfter` = 0.5 s of a glide, at most once a glide and every
  `oleEvery` = 30 s: "Det er flyging!" [F*] (his Concorde dream on the plane, flight.js:321) as a
  bubble. His home under the Flamenco pergola is 16 m from the diving board's glide.
- **Where.** Anywhere he can get up; the player finds the spots. Oles prylar already lead to the
  island's heights (the dream plane's wing up the crate stairs, the building site's second floor at
  6.95 m, the farm's roof terrace at 5 m), and the diving board at Flamenco's pool throws him
  highest; scenario `glide` checks the wing and the board. Hotel roofs, the bell tower and the
  crane are walls topped at 99 m, so they are no launch spots (making them real roofs is another
  feature).
- `game.glide.last` (the last glide: start, peak, end, seconds, distance, `landed`, `water`,
  `pool`) is for tests. Session state only, but `glid` and `glidPlask` are saved unlocks.
  Lines and numbers live in `GLIDE`; scenario `glide` (§16.4).

### 10.8 Siv och Majsan sätter poäng – the diving judges (free roam; feature 4, 2026-10-15)

`game/poolJudges.js` (`PoolJudges`, owned by Game as `judges`), config `POOL_JUDGES` in
content/island.js. The plane's points scene as a game at Flamenco's pool: Stig bounces off the
diving board, and every hop that ends in the pool gets a card from Siv and one from Majsan. The
scene is the reward, and the best total is a saved record. The judging, the cards and Majsan's tens
are [N] (§1.6); the lines are the film's.

- **When.** On the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. A hop starts and is judged only when
  `canHop()`: also no dialogue, on foot, not carrying, no bust freeze or PANIK, `player.state ===
  'normal'`. Any other mission state (an intro, a run, the fail screen, an outro) or level ends it
  all at once (`reset`): a sister who is still ours (`npc.spot === 'poolJudges'`) is `placeNpc`d at
  her HOMES spot (or her `homeOverrides` one), `busy = false`; the cards, the laugh, the lines not
  yet said, the hop and the result line go. One placed meanwhile by anyone else (a cue's
  `placeNpc`, a forced `placeNpcs`) stays where she was put. No mission, stage kind, timer, fixture
  or calibration pool changes.
- **The board.** The bounce pad under the landmark `flamencoBoard` (block (3,3) local (−14.1, 7),
  yaw π/2: along the board out over the deep end; the pad's top 0.97, hotels.js). Character.step
  hands its block to `game.onBounce(ch, b)` (§14.3): the boing as before, then `judges.onBounce(b)`.
  Other trampolines change nothing, and the bounce itself (vy 15.5) is unchanged.
- **The call.** A bounce on the board while `canHop()`, with both sisters `here`, starts a hop.
  `here`: standing, shown, not held by a mission's `idleAnim` or the Berra job, not `busy` unless
  ours, and within `judgeR` = 22 m of the board (as buss17's and friskotek's extras they wait at the
  airport and on the friskotek lawn, and the board is only a trampoline). The first hop of a visit
  calls them. Stig says `call` "Mina ögon tål inte klor." [F*] (his line on the morning he would not
  go to the pool, research-plot.md:281), at most every `callAgain` = 120 s. Each sister walks
  (`npc.steer`, at most `walk` = 1.6 m/s, easing in) to her spot at the pool's edge: `spots` [dx, dz]
  from `flamencoBoard`, Siv (−6.9, 8.3) → (−5.8, 13.9) and Majsan (−6.9, 10.3) → (−3.8, 13.9). The
  spots are on the deck 0.6 m south of the coping, 4.1 and 4.8 m from their homes (−5, 18) and
  (−1, 18), in the frame from the board and from the deep end.
  - While she walks there, and while she stands there, she is ours: `busy`, `spot = 'poolJudges'`
    (her own spot id is kept for the way back), and `judges.posed(key)`, so main.js `syncAll` gives
    her no wave, no 10 m turn and no chatter. Standing, she turns to Stig (`dampAngle`, 5/s).
  - **Pinned:** a sister who is the idle mission's giver or extra at the pool (ropavieja: Siv gives,
    Majsan is the extra; fataga: the other way round; both at `flamencoPool`) does not walk, since
    placeNpcs keeps her at `at`. She judges from there and turns to him while the visit lasts.
- **The hop.** The bounce gives the double jump back (`game.jumps` at most 1), so every hop can
  be a somersault. On the way down, a plain hop shows `player.anim.swan` (§14.6: arms out and back,
  chin up, legs together, the body tipped 0.5 forward). Plain means no double jump and no stomp,
  with `vy < 0` and the board no longer under him. The pose is only a look: his wish and air control
  are untouched (`wings` would zero the wish and drop him back onto the board). A glide (§10.7)
  takes the hop over, unjudged. So does landing anywhere but the water (the board again, the step,
  the deck) or any change of state.
- **The verdict.** `game.onLand(ch, v, y)` (a fall over 6 m/s; Character.step now passes the floor
  height `y`) calls `judges.onLand(y)` before the stomp's own landing.
  - A hop that lands on a `water` floor (`collision.waterAt(x, z, y)`, not on a car roof) is judged
    and splashes: `fx.splash` 28 drops at 4.5 m/s (the belly flop 44 at 5.5), `audio.splash()`. The
    stomp keeps its crash, shake and `areaHit`, but not its dust.
  - The kind: `game.stomping` → `magplask`, and Stig `flop(flopSecs = 1.4)`s (face down along his
    facing, then up); `game.jumps === 2` → `volt`; else `svanhopp`.
  - The sisters judge it when both are `free` and within `judgeR` of him:

  | kind | Siv | Majsan | sum | lines ([delay s] who: text) |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `svanhopp` | 4 | 10 | 14 | [0.4] siv "Giraffen, då? Fyra." [F*](t) · [1.9] majsan "Mindre än pizza-racern?" [F*](t) · [3.3] majsan "Tio!" [N] |
  | `volt` | 9 | 10 | 19 | [0.4] siv "Majsan, en niopoängare!" [F*] (her line on the transfer bus, research-plot.md:245; buss17's radio keeps it as [F]) · [2.0] majsan "Tio!" [N] |
  | `magplask` | −1 | 10 | 9 | [0.4] siv "Han är så bortkommen. Det blir minuspoäng." [F*](t) · [2.8] stig "…Minuspoäng?" [N]; Majsan `laugh`s while the cards are up |

  - Siv never gives more than nine. The plane's points lines (research-plot.md:197; landning's intro
    speaks them as [F*](t), flight.js:432–435, ending in Stig's "…Fyra?") are relocated here.
  - The cards: `anim.card` = '4', '9' or '–1' (an en dash, which Luckiest Guy has) on Siv and '10'
    on Majsan, for `cardSecs` = 3.4 s. They use the models.js `scoreCard` prop (§14.6), held out at
    shoulder height to her right, under her speech bubble.
  - The result line, `hud.showScore` (§11.4), for 4.5 s: `result` "{kind} {a} + {b} = {sum} P" [N],
    with the `title` SVANHOPP! / VOLT! / MAGPLASK! [N], over `newRecord` "NYTT REKORD!" [N] (teal)
    or `record` "REKORD {n} P" [N].
- **Lines.** Each line goes through `game.say`, at most once every `again` = 20 s, so a quick second
  dive shows the cards and the result line without the same lines again. A new verdict drops the old
  one's lines not yet said; during a dialogue they wait, and they are dropped when 2 s late. Siv's
  `tease`, "Så att du vågar stöta på giraffen." [F*] (from the balcony, research-plot.md:256), comes
  1.6 s after the verdict lines of Majsan's `teaseAfter` = 3rd ten in a visit, once a visit.
- **The visit ends** `stayOut` = 25 s after the last bounce, when Stig is more than `leaveR` = 30 m
  from the board, or when a sister is no longer free (knocked over, placed by someone else). The
  ones out walk home. There (within 0.3 m) they are free again with their spot id back, and
  placeNpcs leaves them.
- **The pool fest** (feature 8, §10.13): a sister dancing in its ring (`fest.posed`, `spot =
  'poolFest'`) is `free` too, so the judges still work after the end. The call takes her out of the
  ring (her spot becomes `poolJudges`, and the fest lets her go where she stands); home after the
  visit, her spot id is the fest's again and the fest takes her back into the ring.
- **The record.** `game.records.simhopp` is the best total, saved at once when it is beaten (§10.5);
  the first verdict ever is a record. `judges.last` ({ kind, siv, majsan, sum, record, best }) is
  for tests. The rest is session state. Lines and numbers live in `POOL_JUDGES`; scenario `simhopp`
  (§16.4).

### 10.9 Tutan som folk reagerar på – the horn the island hears (free roam; feature 5, 2026-10-15)

`game/honk.js` (`Honk`, owned by Game as `honk`), config `HONK` in content/island.js. In free roam H
in a car is an event, not only a sound: pedestrians ahead hop aside, the nearest of the gang answer
in their own way, and Stig, the most polite man on the island, says sorry. The grisbil grunts. The
reactions are [N] (§1.6); the lines are relocated film lines [F*] and ours [N]. Later ideas that
react to the horn read `game.hornAt`.

- **When.** `honk.press()` from `handleOneShots` on `input.pressed('horn')` in the player's car (not
  a wrecked one), and only when `active()`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`, no dialogue.
  In a mission (any state but idle), in a dialogue and in the flight level the horn stays the sound
  it was (`updateAudio`), so the pedestrians' dodges during timed drives and every calibration pool
  are as before. A free-roam press sets `game.hornAt = { x, z, yaw, t, pigs }` (null before the
  first). The horn adds no SKANDAL.
- **Pedestrians.** Each one standing (`state 'normal'`, within 2.5 m of the car's height) ahead of
  the car within `pedR` = 14 m and no further aside than `pedLat` 4 + `pedCone` 0.7 × his distance
  ahead (the near sidewalk from the bumper on, the far one from about 8 m ahead), at most every
  `pedEvery` = 3 s each (`ped.honkedAt`), gets `ped.startle` (§6.7) with a delay of 0.1 + 0.02 × his
  distance ahead + up to 0.15 s, and hops away from the car's line. The nearest one always shouts
  the dodge shout, the others at `pedShout` = 50 %. One behind the car or outside the cone does not
  move.
- **The cast.** The NPCs that are `free` (standing, shown, not held by a mission's `idleAnim`, the
  Berra job or the diving judges: the chatter rule), within `castR` = 35 m of the car, and `sees` it
  are ranked nearest first, the ones with their own `lines` (with the grisbil, `pig`) before the
  rest; the first `replies` = 2 answer, `replyAt` = 0.35 and 1.1 s after the press, each at most
  every `castEvery` = 8 s (so a second press lets the next ones answer).
  - `sees`: `collision.segmentBlocked` at `eye` = 1.5 m over his feet is clear to the car's middle,
    or to a point `seeW` = 1.2 m to either side of it (a palm trunk or a lamp post at the curb does
    not hide the car; a building does). So Ole under Flamenco's pergola answers from the west street
    (27–31 m off), not from the SunTrip street behind the hotel, and no bubble rises from behind a
    wall. 35 m: the AI drivers' honks are heard within 40 m (`onHonk`).
  - The answer is `game.say(n, text, 2.4)`, and `n.chatT` restarts (7–13 s), so no chatter bubble
    lands on it. For `poseSecs` = 1.6 s he turns to Stig (`dampAngle`, 6/s) and holds his pose:
    `wave` for Ole and Lasse (`honk.waving(key)` in `syncAll`, at any distance; a giver waves only
    within 9 m), the raised arm `oath` for Angerud. It comes down after that, or at once when he is
    no longer free.
  - A dialogue, a mission state or the other level drops the answers not yet said and takes the
    poses down (`reset`, every frame while not `active`).

  | who | lines | with the grisbil |
  |---|---|---|
  | `ole` | "Det er farligere å kjøre bil enn å fly." [F*] (his comfort to the flight-shy Stig at Arlanda; the flight level keeps it in `OLE_STATS`), "Hei hei, Stig-Helmer! Kjør forsiktig, da!" [N] | the same |
  | `lasse` | "Hä-pååre!" [F*] (his signature greeting) | the same |
  | `angerud` | "Jag ska tala med platschefen!" [F*] | the same |
  | `berra` | "Ra-tara-tara!" [F*] (at the bikini girls by the bar) | "Skit i det. Vi slipper gå." [F*](t) |
  | `robban` | "Ra-tara-tara!" [F*] (the two say it together) | "Fan, de luktar.", "Snacka om grisfest." [F*](t) |
  | the Spanish cast (`LOCAL_CAST`) | "¡Turistas!", "¡Ay, los suecos!", "¡Hola, hola!" [N] | the same |
  | the rest | "Hallå där!", "Tuta inte åt mig!", "Vad är det nu då?" [N] | the same |

  A speaker's first answer in a session is the first of his own lines (Ole's statistics first), later
  ones another than his last; a class line is one nobody said in the same press and not his last.
  The lift lines are research-plot.md:319, where who says which is unsure; they follow the bodega
  radio (island.js:363: Robban "Fan, de luktar." and "Snacka om grisfest.", Berra "Skit i det."). That
  the lift is on a pig truck is the research's guess (osäkert), so they answer the grisbil. Angerud is hidden after
  julafton (the ambulance, §8.13), so he answers only while he is on the island.
- **Stig.** The first press in a session that anyone reacts to (a pedestrian startled or an NPC
  answering) brings his `sorry` "Förlåt! Jag kom åt tutan!" [N], `sorryAt` = 0.6 s after the press.
  When an answer is the `tease` "Ra-tara-tara!" (Berra or Robban taking the horn for a whistle after
  the girls), his `teaseReply` "Det var inte så jag menade!" [N] comes `teaseGap` = 1.5 s after it,
  once a press. He does not blush: the faces are vertex colours in a merged mesh.
- **The grisbil.** Its horn is a grunt (`car.spec.pigs`): `updateAudio` keeps the horn tone off in
  it, and `honk.update` plays `audio.oink()` on the press and every `oinkEvery` = 0.75 s while H is
  held, in missions too (the car's sound, as the horn is). In free roam a press also shows
  `oinkBubble` "NÖFF! NÖFF!" [N] over its bed (a plain bubble anchor 0.28 × its length behind its
  middle, 2.1 m up) at most every `bubbleEvery` = 1.5 s, while a pig is in the bed (an emptied bed
  after a delivery, feature 15, §10.15, still grunts). Berra and Robban answer with their lift's
  lines, and a grunt gets no tease reply.
- **The rollerskier** (feature 7, §10.12) answers the horn himself: `free` leaves him out
  (`eslov.owns`), and `press` hands the car to `eslov.horn(car)` after the cast's answers. When he
  takes it (within 22 m, seeing the car) Stig cheers "Heja Eslöv!" instead of saying sorry
  (`honk.last.eslov`).
- A dancer or the porter held by the pool fest (feature 8, §10.13: `fest.posed`) does not answer, nor
  Majsan on her ticket round or Angerud in the tow scene (feature 20, §10.17: `lapp.owns`), nor the
  grisfest evening's cast (feature 21, §10.18: `party.posed`), nor the gang in the crowd at the SunTrip
  stage (feature 44, §10.30: `mic.posed`).
- `honk.last` ({ t, pigs, peds, replies: [[key, text]], stig: [text], eslov? }) is for tests. The
  rest is session state; nothing is saved. Scenario `tuta` (§16.4).

### 10.10 Dygnet runt – the island's clock, its evenings and the nap in room 107 (free roam; feature 30, 2026-10-15)

`game/dayClock.js` (`DayClock`, owned by Game as `day`), config `DAY` in content/island.js. Between
missions time goes by on the island: the sky glides through the existing palettes (§13.3; no new
ones), the town lights up in the evening, Ole's watch shows the time once found, and Stig can nap
on his bed in room 107 until Ole wakes him with his calculator's alarm. The clock, the nap and the
alarm waking him are [N] (§1.6); the words are the film's (Affe's "kvarta", Ole's gadgets) and ours.

- **The clock.** `day.h`, Spanish time in hours (0 ≤ h < 24), starts at `start` = 15 (Lasse in the
  bus: "Klockan är tre spansk tid"). It moves only while `live`: on the island, `missions.state ===
  'idle'`, no dialogue, and not during its own nap or morning cut; nor while `day.hold` is set (the
  grisfest's evening holds its hour, feature 21, §10.18). By day (06–21) a game hour takes
  `hourSecs` = 60 s, at night (`night` 21–06) `nightHourSecs` = 30 s, so a whole day takes 19.5 min;
  the step is `dt × timeScale`. `day.run` (true unless test mode) lets it move by itself: **in test
  mode it holds at 15:00**, so `story`, `fullstory` and `calibrate` play in the day palette exactly
  as before (`day.set(h)` still sets it). Not saved (§10.5): every session's island starts at three.
- **The sky.** `sky` key frames `[[6, night], [7, day], [19, day], [19.75, sunset], [20.5, night]]`,
  smoothstep-eased between neighbours: dawn 06–07, the sunset 19–19:45, dusk 19:45–20:30, night
  till six. Blended as the cabin's (`cabin.stepPalette`): `top`, `horizon`, `sun`, `hemiSky`,
  `hemiGround`, `cloudRim` in linear light, `fogNear`, `fogFar`, `sunI`, `hemiI` straight, and
  `sunDir` with the blend towards the sunset (the long evening shadows) but with its cube towards
  night (it swings late, at a weak sun, so the shadows do not wheel round over the town at dusk;
  night→day keeps one direction). The clock writes (`setSkyPalette`, `setNightLights`, `game.sky` =
  the nearer palette) only when the state changes: the blend in 1/200 steps plus the lights
  (`day.key`). Measured, top r + g + b in linear light (day 1.007, sunset 0.472, night 0.063): 19:24
  0.71, 19:45 0.472, 20:10 0.232 (fog near 153, sun 1.44: the sketch's dusk, a little past halfway
  from sunset to night), 21:00 night, 06:15 0.212, 06:45 0.859; at 60 × speed the blend runs at
  60 fps.
- **The lights.** `lit` = [20, 6.5]: from 20:00 to 06:30 the clock forces the night lights
  (`gfx.skyDark`: the hotels' windows, `nightGlow`'s lamps and globes) and the lighthouse
  (`gfx.beaconLit`) on, and off by day, so the town lights up at one time (by the sky's own
  thresholds the windows would come on at about 19:20 and the lighthouse at about 20:05). `Game.setSky` hands both
  back to the sky (§13.3), so the missions' palettes and the end card light as before. The idea said
  nine; by then the sky has been night for half an hour, and the sketch shows them lit at 20:10.
- **Missions are not touched.** The clock stands still in every mission state but idle (intro,
  running, outro, failed). `runner.begin`, after `state = 'intro'`: outside `dayHours` = [7, 19)
  (any palette but day) it awaits `day.toMorning()`: `inDialog`, a black fade (`fadeSecs` 0.7), the
  banner `NÄSTA MORGON` / `Klockan nio, spansk tid` [N], the watch (if found) spinning on to
  `morning` = 09:00 over `spinSecs` 1.4 s, the day palette, `holdSecs` 1.2 s, the fade back; then
  the talk goes on as by day. So every mission starts in the day palette, where its timer was
  measured; grisfest's and julafton's own skies (their `startCue`s) and the end card are unchanged.
  When a mission hands the sky back, `day.resync()` brings the clock's palette back at the next
  free-roam frame: `restoreAmbience` (fail, abort) and `complete` once the state is idle (before an
  end card, which holds `inDialog`). Grisfest's `onEnd('complete')` (MORGONEN EFTER) sets 08:00.
- **Ole's watch.** With pryl `klocka` found (§10.1), on the island: `#klocka` under the pesetas
  (§11.4) with the watch icon, the Spanish time and `SPANSK TID` [F*] over `{no} norsk · {sv} svensk`
  [F*], an hour on (the same time twice, as on Ole's watch: "Spansk, norsk, svensk tid"). It goes
  with the coins under the letterbox, except while it is drawn `over` the black fade (the nap and
  the morning cut), where it spins on.
- **The nap.** An interactable (`kvarta`, §14.3) at landmark `stigSang` (Stig's turquoise bed in
  room 107, §6.3), radius `nap.r` = 2.0 m (the bed's foot and side, not Ole's bed 3.5 m off), prompt
  `E Kvarta en stund` [F*] (Affe's "Jag måste få kvarta nån gång."), enabled by `canNap`: `live`, no
  pursuit, nothing carried, on foot, standing on the ground. E (`inDialog`, letterbox):
  1. A black fade (0.7 s). In the dark: the banner `ZZZ…` [N]; Stig teleported onto the mattress
     (0.70) and laid on his back (`tumble` past its roll); Ole, if free (shown, standing, not in a
     car or seat, not held by an idle pose, the Berra job or the judges), `placeNpc`d at the bed's
     head facing it (`oleAt`: 1.0 m left, 0.2 m back, world yaw −π/2); the camera cut to the room's
     front-left corner (`cam` −0.4, 3.75, 2.45 m up, looking at `look` 0.45, 0.15, 1.2 m: Ole does
     not hide Stig); the watch spins on to the next `wake` hour at least `minGap` = 0.5 h on (08
     `morgonen`, 15 `eftermiddagen`, 20 `kvällen`, 23 `natten`); the palette for that hour, and while
     the lights are on the `lamp` (hemisphere `0xffe2b8` / `0x9a7050`, 1.7) for the scene, as if Ole
     had switched on the ceiling lamp (the glowing pane over the room; at night the room was too dark
     to read).
  2. The fade back. Stig "Zzz…" [N]; `pipAt` 0.7 s later `audio.pip()` and Ole's `calc` (the
     calculator up in his near, left hand, §14.6) with "PIP-PIP-PIP! Kalkulator – med vekkerklokke!"
     [F*] (his gadget line; the alarm call ours); `sleepOn` 2.2 s later "Zzz…" again (he sleeps on);
     `wakeAt` 1.4 s later the second PIP and Stig on his feet at the bed's foot (`stigAt`, facing
     the bed), the toast `Stig kvartade till {part}.` [N], and at 23:00 his "Vad härligt det är med
     de här varma nätterna…" [F*](t); `after` 1.6 s later the camera back behind him, the clock's
     palette (the lamp off) and play.
  3. Ole is let go (`busy` false, `spot` null): `placeNpcs` leaves him by the bed until Stig is
     50 m off (it never pops anyone in front of him) and then sends him home. When the waiting
     mission needs him at its place (its giver or an extra: asnan, grisfest, julafton; buss17's and
     friskotek's extras), the end goes through black and he is there when it lifts. The giver's "!"
     is hidden during the nap. Ole never wakes him with julafton's "Morn, gutten min!".
- **Chatter with a time of day** (`DAY.chatter`, filtered in `syncAll` by `day.lineOk` while the
  clock runs): Gabbe's "Natturen går klockan nio!" 17–21, Lasse's "Friskoteket börjar halv tio varje
  morgon." 06–10 and "Klockan är tre spansk tid." 14–16 (that one so he does not say it at midnight).
- **Others that move it**, through `day.spin`, `day.set` and `day.write` behind their own fades: the
  grisfest's evening and its morning (feature 21, §10.18), and Uppför fyren (feature 52, §10.35): a
  climb by day to 19:45, the long blink on the gallery to 22:00.
- **Not done** (it would make this L): own palettes for the forenoon or the siesta, lights fading
  in (they share `MAT.mouth` and switch at once), night routines for people or cars; traffic and
  pedestrians are the same at night. No day cards (§15.5).
- `day.last` (`{ kind: 'nap' | 'morning', from, to, part?, ole?, pips? }`) is for tests. Scenarios
  `dygn` and `dygnGiver` (§16.4).

### 10.11 Lite film. – herr Storchs semesterfilm (free roam; feature 6, 2026-10-15)

`game/storchFilm.js` (`StorchFilm`, owned by Game as `film`), config `STORCH_FILM` in
content/island.js. The witness gag (§7.2) gets a cameraman: Herr Storch notices Stig's tricks, trots
over the sand and films them with the lens cap on, and E by him shows his viewfinder: black. Only the
player knows why. After the end the cap is off: the viewfinder shows the island in pale small-gauge
colours, his filming keeps stills, and his film night shows the black week and then the player's
own julafton stunts. The lens cap and the lost week are the film's julfest (Ole: "Har du filmet sånn
lenge?", Storch: "Hela veckan.", "Blir'e inge film?", §8.13, notes/research-plot.md:370); his
reactions, the viewfinder, the stills and the film night are [N] (§1.6).

- **When.** Only while `active`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. In any other state
  `update` resets at once: a view closes, and a Herr Storch who is out is teleported back to his
  place and let go (then `startStage`'s `placeNpcs(true)` places everyone as before). So he never
  moves in a mission, the 20 m witness zone, which follows him, is at his home in every mission,
  julafton's round-up finds him at `playa` (its `findAt` places him there anyway), and no timer or
  calibration pool sees a new actor.
- **Tricks** (`film.trick(kind)`; refused in a dialogue or a view, while he is not `free`, while he
  is on another trick (he may be walking home), within `every` = 30 s of the last one taken, or more
  than `r` = 25 m from Stig, the focus, his car included):
  - `volt`: the double jump (`handleOneShots`, the second press);
  - `studs`: a bounce (`onBounce`, any trampoline);
  - `stamp`: a stomp's landing, and `fall`: a landing `drop` = 3 m or more under the top of his air
    time (off the lifeguard tower; not on a trampoline, which is `studs`), both from `onLand`
    (`film.onLand(y, stomping)`, before `stomping` is cleared; `film.watchAir` keeps the top);
  - `glid`: the glide starting (`game.glide.on`, §10.7);
  - `bus`: an offence the witness rule sees (§7.2: within 20 m; a kicked sunbed, a hit tourist, a
    car knock).
  `free`: standing, shown, not in a car or a seat, not held by a mission's `idleAnim`, the Berra job
  or the diving judges, and not `busy` on anyone else's errand.
- **The run.** A taken trick claims him (`busy`, `spot = 'storchFilm'`, `npc.steer`; `from` is his
  home spot when he stands within 6 m of it, else where he stands) and goes through:
  1. `notice` (`notice` = 0.35 s): he turns to Stig.
  2. Within `near` = 7 m, as the waiting mission's giver or extra (`pinned`: friskotek's extras),
     or when he is not on the sand: he films from where he stands. Otherwise `trot`: at `trot` =
     3.4 m/s to `filmDist` = 5 m from Stig on the line between them, re-aimed every frame and
     clamped to the `sand` rectangle (x −29.5…29.5, z −34.5…19.5 around `playa`, world x
     −29.5…29.5, z 215.5…269.5: the beach of block (3,6), not the paseo or the roads; the rectangle
     is convex, so a straight run from sand to sand stays on it). It ends
     at the goal (0.4 m), within 5.3 m of Stig, after `giveUp` = 7 s, or stuck (under 0.5 m/s for
     `stuckSecs` = 0.6 s after the first 0.4 s: a sunbed in the way).
  3. `film` (`filmSecs` = 2.6 s): `anim.film` (the camera at the eye, §14.6), `say` "Lite film."
     [F*](t) (2.4 s), `audio.whirr()`, turned to Stig all the while.
  4. `home` at `walk` = 1.5 m/s to `from`, then `settle` (0.6 s, turning to the way he faced) and he
     is let go: `busy` false, `spot` his home id again (so `placeNpcs` leaves him), or none when he
     is not on it (stuck 2 s on the way: `placeNpcs` takes him home once Stig is 50 m off). Knocked
     over, he drops the filming and walks home once up. A trick while he walks home starts again
     from 1.
  While he is out (`film.posed(key)`) `syncAll` gives him no turn to the player, wave or chatter, and
  the horn's answerers skip him (`honk.free`).
- **The viewfinder** (an interactable `storchFilm`, §14.3, at Herr Storch, `look.r` = 2 m; prompt
  `<b>E</b> Titta i kameran` [N]; enabled by `canLook`: `active`, no dialogue or view, he is `free`
  and not noticing or trotting (filming or walking home is fine), no pursuit, nothing carried, Stig on
  foot, standing, on the ground). E: `inDialog`, letterbox, Stig still; Herr Storch claimed for it if
  he was not out, held where he stands, the camera up. The cut camera stands at his eye (`look.eye`
  = 1.6 m over his feet, `look.ahead` = 0.45 m in front) looking 12 m along the chase camera's
  heading (where the player was looking), 0.5 m down; both men are hidden for it (behind the lens).
  `hud.viewfinder` (§11.4) over everything: `I KAMERAN` [N], the gate, sprocket holes either side,
  dust, the counter `DAG {n}` [N] (n = missions.index − `dayFrom` 5, clamped 1–7: DAG 1 at buss17
  and friskotek, DAG 7 before julafton) and his line in Nunito under it. **Before the end** the gate
  is black (the lens cap), and his line is one of `capLines`: "Strålande ljus i dag." or "Det här
  blir en fin semesterfilm." [N], never "Blir'e inge film?" (he does not know yet). **After the
  end** (unlock `after` = `bodega`) the gate is clear, `body.film-live` filters the canvas (sepia
  0.42, saturate 0.8, contrast 1.06, brightness 1.04: pale small-gauge colours, a style choice,
  since 1979 home film was colour), a faint flicker, the counter `JULAFTON` [N] and "Nu blir'e film!"
  [N]. It holds `look.secs` = 4.5 s, or E or Space after `minSecs` = 0.6 s (not in test mode); then
  the camera comes back, `inDialog` is cleared and he is let go if the view claimed him.
- **Stills** (after the end only). While he films, `grabNow` asks `main.loop` for a take right after
  the frame's render (`preserveDrawingBuffer` is false): `film.grab()` renders the scene once more
  from his eye at Stig (a separate camera, fov `stills.fov` 48, aimed 1.0 m over Stig's feet or
  0.9 m over the car's; Herr Storch hidden for it), copies the canvas's middle 16:9 into a 320×180
  canvas, keeps it as `toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.75)`, and renders the player's frame again, so the
  screen never shows his. The first take is `first` = 0.2 s into the filming; another when Stig is
  `higher` = 0.5 m higher than in the last kept one (up to `grabs` = 3): the highest is kept. When the
  filming ends it joins `film.stills` (the newest `max` = 8; §10.5 saves them under their own key).
- **The offer and the film night.** `offering` = after the end with more stills than `seen` (0 at
  the start of a session, so a saved album is offered once a session). Then, standing free and
  idle at home with Stig within `offerR` = 7 m, he says "Vill du se min film?" [N] (every
  `offerEvery` = 25 s), and E at him is `<b>E</b> Se filmen` [N]: `hud.filmNight` over everything,
  with the letterbox and `inDialog` as for the viewfinder. `FILMKVÄLL` [N] (Luckiest Guy) over
  "Herr Storchs semesterfilm · dag 1–7 och julafton" [N] (Nunito: the O in STORCHS came out small in
  Luckiest Guy), a film strip of seven black frames `DAG 1`…`DAG 7` with dust (they stay black: the
  film's point is the lost week); at `steps` 1.7 s his "Blir'e inge film?" [F*] (his julfest line,
  said again over his black week; this is the only place he says it outside julafton); at 3.0 s a
  second strip with the newest `night.max` = 4 stills tagged `JULAFTON`, in the same pale filter; at
  4.6 s "Lite film." [F*](t). `night.secs` = 10 s, or E or Space after 1 s. `seen` then counts every
  still, and E is the viewfinder again until he keeps a new one.
- **Sound.** `audio.whirr(secs)`: the camera's clockwork (§12.3), when he films, on a viewfinder and
  for the film night.
- `film.last` ({ kind, t, d0, ran, filmed, still, at, grabs }) and `film.lastView` ({ kind, live,
  label, line } | { kind: 'night', stills, steps }) are for tests. Scenarios `super8` and `filmkvall`
  (§16.4).
- **Not done:** Fru Storch does not react; he does not film car stunts other than offences (a car
  landing is no trick); the stills are of the player only; the black week has no stills from the
  flight. The witness multiplier and the day cards of §15.5 stay P2 (the counter `DAG n` is only in
  his camera).
