### 10.12 Heja Eslöv! – the rollerskier trains for real (free roam; feature 7, 2026-10-15)

`game/eslov.js` (`Eslov`, owned by Game as `eslov`), config `ESLOV` in content/island.js. The
rollerskier at the ESLÖV 3 900 KM sign stops being a statue: in free roam he skis up and down the
Eslöv lane, the horn and E bring Stig's "Heja Eslöv!" and his wave of the pole, and he offers
Eslövloppet, a run once round the tomato fields against him. "Heja Eslöv!" is Berra's in the film
(notes/research-plot.md:318, research-characters.md:364), given to Stig [F*]; the ESLÖV on his
chest is the film's; the training, his answers, "Spår!" and the race are [N] (§1.6). The bodega
drive's radio exchange (§8.9 stage 4, `overhear` at `eslovVag`) is untouched: it is tied to the
landmark, and in a mission he stands there as before.

- **When.** Only while `active`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. In any other state
  `update` resets at once: a race ends without a result, his lines not yet said are dropped, and he is
  teleported to his place (`eslovVag`, facing the road) and let go (`busy` false, `spot` his home id
  again; `startStage`'s `placeNpcs(true)` then places everyone as before). So he never moves in a
  mission, and no timer or calibration pool sees a new actor. The `ski` look (skis, poles, §14.6) is
  on whenever the level is the island, missions included (a look only).
- **Whose he is.** In free roam he is claimed as soon as he stands free (`busy`, `spot = 'eslov'`,
  `npc.steer`); a placement by anyone else (a forced `placeNpcs`) lets him go, and the next frame takes
  him again from where he is. While he skis, counts down, races or finishes his lap (`eslov.posed`)
  `syncAll` gives him no turn to the player, wave or chatter; standing (a rest, the greeting, the
  offer, after the race) he turns to Stig within 10 m and chatters within 9 m as anyone
  (CHATTER.eslov: "Man får passa på när det är barmark.", "Hemma i Eslöv är det slask nu." [N]).
- **Training.** A loop on the Eslöv lane (block (0,1), local x 24.5…30.5, z −30…30; world x
  −215.5…−209.5, z −190…−130) from `eslovVag` (world (−212.5, −136)) `lane.to` = 50 m north and back:
  north `lane.side` = 1 m east of the lane's middle, a half circle of that radius at the north end,
  south 1 m west of it (he keeps right), a half circle at the south end; about 107 m. `speed` =
  3.2 m/s on the legs, `turnSpeed` = 1 m/s in the half circles, braking for them and speeding up at
  `accel` = 1.2 m/s² (`vWant`); his place on the loop (`s`) moves on only while he is within 2.5 m of
  his line (knocked off it, he skis back first). Every `restEvery` = 2nd lap, and at night
  (`day.dark`), he brakes to a stop at the south leg's end and stands `restSecs` = 5 s facing the road
  (at night until it is day; with Stig within 10 m `syncAll` turns him to Stig instead). Each free
  roam starts with a rest at his place. After Pepes Bodega (feature 71, §10.39) Stig on foot within
  4.5 m of his place makes a stop there due, brakes him on the north leg and turns him back
  (`comeBack`), and keeps the rest going while Stig stays: there E is the loan of his skis. Lent, he
  is in the mode `lent`: no skis, standing at the lane's west edge (`walkTo`), not posed; with them
  back he walks to his rest and skis on.
- **"Spår!"** Stig on foot in his track (`inTrack`: a point of the track −1.5…`spar.ahead` = 7 m
  ahead along the loop, so the half circles count as he will ski them, level with Stig and within
  `spar.pass` = 1.5 m of his swerved line): he swerves to pass Stig 1.5 m off (2.4 m/s sideways,
  clamped to the lane). With Stig 1.5 m or more ahead and within `spar.lat` = 1.1 m of the track, at
  most every `spar.every` = 15 s and never over another line of his, he calls "Spår!" [N] (the
  skiers' old call on the track), and `spar.sorryAt` = 0.7 s later Stig says "Oj, förlåt!" [N] and,
  still on the ground within 1.5 m of the track, hops aside (a 5.5 m/s jump and `spar.hop` = 3.2 m/s
  away from the skier's line; the player's keys still steer him).
- **Blocked.** A car in his track within `block` = 5 m of its near side: he brakes to a stop, and
  after `blockSecs` = 2.5 s stopped he turns back (the same spot on the other leg).
- **The horn** (`horn(car)`, from `honk.press` in free roam, §10.9): within `heja.r` = 22 m, if he
  sees the car (`honk.sees`), at most every `heja.every` = 8 s: Stig's "Heja Eslöv!" [F*] 0.3 s after
  the press and the skier's reply at 1.25 s, with a wave of his pole for `heja.waveSecs` = 1.8 s
  (`eslov.waving`: `syncAll` waves him even while he skis; the `ski` pose holds the left pole up). The
  first reply of a session is "Bara 390 mil kvar!" [N] (the sign's 3 900 km), later another than the
  last of it, "Tack! Det är bara att staka på!" and "Hälsa hem till Sverige!" [N]; after a won race
  (`records.eslov` set) the `won` list: "Där har vi löparen!" [N] first after each win (and as a
  session's first answer), then another than the last ("Bara 390 mil kvar!").
  He skis on. Stig is not sorry (honk skips its `sorry` for that press), and the island's class
  answers never come from him (`honk.free` leaves him out).
- **E on foot** (the interactable `eslov`, §14.3, at him, r `heja.r2` = 3 m; `canTalk`: `active`,
  he stands normal and is ours, skiing or resting 8 s or more after the last cheer, or offering; no
  dialogue, car, carry, pursuit, freeze or PANIK; Stig standing on the ground). Prompt
  `<b>E</b> Heja Eslöv!` [F*]: Stig's line at once and the reply 0.95 s later (as for the horn); he
  brakes to a stop on his line (5 m/s², a metre from 3.2 m/s; a standing skier stays where he
  stands) and turns to Stig;
  `race.offerAt` = 1.2 s after the reply (not at night) "Ska vi ta ett varv runt fälten? Start och
  mål vid skylten." [N], and for `race.offerSecs` = 9 s (or until Stig is 9 m off or in a car) the
  prompt is `<b>E</b> Eslövloppet – ett varv runt fälten` [N]; then he skis on.
- **Eslövloppet** (`startRace`, E on the offer). Stig's "Ett varv? Det klarar jag." [N]; 0.9 s later a
  black cut (`hud.fade`, `fadeSecs` = 0.6 s) puts Stig 1.2 m west and the skier 1 m east of the lane's
  middle on the start line (`stig`, `skier`: dz −7 from `eslovVag`, a metre south of the line at the
  sign), both facing north, the camera behind Stig; `game.frozenT` holds Stig through the countdown
  (`count` = 3.5 s: banners `3`, `2`, `1`, `KÖR!` with `audio.tick` / `audio.checkpoint`, as the
  mission race). Then the clock runs (`game.time`, unscaled, as the stage timers) and the objective
  card shows `ESLÖVLOPPET` [N], "Spring ett varv runt tomatfälten – före rullskidåkaren!" [N] (with
  `Rekord {t}` [N] once there is one), the time left and the race bar (`1:A` / `2:A · KONTROLL i/5`,
  green / orange; first = more checkpoints than the skier's schedule has passed, or as many and
  nearer the next). The guide arrow, the Beacon and the minimap star show the next checkpoint
  (`target`), the minimap the skier (`enemy`) and the checkpoint after it (`item`).
  - **The course** (offsets [dx, dz] in world axes from `eslovVag`): north up the lane, west on the
    z −200 road, south on the island's west edge road (x −280), east on the z −120 road and north up
    the lane to the line. Stig must take the four checkpoints in order (`cps`, radius 6 each: (−212.5,
    −195), the lane's north end at the road; (−275.5, −195) and (−275.5, −125), the inner corners of
    the west road's crossings; (−212.5, −125), the lane's south end), then cross the line at z −144
    (`line`: within 3.6 m of the lane's middle) going north. The cane windbreaks on the field's north
    and west edges (2.4 m walls) and the order keep the run on the roads; the shortest run through
    the checkpoints is about 244 m.
  - **The skier** skis `path` (the roads' inner edges 0.6 m in from the asphalt's edge, clear of the
    traffic lanes, then up the lane 1 m east of its middle; 268.6 m) at `len / timer` = 6.89 m/s (a
    strong double-poler's 25 km/h) on a schedule (`s` = elapsed × v), steered back onto it, and
    `invulnerable` for the race (a car pushes him aside instead of flinging him). More than 4 m off
    his schedule (held up), he follows the course to catch up (`projS`: the nearest point of it, 3 m
    on), never across the field. He crosses the line exactly when the clock runs out: beating him is
    beating the clock.
  - **Win** (Stig over the line first): `DU VANN!` with `Eslövloppet på {t}` or `Eslövloppet på {t}
    – nytt rekord!` [N] (`raceClock`: m:ss,d), `audio.jingle('complete')`, `prize` = 100 pta and the
    toast `Rullskidåkaren gav dig {n} pta.` [N]; a new best is saved at once (`game.records.eslov`,
    §10.5). **Loss** (the clock at 0): `RULLSKIDÅKAREN VANN` / `Eslövloppet – försök igen` [N],
    `audio.jingle('fail')`, no pesetas. **Abort**: Stig in a car, or more than 3 m of his position in
    one frame (R, any teleport): the toast `Eslövloppet avbrutet – det springs till fots.` [N].
  - Then the skier finishes his lap on the course from where he is, at the race's pace (`back`:
    across the field the canes would stop him), stops at the line and, with Stig within 25 m, has
    his say: on a win "Där fick jag! Här, en slant till en läsk." [N] and Stig's "Tack! Det var nog
    bara tur." [N] 1.8 s later; on a loss "Det är träningen som gör det!" [N]. He faces Stig
    `afterSecs` = 3.5 s and skis on. Still on the first leg up the lane when it ends (an early
    abort), he stops there and trains on. Held up 1.5 s at a standstill on the last metres (a car
    on the line), he has arrived where he stands. A new race needs a new cheer.
  - Skiing more than 8 m off his lane's loop (held up somewhere) with Stig more than 50 m from him
    and from his place, he is put back at his place (`eslovVag`) and rests, as `placeNpcs` would.
  - **The timer is measured** (§8 "Timers and difficulty", on foot): scenario `eslovlopp` runs
    calibrate's walker (`walker-r1r2`, sprinting, `&ts=1`) from the start line through the
    checkpoints to 1.2 m past the line, heading for each checkpoint's middle and switching as soon as
    the race takes it (as a player follows the arrow), with the clock raised. A deterministic course,
    so T_ref = the median + 0.5 s × 5 targets (the four checkpoints and the line): median 28.18 s of
    27 clean runs (28.18–28.20; pool `eslovLopp` in `notes/calibration-samples.md`, `node
    tools/pool.mjs eslovLopp`), T_ref 30.68, timer = ceil(1.25 × 30.68) = **39**. The walker's clean
    lap keeps 28 % of the clock, a run at T_ref 21 % (the 0.5 s per target and × 1.25, as on every
    on-foot stage).
- **The loan** (feature 71, §10.39): from index 9, E at him resting at his place is
  `skidor:lan` (priority 1 over `eslov`), so "E Heja Eslöv!" and the race offer are for him skiing.
- `eslov.last` ({ kind: 'heja', by: 'horn' | 'foot', t, reply } | { kind: 'spar', t, hop } |
  { kind: 'race', result: 'win' | 'lose' | 'abort', t, T, cps, at, record? }) is for tests;
  `eslov.timer` overrides the next race's clock in a test. The rest is session state; only the best
  time is saved. Scenarios `eslov` and `eslovlopp` (§16.4).
- **Not done** (deviations from the idea): the pedestrians do not dodge him in the race (`carThreat`
  counts cars at 7 m/s or more; his race pace is under that, and the outskirts' roads have hardly any
  pedestrians); the grunting grisbil horn is feature 5's (§10.9); Stig's hop aside is a hop and a
  push, not a forced step (the skier passes him either way).

### 10.13 Små grodorna i poolen – the pool fest after the end (free roam; feature 8, 2026-10-15)

`game/poolFest.js` (`PoolFest`, owned by Game as `fest`), config `POOL_FEST` in content/island.js. The
Christmas party is not quite over: whenever Stig comes onto Flamenco's pool deck after the end, the
SunTrip lot wade into the shallow end, stand in a ring round Lasse in his Santa outfit and dance Små
grodorna, a couple of rounds and a pause, again and again; at a gap in the ring Stig can step in and
hop with them, stiff in his suit. The film's julfest has the others dancing Christmas dances in the
pool ("Små grodorna"), with the Spaniards' "De där svenskarna är heltokiga!", while Stig-Helmer and
Ole open the crispbread (notes/research-plot.md:373; research-characters.md:50); Stig-Helmer dancing,
the ring round Lasse, the porter's walk, the counter and the coin are [N] (§1.6). The melody is
traditional and only the melody plays (§1.5): no verses, no lyrics in a bubble.

- **When.** Only while `active`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, `missions.index >=
  fromIndex` = 13 (after julafton) and julafton's unlock `after` = `bodega`. Out of it `update`
  resets at once: everyone ours is `placeNpc`d at home (HOMES or `homeOverrides`), `busy` false,
  their dance and wade off, Stig out of the ring, the counter hidden. So no mission, stage kind,
  timer, fixture or calibration pool sees it (there are no missions after the end; the reset covers a
  debug `?mission`). A visit begins only between `hours` = [9, 23) on the free-roam clock
  (`day.h`, §10.10; held at 15 in test mode), with no dialogue and no nap or morning cut
  (`day.busy`), and with at least `minDancers` = 3 of them free; past 23 the visit ends.
- **Homes after the end** (`UNLOCKS.bodega`, §2.3, §10.3): Lasse, Affe, Gabbe and Fru Storch live on
  the south pool deck by the plastic tree, and Lasse wears `jul` (red T-shirt, shorts, tomte hat).
  Ole stays under the pergola, the sisters on the deck, Herr Storch on the beach (his camera, §10.11).
- **The visit.** It begins when the focus (Stig on foot or his car) is on the `deck` (world-axis
  offsets [x −22…23], [z −13…22] from the ring's middle `flamencoRing` (2, 8): Flamenco's pool deck,
  not the hotel) and ends when it leaves the deck by more than `margin` = 8 m. At the start the fest
  claims every one of `leader` (`lasse`) and `ring` (`majsan siv affe gabbe fruStorch ole`) who is
  free (standing, shown, not in a car or a seat, not `busy` unless ours, not held by a mission's
  idle pose, the Berra job, the diving judges or Herr Storch's camera) and within `claimR` = 40 m of
  the ring's middle (each frame of the visit it claims again whoever is free: back from the judges
  or the nap). Ours: `busy`, `spot = 'poolFest'` (the old spot id kept for the way back),
  `invulnerable` (a car in the pool pushes them aside, `fling` refuses), `npc.steer` to their place
  at `walk` = 1.7 m/s easing in, and `fest.posed` (`syncAll`: no wave, 10 m turn or chatter; `honk.free`
  leaves them out). A placement by anyone else (the judges' call, the nap, a forced `placeNpcs`) lets
  one go where they stand (only our own `steer` is removed).
- **The ring.** Lasse in the middle; the ring's places on a circle of `r` = 2.9 m, seven of them
  (the six and Stig's gap), from the gap at world yaw `gapYaw` = −0.35 (south-south-west, so the
  chase camera behind Stig in it clears the plastic tree) clockwise seen from above: Majsan, Siv,
  Affe, Gabbe, Fru Storch, Ole (Majsan and Ole on either side of the gap). The places span x
  −0.75…4.9, z 5.1…10.7 in the shallow end (x −7…6, z 1.5…12.5): 1.4 m and more from the circling
  fin's path (r 1.2 round (−3, 7)) and 1.2 m from the red ring toy. In place (within 0.35 m, still)
  they face the middle (5/s). Standing on a `water` floor they wade: `Character.wade` eases to
  `wade` = 0.5 m at 1.4 m/s (the model sunk below the feet, §14.6: the water plane hides the legs),
  and a ring of foam (a shared white `RingGeometry` 0.4–0.55 m at the water + 0.075 m, over the
  lane line and glints) lies round each wader, swelling 1.9× on a landing.
- **The set.** `form` until everyone ours is in place (at least `minDancers`) or `formSecs` = 12 s,
  `wait` `startSecs` = 1.5 s, then `rounds` = 2 rounds of `tune` = `smaGrodorna` (32 beats at 132
  bpm, 14.55 s), the second `gapBeats` = 2 beats after the first ends, then `pause` `pauseSecs` =
  12 s, and again while the visit lasts. A round starts with `audio.trad(tune, { vol, duck })`: `vol`
  falls from 1 within `vol.near` = 12 m of the ring to `vol.min` = 0.15 at `vol.far` = 50 m (set once
  per round), `duck` = 1 − 0.7 × vol (the island tune dips less under a faint round).
- **The clock.** A round's beat 0 is `audio.tradAt` (the audio clock of the cue's first beat), its
  time `audio.clock() − tradAt`, so the ring dances on what is heard. With the music off or muted
  (`trad` returns 0) the round runs silent on the audio clock from now + 0.12 s; with no running
  audio context (`clock()` null, also mid-round: re-anchored) on `game.time`.
- **The dance.** Every other beat from beat 0 (the oom-pah's bass beats: 16 hops a round) the ring
  hops for `hop.air` = 0.42 of the two beats (0.38 s, as Stig's real hop), a parabola `hop.h` =
  0.3 m high, `hop.chorus` = 0.42 m from beat `hop.chorusFrom` = 16 ("kou ack ack ack"): `anim.hop`
  lifts the body, a look only. The arms (`anim.groda`, §14.6): 2 "svansar" (hands behind) on beats
  0–7 and 12–15, 1 "öron" (straight arms up by the head) on 8–11 and the chorus. The `musicians`
  (`affe`, `gabbe`) hop without `groda`: they play their accordion and congas. Lasse turns once round
  in a round (from the gap, 12/s), and between rounds faces Stig within 20 m, else the gap. A
  landing swells the dancer's foam and throws four small drops from the waist (with Stig within
  60 m of the ring).
- **The exchange.** The first visit of a session, once the ring has formed and Stig stands on foot
  within `askR` = 14 m of the gap, not in the ring, with Majsan in her place: Stig "Måste man gå på
  den?" [F*] (julafton morning, about the party, research-plot.md:365), 2.4 s later Majsan "Var inte
  så typiskt svensk." [F*] (research-characters.md:224), 5.0 s Stig "Det är väl typiskt svenskt att
  ha julfest bland palmerna." [F*](t) (the same exchange; speaker interpreted). Stepping into the
  ring first skips it.
- **The porter.** At the first round of each visit (at most every 60 s) the porter, if free and within
  `claimR`, is borrowed the same way and walks at `porter.walk` = 1.4 m/s from his desk to
  `porter.at` = (+1.4, −9.6) from the ring's middle (world (3.4, −1.6), the north deck between the
  pergola and the pool), faces the ring, says "De där svenskarna är heltokiga!" [F*](t) 0.4 s after
  arriving, shakes his head (`anim.look` = 0.42 sin 11t) for `shakeSecs` = 2.2 s, stays `stay` = 6 s,
  walks back and is free with his spot id back.
- **Stig in the ring.** Once the ring has formed, an interactable (`poolFest`, r `join.r` = 2.6 m)
  at the gap (marked on the water by two pulsing sun-yellow rings, 0.5–0.64 and 0.2–0.27 m) offers
  "E Dansa med" [N] to Stig on foot, on the ground and free (no car, carry, bust freeze, PANIK or
  dialogue). E teleports him into the gap facing the middle (the chase camera behind him, turned
  `join.camTurn` = 0.4 rad so his head does not hide Lasse), `fest.joined`; he wades 0.5 m and stands
  stiff as a stick (`groda` 3). In the ring (main.js): movement wishes are zero, Space is
  `fest.hop()` (a real jump at `join.hopV` = 4.6 m/s, 0.44 m up and 0.38 s in the air; no double
  jump), J does nothing, E is "E Kliv ur ringen" [N] (back up onto the coping `join.out` = 2.4 m
  behind the gap, dry at once), and a move key (input over 0.5) also takes him out (he walks; the
  wade eases out). His first hop after stepping in: "Hopp… och hopp…" [N] (at most every 25 s).
- **The beat.** A hop during a round is judged against the nearest hop beat k (0, 2 … 30): within
  `window` = 0.18 s and not yet hit, it is in time (`streak` + 1); in the gap between two rounds the
  next round's beat 0 counts (`nextAt`), early. Otherwise it is off the beat: the row is gone, the
  two nearest in the ring (not Lasse) laugh for `laughSecs` = 1.3 s and `audio.laugh()` (at most every
  `laughEvery` = 4 s). A hop beat whose window closes without his hop breaks a row of one or more
  (`stats.breaks`, no laugh). The pause ends a row. Hops outside the rounds are only hops.
- **Eight.** `goal` = 8 in a row: the counter shows 8 / 8, the ring cheers (`anim.cheer`, the hop
  off) for `cheerSecs` = 2.2 s, `audio.applause(2)`, Ole's "Heia Norge!" [F*] (his grisfest solo
  dance's "Heja Norge!", research-plot.md:348) 0.3 s later if he is in place, and once a visit, with
  Lasse in place, `pay` = 50 pta, the toast "Lasse gav dig 50 pta." [N] and 1.5 s later Lasse's
  "Bravo, Stig-Helmer! En slant från SunTrip." [N]. The row starts again from 0.
- **The counter** (`hud.setTakt`, §11.4) shows while he is in the ring: "I TAKT {n} / 8" [N], "OTAKT!"
  [N] in red for 0.9 s on a miss, teal for 0.9 s on the eighth.
- **Lines** go through `game.say`, each at most every `again` = 20 s; queued ones wait through a
  dialogue and are dropped when 2 s late. Dancing never adds SKANDAL (the fest adds none, and in the
  ring J does nothing).
- **The judges** (feature 4, §10.8) may take Siv and Majsan out of the ring for a dive and give them
  back (see there). **The nap** (§10.10) may take Ole (the visit has ended by then: room 107 is not
  on the deck).
- **The visit ends:** everyone ours walks home (`homeOf`: HOMES or `homeOverrides`) and is let go
  there (within 0.3 m) with the old spot id; with Stig and the place both more than 60 m off, at
  once. Stig leaves the ring, the counter goes.
- `fest.last` ({ kind: 'begin' | 'end' | 'join' | 'leave' | 'goal', … } or a hop's { k, off, ok,
  round }) and `fest.stats` ({ hits, misses, breaks, goals, rounds }) are for tests. Nothing is saved.
  Scenarios `grodorna` and `grodtakt` (§16.4).
- **Not done** (deviations from the idea): Herr Storch does not film the fest from the north edge
  (his camera keeps him on the beach, §10.11), so the ring is six and Lasse, not eight; the ring
  stands still (no walking round in the verses); the porter's line is once a visit, at the first
  round; the fest is a day fest by the clock (not at night), and the sky is the clock's as anywhere.

### 10.14 Förlåt, förlåt! – Stig-Helmer says sorry (free roam; feature 11, 2026-10-15)

`game/stigSorry.js` (`StigSorry`, owned by Game as `sorry`), config `STIG_SORRY` in content/island.js
(§14.10). Stig-Helmer is too well brought up for Hit & Run: what he does in free roam he apologises
for, in his own bubble. The damage is done all the same: every SKANDAL amount (§7.2) and every bark of
the people he hurts (§14.10) is what it was. The apologies are [N]; the carjacking's question and
answer are the film's first exchange with the roles swapped, [F*] (§1.6).

- **When.** Only while `active()`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`, no dialogue. In a
  mission, a dialogue or the flight level (which has its own "Ursäkta!", §5.10) he says nothing, so
  no scripted line of his is covered or replaced (a speaker has one bubble, §11.4) and no mission,
  timer or calibration pool changes; nothing reads these bubbles (the mantra auto-bubble and the
  glide's only wait while one is up). Never while he is still saying something (`saying(player)`:
  the horn's sorry, a judge's call, a line of the free-roam modules): then nothing is queued, and a
  queued line is dropped if one of his came first.
- **The offences** (`offence(kind)`), each `at` = 0.5 s after it, so the victim's line comes first:
  - `kick`: a kick or a stomp (`areaHit`) that bowls a pedestrian over or hits a cast NPC. One line a
    kick however many it hits (`areaHit` sums the kick up and calls once).
  - `hit`: his car runs someone over (`onCharHit` with `car === playerCar`).
  - `prop`: he breaks a thing, on foot (`areaHit`, when it hit nobody) or with his own car
    (`Game.breakProp(p, vx, vz, car)` with `car === playerCar`; an AI car's breakage is not his).
  - `boom`: the thing he broke goes up (`def.explode`: a petrol pump or a butano bottle), on foot or
    in his car; it outranks the rest in the same kick.
  - `stand` (feature 28, §10.19): his car goes through one of the market's fruit stalls.
  The session's first offence always gets a line (so the first prank shows it); after that each
  kind's `chance` (kick 0.5, hit 0.6, prop 0.35, stand 1, boom 1), and none sooner than `gap` = 7 s
  after his last (he would never stop mowing through a crowd). A queued line not yet said gives way
  to a weightier one in the same moment (prop < stand < kick = hit < boom < carjack: the parasol and
  the man under it in one frame give the man's line).
- **The carjacking** (`carjack(ch)`, from `enterCar` when a driver tumbles out): no gap and no draw,
  only the `saying` rule. `askAt` = 0.6 s after it Stig asks "Ursäkta, är det din bil?" [F*] (in the
  film the traffic warden Majsan asks him at the travel agency's window, research-plot.md:95).
  When the driver is a Swedish tourist (`!def.local`), the session's first time and then at
  `noChance` = 35 %, the driver keeps quiet as he tumbles out (his `carjack` bark is left out) and
  answers `noGap` = 0.9 s after the question with Stig's own "Nej." [F*] from there, standing anchor
  (§11.4; the two bubbles are metres apart: the car and the asphalt). He is dropped if hidden,
  seated or over 40 m off by then. Otherwise his own complaint comes at once, as before.
- **Lines** (`game.say(player, text, secs = 2.2)`; the "Nej." 1.6): a kind's first line in a session
  is its first, later ones not the one it gave last.

  | kind | lines |
  |---|---|
  | `kick` | "Oj! Förlåt, förlåt! Det var inte meningen.", "Ursäkta! Har ni slagit er?", "Förlåt! Jag tappade balansen.", "Oj, oj… Förlåt! Jag ville inte…" [N] |
  | `hit` | "Förlåt! Jag såg er inte!", "Oj! Förlåt! Hur gick det?", "Förlåt! Bromsen satt inte där jag trodde." [N] |
  | `prop` | "Jag ersätter den, självklart!", "Oj… Den stod visst i vägen. Förlåt.", "Förlåt! Jag betalar, så klart." [N] |
  | `boom` | "Oj… förlåt." [N] |
  | `stand` | "Oj… förlåt… jag ersätter naturligtvis!" [N] (a fruit stall, §10.19) |
  | `carjack` | "Ursäkta, är det din bil?" [F*] (Majsan's question, relocated) |
  | `no` (the driver) | "Nej." [F*] (Stig's answer, relocated) |

  "Det måste vara värmen." is not his (it is the pedestrians' `GETUP`, §14.10), and none of these is
  ever shown as a film quote (README, tips).
- **Leaving free roam** (a mission state, a dialogue, the other level) drops the lines not yet said,
  and a bubble of ours still up comes down (`game.unsay`, only when it is still ours: a line said
  over it since is left alone).
- `sorry.last` ({ t, kind, text, no }) is for tests; `first`, `noDone`, `said` and `lastT` are
  session state, nothing is saved. Scenario `artig` (§16.4).
- **Not done** (deviations from the idea): no fifth kind for a hard crash ("Jag har lite anlag för
  åksjuka." stays the bus mission's, §8, and since feature 15 the pig delivery's, §10.15); a car he dents with a kick is not counted; the first Swedish
  carjacking of a session always gets the "Nej." (later ones at 35 %), so the film's exchange is seen.

### 10.15 Grisarna ramlar av grisbilen – the pigs tumble off the grisbil (free roam; feature 15, 2026-10-15)

`game/pigTruck.js` (`PigTruck`, owned by Game as `pigs`), config `PIG_TRUCK` in content/island.js.
Driven wildly, the unlocked grisbil loses its pigs over the side of the bed; they shake themselves
and trot off, and Stig rounds them up, politely, on foot or by creeping the bed up to them. Taking
all three home to the piglet pen at the grisfest farm earns the grisbonde's thanks and some pesetas.
All of it is ours, [N] (§1.6): nobody falls off the pig truck in the film, and Stig is not in that
scene. The lines are ours [N] and two relocated film lines [F*]. The grunting horn is feature 5's
(§10.9).

- **When.** Only the unlocked grisbil (`car: 'grisbil'`, `game.named.grisbil`, UNLOCKS.grisbil),
  only with the player at its wheel, only while `live`: on the island with `missions.state ===
  'idle'`; no fall, catch or delivery in a dialogue. The bodega's mission truck `grisbilFollow`
  (§8.9) has the same pig meshes but never loses one, so its jeep chase (`TIMERS.bodegaJeep`, a
  rammed destroy stage) and every calibration pool are as before; no timer, mission, stage kind or
  fixture changed. In a mission (any state but idle) and in the flight level nothing falls; leaving
  free roam (`release`) takes a carried pig off his head and puts every loose pig back in the bed,
  empties the pen, stops the grisbonde's walk and drops the lines not yet said.
- **The pigs** (§6.6, §14.6): each of the three is its own mesh (`car.pigs[i] = { mesh, in }` for
  `PIG_SLOTS[i]`, built by `pigMesh(scale)`), so one can leave the bed; `car.setPig(i, on)` and
  `car.pigWorld(i)` (its spot in world space). A burnt wreck hides them with the decals.
- **The falls.** One pig a jolt, in `order` [1, 2, 0] (the back right, the back left, then the one
  by the cab), no sooner than `gap` = 1.2 s after the last:
  - a landing at `land` = 6 m/s or more (`main.onCarLanded` → `pigs.jolt(car, 'land', impact)`;
    a drop of about 0.8 m; a curb is nothing);
  - a crash at `crash` = 7 m/s or more into a wall or a car (`main.onCarImpact` →
    `pigs.jolt(car, 'crash', impact)`; car damage starts at 5);
  - a long skid: `skidSecs` = 0.6 s of `car.skidAmt` ≥ `skidAmt` 0.5 at `skidMin` = 6 m/s or more
    (the clock runs down at 1/s between skids): a handbrake slide, a fast full-throttle turn, or a
    full stop from about 26 m/s or more (braking from over 8 m/s reads 0.6; the grisbil's top
    speed is about 32). Measured on the x = −40 road: full throttle, a gentle weave and full-steer
    corners at 10, 16 and 22 m/s off the throttle drop none.
  The pig spawns where it stood (`pigWorld`, its slot's yaw) and flies out with `fly`: `keep` 0.55
  × the car's velocity, `back` 1.6 m/s backwards, `side` 3.2 m/s over its own side (the back two
  their side, the front one either way) and `up` 4.6, rolling. No SKANDAL, ever.
- **A loose pig** (`LoosePig`, a plain bubble anchor): `fly` → on landing `down` on its side for
  `downSecs` 0.55 s (sliding to a stop) → `shake`, up and shaking itself for `shakeSecs` 0.7 s with
  `oink` "NÖFF!" [N] over it (and `audio.oink()` within 25 m) → `trot` off at `trot` 3.2 m/s for
  `trotSecs` 2.2 s, away from the grisbil (from Stig, when he is on foot) → `roam`: pauses and short
  trots at 0.6 × `trot`, pulled back within `roamR` = 9 m of where it landed. Within `shyR` = 4.5 m
  of Stig on foot it trots away at `shy` = 3.0 m/s (his walk is 5.4, so he catches it). The
  rabbits' wall rule (a block over 0.5 m above its feet stops it; it turns off it). It is never run
  over: a car coming at it faster than `creep` (along its line, within its width + 1.6 m, as far
  ahead as its half length + 0.6 × its speed + 2 m) makes it `skip` `dodge` = 6 m/s aside with a
  hop (and a "NÖFF!", at most every `oinkEvery` 3 s), and one inside a car's box is pushed out. It
  is not kicked (areaHit does not know it). Stig's "Oj! Grisen!" [N] comes 0.5 s after the
  session's first fall.
- **Catching.**
  - On foot within `catchR` = 1.4 m (and 1.2 m of height) of a pig on its feet or side, Stig lifts
    it over his head: `anim.carryOver`, `game.carrying = { who: 'gris', job: 'pigs' }` (no car, no
    mission talk, no glide or nap while he holds it), `speedCap` = the walk; `pickup` (his first
    always "Förlåt, lilla gris. Upp med dig.", later at `pickChance` 50 % "Ursäkta! Nu åker vi
    hem." / "Såja. Ingen fara.", not the one he said last) [N]. A fall, a bust, R (`bumpedT`) or
    anything taking `carrying` drops it, and it tumbles and trots off again. Within `bedR` = 2.6 m
    of the bed's middle (0.28 × the length behind the car's middle) it hops into its place (0.4 s).
  - In the grisbil: rolling (over 0.3 m/s) at under `creep` = 3.5 m/s with the bed's middle within
    `carCatchR` = 2.8 m of a pig that is up and about (`trot`/`roam`), the pig hops in (0.45 s). A
    standing grisbil does not take it, so a pig that lands by the bed after a full stop first trots
    off.
- **Lasse.** Stig on foot within `askR` = 10 m of a loose pig, Lasse free (`honk.free`) within
  `lasseR` = 22 m and nobody saying anything: "Lasse! Kan du ta den där?" [N]; `refuseGap` = 1.4 s
  later Lasse, turned to him, "Det ingår inte i mina åtaganden." [F*] (his reply to Angerud,
  research-plot.md:284, relocated; OUCH_STAFF has it too). At most every `askEvery` = 60 s. Both
  NPC lines restart the speaker's chatter clock (as the horn's answers).
- **The pen.** `zone` = 6 m round the landmark `grisfalla` (block (2,0) local (−11, 20.5), facing
  the piglet pen's east fence at x −14.8, between the café table, the palm and the cart; the gravel
  drive's way in from x −2 is clear for the grisbil: scenario `grisar`). With all three in the bed
  and the grisbil stopped there (under `zone.stop` = 2 m/s): they hop out one by one (0.45 s apart,
  0.95 s arcs 2.4 m over the higher end) over the fence to spots in the pen (`pen`: round
  `grisfallaIn` (−18.5, 20.6), half-sizes `hw` 2.4 across × `hd` 2.9 along its yaw, the shelter and
  trough left out), where they wander at 1.1 m/s with pauses; the previous delivery's three go.
  About 2.2 s in, the grisbonde (if `honk.free` and within 45 m) says "¡Gracias, señor! Alla grisar
  hemma!" [N], turned to Stig; `game.addCoins(pay)` with the coin sound and the toast "Grisbonden
  betalade {n} pta." [N]: `cleanPay` = 250 when no pig fell since the bed was last full, else `pay`
  = 100 and `sickGap` = 1.8 s later Stig's "Jag har lite anlag för åksjuka." [F*](t) (his line from
  the bus, research-characters.md:128, relocated; mission 6 keeps its own). With a pig loose and the
  grisbil stopped in the zone: the grisbonde's "Det fattas grisar, señor!" [N] (at most every 10 s),
  no delivery. When the grisbil comes within `bonde.r` = 45 m of the zone with pigs in the bed, the
  grisbonde walks over (`npc.steer`, 3.2 m/s, by `bonde.path` [[4.1, −6], [3.9, 2.2]]: [left,
  forward] from `grisfalla`, round the palm, to the pen's south-east corner) and stays until the
  grisbil has gone or `bonde.hold` = 4 s after his thanks; placeNpcs takes him home when Stig is
  far off (its 50 m rule). His chatter "Akta grisarna, señor!" fits it.
- **The bed fills again** (`fill`) when the grisbil stands within `home.r` = 20 m of its bay
  (UNLOCKS.grisbil's spot, `flamencoDrive` + 4 m) with nobody at the wheel and Stig over `home.away`
  = 30 m from it: after a delivery, or with pigs left loose more than 60 m from him. Then `falls` = 0
  (the clean pay counts from there). A grisbil that is gone or wrecked takes its loose pigs with it.
- **HUD** (after the mission's, the paint shop's, the Berra job's and Eslövloppet's): carrying, the
  objective "Bär grisen tillbaka till flaket." and the guide follows the bed; a pig loose, "En gris
  har ramlat av flaket! Gå fram till den – eller krypkör intill." ("{n} grisar har ramlat av
  flaket! Gå fram till dem – eller krypkör intill.") and the guide follows the nearest; at the wheel
  with a full bed, "Kör hem grisarna till fållan på grisfesten." and the ring at the zone; title
  "Grisbilen" [N]. Every loose pig is a `friend` blip on the minimap. Nothing after a delivery until
  the bed is full again.
- The horn's "NÖFF! NÖFF!" bubble over the bed shows only while a pig is in it (§10.9); the grunt
  itself stays.
- `pigs.last` ({ t, why, slot, impact }) and `pigs.paid` ({ t, pay, clean }) are for tests; `falls`,
  `delivered`, `loose`, `pen` and the rest are session state, nothing is saved (a reload starts with
  a full bed). Scenario `grisar` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the pigs hop over the fence themselves (the
  sketch had Stig lift the last one); R in the grisbil does not take loose pigs away (only a mission,
  the other level, a wreck or the bed's refill at Flamenco do); the grunting horn was already feature
  5's; "Fan, de luktar." stays Berra's and Robban's (the horn, §10.9).

### 10.16 Åk bagageband – the baggage belt carries Stig (free roam; feature 25, 2026-10-15)

`game/baggageBelt.js` (`BaggageBelt`, owned by Game as `belt`), config `BAGGAGE_BELT` in
content/island.js, the belt itself `BELT` in world/blocks/coast.js (§14.7). The belt of CINTA 2 in
Gando's arrivals hall (block (6,0), local (6, 5.5), world (246, −234.5)) carries Stig-Helmer round in
the ring's own time, and standing still on it he sits down on the nearest bag and rides on as
luggage. Invented (§1.6): in the film his bag is missing at Las Palmas ("Min väska har inte kommit.",
research-plot.md:238) and goes round the world's airports in cutaways (a Japanese voice: "Den här
väskan ska till Las Palmas"); nobody rides a belt. The two film lines are [F*], the rest [N].

- **When.** Only while `active()`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. In a mission (any
  other state) and in the flight level the belt carries nobody; a ride then ends (a seated Stig
  stands up on the belt, the lines not yet said go). No mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or
  calibration pool changes: no stage plays in the hall (buss17's intro stands at `airport`, 16 m off,
  and its drive starts at `busBay`). In a dialogue the belt keeps turning, but its lines wait (below).
- **The floor** (coast.js, §6.3). The belt is a `carousel` circle (`r1` = 3.3, the skirt included)
  with its top at the belt's surface, `BELT.top` = CURB + 0.64 = 0.79. (It was one circle at CURB +
  0.8 over the whole carousel, so he stood above the belt and sank into the centre island.) The
  centre island stands still: its own floor at CURB + 0.9 (r 1.85, `r0`), stepped up the cone at
  CURB + 1.03 (r 1.35) and CURB + 1.17 (r 0.85), and the sign's post a pole (r 0.1). From the hall
  floor the belt is a wall for people (0.64 m over a 0.45 step) and for cars (step 0.6): he jumps on.
  From the belt the island is a step. `teleport`'s ground snap (`groundAt(x, z, 0.2, 0.6)`) reaches
  the belt's top, so a spot on the belt snaps onto it; no landmark is there.
- **Carried.** `carry(h)` runs after the player's step every fixed step. On foot, on the ground and
  standing on `BELT.block` (its top within 0.02 m), he and his facing turn round the middle by
  `BELT.spin` × h = 0.32 rad/s, the ring's own spin: the ring's `rotation.y` is `game.time × spin`,
  so a turn takes 2π / 0.32 = 19.6 s. A walk on the belt adds to it. The follow camera's yaw is not
  his (on foot it never turns by itself, §14.5), so the view does not spin; it follows him round. In
  the air he is not carried (he lands a little behind), and a hop over the belt keeps the ride.
- **Sitting.** Standing still on the belt for `sitAfter` = 2.5 s (no move input, under 0.3 m/s, on
  the ground, nothing carried, no mantra, kick, hold, bust or flail, no dialogue) he sits down on the
  nearest bag by its angle round the middle (13 bags; the skis are not one). `seatAt` gives state
  `seated` and the plane-seat pose, with no `seatId`. He faces out, on its lid (`top`: CURB + 0.92
  or 0.98), `seatIn` = 0.28 m in from its outer end, with his legs over its end, and slides there in
  `sitSecs` = 0.35 s (his hips from where they stood). Every frame after `syncAll` the seat is the
  bag's place in the turning ring (`placeSeated`), so he goes round exactly with it. The prompt is
  "E Kliv av bandet" [N].
- **Off.** Space hops him off the bag: up on the belt where he sat, facing out, with a jump at `hopV`
  = 8.6 m/s. The ride goes on, and after 2.5 s standing still he sits down again. E steps him off the
  belt onto the hall floor, `offR` = 3.9 m from the middle, facing out: the ride ends. R lets go of
  the bag first (`release`), then resets as always.
- **A ride** starts when the belt first carries him and ends `offSecs` = 0.6 s after he has left the
  belt (not while he is in the air over it), when E takes him off, or when free roam ends. It counts
  the angle the belt has carried him, standing or sitting, so a turn is about 19.6 s of game time
  whatever he does on it:
  - The session's first ride, `boardAt` = 0.8 s in: Stig's "Min väska har inte kommit." [F*]
    (relocated from the arrival; buss17's intro keeps its own, §8.6). Once julafton has brought the
    bag back (missions index ≥ `bagBackIndex` = 13) it is "Det är faktiskt rätt rogivande." [N].
  - Every full turn, a toast: "Ett varv på bagagebandet!", "Två varv på bagagebandet!", "Tre varv på
    bagagebandet!", then "{n} varv på bagagebandet!" [N].
  - After the session's first turn, before julafton, `lasseAt` = 1.2 s later, Lasse on the radio:
    "Den dyker upp. Det gör de alltid." [N] (his answer in buss17's intro, relocated).
  - After the third turn of a ride (`luggageLap`), `luggageAt` = 0.6 s later, Stig is the bag: "Den
    här väskan ska till Las Palmas." [F*] (said in Japanese at an airport in the film,
    research-plot.md:238; relocated).
  Stig's lines are his own bubble (`game.say`, 2.4 s). A line due in a dialogue, or while he is
  saying something, waits up to 4 s and is then dropped; a ride's own lines go when it ends.
- `belt.last`, `belt.events` (the last 40: `board`, `lap`, `sit`, `hop`, `off`, `lasse`, `luggage`)
  and `belt.rides` are for tests; `boarded` and `lasseDone` are session state, and nothing is saved.
  Scenario `bagage` (§16.4).
- **Not done** (deviations from the idea): only Stig rides (the hall's loose suitcases and trolleys
  are props, and people cannot step on); he sits facing out over a bag's end, as in the sketches, on
  the nearest bag, not one he picks; the third turn's line is his own (in the film a Japanese voice).
  The game has no achievements, so the toasts and the lines are the reward.
### 10.17 Lapplisan Majsan – "Ursäkta, är det din bil?" (free roam; feature 20, 2026-10-15)

`game/lapplisa.js` (`Lapplisa`, owned by Game as `lapp`), config `LAPPLISA` in content/island.js.
Majsan is a traffic warden in Stockholm (the film's first meeting, research-plot.md:94–102), and on
the island she cannot leave it be. Three parts: (1) a car Stig leaves on the sidewalk brings her with
her ticket pad, the film's question and his true "Nej.", and then the tow; (2) between missions
Angerud's hire car stands on the sidewalk outside Centro La Medina, and the first time Stig walks
past it the film's scene plays, with the GRÚA truck and Angerud's outburst; (3) a car he leaves
straight in one of Flamenco's painted bays gets her praise over the hedge, and Siv's answer from the
balcony scene. Invented (§1.6): her tickets on the island, the tow, the praise; the film lines are
relocated, [F*], and three lines are ours, [N].

- **When.** Only while `live`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. Nothing new starts in
  a dialogue, the nap or the morning cut (`day.busy`), the pool fest's ring or a pursuit (`calm`).
  Any other mission state, or the other level, ends all of it at once (`end`): Majsan and Angerud
  placed home, Angerud's car and the truck out of the world, every slip off its windscreen, Angerud's
  chatter his own again, the gag and the car he left forgotten. So no mission, stage kind, timer,
  fixture or calibration pool sees any of it (asnan's paint run ends at Viking Bar with its measured
  19 s, §8.8: the car is gone the moment it starts), and `story`/`fullstory` play as before. The
  grisfest's evening (feature 21, §10.18: `party.on`) is not `live` either: it ends all of it the
  same way, and Majsan, home, is free for the dance.
- **The people.** Majsan (and, in the scene, Angerud) is taken only when `free`: shown, standing, in
  no car or seat, nobody's (`!busy`: not placed by a mission, the judges, the fest or another module),
  not the waiting mission's giver or extra (Majsan: buss17, friskotek, ropavieja, fataga, so nothing
  happens at those indices) and `honk.free`. Taken, she is ours (`busy`, `spot = 'lapplisa'`,
  `npc.steer` walks her): `posed(key)` keeps `syncAll` from waving, turning her by the 10 m rule or
  giving her chatter, and `owns(key)` keeps `honk.free` (and with it the horn, the pigs' Lasse and
  the rest) off her. Let go, she is placed home at once where nobody sees it, or left for
  `placeNpcs` (its 50 m rule).
- **(1) The sidewalk** (`layout.sidewalkAt(x, z)`): the kerb-high band `SW` = 3.5 m beside every road,
  round each block (`ring`, with a corner at each end of its straight stretch `lo`..`hi`) and round
  the town (the outer ring), as town.js lays it; not the asphalt (the west stub too), not a block's
  lots, squares and gardens (the square before La Medina, Flamenco's and SunTrip's lots), not the sand
  past `EDGE`. A car counts with `wheels` = 2 or more of its four contact points on it (`wheelsOn`;
  two up on the kerb is enough).
- **The ticket.** The car he last got out of (`track`: `playerCar` turning null), still (under
  `still` = 0.5 m/s) on the sidewalk: its clock runs while he is within `nearR` = 45 m (it holds
  further off and starts again when the car is moved off). After `delay` = 6 s, looked for twice a
  second: Majsan free, not where the camera sees her (`seen`: inside the view within `seenR` = 90 m
  with nothing tall in between) and not within 25 m of him (she never vanishes before his eyes or
  from beside him at the pool, so a car on Flamenco's own sidewalk gets nothing), and a way in
  (`comePlan`): round a corner of the car's block, `cornerIn` = 7 m round it on the side street, when
  that walk is at most `cornerMax` = 32 m, the nearer first; else from `alongR` = 22 m along the same
  sidewalk (the outer ring has no corners); its start on free sidewalk, out of view and
  `minFromStig` = 12 m from him. She appears there and walks at `walk` = 2.6 m/s on a line `ins` =
  1.9 m in from the kerb (clear of the lamps, palms and sidewalk furniture) to the car's near end,
  then beside its windscreen (either side or before the nose, the free spot nearest; `standAt`). A
  walk that makes no headway for `stuckSecs` = 2 s hops to its next waypoint (unseen, or on the second
  try). There she writes for `writeSecs` = 2.2 s (`anim.ticket`, §14.6), and the slip goes on the
  windscreen: a yellow 0.26 × 0.17 slip low on the glass on the driver's side (car-local, so it
  rides along; vans and the ice-cream van on the cab's front), `car.lappSlip`. With Stig on foot within
  `askR` = 14 m and not saying anything she turns to him: "Ursäkta, är det din bil?" [F*], and
  `askGap` = 1.1 s later his "Nej." [F*] — true: he took it off the street — or for the hire car
  (`name === 'hyrbil'`) "Den är… hyrd." [N]. `towGap` = 3.5 s later (after the answer, or the slip
  when there was no question) she raises a hand (`anim.oath`), "Okej, grabbar!" [F*], and `fadeAt` =
  1.2 s after that the car goes: with the car within `seeR` = 60 m of him behind a black fade
  (`hud.fade`, `fadeSecs` = 0.6 s each way, him frozen by `inDialog` meanwhile), else at once. A car
  from the street or a parked one is removed (`removeCar`); a named one with a bay (`car.home`: the
  hire car, the grisbil) is put back in it, as getInCar's `atHome` does (§9, the grisfest's hire car
  is there for its stage 2), its slip off. Then she walks off round the nearer corner (`awayPath`;
  still in view at its end she walks on 10 m, twice at most) and is placed home once nobody sees
  her, or after `leaveMax` = 25 s left for `placeNpcs`.
  - Getting back into it first (any time before the fade) keeps the car, and its slip stays on the
    windscreen; she walks off. A car moved more than 3 m from where she found it, a wreck or a car
    gone ends it the same way. Knocked over or in a dialogue, her clock waits.
  - Never towed: a bus, a Guardia jeep, a locked car (the airport taxis, Angerud's), one the player
    can never enter, the GRÚA truck, the grisbil with a pig off its bed or over Stig's head (§10.15),
    a car Stig sits in. No SKANDAL, no fine and no money for any of it.
  - Lines are bubbles (`game.say`, `secs` = 2.4; his 1.8), each NPC's chatter clock restarted.
- **(2) Angerud's hire car and the film's first meeting.** A white (`0xf4f4f0`) `hatch` (Småbil) made
  once, locked, stands on the south sidewalk of block (1,2) outside Centro La Medina, at landmark
  `angerudBil` (−7, 32.75, −π/2: facing west with the traffic on that side, between a palm 5 m
  ahead of its nose and the post box behind), while the scene is still to come (`onceKey` `lappFilm`
  not in the saved unlocks) and Angerud stands at his home spot at Viking Bar (`vikingbar` + (2, 1);
  shown, nobody's): between missions on the island, until julafton's end sends him to hospital
  (UNLOCKS.bodega's `angerud: null`, §8.13); the scene needs Majsan free too, so it can first play at
  asnan's index (7). It is put there and taken away only where the
  camera does not see its spot (looked at twice a second) and never on top of another car; a mission
  start takes it away at once. The first time Stig is on foot (standing, nothing carried, no
  pursuit) within `angerud.r` = 12 m of it, with Majsan and Angerud free, the scene plays (`film`;
  `lappFilm` saved at its start, so it plays once ever):
  1. Letterbox, `inDialog`. Majsan at its nose writing on her pad, Stig stopped on the sidewalk 2.4 m
     up the street, a still camera from the road (the palm in the foreground, Viking Bar behind); 1 s
     later the slip is on, she looks up. Dialogue: Majsan "Ursäkta, är det din bil?", Stig "Nej.",
     Majsan "Okej, grabbar!" (her hand up, `oath` 1.6 s) [F*].
  2. Black: the GRÚA truck (a `pickup` Flakbil in orange `0xf07a1e`, GRÚA [N] on both bed sides and a
     board on the cab roof, a boom over the tailgate, a driver bust; locked, never enterable; no firm's
     name, §1.5) stands in the road with his car on its hook behind it (`car.lift` = 0.16 rad: the nose
     up about the rear wheels, §14.6), Majsan in the road at the gap, Stig further along the sidewalk.
     Back from black, Angerud runs out from the bar's courtyard (`run` = 3.2 m/s, `oath` and `yell`) to
     its tail by the post box; dialogue: "Vad i helvete tar ni er till?", "Hederliga bilister ger ni
     er på, men få hyfs på ungdomen klarar ni inte!", "Förbannade förmyndarmentalitet!" [F*] (his own
     swearing from the film).
  3. Black: truck and car gone, Angerud home at his bar. Majsan and Stig face to face on the sidewalk
     (`cam.frame`): Stig "Är det inte jobbigt när alla skäller?", Majsan "Jo, jag gör ju bara mitt
     jobb." [F*]. Then free roam: the camera behind Stig, she walks off round the corner and home.
  After it Angerud's chatter is `mutter` ("Hederliga bilister ger ni er på…", "Förbannade
  förmyndarmentalitet!", "Jag ska tala med platschefen." [F*]; `game.chatterOverrides.angerud`) until
  the next mission starts ("the rest of the day"). Driving past does nothing.
- **(3) Flamenco's bays** (`hotels.js` `flamencoBays`: the lot's eight painted bays, two rows of four,
  2.8 × 5 m, world `{ x, z, hw, hd, yaw }`). A car he has driven (it got more than 5 m from where he
  got in: not the hire car got into and out of in its bay) and left, once it stands still (under
  0.3 m/s), with its middle within 0.8 m across and 1.5 m along of a bay's and its axis within `bayYaw`
  = 0.17 rad (10°) of the bay's either way (nose in or out): Majsan at home by the pool (within `homeR`
  = 4 m of her spot, free, within `praiseR` = 40 m of the car, not saying anything) says "Där ser man.
  Det går att parkera här nere också." [N] (her "Här nere parkerar de hursomhelst." [F*] chatter is
  the setup), and `replyGap` = 2.4 s later Siv, free within 8 m of her, "Spänn av, Majsan. Du är
  ledig." [F*](t). The first time ever (`praiseKey` `lappRuta` in the saved unlocks) +`praisePay` =
  50 pta with the coin sound and the toast "Snyggt parkerat! 50 pta." [N]. At most every
  `praiseEvery` = 90 s; one look a time he gets out.
- `lapp.last` ({ kind: come | ticket | drove | tow | praise | film, t, … }) and `lapp.stuck` are for
  tests; everything else is session state except the two saved markers. Scenarios `lapplisa` and
  `lappfilm` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the tow in free roam is the M version's fade,
  with no truck driving up (the truck stands only in the film scene, put there in the black); a car
  he leaves far off (over 45 m) waits for him to come back; near the pool (Majsan within 25 m of him)

### 10.18 Grisfest varje torsdag – 800 pesetas (free roam; feature 21, 2026-10-15)

`game/grisfestFree.js` (`GrisfestFree`, owned by Game as `party`), config `GRISFEST_FREE` in
content/island.js. In the transfer bus Lasse says "Grisfesten är på torsdag och kostar 800 pesetas"
(research-plot.md:246), and SunTrip's poster has promised GRISFEST / TORSDAG / 800 PTA all game (§6.3).
After the grisfest the farm sells its evening again for exactly that: the film's warmest scene, where
Majsan asks Stig to dance, bought back. Invented (§1.6): the fest in free roam, the fee at the gate, the
tourist's refusal; the film lines are the grisfest's own [F] or relocated [F*], and five are ours [N].

- **When.** Only while `open`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'` and `missions.index >=
  fromIndex` = 12 (the grisfest done). Any other state, or the other level, ends it at once (`reset`):
  no fade, everyone placed home, the band and the tourists out of the world, the island's tune and
  Ole's outfit back (the one he wore before his `gris` shirt, unless someone has dressed him since),
  the clock running again (a mission that starts in the dark gets the clock's morning cut, §10.10). So no mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees it (the
  grisfest race's finish at (−80, −200) is just outside the gate, but the evening never plays in a
  mission), and `story`/`fullstory` play as before.
- **The gate.** The host (`varden`, the unnamed grisfest host, §1.5) at his post (his HOMES spot
  `['grisfest', 3, 0]`, 4.6 m inside the gate; free and within 2.5 m of it): the interactable
  `grisfest:pay` (r `pay.r` = 2.6 m; on foot, nothing carried, no dialogue, no SKANDAL pursuit) `E
  Betala grisfesten (800 pta)` [N]. Stig on foot within `greetR` = 7 m of him: Stig "Är det torsdag i dag?" [N], 1.8 s later
  the host "Här är det alltid torsdag, señor. Åttahundra pesetas!" [N]; again only after Stig has been
  `greetAgainR` = 20 m off (his own sangria chatter waits 6 s, so it does not cut his answer). E with fewer than `fee` = 800 pesetas: the host's "Åttahundra, señor. Inte
  en peseta mindre." [N] and nothing else: Ole does not pay here (`game.pay` would let him, and the
  evening would be free). With 800 or more: `addCoins(−800)`, the coin sound, the evening.
- **The evening** (`begin`, `inDialog`): a black fade (`fadeSecs` 0.7 s); in the dark the banner
  `TORSDAG KVÄLL` / `Grisfest på vischan` [N], the clock held (`day.hold`, §10.10) and the watch (if
  found, drawn `over` the black) spinning on to `hour` = 21:00 unless it is already night (from 21:00
  or before `nightTill` = 05:30 it keeps its hour), its palette written (night: the bulbs over the
  floor and the pergolas against the dark, the hotels' windows and the lighthouse lit, §13.3);
  `holdSecs` 1.0 s; the fade back. Set up in the black (`setUp`):
  - the music `vals` (§12.1: the game's own waltz, never Kostervalsen, §1.5);
  - the cast, each only if `free` (shown, standing, in no car or seat, not `busy`, `honk.free`, not
    the waiting mission's giver or extra), `placeNpc`d at [dx, dz, yaw] from `dansgolv` (yaw 0: dx
    east, dz south towards the gate). Dancing (`anim.dance`): Berra (−3.2, −3.0) with Siv (−2.1,
    −3.0), Robban (1.6, −0.5) with a tourist, and Ole (0.3, 3.4) front and centre facing the gate in
    his `gris` shirt, only from `oleFrom` = 13 (until julafton is done he is its giver, and
    `nearestInteractable` starts a mission within 3.4 m of a giver wherever he stands). Majsan at the
    floor's east edge (7.6, 0.5) watching (facing Stig while he is within 5 m); Herr Storch filming the
    floor from its south-west corner (−7.8, 5.2; `anim.film`); Fru Storch at the west long table
    (−11.2, −2.5). Never Angerud (in the film he searches Stig's room during the fest,
    research-plot.md:347). Held, they are ours (`busy`, `spot = 'grisfestFree'`, `npc.steer` walks
    them back to their places at `walk` = 1.5 m/s): `posed(key)` keeps `syncAll` from waving, turning
    or chattering them, and `honk.free` leaves them out (and with it every module that asks it). A
    placement by anyone else (a forced `placeNpcs`) makes them nobody's.
  - The host walks `round` ((−9, −0.5) → (−9, 7.6) → (9, 7.6) → (9, −0.5) and back: round the floor's
    south side, between its edge, the light poles and the pergolas' posts) at `hostWalk` = 1.3 m/s,
    waiting `hostWait` = 5 s at either end, a cup in his hand (`cupHeld`).
  - The band: three local men (seeded `randomPed` from `seed` = 2100, a red `sash`, no hat) on the
    bandstand (top 1.0): an accordion (−2.4, −18.8), a singer behind the mic (0.2, −18.8; `anim.talk`)
    and congas (2.0, −19.2). The tourists: five Swedish ones (seeded), dancing: Robban's partner (2.7,
    −0.5), a couple at (3.0, −5.5) and (4.1, −5.5), and two women on their own (`solo`: (−1.9, 2.3)
    and (4.4, 2.8)). These eight are the module's own `Character`s (`party.extras`, built at the first
    evening, hidden between evenings): main.js adds them to `allChars` (the player and cars push and
    bowl them over), steps them in `fixedStep` (`party.step`: back to their places when pushed off, put
    back after 2.5 s stuck) and bowls them over with a kick in `areaHit` as it does pedestrians (the
    SKANDAL and their barks as a pedestrian's, Stig's sorry, §10.14).
  - Stig on the gravel drive at (0, 20) facing the floor (the first free of `enterAlt` if his car
    stands there), the camera behind him.
- **In free play** (no scene, no dialogue): the host's "Sangrian, grabbar." [F*](t) with Stig within
  `sangria.r` = 10 m, every 9–14 s; Ole's "Heia Norge!" [F] within 16 m, every 14–22 s. Once an
  evening, Stig within `coffee.r` = 9 m of Fru Storch: she turns to the host (4 s) and asks "Finns det
  svenskt kaffe på grisfesten?" [F*] (the film's subtitle, research-plot.md:37), and with Ole there
  `coffee.gap` = 2.0 s later his "Norsk, da?" [F*](t) (his "Norskt, då?" to her question at the hotel,
  research-plot.md:247). The plates on the long tables break as ever (§6.3: 2 pta each; no counter,
  no timer).
- **The invitation.** E on a `solo` tourist (`grisfest:ask`, r `ask.r` = 1.9 m, `E Bjud upp` [N]; until
  Majsan has asked him this evening): `cinematic(tourist, Stig)`, a side two-shot (behind him the
  chase eye hid her); Stig "Ska vi dansa? Hej hej." [F*] (Ole's advice in the film, tried by Stig);
  `turnAt` = 1.3 s later she turns her back on him and dances on; `scaredAt` = 1.2 s later his "Jag är
  skraj att de ska nobba." [F]. Majsan starts over to him, and `comeSecs` = 1.6 s later, in a cut, the
  two stand face to face on clear floor (`pairSpot`: Stig within 2.4 m of where he stood, Majsan
  `frontR` = 1.1 m from him, both a metre or more from anyone else, and the sight line from the side
  `camera.frame` takes clear) in `cam.frame(Majsan, Stig)`; his bubble comes down. The dialogue:
  Majsan "Vill du dansa med mig?" [F], Stig "Får jag lov…" [F](t) (from his line both dance), Siv (if
  at the evening) "Nu blev hon uppbjuden." [F](t); Ole (if there) "Heia Norge!" with applause;
  `danceSecs` = 4.5 s; then play. From then on Stig standing still (no move input, on his feet) within
  `partnerR` = 1.6 m of Majsan dances with her, turning to her; a step stops him. Not turned round:
  Stig never asks Majsan (in the film she asks him, research-plot.md:346). Without Majsan at the
  evening the scene ends after his fear.
- **The morning after.** Stig (on foot or in a car) out of the walled square (more than `walls` + `out`
  = 31.6 m from `dansgolv` in x or z: through the gate, over a wall or round the farmhouse): a black
  fade, the banner `MORGONEN EFTER` / `Nästa grisfest: torsdag` [N] (the grisfest mission's own end
  is `MORGONEN EFTER`), everyone placed home (the host at his post), the band and the tourists out of
  the world, Ole's outfit and the island's tune back, the watch spinning on to `morning` = 08:00, the
  clock's palette and its hold off; the fade back. He can pay again at once.
- **The others meanwhile.** The Berra job (§10.6) waits during the evening (`berraJob.active` is false:
  a nap on its bench is called off and both go home, free to come), and Majsan's tickets (§10.17) stop
  (`lapp.live` is false: her round ends as at a mission start, and she is home, free to come).
- `party.last` ({ kind: greet | short | paid | evening | ask | coffee | morning, t, … }; the
  invitation's `step`: line | away | scared | alone | invite | dance | done, and its `pair`) is for
  tests; everything is session state, nothing is saved. Scenarios `torsdag` and `torsdagOle` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the evening keeps the free-roam clock (feature 30,
  §10.10): paying moves it on to 21:00 and holds it, and leaving is the morning after at 08:00 rather
  than "back to day" at the same hour; the refusal is a short side two-shot and Majsan's arrival a cut
  to a two-shot on clear floor; Stig dances with her again by standing still by her (no prompt: he
  never asks her); the host's round is a fixed walk round the floor's south side; no plate counter;
  the band is three seeded figures of the module's own, not the cast.

### 10.19 Rakt genom fruktståndet – his car through the market's fruit stalls (free roam; feature 28, 2026-10-15)

`game/fruitStands.js` (`FruitStands`, owned by Game as `stands`), config `FRUKTSTAND` in
content/island.js, the prop type `frutas` (world/props.js, §6.8). The car chase's cliché: until now
every stall stopped his car dead; five of them now go to pieces under it, the fruit flying.

- **The stalls.** The market's five fruit stalls (§6.3 (2,1): rad A's two ends, rad A2's, rad C's and
  the lone one) are `frutas` props in place of `stall()` calls: the same place, 5 × 3.5 m, a walkable
  awning at 2.55, the block's kind `'stall'` (the camera, the guides and the officer see the stall's
  solid, not a see-through prop). One instanced look, so they lose the market's colour round: the
  yellow-and-orange awning, which no other stall has (the old `SCH[2]` stalls are plum and white), so
  a player learns which stalls go. The `FRUTAS` board is rad A's west stall's `sign`, hidden with it.
- **When.** Only `Game.breakProp(p, vx, vz, car)` with `stands.canBreak(car)`: his own car, on the
  island, `missions.state === 'idle'`, no dialogue; car.js breaks it above `minSpeed` 6 m/s and the car
  keeps `slow` = 0.8 of its speed. Otherwise `breakProp` returns null and car.js meets the stall as a
  wall, as before (a car at 3 m/s, any car in a mission, an AI car, a Land Rover). A kick never
  (`carOnly`).
- **The smash** is the props' (§6.8): 26 chunks in the fruit colours over the counter (tomato red,
  banana yellow, orange, melon green, light red, crate brown), 4 flaps of awning that flutter down and
  lie where they land, the board gone, `audio.smash`, 4 coins (100 pta), SKANDAL `shame` 3 × 1.2 in a
  car (× `gain` 3: +10.8), and two juice spills (`fx.spill`, red and yellow).
- **The seller** (`vendor`: a Spanish market woman in a red headscarf, a blue dress and a yellow apron,
  a `Character` of her own with `key` `frutera`, in no NPC list, no collision): she pops up with a
  dust puff beside the wreck, at the first of six spots round the footprint (the front corners 0.6 m
  in from the ends and 0.9 m out, the middles of the sides 0.8 m out, the back corners) with 0.45 m
  clear of solids and out of the car's lane (2.4 m either side of its line, ahead of it); none such,
  the clear one furthest behind it. Nobody comes to harm (§1.2): she is never ahead of the car. She
  flails (`flail`, `yell`), turns to him and cries "¡Mis tomates!" [N] (2.4 s; the form of the locals'
  "¡Mi coche!"), and after `vendorSecs` = 4 s (or at a dialogue) she is gone with another puff. The
  next crash takes her there.
- **Stig** says sorry through StigSorry's `stand` kind (§10.14): "Oj… förlåt… jag ersätter
  naturligtvis!" [N] 0.5 s after (chance 1; the 7 s gap and the saying rule as every kind), from the
  car. He does not stop.
- **The souvenir seller** (at `asnestand`): from missions index `swearFrom` = 8 (after asnan, whose win
  has his swearing), within `swearR` = 25 m of the stall (rad C's, A2's and the lone one; not rad A's
  ends), free (`honk.free`) and not saying anything: `swearAt` = 1.4 s after the crash "Jävla
  smålänningar!" [F*] (the line Ole's haggle gets from him, research-plot.md:302–304, relocated), 2.4 s,
  with `yell`, turned to the wreck, then 2.4 s turning back to his stand; meanwhile
  `stands.posed('souvenir')` (syncAll neither turns him to Stig nor gives him chatter). At most once
  in `swearGap` = 60 s, a shared pause, so he never swears twice in a row.
- **Coming back.** A broken stall comes back by the props' rule (75–115 s, him more than 70 m off,
  `tickProps`), but not while a car's OBB overlaps its footprint (`update`, before `tickProps`, holds
  its `respawn` at 0.5 s). A mission start (any state but `idle`) or the other level brings all five
  back at once (`reset`): a car in a footprint is first moved out along the SAT normal (depth + 0.3 m),
  the seller is hidden, the souvenir seller's swear dropped. So every mission (asnan's drive to the
  market and haggle at the souvenir stand, julafton's pickup at the entrance) meets the stalls as
  before, with the same footprints and tops (the lone stall 0.5 m shallower at the back, its counter
  where it was): no mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool changed.
- `stands.last` ({ t, i, x, z, vendor: { x, z }, swear }) is for tests; nothing is saved. Scenarios
  `frukt` and `fruktFore` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): Ole's "Blomster? … Meloner? Agurker? Bananer?"
  (it needs "Ole åker med", not built); no tomato stains on the ground; the debris is the props' cubes
  in the fruit colours, not fruit shapes; only his car breaks one (traffic and the Land Rovers meet the
  wall, so no sorry or seller for theirs); the lone stall 3.5 m deep (it was 4); the market's three
  other yellow-and-orange stalls repainted plum; the seller has no collision (the car can pass
  through her, but she never stands in its way).

### 10.20 Från fjärde våningen – the diving tower at Flamenco's pool (free roam; feature 24, 2026-10-16)

`game/diveTower.js` (`DiveTower`, owned by Game as `tower`), config `TOWER` in content/island.js,
the tower in world/blocks/hotels.js (`diveTower`, `DIVE_TOWER`). Lasse's phone call in the film,
"Från fjärde våningen? Ner i poolen? Ring kliniken." (research-plot.md:292), had only ever had its
second half used; now Stig climbs a 10 m tower at the deep end, says Levander's mantra with his arms
out and comes down in the pool. The tower, the cannonball and the belly flop are [N] (§1.6).

- **The tower** (§6.3 (3,3)): on the strip between the hedge (x −17.6) and the pool's coping
  (x −14.8), north of the low board. A white room with a teal foot over the whole footprint x [−17.4,
  −14.8], z [2.4, 4.8] (to C + 3.0), four posts and two terracotta landings (C + 3.0, C + 6.4), the
  platform slab with a teal mat at `DIVE_TOWER.top` = C + 9.8 = 9.95 (the hotel's fourth floor,
  Y1 + 2 FH, counting the ground floor as the first), railed (two chrome rails, 1.0 m) on all four
  sides but at the board, which reaches 1.4 m (x −14.8 to −13.4, 1.0 m wide) out over the deep end.
  The steel ladder runs up the north face at x −15.5 and stands 0.9 m over the platform as grips. The
  signs `TRAMPOLÍN 10 M` [N] (§1.3) on the room's pool side and `TRAMPOLÍN / 10 M` beside the ladder.
  It is static geometry (no random draws: the rest of the world builds as before) and shows in every
  shot that looks that way (the title orbit, the julafton party, the sunset duet and the pool intros
  at the frame's left edge).
- **Its solids** (`DIVE_TOWER.blocks`, kind `'tower'`): the tower with its ladder (x [−17.4, −14.8],
  z [2.12, 4.8], top 9.95: the platform's floor), the board (top 9.95) and six railing strips (top
  11.05: walls up there; the ladder's gap is 0.6 m, narrower than he is). Collision is footprints,
  so the tower is solid from the ground up (the room shows it) and the board an unseen pillar in the
  water under it, as the low board's step is. Each block's `dead` is a getter, `!DIVE_TOWER.live()`,
  and `tower` sets `live` to `level === 'island' && missions.state === 'idle'`. **So no mission sees
  the tower:** in any other state `queryBlocks`, `groundAt`, `spotFree`, `freeSpot`, `footReach`,
  the cars, the camera and calibrate's walker meet the strip as before (grisfest's flowers spawn
  round `flamenco` within 40 m, which takes it in), and no stage's world, timer, fixture or
  calibration pool changes. In a mission he walks through where the tower stands.
- **The ladder.** Two interactables (§14.3): `hopptorn:upp` at the landmark `hopptorn` (−15.5, 1.55),
  `promptUp` "<b>E</b> Klättra upp" [N], and `hopptorn:ner` at `hopptornTopp` (−15.6, 3.15, y 9.95),
  `promptDown` "<b>E</b> Klättra ner" [N]; `r` = 1.3, and the ±2.5 m height rule of
  `bestInteractable` keeps each to its own level. Both only when `canClimb()`: on the island, idle, no
  climb under way, no dialogue, on foot and on the ground, not carrying, no bust freeze or PANIK, not
  in the pool fest's ring or on the baggage belt. E: `inDialog` holds his keys and the camera, a
  black fade (`hud.fade`, `fadeSecs` = 0.35 s), then he is `put` (by hand: `teleport` snaps to
  ground-level floors only) on the platform facing along the board (yaw π/2), or at the foot turned
  away from the ladder; the camera behind him (`cam.yaw`, `snapNext`), `holdSecs` = 0.2 s, the fade
  lifts. The railing keeps him up there: the board is the only way off (and R, which puts him on the
  road as anywhere).
- **The dive.** On the platform or the board (`groundInfo.block` one of the tower's, y at the top)
  `fromTop` is set; airborne and 0.4 m under the top, the dive starts: `anim.leap` (§14.6: Levander's
  arms straight out as `wings`, shaking a little, tipping forward as the fall gathers speed, so he
  comes down flat; only a look, his wish and air control are untouched) and the mantra
  (`S.mantraLine` "Jag kan flyga, jag är inte rädd." [F*], the exercise at the clinic,
  research-plot.md:122–123, through `game.say`). J in the air is the stomp (§3): `anim.bomb` instead
  (knees up, arms round them). After julafton a held J glides (§10.7) and the glide takes the dive
  over (no tower landing). A change of state, a car or a landing `onLand` did not hear ends it.
- **The landing.** `game.onLand(ch, v, y)` calls `tower.onLand(v, y)` first (then the judges', §10.8).
  A dive that ends on a `water` floor (`waterAt`, not on a car roof) splashes through
  `game.waterSplash(x, z, v, bomb)` (§14.3) instead of the dust:
  - a stomp: **the cannonball** (`last.kind` `'bomb'`): the biggest splash (a column of water), the
    boom, the camera shaken (1.4 off the top), and the stomp's own crash and `areaHit` (§3);
  - anything else: **the belly flop** (`'magplask'`): the wide splash, `flop(flopSecs = 1.6)` (face
    down along his facing), and "Oj." [N] when he is up (at most every `ojAgain` = 8 s).
  - The session's first dive into the water: `radioAt` = 1.2 s later Lasse on the radio, the whole
    line, `radio` "Från fjärde våningen? Ner i poolen? Ring kliniken." [F*] (his phone call,
    relocated: now it is about Stig). Not when the glide's pool landing has said it this session
    (`glide.radioSaid`); the glide in turn holds its once-ever line back after the tower's
    (`tower.radioSaid`, §10.7). "Ring kliniken" is Lasse's dry joke: no clinic, no ambulance, no
    injury text (§1.2).
  - On dry ground (off the board's side onto the coping) it is an ordinary hard landing (dust).
  Walked off the board he lands about 4–5 m out, x ≈ −9.4 to −8.6, in the deep end (v ≈ 21.6 m/s, 26.8
  with the stomp, measured by `hopptorn`).
- **A mission start** (any state but `idle`) or the other level: the solids go (above), the dive and
  the queued radio line are dropped, and if he is up there (within 1.5 m of the top over the tower or
  the board) he is `put` at the foot first, so he never falls. Nothing is saved; `tower.last` ({ kind:
  'bomb' | 'magplask' | 'dry', x, z, v, t, secs }) and `tower.climbs` are for tests. Scenario
  `hopptorn` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the ladder is two E points with a fade, not a
  climb; the "two landings" are the tower's look (nobody stands on them); the tower is solid only
  between missions (the idea's own alternative), so it stands in every mission's shots but a player
  in a mission walks through it; no score for the biggest cannonball (the splash is the reward); the
  sisters do not judge the tower (only the low board's hops, §10.8). Any other hard landing in water
  splashes now too (`waterSplash`, built once for this and the later roof jumps), in missions as
  well: a look only.

### 10.21 Fin hund… – the watchdogs in the bungalow gardens and at the farm (free roam; feature 31, 2026-10-17)

`game/dogs.js` (`Dogs`, owned by Game as `dogs`), config `DOGS` in content/island.js, the lots from
world/town.js (`dogLots`) and world/blocks/nature.js (`FARM_YARD`). At Arlanda's baggage check a drug
dog sniffs at Stig's parcel and somebody says "Fin hund." (research-plot.md:162; the speaker is not
known); now Stig says it, hands up, to the watchdogs of the island's gardens, and talks to one from out
of its reach with the mantra and his arms out until its owner whistles it home. The dogs, their owners
and their calls are [N] (§1.6).

- **The dogs.** 12 of the 48 `bungalowR` lots (§6.5) and the finca's yard on vischan keep one each.
  `build()` (on the first update in free roam) takes the lots with a trampoline first (all 7), then
  those with a parked car, then the rest, each group in an order of its own seeded draws
  (`mulberry32(31)`: the town's draws are spent as before), at most `perBlock` = 2 a block, up to
  `lots` = 12, and gives out the `pack` in that order: Bobi, Bijou, Rufo, Kasper, Lola, Pirre, Trofast
  (the trampoline lots), Tango, Ludde, Pelusa, Canelo, Sickan (car lots). Each has a look (`brun`,
  `gul`, `svart`, `flack`, `pudel`, `gra`: six looks built in dogs.js from coloured primitives, a body,
  a head, a tail and four legs on pivots of their own, at 0.72–1.18 × a medium dog of 0.6 m at the
  shoulder), a bark bubble ("VOFF! VOFF!", the small ones "VIFF! VIFF!", the Spanish-named ones
  "¡Guau! ¡Guau!") and its owner's call. Bijou is a small white poodle, the breed of the dog on
  Angerud's portrait (research-characters.md:279), not named Chérie. The farm's dog is Chispa, a
  yellow mutt. They are not cast and not characters: in no NPC list and no `allChars`, so no kick,
  stomp, car or stage reaches them, and they add no SKANDAL (§1.2).
- **Its lot.** A bungalow dog keeps its lot from the front wall (local z 0.75) to the back wall, and
  `reach` = 2 m into a neighbour's garden beside it (the front gardens are open between the lots, in
  front of the dividers), never out over the front wall (it stays `wallIn` = 1.35 m in), the back wall
  or onto a side street. The farm dog keeps the yard x [−30.1, −2.6], z [−30.1, −14.8] (block-local:
  from the canes on the west and north to the fields; not the track at x 6, where the vischan scene
  parks the car) and 2 m round it. It runs round its lot's walls (the house; at the farm the finca,
  and the tank with its ramp as one box) by the shortest way over their corners 1.2 m out (clear of
  the bougainvillea at a bungalow's front corner), slides off anything else over `climb` = 0.45 m above
  its feet and off water, never stands higher than 0.45 m over its yard (so no ramp takes it up the
  tank) and is pushed out of any car's box; a car coming at it faster than 2 m/s makes it hop aside
  (the pigs' rule, §10.15).
- **Home and the wall.** It lies by the front door (`rest`; the farm's by the finca's), its head
  turned to him when he is within 14 m. Stig (on foot or in his car) within `hearR` = 9 m of its lot,
  outside it: it runs to the inside of its wall opposite him (`alert`, `alertSpeed` 4.2 m/s) and
  barks; `alertHold` = 2.5 s after he has gone it trots home (`trot` 2.4 m/s). His car in its lot: it
  barks from `carR` = 4.5 m off.
- **In its lot.** Stig on foot and on his feet inside the lot: it rushes at him (`rush`, `speed`
  6.5 m/s) and stops `stopR` = 1.3 m off (`bay`), barking every `barkGap` 0.9–1.5 s (the bubble,
  `barkSecs` 0.9 s; `audio.woof` within `barkHear` = 35 m), its head jerking up each time; as he moves
  it keeps 1.3 m from him at a walk. He cannot walk through it: it stands its ground and he is pushed
  off it. When no nearer for `stuck` = 0.7 s (against a car, a wall, a trampoline) it stays where it
  is. Out through the gate (or past `reach` into the next garden) it stops at its edge (`back`), barks
  after him for `backSecs` = 2.2 s and trots home.
- **Stig.** While it is at him within `poseR` = 5 m his hands are up by his head, palms out, trembling,
  his eyes on it (`anim.placate` 1, §14.6; only a look). Its first arrival within `firstR` = 3.2 m:
  "Fin hund… fin hund…" [F*](t); then every `lineGap` = 3.4 s while it bays at him on the ground
  "Lugn… lugn nu…" [N], "Jag går nu. Jag går." [N] and "Fin hund… fin hund…" in turn (each only when
  he is saying nothing else).
- **Up out of its reach.** He is up when standing at least `upH` = 0.8 m over its yard (a car roof, a
  garden wall, the tank's rim, a tomato crate) or on a trampoline (where he bounces as on any; a jump
  is not up). It runs as near as it gets (round the house to the trampoline; for him on the tank to
  the side of the tank's box nearer him, the yard's side on a near-tie) and stands rearing up at him,
  barking. Stig: "Snälla hund… sitt!" [N] (0.4 s after he is up), then the mantra `S.mantraLine` "Jag
  kan flyga, jag är inte rädd." [F*] (Levander's exercise, research-plot.md:176, relocated) with his
  arms straight out (`placate` 2 for `mantraSecs` = 2.6 s: a look, not `wings`, which would stop him),
  then "Fin hund… fin hund…", in turn.
- **The call.** After `callAfter` = 7 s up (or `groundCall` = 18 s in its lot on the ground, so nobody
  is barked at for ever) the owner whistles from the house (`audio.whistle`) and calls it, unseen: a
  bubble (`callSecs` 2.6 s) at the door nearer Stig (the back door when he is on the trampoline behind
  the house), "¡Bobi! Hit!" [N] (the idea's), "Bijou! Kom till matte!", "¡Rufo! ¡Ven aquí!", "Kasper!
  Hit med dig!", "¡Lola! ¡A casa!", "Pirre! Kom nu!", "Trofast! Ligg!", "¡Tango! ¡Basta ya!", "Ludde!
  Kom hit!", "¡Pelusa! ¡Aquí!", "¡Canelo! ¡Ven!", "Sickan! Hit, sa jag!", at the farm "¡Chispa! ¡Ven
  aquí!" (all [N]). It trots home wagging and lies down, deaf to him for `restSecs` = 40 s (`called`,
  `calm`). `thanksAt` = 1.6 s after the call, if he is on foot within 25 m of that door: "Tack… tack
  så mycket!" [N]. Nobody is ever seen: there are no owners on the lots and no farmer at the finca.
- **Only in free roam.** `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`; otherwise (`release`)
  every dog is hidden at home and his hands come down, so no mission stage, timer, fixture or
  calibration pool meets a dog. Eslövloppet (§10.12, the one free-roam pool) runs on the roads round
  block (0,1), 4.5 m outside the yard's canes, where Chispa can only bark from inside; its walker ran
  28.18 s three times on this feature's tree, as in its pool. A dog further than `farR` = 75 m from
