  him (or his car) is put away (hidden at home, lying); with at most 2 a block and the blocks 80 m
  apart, rarely more than two are awake at once.
- `dogs.events` ({ t, name, kind: alert | rush | up | call | back }), `dogs.enc` and each dog's
  `mode`, `calm` and `lot` are for tests; nothing is saved. Scenario `hund` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): 12 dogs, picked by trampoline and car rather than
  every fourth lot; they bark at him from inside the wall rather than only being heard from the
  sidewalk; the farm's dog is Chispa (Bobi, with the idea's "¡Bobi! Hit!", is the first bungalow dog);
  the owner calls after 18 s on the ground too; the dogs do not react to other people, the horn or the
  night; the call bubble stands at a door, with nobody there.

### 10.22 Badgäster på solstolarna – and Berra and Robban fried (free roam; feature 32, 2026-10-17)

`game/bathers.js` (`Bathers`, owned by Game as `bathers`), config `BATHERS` in content/island.js. The
island's sun loungers, each with its SunTrip towel and the beach's `RESERVADO · RESERVIERT · UPPTAGET`
sign, had never had anyone on them; now tourists lie there and cook, and between buss17 and the
bodega Berra and Robban sleep lobster red on Flamenco's pool deck (the film's scene 7.8,
research-plot.md:296: they fall asleep in the sun, before the bodega odyssey). The bathers, their
burn and the fly-off are [N] (§1.6).

- **When.** `live`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`, `levelDef.sim.peds`; the bathers by
  day only (`day.isDay()`, the clock's `dayHours` 7–19; in test mode the clock holds at 15:00). Any
  other state or level (`reset`): every bather is hidden at once and Berra and Robban go home (below),
  so no mission, cutscene, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it.
- **Who lies where.** Every `solstol` (225 on the island: the beaches, the hotel and apartment pools)
  has a draw (`roll`; mulberry32 from `seed` 3201 + its index × 7919 + `dayN` × 104729 + `n` × 613): taken
  at `share` = 0.4, a look seed, a time lain (the session's first crowd 0 to `burn[1]` + 120 s, so the
  first beach is mixed; a morning's 0–60 s), its arms (`side` or `belly`, even odds) and a head tilt
  (±0.25). A new morning (`dayN` + 1, the day palette after night) draws again for every lounger
  without a body: a new crowd. Of the taken loungers at most `max` = 10, the nearest within `r` = 40 m
  of `focus()` (him or his car), have a body, kept to `out` = 48 m; with all ten in use a taken lounger
  `swap` = 6 m nearer than the furthest body takes it. Reserved (no bather): Berra's and Robban's two
  in their window, and the Berra job's lounger (`berraSolstol`, §10.6) while the job is `active`.
- **No popping in view.** A body appears or goes (or changes its burn) only while its lounger is out
  of the camera's frustum (a 1.4 m sphere round it) or more than `seenR` = 24 m off, or within
  `cutSecs` = 1.2 s of a cut (free roam beginning: a mission's end, a load; the focus jumping 15 m or
  more in a frame: R, a warp). One body is built a frame (a rebuilt `Character`, about 3 ms; the old
  model's geometries are disposed; bodies are made on demand, never more than `max`).
- **The look.** A `randomPed` tourist (drawn again until not `local`: no nationality, the Swedish
  tourists' barks, no German text, §1.3), without `held`, in the skin of his stage, one of three by
  the seed: `skins` pale `0xf6d3c0 0xf2c9a8 0xf4dcc8`, pink `0xf7947a 0xf28c74 0xf9a086`, lobster red
  `0xf0705a 0xec6852 0xf47a62`. The stage is the time on the lounger: pink from `burn[0]` = 150 s,
  lobster red from `burn[1]` = 360 s (by day the clock's hour is 60 s: two and a half hours, six), so
  whoever comes back finds the beach cooked.
- **Lying** (`Character.lieAt`, the `lie` pose, §14.6): the hips 0.08 × scale over the seat (0.395 over
  the lounger's foot) and as far towards the backrest as the back of the torso (`torsoD / 2` + 0.01)
  reaches its face (through u 0.636, y 0.596, sloping 0.75); facing down the bed (the prop's yaw + π),
  leaning back 0.75 on the backrest, the legs on the seat. The lounger's facing is its backrest end,
  so on the beach (yaw 0, backrests to the sea) they face the land, as the loungers were built. Lying
  bodies are not people: no physics, not in `allChars`; a car meets the lounger.
- **The fly-off.** A kick, a stomp or a car through a taken `solstol` is the props' own smash
  (debris, a coin, the lounger's SKANDAL: 1 × 0.7 on foot, × 1.2 in a car, × `gain`; Stig's `prop`
  sorry, §10.14; Herr Storch's witness as for any offence, §10.11). `Game.onPropBroken` then calls
  `bathers.onPropBroken`: the bather goes off backwards over the backrest, a somersault about his own
  right axis at `flip` = −11 rad/s from his lean (`fling`'s `flip`), at `back` = 3.2 m/s along the
  lounger's facing plus `push` = 0.25 × the kick's push (8 m/s along it) or `carK` = 0.5 × the car's
  velocity, and `up` = 6.5 m/s (+ 0.12 × the car's speed), with `audio.ouch` and an OUCH bark (1.8 s,
  the Swedish tourists' table: "Jag ska tala med platschefen!", the SunTrip and the fuel-surcharge
  lines, "Aj!"). He adds no SKANDAL and is **not a person hit** (no `onCharHit`, no `hit` sorry). He
  lands as any flung body, and on his feet (`onGetUp`, first: true for a bather) says a GETUP bark
  within `getUpR` = 30 m, always (one of the table's three sun lines: "Det är ju fan vad solen tar här
  nere." is one, so the line gets no new copy); he stands turned to Stig within 12 m, and is gone once
  he has stood 4 s under the appear rule, or at `out` m. Off his lounger he is a person (`loose`: in
  `allChars` and `areaHit`'s people): a car or a kick on him then counts as on any pedestrian.
- **Back.** A lounger back after its smash (tickProps: 75–115 s, him 70 m off) has someone new on it:
  taken, a new draw (`n` + 1), lain 0 s (pale).
- **Berra and Robban, fried** (`stekt`). From missions index `from` = 6 to `to` = 8 (friskotek or
  asnan next) they lie on two pool-deck loungers in Flamenco's north row, `stektBerra` (8.2, 21.6) and
  `stektRobban` (6.6, 21.6) (§6.3), 12–13 m from BAR PISCINA and in the sun (the row by the bar the
  idea named, (8.9, 8.6) and (8.9, 10.6), lies under the parasol at (10.2, 9.6), whose shade falls on
  it with the day sun from (70, 130, 45): their red read brown). Claimed together when both are free
  (standing, shown, in no car or seat, not busy, `honk.free`, not the waiting mission's giver or extra),
  both loungers stand, no dialogue, and the two men's places and the two loungers are each more than
  `clearR` = 50 m off or out of view (or in the cut window): the outfit `stekt` (their island looks
  with `STEKT_SKIN` 0xf0705a, models.js), `busy`, `spot` `stekt`, lying (Berra's arms `side`, his head
  −0.15; Robban's `belly`, 0.2), `slump` (asleep: the head lolling, the mouth open). Every `snoreEvery`
  = 4.5 s, by turns, within `snoreR` = 30 m, outside dialogue and while the man says nothing else:
  Berra "Zzz…" [N] and "Zzz… Pepes Bodega… zzz…" [N] in turn, Robban "Zzz…" [N] (2.4 s).
- **The wake.** The interactable `stekt:wake` at Berra (`wake.r` = 2.4, `wake.prompt` "<b>E</b> Väck
  Berra" [N]), while both are held, Berra lies, no wake runs, no dialogue, Stig on foot: Stig turns to
  him, "Ursäkta… ni bränner er." [N] (2 s); at `liftAt` = 1.6 s Berra lifts his head (`liePose.lift`
  eased at 5/s to 1) with "Fem minuter till…" [N] (`liftSecs` = 2.4 s), then lays it down again;
  `gap` = 0.9 s later Robban in his sleep, "Fan, vad jag är törstig…" [F*] (his line on the
  countryside walk, research-plot.md:318, relocated); 2.4 s later the snores go on. No cinematic:
  bubbles, and Stig keeps his keys.
- **Their lounger smashed:** off it in the same somersault, with no word (he sleeps through it), then
  `down` held (his timer 999), snoring on the ground; with the lounger back (him 70 m off) and the man
  and the lounger unseen, on it again. No SKANDAL beyond the lounger's.
- **Handed back.** Anyone else's placement (a forced `placeNpcs`, a scene: `spot` no longer `stekt`,
  or hidden or seated) ends the hold: no `slump`, a `stekt` outfit back to their island look (the
  level's set with the unlocks' overrides). Out of the window (a mission start, any state but idle;
  the other level; index 8 on) they go home at once (`placeNpc` to their HOMES spot at the bar),
  standing, awake, in their own skin, `busy` false, `spot` null. So friskotek's and asnan's intros and
  stages, and the bodega's intro with Berra's "Det är ju fan vad solen tar här nere, Robban." as its
  first line, are as before (red in that intro would be the user's decision: the idea leaves it open).
- **The shark warning** (feature 44, §10.30): `scare(x, z, r, flee)` stands every bather lying on a
  lounger within r m of (x, z) up beside it (0.9 m out, away from (x, z)) and makes him loose with
  `bather.flee`: `step` walks him away from (x, z) at `flee.speed` for `flee.secs` with `anim.flail`
  (not turned to Stig meanwhile), then he stands and goes as any loose bather. His lounger's `occ` is
  false, so it stays empty until the next morning's draw; `put` clears the flee and the flail.
- `bathers.last` ({ kind: 'claim' | 'flyoff' | 'stekt' | 'wake' | 'letGo', who?, t, x?, z?, car?, up?,
  step? }) and `held` are for tests; nothing is saved. Scenarios `badgaster` and `stekt`; `perf`'s
  `playa` view measures the beach with its bathers (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): Berra's and Robban's loungers moved to the sunny
  north row (above); the bathers do not walk to their loungers, lay out towels or redden smoothly
  (three stages, rebuilt unseen); the bathers keep to the day and a new crowd comes each morning; the
  fly-off line is the OUCH table's bark (the platschef line one of four); Stig gets a line of his own
  at the wake ("Ursäkta… ni bränner er.", the idea had none); the wake is bubbles, not a scene; a lying
  bather is reached through his lounger, not as a person in `allChars` (he joins it once off it); Stig
  pink after the bodega (the idea's cheap extra) is not built.

### 10.23 Bränsletillägg tillkommer – SunTrip-butiken (free roam; feature 34, 2026-10-17)

`game/suntripShop.js` (`SuntripShop`, owned by Game as `shop`), config `BUTIK` in content/island.js,
the counter in world/blocks/hotels.js (`suntripShop`, `SUNTRIP_SHOP`). The film's travel agency in
Stockholm sells the Storches high season, cancellation cover, travel insurance and the fuel surcharge,
"SunTrips Trapp Trull-konto" with a sun hat and a beach bag, and a nose guard "också gratis"
(research-plot.md:135–142); later on Gran Canaria Stig-Helmer wears a white SunTrip bucket hat,
sunglasses and a light short-sleeved shirt with small dots (research-characters.md:111–112). Here the
agency's counter stands on the island and Stig pays the add-ons; the shop and his buying there are
[N] (§1.6), its lines the agency's, relocated.

- **When.** `live`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. Then the counter's group
  (`SUNTRIP_SHOP.group`: the counter, its signs, the wares, the price board) is shown and its two solids
  (`SUNTRIP_SHOP.blocks`: the counter from the window to its front, kind `'counter'`, top C + 1.02, so
  nobody walks behind it; the price board, kind `'sign'`) are live (each block's `dead` is a getter,
  `!SUNTRIP_SHOP.live()`), and the travel agent stands behind it. In any other state or on the other
  level all of it is gone at once (the group hidden, the solids dead, the clerk hidden, the queued
  lines dropped), so no mission stage, cutscene, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it
  (friskotek's balls are blown about within 30 m of `friskotek`, which takes the porch in). No free-roam
  race runs near it (Eslövloppet is on vischan).
- **The counter** (§6.3): yellow with a red top, x [−11.9, −8.5] local, 0.6 m deep at its front (z
  [21.6, 22.2]) and closed to the window by side panels; `SUNTRIP-BUTIKEN` [N] on two posts over the
  clerk's head, just under the awning; `BRÄNSLETILLÄGG TILLKOMMER` [N] (the title screen's fine print)
  on its front; west of it the price board on two legs, turned 0.38 rad to the counter's front:
  `PRISER I PTA / SOLHATT 100* / SOLGLASÖGON 150 / PRICKIG SKJORTA 200 / NÄSSKYDD 0 / *TRAPP
  TRULL-KONTO` [N] (the account [F*]). On the counter from the west: the white hat with its red band
  and SunTrip's sun, the sunglasses on a stand, the folded dotted shirt, a box of nose guards
  (`SUNTRIP_SHOP.wares`, world positions). The beach bag (`SUNTRIP_SHOP.bag`, its own mesh, yellow
  with red stripes and handles) stands on the porch at the counter's west end while the account's bag
  waits. Lasse at `suntrip` is 3–5 m west; his missions are given elsewhere (friskotek, the airport),
  so his talk never takes the counter's E.
- **The travel agent** (`clerk`, "Reseförsäljaren", the film's uncredited agent, research-
  characters.md:504–507): a figure of the module's own (not in `CHARS`, not in `allChars`: no kick,
  car or SKANDAL), short brown hair, a thin moustache, a white T-shirt with a yellow band and a red
  `SUNTRIP` printed on it (`bib`, `bibC` '#d8321e'), at `SUNTRIP_SHOP.clerk` (local (−10.2, 21.05),
  facing the street). He turns to the focus within 10 m, else back; his mouth goes with his bubble. Not
  Gabbe (the idea's first choice): Gabbe's home is the stage, and after the end he plays in the pool
  fest's ring (§10.13).
- **Greeting.** Once a session, him within `greetR` = 4.5 m on foot: "Välkommen till SunTrip-butiken!
  Bränsletillägg tillkommer." [N].
- **The wares** (`items`; E at `r` = 1.25 m from a ware, Stig on foot, standing, carrying nothing, no
  dialogue). Prompt: `<b>E</b> Köp {name} ({n} pta)` [N] with the sign's price, the nose guard `<b>E</b>
  Ta ett nässkydd (gratis)` [N]:

  | id | name | base | add-ons (högsäsong, avbeställningsskydd, reseförsäkring, bränsletillägg) | total | paid now | sell line | Stig |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | `hatt` | solhatten | 100 | 25, 25, 25, 50 | 225 | 75 (Trapp Trull) | "Solhatten säljer vi bara på SunTrips Trapp Trull-konto. Strandväskan ingår!" [F*] | "Det var en väldigt massa tillägg…" [F*](t) |
  | `glas` | solglasögonen | 150 | 25, 25, 25, 50 | 275 | 275 | "Solglasögon. Med solfilter, för en blygsam merkostnad." [F*] (the bungalow seller's words) | the same sigh |
  | `skjorta` | den prickiga skjortan | 200 | 50, 25, 25, 50 | 350 | 350 | "Vad den kostar? Det beror på var du bor." [F*] (the agent's answer to the Storches) | the same sigh |
  | `nasa` | ett nässkydd | 0 | –, –, –, 50 | 50 | 50 | "Nässkydd – det får du också gratis." [F*] | "Gratis… plus bränsletillägg." [N] |

  Bought: the purse goes down by what is paid now (`addCoins(−n)`, `audio.coin`; never `game.pay`, so
  Ole never pays), he turns to the clerk, the clerk says the sell line, and the receipt is a toast
  (class `receipt`, 7.5 s): `Kvitto · SunTrip` [N], then a line per entry, `solhatt 100` [N], `+ högsäsong
  25` …, `= <b>225 pta</b>`, each `lineSecs` = 0.45 s after the last (a CSS fade per line, style.css);
  on the account a last line `Trapp Trull-konto: 75 pta nu, resten i 2 avbetalningar` [F*]. A bell
  (`audio.pling`) with the total, and Stig's line `sighAt` = 0.5 s after it. Short of what is paid now:
  the clerk's "Med alla tillägg blir det {total} pta, tyvärr." [N], or under `poorBelow` = 50 pta (the
  fuel surcharge) "Det räcker inte ens till bränsletillägget." [N]; nothing is paid or bought.
- **His look.** What he owns and has not taken off is worn at once (`shop.worn`, ids in item order) as
  a layer over his outfit (`setPlayerOutfit` → `shop.dress`, §10.4): the hat `{ hat: 'bucket', hatC:
  0xf4f1e8, hatBand: 0xd8321e, hatSun: true }`, the sunglasses `{ shades: 0x2a2a2a, glasses: null }`,
  the shirt `{ shirt: 0xf6f3ea, print: [0x2f6ad8], printStyle: 'dots', longSleeves: false, collar: true }`
  with the suit's parts off (over `kostym` his brown trousers stay, over `hawaii` the shorts), the nose
  guard `{ noseGuard: 0xfafaf6 }` (the new look fields, §14.6). E at a ware he owns takes it off (`<b>E</b>
  Ta av {the}` [N]; the nose guard's `the` "nässkyddet") or puts it on again (`<b>E</b> Ta på {the}`
  [N]), free. The layer is only `live` and never over `rio`; out of `live` (a mission start: the runner
  leaves `idle`) it comes off at once, and back when the runner is idle again; in a car a change waits
  until he is on foot, so no car seat holds a model scaled for another head (`seat` shrinks him by the
  hat, as by any head: in every enterable car type the hat stays under `roofY` and the brim within the
  body, `butikbil`). The flight level never sees it. Kept after a restart (§10.5).
- **SunTrip's Trapp Trull account** (the hat only, `trapp`: `parts` = 3): a third of the total now (75),
  and `parts` − 1 instalments of the same, each after `every` = 150 s of free roam (the account's
  clock runs only while `live` and out of dialogue): a toast "Trapp Trull-kontot: avbetalning {i} av
  {k}, {n} pta" [N] (`audio.coin`), the last with "Trapp Trull-kontot är betalt. Tack för att du reser
  med SunTrip!" [N]. With less than 75 in the purse it waits `retry` = 15 s and tries again (nothing
  floors at 0, nothing is owed further). Saved (`trapp`, `trappT`).
- **The beach bag and "Paketet!"** The account's bag waits by the counter (`bagWaiting`: the hat owned,
  the bag not taken). E at it (`<b>E</b> Ta strandväskan` [N]): Stig's "Paketet. Ja. Tack." [N], and it
  is gone (saved, `bag`). Walking or driving `leaveR` = 8 m from `butik` while it waits, after having
  been within `backR` = 4 m: the clerk calls "Paketet!" [F*] (the film's running gag, research-
  plot.md:133) (`yell`), once per departure; back within 4 m arms it again.
- **Ole sees the hat.** Bought, or put on again at the counter, the hat makes Ole's next sight of it
  (`oleDue`) a line: him within `oleR` = 7 m of Ole (shown, `honk.free('ole')`, not busy or in a car,
  saying nothing): "Nå ser du ut som en ekte sydenturist, Stig-Helmer!" [N] (3 s; his chatter waits
  8–12 s). Not saved: a restart does not repeat it.
- `shop.last` ({ kind: 'buy' | 'short' | 'toggle' | 'bag' | 'paketet' | 'instalment' | 'ole', id?,
  total?, paid?, lines?, need?, coins?, on?, i?, n?, d?, t }) is for tests. Scenarios `butik` and
  `butikbil` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the clerk is the film's travel agent, a new
  figure, not Gabbe; the bag goes into his luggage (no bag in his hand), and taking it is a prompt of
  its own; an instalment falls due after 150 s of free roam, not after missions; owned wares can be
  taken off and put on again at the counter; Ole's line is said in person, not on the radio; the
  SunTrip T-shirt for 15 kr is not sold; the layer is worn in free roam only (the idea's "behåller det
  i free roam", and the binding free-roam rule), so missions and their cutscenes show his own outfit.

### 10.24 Kontrollerad av G17 – the island's toasters (free roam; feature 33, 2026-10-17)

`game/toasters.js` (`Toasters`, owned by Game as `toasters`), config `BRODROST` and the set
`COLLECTIBLES.brodrostar` in content/island.js, the kind `brodrost` in actors/pickups.js. Stig-Helmer's
one boast in the film is his job: "Om du köper en brödrost, och det står 'Kontrollerad av G17', så är
det jag." (research-plot.md:61, research-characters.md:94–95; said to Majsan by the pool, :286, and in
the game in fataga's intro, island.js:450 [F]). Now the label is on the island: a third collectible set
whose pickup is a timing game. The game, the toasters and the label on them are invented (§1.6).

- **The toasters.** Seven unbranded 1979 chrome pop-up toasters (§1.5), a little over life size
  (0.42 × 0.24 × 0.225 m: bakelite base and ends, a rounded chrome top with two slots, a red lever on
  the front's right, a browning knob on its left), each on something that was there, with no collider of
  its own (the counter, crate or table's solid is what he meets), so no route, mission or calibration
  pool changed: FERRETERÍA's paint-can crate (its two east cans of each row gone, `brodrost_ferreteria`),
  BAR PISCINA's counter at its south end (`brodrost_poolbar`, 3.6 m from Berra's `flamencoBar`: a giver's
  talk reaches 3.4 m, so Berra's prompt never hides it at its front), stall K's counter at the market in
  its radios' gap 5 (`brodrost_marknad`), the porter's desk east of the bell (`brodrost_portier`),
  SUPERMERCADO's east fruit crate, its fruit gone (`brodrost_supermercado`), a terrace table at Casa
  Lola, the game's Grill Paco (`brodrost_grillpaco`), and the lost-and-found counter at Gando
  (`brodrost_hittegods`). Landmarks with `y` (the top) and `yaw` (the front, where Stig stands; §6.3).
  They stand all the time, in missions too (asnan's cut to the FERRETERÍA front shows the crate's one).
  The parts that move (`setToaster(mesh, { bread, up, lever, label })`): the lever (0.165 up, 0.075
  down), the two slices in three looks (`pale`, `golden`, `burnt`; down in the slots, or 0.1 up so 7.5 cm
  stick out), and the yellow `KONTROLLERAD / AV G17` label [F*] on the front, hidden until it passes.
- **When.** `live`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`. Free: on foot, `normal`, not in a
  dialogue, not carrying, not frozen, no PANIK, no SKANDAL pursuit (the porter's bribe has the desk's
  E then), not in the pool fest's ring or on the baggage belt. Each toaster is an interactable (`r`
  1.3, priority −1: a giver's talk goes first, as does any interactable over 0; it goes before a car).
  The reception's bell beside `brodrost_portier` has the same priority (feature 59, §10.37): the nearer
  one wins, and in front of the toaster that is the toaster.
  The prompt `<b>E</b> Kontrollera brödrosten` [N]; a passed one has none. The minimap shows the ones
  not passed within 45 m while `live` (`idle`).
- **A try.** E pushes the lever down (`audio.toasterDown`), the bread goes down, Stig turns to it, and
  the objective card (`objective()`, last of the free-roam cards in `updateHud`) shows the title
  `KONTROLLERAD AV G17` [F*], `Tryck E när brödet är gyllenbrunt` [N] and the haggle's bar as a scale:
  the fill a gradient from pale (left) through golden to burnt black (right), the golden field a
  `zone` 0.22 wide whose left edge is drawn in `zoneAt` [0.48, 0.60] (fill and cream edges from
  `zoneColor`), and the marker, which crosses the bar once, left to right, in `secs` = 3.2 s ×
  `speedUp` 0.92 to the power of the toasters already passed (3.2, 2.94, 2.71, 2.49, 2.29, 2.11,
  1.94 s: the field lasts 0.70 s on the first, 0.43 s on the last), real time. The clockwork ticks
  (`audio.tick`) every 0.4 s; past the field a wisp rises. The active toaster's interactable reaches 3 m
  with priority 100 and the prompt `<b>E</b> Upp med brödet!` [N], so E pops it, never a talk or a car.
- **The pop** (E, or the marker at the right end): the lever up, the bread jumps 1.8 × and settles in
  0.3 s (`audio.pop`), and by the marker:
  - in the field (`ok`): golden bread, "Gyllenbrun. Godkänd!" [N] from Stig with his arms up (`cheer`,
    1.6 s), three wisps, then the set's `collect` (+250 pta, the `pling`, a golden sparkle, the collect
    card `G17-brödrostar n/7`, the save; `keep` dresses it with the label and golden bread up); 7/7: the
    set's 1000 pta and Majsan on the radio 2.4 s later, "Så det är du som är G17! Nu vågar jag köpa en
    brödrost." [N];
  - before it (`pale`): "Blekt. Underkänd." [N], the toast "För blekt. Tryck E för en ny provrostning."
    [N] and `audio.thud`;
  - after it (`burnt`): black bread, five dark smoke puffs and more for 2.4 s, Stig flailing (1.4 s)
    with "Det här hade aldrig gått igenom på lagret." [N], the toast "Bränt! Underkänd. Tryck E för en ny
    provrostning." [N]; and 1.2 s later the nearer sister within 25 m who is free (`honk.free`, not
    saying anything) says "Bara de inte är ingenjörer." [F*] (said on the plane, research-plot.md:199,
    the source not saying which sister), at most once in 45 s: at the pool bar they hear it from the
    deck.
  A miss is tried again with E after `restSecs` 0.6 s; no timer, no SKANDAL, nothing lost.
- **Off.** A try is off (the lever and bread up, no result) when he is over `cancelR` 3 m from it or no
  longer free (above). A mission start or the other level (`reset`) also drops the queued sister line
  and Stig's pose and puts the bread of every toaster not passed back to pale and up.
- **Saved** in the set (`collected.brodrostar`, §10.5); a load marks them. `toasters.last` ({ id, kind:
  'ok' | 'pale' | 'burnt', mk, zone, secs, t }) and `tries` are for tests. Scenarios `brodrost` and
  `rostar` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): no new table or `TOSTADORAS ¡OFERTA!` sign (the
  sketch's): each toaster stands on what was there, so the world's solids are unchanged; FERRETERÍA's
  is on the paint-can crate, not in the shop window (the glass is opaque); the Supermercado and the
  Ferretería are both in Centro Nórdico, 50 m apart, as the idea lists them; the field's position varies
  a little from try to try; Stig gets a line at a pale one too (the idea's "Blekt. Underkänd.") and the
  toasts word the retry; the label and the counter carry the film's boast, which is not said again.

### 10.25 Rum 107 fylls med resans minnen – the keepsakes in room 107 (free roam; feature 38, 2026-10-17)

`game/room107.js` (`Room107`, owned by Game as `room107`), config `RUM107` in content/island.js, the
shelf and the keepsakes in world/blocks/hotels.js (`stigOleRoom`, `roomKeepsakes`, `ROOM107`). In the
film Ole shows his gadgets in the hotel room (the watch "digital och analog", the calculator with an
alarm, "'Pool Pen.'", the knife's "Sax – utan skruvmejsel.", the cameras; research-plot.md:255; the
money pouch and the goggles come later, :280–281) and furnishes it for his boombox: "Ja, det är fint!
Samba!" (:254). The suitcase comes back to the room's door on julafton morning (:362; the game cuts to
room 107 there), Majsan gives Stig the plastic giraffe at the julfest, "Precis en sån har jag önskat
mig." (:371; the speaker is the source's reading), and the money is in the crispbread pack (:373).
Now the trip comes home to room 107: what the collectibles find stands in the room. The shelf, what is
put on it and the lines at it are invented (§1.6).

- **The shelf** (hotels.js `stigOleRoom`; block (3,3), local = world; room 107 is x [−21, −15],
  z [−21.5, −14]): a wooden board over the print on the back wall, 3.8 × 0.24 m, its top at
  C + 2.6 = 2.75, on two brackets. Static and out of reach, with no collider, like everything here:
  no route, mission, timer, fixture or calibration pool changed.
- **The keepsakes** (`roomKeepsakes`): the collectibles' own models (`COLLECT_KINDS`, pickups.js),
  each a mesh of its own (the block's geometry is merged and cannot show one thing at a time), still,
  without the beam:
  - Ole's seven gadgets in `PRYL_IDS` order (klocka, poolpen, kalkylator, kniv, kamera, glasogon,
    pung) at 0.45 of their street size, standing on the shelf 0.5 m apart, each in its own place, so
    one not found yet is a gap;
  - the fins Stig trod down, flattened (each 0.7 m across and 0.14 m high), one more in the pile for
    each fin, each 3.5 cm higher and turned 0.95 rad further, on the floor before his bed's foot
    (about (−20.35, −18.9));
  - after julafton (unlock `bodega`): the suitcase (`vaska`, × 0.9, standing on the floor by the foot
    of Ole's bed; its green-white sticker is all there is of Hammarby, no text), the plastic giraffe
    (`giraff`, × 0.45, on Stig's bed by the pillow's outer end: in the nap his head lies beside it)
    and the SPORT-KNÄCKE pack (`knacke`, × 0.55, flat on Ole's bed, the label up). Not the painted
    donkey (Stig leaves it at Viking Bar for Angerud) and not the pack bought in asnan (it went into
    the fake present): only the one the money was in. During the trip the room fills only with gadgets
    and fins.
  `worldHooks.rum107(collected, unlocked)` shows what is there; main.js `dressRoom107()` calls it at
  every pickup (`collect`), every unlock (`unlock`) and a load (`applySaveToWorld`). `ROOM107` holds
  the meshes (`gadgets` by id, `fins`, `after` by kind) and `held`, the keepsake in his hand, hidden
  from its place meanwhile. The room is the same in missions: buss17's havsutsikt line and
  julafton's knock cut to `rum107Cam` and show what has been found (on julafton morning nothing of
  julafton's yet).
- **The E spots** (`RUM107`; landmarks `rum107Hylla`, `rum107Giraff`, `rum107Radio`, §6.3), live on
  the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. Free: on foot, `normal`, not in a dialogue (the nap, a
  talk), not carrying, not frozen, no PANIK, no SKANDAL pursuit, not in the pool fest's ring or on the
  baggage belt (the toasters' rule). Priority 0, so the nearest wins; the nap's `stigSang` (r 2.0)
  still answers from the middle of the side of Stig's bed and from its foot.
  - **The shelf** (`rum107Hylla` (−18, −18.9, π), between the beds' feet; `r` 1.3):
    `<b>E</b> Kontrollera hyllan` [N]. Stig turns to it and says "Kontrollerad av G17." [F*] (his
    boast, research-plot.md:61, relocated), or "Inget att kontrollera." [N] with no gadget and no fin
    found; the collect card shows `Oles prylar n/7 · Hajfenor m/7`; `oleAt` 1.4 s later Ole on the
    radio counts his gadgets: "{N} av sju! Snart er hylla full." [N] with N in bokmål (`nums`: En, To,
    Tre, Fire, Fem, Seks), "Hylla er tom – dingsene mine er spredt over hele øya!" [N] (after his line
    in friskotek's outro) with none, "Alle sju! Nå er hylla full." [N] with all seven. The next check
    after `gap` 4 s (no prompt meanwhile).
  - **The giraffe** (after julafton; `rum107Giraff` (−18.85, −21.05, −π/2), in the gap between the
    bed's head and the dresser, facing it; `r` 0.55): `<b>E</b> Ta upp giraffen` [N]. Stig turns to
    it and holds it up (the julfest's anim `giraffe`), the bed's one hidden (`held`), with "Precis en
    sån har jag önskat mig." [F*](t). For `holdSecs` 3.5 s the prompt is
    `<b>E</b> Ställ tillbaka giraffen` [N] (`dropR` 2.5 m, priority 100: over the nap's prompt and a
    giver's talk); it goes back on the bed with E, after 3.5 s, more than 2.5 m from the spot, or
    when he is no longer free.
  - **The boombox** (after the samba unlock, while the samba is not playing; `rum107Radio`
    (−18, −20.45, π), before the dresser; `r` 0.8): `<b>E</b> Spela samba` [N]. The island tune to
    the samba as the pause menu's Musik button sets it (`setIslandTune('samba')`, saved as `tune`; the
    music on if it was off), and Ole on the radio: "Ja, det er fint! Samba!" [F*] (his line in the
    room, in bokmål). The samba stays the gadgets' reward: the boombox is another way to the pause
    menu's choice. Since feature 67 (§10.36) it answers before the unlock too ("Bergsprängaren", Ole's
    "Kvarts og digital.", no tune), turns the samba off again ("Stäng av sambaen") and has Ole's
    "Hører du? Samba." every second time.
- **Off.** A mission start or the other level (`reset`): the giraffe back on the bed, Ole's queued
  count dropped.
- **The wardrobe** inside the door (feature 36, §7.2) is not one of these three spots: its E spot
  `rum107Garderob` (−19.6, −15.6, −π/2) is the SKANDAL hideout "Byt till kostymen" during a pursuit
  and "Byt till hawaiiskjortan" after it, and between them feature 67's "Byt kläder", a fourth
  Room107 spot (§10.36); its doors open only for those (`WARDROBE`, hotels.js).
- **Saved**: nothing new; the room follows `collected` and `unlocked` (§10.5). `room107.last`
  ({ what, … }) and `room107.world` (= `ROOM107`) are for tests. Scenarios `rum107` and `troferum`
  (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): Ole is on the radio, not in the room (he lives
  under the pergola, and every gadget line is on the radio); the giraffe stands by the pillow, not at
  the bed's foot as in the sketch (in the nap Stig's legs lay round it there), so its E spot is
  beside the bed's head; Ole's full-shelf line is not "Ja, det er fint! Samba!" (the boombox's); the
  G17 toasters (feature 33) stay where they stand with their labels and are not in the room; the
  boombox only switched to the samba (feature 67 made it a switch both ways, §10.36).

### 10.26 Smörj in Majsans rygg – the SOLKRÄM meter (free roam; feature 35, 2026-10-17)

`game/solkram.js` (`Solkram`, owned by Game as `solkram`), config `SOLKRAM` and the unlock
`UNLOCKS.sjuPoang` in content/island.js, the anim flag `rub` (§14.6), `audio.squirt` and `splat`
(§12.3). By the pool in the film: "Du, vill du smörja in mig på ryggen?" / "Ta inte för mycket, då kan
det börja koka." (research-plot.md:286; the source does not say who, the game gives both to Majsan
(t)), first heard in the game in fataga's intro (§8.11). After fataga she asks again in free roam and
Stig does it with a G17 inspector's care; the points scene on the plane ("Giraffen, då? Fyra." /
"Mindre än pizza-racern?" / "Det blir minuspoäng.", research-plot.md:197) becomes Siv's score for it.
The meter, scores for sun cream, Siv's cards and the cream running are invented (§1.6). The game has
no sunburn and no swimsuit: Majsan keeps her dress, and the shots stay on Stig's hands and face (§1.2).

- **When.** `live`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`, `missions.index` ≥ `fromIndex` 11
  (after fataga, index 10). By day (`day.isDay()`, DAY.dayHours 7–19). Stig free: on foot, `normal`, on
  the ground, not in a dialogue, not carrying, not frozen, no PANIK, no SKANDAL pursuit, not in the pool
  fest's ring or on the baggage belt, not in Eslövloppet (its clock would run on through the scene).
  Both sisters at home: on their HOMES spot (its spot id, within `homeR` 0.8 m), `normal`, shown, not
  `busy`, nobody's (`honk.free`: not the diving judges', the pool fest's, Majsan's round with the
  ticket pad, the grisfest evening's…), not the waiting mission's giver or extra (fataga's Majsan).
  After the end the pool fest's ring has the sisters whenever Stig is on the deck in its hours (9–23,
  §10.13), so then it is the morning, 07–09 (the nap wakes him at 08, §10.10).
- **The prompt.** An interactable on Majsan (`r` 1.8, priority 0; a giver's talk goes first): `<b>E</b>
  Smörj in ryggen` [N].
- **The ask.** E holds both sisters (`busy`), snaps Majsan to her spot (−1, 18) facing west and Stig
  `talk` 1.3 m in front of her, facing her, puts the bottle on the deck (unbranded: an orange body, a
  white cap and nozzle, 0.24 m, §1.5) and cuts to a side shot from the north (`camAsk`/`lookAsk`); Siv
  turns to them. A dialogue: the first time ever the film's pair [F](t) and Stig's "En kontrollerad
  mängd. Det är mitt yrke." [N] (the once-ever marker `solkramFilm` in the saved unlocks, saved at
  once); after it one of four asks of ours (`again`, [N]).
- **The meter.** Majsan turns her back (world yaw π/2, `stage.yaw`), Stig stands `back` 0.97 m behind
  her with his hands on her shoulders (`rub` 1), and the shot from her front right (`cam`/`look`) holds
  his face and hands, Siv in the background at her place and the pool to the right. The letterbox goes
  off and the objective card (first in `updateHud`'s free-roam chain, §11.4) shows `SOLKRÄM` [N],
  `Håll E · släpp i det gröna` [N] and the haggle's bar as the cream (fill `#fffbea`, label `Majsans
  rygg` [N]), the green field and the marker on the fill. The field is `zone.w0` 0.26 wide on the
  session's first try and × `zone.shrink` 0.88 each try after it, down to `zone.min` 0.12; its middle
  is drawn in `zone.at` [0.55, 0.74] each try, and a light stripe ± `bull` 0.022 round it marks the 7.
  E must be seen up first (the dialogue's last skip press does not count); held, the fill rises at
  1/`secs` = 1/2.4 a second (real time), Stig rubs (`rub` 2), the bottle squeezes (`audio.squirt`
  every 0.28 s), a dab of cream grows on her back, and the card reads `Håll… håll…`, in the field
  `Släpp i det gröna!` and past it `Släpp! Släpp!` with a red fill labelled `För mycket!` [N]. No hold
  within `readySecs` 12 s: Majsan's "Jaha. Då får jag väl göra det själv." [N] and the scene ends.
- **The result** (E let go, or the bar full), by the fill against the field:
  - in the stripe (± 0.022 of the middle) **7**, within ± `six` 0.055 **6**, elsewhere in the field
    **5**: the hands rest, `audio.pling`, Siv holds up her card (`anim.card`, `cardSecs` 4.6 s) and
    the bubbles: 7 "Mm… precis lagom." [N], Siv's "Giraffen, då? Sju." [F*](t), Majsan's "Mer än
    pizza-racern!" [F*](t); 6 "Mm. Det där var skönt." [N], "Sex, tycker jag." [F*](t); 5 "Tack,
    Stig-Helmer." [N], "Giraffen, då? Fem." [F*](t). The result line (`#score`, §11.4) `SOLKRÄM n P`
    [N] over `NYTT REKORD!` or `REKORD n P` [N].
  - past the field (or held to 1) **over**, −1: a cut to behind them from her right
    (`camOver`/`lookOver`), Stig a step back (`overStep` 0.45 m) flailing for `flailSecs` 1.4 s,
    `audio.splat`; the dab stays and three drops run down her back over `drip` 1.6 s; "Oj! Nu kokar
    det!" [N], Stig's "Den här flaskan hade aldrig gått igenom G17." [N]; at `front` 3.2 s back to the
    front shot for Siv's –1 card, her laugh and "Det blir minuspoäng." [F*](t); `FÖR MYCKET! –1 P` [N].
  - short of it **early**, no points and no card: "Var det allt?" [N], Stig's "Man ska inte slösa."
    [N]; `FÖR LITE!` [N].
  The lines are bubbles at their delays (each up at least `lineSecs` 2.6 s) under the letterbox, and
  the scene ends `tail` 2.2 s after the last (4–6 s in all): the chase camera from her right side (the
  two of them side by side; from behind Stig it stood at Siv's place), the sisters free, no pose, the
  bottle and the cream gone. E again after `restSecs` 0.6 s; no timer, no SKANDAL, nothing lost.
- **Saved.** `records.solkram`, the best points (5–7), saved at once when beaten (§10.5). The first 7
  unlocks `sjuPoang` as its scene ends: the toast "Sju poäng! Nu pratar Siv om det vid poolen." [N]
  and Siv's island chatter is "Sju poäng till Giraffen. Mer än pizza-racern!" [N] from then on
  (`chatter`, §10.3). `solkram.last` ({ kind: 7 | 6 | 5 | 'over' | 'early' | 'giveUp', points, fill,
  zone, mid, record, best, t }), `phase`, `fill`, `zone`, `mid` and `tries` are for tests. Scenario
  `solkram` (§16.4).
- **Off.** The scene is a dialogue throughout (`inDialog`: no other E, kick, move or R), and the held
  sisters are `busy`, so the other free-roam modules leave them be. Not `live` (a mission start, the
  other level): any scene off at once (`reset`; the cinematic ends only if one of ours is under way, so
  a mission's intro keeps its own), Siv's card down, the result line hidden.
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the result lines are bubbles (as the sketches
  show), so the card and the score are seen; Stig adds a line [N] after the film's pair; his pose is
  `push`'s lean with the arms nearer level (`rub`), since `push` itself put his hands at her neck from
  behind; the field narrows with each try of the session (not saved); the cream running is seen from
  behind her right side with Stig a step back; no Ole's chlorine goggles (no goggles model); by day
  only, so after the end it is the morning before the pool fest's hours.

### 10.27 Stunthopp med G17-stämpel – his car's jumps judged (free roam; feature 40, 2026-10-17)

`game/stunts.js` (`Stunts`, owned by Game as `stunts`), config `STUNTHOPP` in content/island.js, the
plank in world/blocks/nature.js `bygge`. The island had jumps (the bygge's yellow ramp, the
half-built garages' decks) and nothing measured them. Now every real jump of his car gets a counter
in the air and a rubber stamp when it is over, and the flagship is a new plank off the bygge's first
floor, over the road at x 200 to the dream plane. The judging, the stamp and the plank are invented
(§1.6); the stamp's text is the label on his toasters in the film (research-plot.md:61), and the
run-out ends before the plane he stands before with his arms out in the film's dream
(research-plot.md:126).

- **The flight** (car.js, every car): leaving the ground (the ground more than 0.35 m below it, as
  before) sets `airT` 0 and `airFrom` { x, z, y }; `airT` counts the seconds in the air; every
  landing, a soft one too, calls `game.onCarAirEnd(car, impact)` before the old `onCarLanded`
  (impact > 4) and the landing damage (impact > 13). `place` clears `airFrom`. No physics changed.
- **When.** `live`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. Only his car (`playerCar`).
  A jump begins when his car is seen in the air (`update`) or, for a flight shorter than a frame, at
  its landing. Its first flight counts if it lasts `minAir` 0.35 s and goes `minDist` 6 m (the
  take-off to the touchdown, flat); a shorter one is dropped without a word. A flight that starts in
  the `settle` 1.0 s after a landing goes on with the jump: the air times and the distances add up
  (the yellow ramp's flight onto the big ramp and off its far side is one jump of two flights).
- **In the air** (from `showAt` 0.15 s): the result line (`hud.liveScore`, §11.4) shows `LUFTTID
  {t} S` [N] (one decimal, a decimal comma), the air time so far.
- **The verdict.**
  - `settle` 1.0 s after the last landing with no impact: **passed**. The stamp comes down for
    `stampSecs` 2.2 s (the banner, cls `stamp`, §11.4): `KONTROLLERAD AV G17` [F*] from mission
    index `g17From` 11 (fataga done: its intro is where the film's boast is first heard, island.js),
    `GODKÄND` [N] before it; `audio.stamp`, the camera shaken to 0.35. The card (`hud.showScore`,
    `cardSecs` 4.5 s): `LUFTTID {t} S · {d} M` [N] (whole metres), ` · +{n} PTA` when it pays, over
    `NYTT REKORD: {name}` [N] (teal) or `{name} · REKORD {d} M` [N] for a named jump, nothing for
    another.
  - An impact of his car (main.js `onCarImpact`, his car `involved`: a wall at over 2.5 m/s, a car
    at over 2) in the air or in the settle: **UNDERKÄND** [N] at once (cls `stamp fail`, tilted the
    other way; `audio.stampFail`), the card with the air time and distance so far and the jump's
    name. His car wrecked (`onCarDestroyed`): the engine's KVADDAD! first and the stamp `wreckAt`
    1.0 s later. Stig's `failLine` "Det där får jag kontrollera en gång till." [N] `lineAt` 0.45 s
    after the stamp, at most every `failGap` 20 s. The verdict never rests on damage: the plank's
    landing at about 15 m/s down costs the hire car about 5 hp.
  - **Off** with no verdict: out of the car, another car, a teleport (`place`), wrecked as nobody's,
    busted (`frozenT`), a dialogue, a mission start or the other level (`reset`: the result line
    down, the queued line and the arms dropped).
- **Named jumps** (`jumps`): the take-off point inside a square `r` m round a landmark, or over a
  half-built garage's deck 1 and `pad` m past its edge (town.js `frameRamps[].deck`), at `yMin` or
  higher:
  - `planka` **Bygget – drömplanet** [N]: `stunt_planka` (block (5,1) local (22, −1.4), the plank's
    end), r 3, yMin 4.0; the mantra and the dream (below).
  - `gula` **Gula rampen** [N]: `stunt_gula` ((5,1) (−16, 4), the yellow ramp's crest), r 3.5, yMin
    1.2.
  - `garage` **Garagedäcket** [N]: every frame lot's deck 1 (13 m × lot width − 4), pad 1, yMin 3.0.
  A named jump pays `pay.first` 100 pta the first time it passes and after that only a new record,
  `pay.record` 25 pta: its distance more than `recordBy` 0.5 m over the best. The best is
  `records.stunts[id]` (metres, one decimal), saved at once (§10.5). Another jump is judged and
  stamped, with no pay and no record.
- **The plank** (nature.js `bygge`): at the 1st floor's east end, local x [19.2, 22], z [−2.7, −0.1]
  (clear of the column at (22, −3)), a board rising east from the deck (S1 3.55) to S1 + 0.9 = 4.45
  at the floor's edge, on cement bags under its high end and a brick under its middle, with the
  yellow ramp's yellow and black stripes across its end; its collider is a `ramp` (2.6 × 2.8) under
  the board. The way to it: up the big ramp from the west road, then onto the 3 m strip between the
  2nd floor's block (from x 2) and the deck's south edge, whose orange rail is only a look. A route
  follower (scenario `stunthopp`: in along the big ramp's south edge at 9 m/s, round the S at 3.5 m/s,
  flat out along the strip) leaves the plank at 17.6 m/s (63 km/h): 0.93 s in the air, 16.4 m, 5.1 m
  over the road at the top, down on the road at x 198.6 and on into the dream plane's lot. Off the
  plank Stig says the mantra (S.mantraLine, [F*] here) in his bubble from `showAt`; at a pass
  `dreamLine` "Godkänd av G17. Det är ju jag." [N] (`g17From` on) or "Jag flög. Jag flög faktiskt."
  [N] before, `lineAt` s after the stamp (it may replace the mantra's bubble, nothing else). Out of
  the car within `arms.window` 20 s of that pass and `arms.r` 24 m of `stunt_landning` ((6,1) local
  (−26, −1.4), the run-out west of the wing tip), he stands with his arms out (`wings`) facing the
  plane (`pryl_kamera`, on the wing) for `arms.secs` 3 s (cannot walk meanwhile; a car or a fall ends
  it). The dream plane lot's palm moved from (−24, −2) to (−24, 6): it stood in the run-out's lane 17 m
  past the landing, so nearly every plank jump hit it within the settle (UNDERKÄND). Past the palm's
  old place the wing tip at x 223 is the run-out's end: brake, or meet it after the stamp.
- **The yellow ramp** (5 × 8 m, up to CURB + 1.8 northwards, inside the yard: the hoarding closes the
  street side, so the run-up is from the gate or the yard): at 20 m/s (73 km/h) the car flies 8.4 m
  in 0.42 s onto the big ramp's surface (1.85 there), crosses it and drops off its far side (0.40 s,
  8.7 m): one jump, 0.82 s, 17.2 m. At 16–17 m/s it comes down short of the big ramp and hits its side:
  UNDERKÄND. At 6 m/s it is a 0.47 s hop of 3.6 m: no jump.
- **A garage deck**: off deck 1's front edge at 14 m/s, 0.55 s and 7.4 m into the forecourt.
- **The dunes lift no car**, so they are not a named jump: a car follows the ground unless it drops
  0.35 m in a 60 Hz step, and their slip faces slope 0.46 (2.6 m over 5.6), so a car would need
  about 45 m/s to leave one (the windward faces and the ends slope 0.2, §6.4).
- `stunts.last` ({ kind: 'pass' | 'fail', id, air, dist, flights, pay, record, best, stamp, reason:
  'krock' | 'kvaddad', t }) is for tests. Scenarios `stunthopp` and `stuntzoner` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): no slow motion at the top of the jump (it would
  scale the game's clock, which the missions' measured timers and the other free-roam features share);
  the dunes are not a named jump (above); the dream plane lot's palm moved out of the run-out; the
  verdict on a wreck waits for KVADDAD!; a jump only pays once more for a record beaten by over half a
  metre; the arms out by the plane come only if he gets out there; no applause (the idea "Applåder
  eller tomater") and no dream scene ("Drömsynen vid drömplanet"): the judge (`stunts.last`, the
  verdict) is there for them to share.

### 10.28 Prata med gänget – E talks to the gang (free roam; feature 39, 2026-10-17)

`game/gangTalk.js` (`GangTalk`, owned by Game as `chat`), config `TALK_ISLAND` in content/island.js
(beside `CHATTER`), and `main.npcPosed(key)`. Between missions the gang no longer only bubbles past
Stig: by Ole, Majsan, Berra or anyone else of the twelve below, standing at their place (or as the
waiting mission's extra, e.g. the gang at the airport and on the friskotek lawn), `E Prata med
<namn>` plays a short exchange in bubbles in which Stig answers, and what they talk about follows the
trip. The fresh ones carry it: Ole's Rio line from the welcome meeting, which was nowhere in the game
("Tenk å sitte her i desember. Det er som i Rio." / "Har du varit i Rio?" / "Nei, men jeg skal reise
dit.", research-plot.md:268, speakers interpreted, Ole in bokmål), set up for the Rio end card; and the
julfest among the palms on julafton morning ("Måste man gå på den?" / "Var inte så typiskt svensk." /
"Det är väl typiskt svenskt att ha julfest bland palmerna." / "Du kan väl komma för min skull?",
research-plot.md:365, research-characters.md:225), before the party, where the film has it (the pool
fest after the end, §10.13, has its first three lines at the pool's edge). Many others are echoes, and
honestly so: Berra's "Ska du ha?" / "Nej tack, jag tål inte starksprit." / "Nej, vem fan gör det?" at
the bodega after the end (the gate's men's room, §8.1), Lasse's oath, Robban's "Invalido.".

- **When.** `active`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`, no dialogue. Stig free: on foot,
  `normal`, not carrying, not frozen, no PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the baggage belt, in
  the SOLKRÄM meter or a toaster's try. The person free (`free(key)`): `normal`, shown, no `steer` (no
  module walks them anywhere), not `npcPosed` (a mission's idle pose, the Berra job, the judges, Herr
  Storch filming, the rollerskier, the pool fest's ring, Majsan's round or Angerud's tow, the grisfest
  evening, the swearing souvenir seller), not the waiting mission's giver (his E starts the mission)
  and not Robban waving Stig over to the napping Berra (the job's own talk, §10.6).
- **The prompt.** `nearestInteractable` returns `{ type: 'chat', who }` after every interactable and
  before the cars: the nearest free person within `r` 3.0 m (height within 2 m) who has an exchange
  now; `updateHud` shows `S.promptTalk` (`<b>E</b> Prata med {name}`), as for a giver. An interactable
  on the person wins where it reaches: Majsan's sun cream (1.8 m, from index 11) inside, the talk
  from 1.8 to 3.0 m; the giver's 3.4 m talk wins over a neighbour's.
- **The exchange.** E (`interact` → `chat.start(who)`) turns Stig to them, takes down a bubble of
  theirs or his still up, and plays the lines one at a time through `game.say` (each up as long as
  `say` holds it, at least `secs` 2.2 s, then `gap` 0.35 s): about 2.5 s a line, 6–11 s an exchange.
  No prompt and no other talk while it runs, and no `inDialog`: a dialogue counts as a scene for the
  SKANDAL pursuit (shame.js), so a talk must not be a way out of a chase. A line's `anim` holds a pose
  flag on its speaker while it is up (Stig's `oath` for the friskotek oath, his `wings` for the mantra,
  which stops him for those 2.6 s as the mantra does). `with` names third speakers (Berra in Robban's
  customs exchange), who must stand free within `withR` 6 m of the person.
- **Which one.** An exchange holds while the waiting mission lies from `from` to `to` (mission ids:
  `to: 'julafton'` until julafton is done, `'end'` after the end), narrowed by `hours` ([from, to) on
  the free-roam clock, §10.10: Ole's "Morn, gutten min!" 06–11; the clock reads 15:00 in test mode) and
  `pryl` (Ole's watch found: then he asks Stig the time, and Stig reads it off in Spanish, Norwegian and
  Swedish time, `{es}` / `{no}`). E again plays the next one in table order after the one that person
  last played, round and round (per session, not saved).
- **The table** (12 people, 33 exchanges, 2–4 lines each; tags in content/island.js):
  - Ole: Rio (buss17–julafton); the donkey, "Undrar vad åsna heter på spanska." / "Cabalho
    folkloristico… nativo!" (bodega–julafton); the watch (from asnan, `pryl: 'klocka'`); the morning
    (from friskotek, 06–11); after the end "Concorde til Rio! 2 300 km i timen!" and Stig's mantra.
  - Majsan: "Lägg av, jag är trött på karlar!" (buss17–friskotek); her FR-terapi (asnan–grisfest); the
    julfest (julafton only); after the end "Jag vill inte åka hem." … "Fast utan bränsletillägg."
  - Siv: "En stor whisky och Sivan Åman är i form." … Valium (to julafton); Sture and the brown beans
    (to grisfest); Ole's calculator (fataga–julafton, after she has set her sights on him); after the
    end "Ole ska ta med mig till Rio!" / "Har han varit i Rio?" / "Nej, men han ska resa dit."
  - Berra: "Jag reser lätt." and Stig's lost bag (to julafton, when the bag comes back); after the end
    "Ska du ha?". Robban: "Invalido." with Berra's "Va? Var jag med där?" (to julafton); after the end
    Sulan's rum and "Du har ingen karaktär, du."
  - Angerud (never after the end: he is in hospital, and no line touches it, §1.2): "Alla tullare har
    varit barn." / "Psykologi." (to asnan); "Har du sett en lång, mörkhårig karl med glasögon och
    mustasch?" (bodega only, after he has the donkey; Stig is that man); "Tänk på det." about the
    hittelön (ropavieja–julafton).
  - Lasse: the week's programme with the jullekar (asnan–grisfest); after the end "Kommer du ihåg vad
    du lovade, Olsson?" and the oath. Affe tired (friskotek–julafton), Små grodorna after the end.
    Gabbe's nattur and Tonga Tonga (to grisfest), the bodega behind the hotel after the end.
  - Herr Storch: "Har du filmat länge sådär?" / "Hela resan." (to julafton, before the lens cap);
    after the end he has started again. Fru Storch: "Vi bor i Mjölby." and "Storch." (to julafton),
    the lens cap off after the end. José: "Datatekniker." (to ropavieja), his mamma at the dinner
    (from fataga).
  Who can be talked to depends on the trip: at index 7, 11 and 12 Ole is the giver; Berra and Robban
  lie fried on Flamenco's deck at 6–7 (§10.22) and from 12 the Berra job has them; after the end the
  pool fest's ring has Ole, Lasse, the sisters, Affe, Gabbe and Fru Storch whenever Stig is on the deck
  in its hours (9–23, §10.13), so their after-the-end exchanges are the evening's and the morning's.
- **Rules kept.** No line repeats a chatter line (CHATTER, CHATTER_FLIGHT, an unlock's `chatter`);
  every line has its source tag; Ole's are bokmål (his greeting "Morn, gutten min!", as in julafton's
  intro, §1.3). While a talk runs no chatter bubble starts (syncAll checks `chat.busy`), and after it
  every NPC within `hushR` 9 m keeps quiet `after` 4 s (`chatT`).
- **Off.** The talk stops when Stig is more than `leaveR` 8 m from the person, in a car or not
  `normal`, when the person or a third speaker is no longer free (kicked, taken by a module), or when
  free roam ends (a mission, a dialogue, the other level: then the bubbles it put up come down,
  only its own). `chat.last` ({ key, id, t, lines: [[who, text]], ended: 'done' | 'left' | 'third' |
  'free roam' }), `busy`, `lastId`, `options(key)`, `nextFor(key)` and `free(key)` are for tests.
  Scenario `prata` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): twelve people, not twenty (the gang, the SunTrip
  staff and José; the locals with own modules or no story are left out); one bubble at a time, not
  several up at once; the julfest exchange gets Majsan's "Du kan väl komma för min skull?" as its
  fourth line; the "cheap S variant" is done too, but only for the two stale lines (Gabbe's, the
  lost-and-found man's), as `UNLOCKS.bodega.chatter` (§10.3); the radius is 3.0 m (not the giver's
  3.4) so that Majsan's sun cream keeps its 1.8 m.

### 10.29 Hoppet mellan hotelltaken – the jump between the hotel roofs (free roam; feature 41, 2026-10-17)

`game/roofJump.js` (`RoofJump`, owned by Game as `roofs`), config `TAKHOPP` in content/island.js, the
roofs in world/town.js (`roofWalk`, `roofJumpFinish`, `ROOF_JUMP`). Levander's exercise ("Jag kan
flyga, jag är inte rädd.", research-plot.md:122–123) moves to a rooftop, seven storeys up, where the man
with a fear of flying has to jump a gap; on the far roof the brochure's promise ("Balkong med havsutsikt
och kvällssol.", research-plot.md:253) and, at last, his own sea view. The walkable roofs, the stairs,
the jump and the dive into the pool are [N] (§1.6); the high-rises are the 1980 resort's setting
(research-setting.md:117), not a film scene.

- **The pair** (§6.5): in (4,4)'s north row, opposite the petrol station, residential lots
  `4,4,0,1` and `4,4,0,2` (`ROOF_JUMP.lots`; `slabLot` now gets its lot id): HOTEL ATLÁNTICO (`atl`,
  x [71.61, 88.39], z [55.88, 66.64]) and APARTAMENTOS SOL DE INVIERNO (`sol`, x [92.06, 109.27], z
  [55.33, 66.57]), both seven storeys, the parapet's top at `floor` = C + 7·2.9 + 0.64 = 21.09. The gap
  between them (`ROOF_JUMP.gap`) is x [88.39, 92.06], z [55.88, 66.57]: 3.68 m (3.38 m between the
  parapets' 0.15 m overhangs, which are not floors). The fronts face north (−z) to the street, the
  backs south to the sea. Their names come from the hotel pool's order (`hotelNext`), as before.
- **Its solids.** `roofWalk` adds, per roof, `blocks`: the roof floor (the slab's footprint, top
  21.09, kind `'building'`), the stair tower's head (its footprint, top C + H + 1.6: 0.96 over the
  roof), and kind `'roof'` walls up there: the lift room (3.2 × 2.8, top C + H + 2.6), the two water
  tanks (r 0.7, C + H + 2.1), the antenna (r 0.12, C + H + 3.4), the name sign on its posts (the
  sign's width, 0.3 deep, C + H + 2.95) and on ATLÁNTICO the brochure's sign (3.4 × 0.3, the floor +
  2.05). Each one's `dead` is a getter, `!ROOF_JUMP.live()`; the slab's own two solids (the body and
  the stair tower, top 99) are captured in `slabLot` and get the opposite getter, `ROOF_JUMP.live()`.
  `roofJumpFinish` (after every block, before the signs are flushed) does the same for the trees in
  the gap: a tree's trunk collider reaches 99, so its two palms ((89.59, 58.38) and (90.86, 56.83))
  would be walls in the air up there; while live a twin circle stops at 8 m (the tallest crown 7.6).
  `roofs` sets `live` to `level === 'island' && missions.state === 'idle'` (before that, during the
  build, it is false). **So no mission sees the roofs:** in any other state every block there is what
  it was (the slabs and the palms to 99, no roof floor, no `'roof'` block), and between missions
  everything under 8 m is the same footprint at the same height, so `queryBlocks`, `groundAt`,
  `spotFree`, `freeSpot`, `footReach`, the cars, peds, the camera at street level and calibrate's
  walker meet the same walls. No stage's world, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes. No random
  draw is added (the lot's stream and frame.js's are untouched): the world builds as before.
- **The look** (static geometry, every state): on both slabs a glass door in the lobby (a bronze frame
  2.1 × 2.2 with two leaves) and a teal door on the lift room's north face (0.86 × 1.74). Over SOL DE
  INVIERNO's lobby door the sign `ASCENSOR AVERIADO` [N] (§1.3; 1.9 × 0.34, under the entrance
  canopy). By ATLÁNTICO's south edge, facing the roof with the sea behind it, the brochure's sign
  `BALKONG MED HAVSUTSIKT / OCH KVÄLLSSOL` [F*] on two posts (3.2 × 1.0, local x −2.4).
- **Coins** (`ROOF_JUMP.coins`, placed once by `roofs` with `placeCoin`, so not saved: every session
  has them again, as the street lines): 8 on SOL DE INVIERNO from 4.3 m in front of the lift room's
  door (out of the coin magnet's 3.7 m where the stairs put him) to the west edge at z 59.53 (`jz`),
  3 over the gap on that line (1.1 m apart, 1.2, 1.6 and 1.2 m over the roof: a running jump takes
  all three) and 6 in a stash by ATLÁNTICO's south edge beside the view: 17 coins, 425 pta.
- **The stairs.** Three interactables (§14.3), `r` = 1.3, held to their own level by the ±2.5 m height
  rule of `bestInteractable`: `takhopp:upp` at `takSolLobby` (100.667, 54.3), `promptUp` "<b>E</b> Ta
  trappan upp" [N]; `takhopp:solNer` at `takSolTopp` (104.97, 61.46, y 21.09) and `takhopp:atlNer` at
  `takAtlTopp` (84.2, 61.65, y 21.09), `promptDown` "<b>E</b> Ta trappan ner" [N]. ATLÁNTICO's lobby
  has no way up: its roof is reached over the gap. All only when `canUse()`: on the island, idle, no
  stairs under way, no dialogue, on foot and on the ground, not carrying, **no SKANDAL pursuit** (the
  roof would be a free hideout where the porter's costs 500 pta, §7.2), no bust freeze or PANIK, not in
  the pool fest's ring or on the baggage belt. E: `inDialog` holds his keys and the camera, a black fade
  (`fadeSecs` 0.5 s), he is `put` by hand (`teleport` snaps to ground-level floors only), `holdSecs`
  0.3 s, the fade lifts. Up: on SOL DE INVIERNO's roof at `takSolTopp`, facing the gap (yaw −π/2), the
  camera behind him; out of breath: `anim.slump` (head down, mouth open) until he moves or `puffSecs`
  2.2 s, and `top` "Sju våningar…" [N]. Down: `outStep` 2.8 m out from the door's lobby spot, turned
  away from the door, so he walks out from under the entrance canopy (at the door the canopy held the
  chase camera at his shoulder).
- **The jump.** `on` is the roof he stands on (any of its `blocks`: he can hop onto the lift room and
  the tanks). Airborne from a roof, the fall starts over the gap (x and z inside `gap`, no more than
  3 m under the floor) or as soon as he is `dropBy` 0.4 m under the roof he left: `anim.leap` (the
  tower's: Levander's arms straight out, tipping forward as the fall gathers speed; only a look, his
  wish and air control are untouched, where `wings` would stop him) and the mantra (`S.mantraLine` [F*],
  through `game.say`). J in the air is the stomp (§3): `anim.bomb` instead. After julafton a held J
  glides (§10.7) and the glide takes the fall over. A sprint jump (8.8 m/s, 8.6 up) carries 5.4–6.3 m
  and the roof's step catch (0.45) forgives a little more, so a jump within about 2 m of the edge
  makes it; from a walk, or later, the double jump does. Measured by `takhopp`: jumped 1.2 m before
  SOL DE INVIERNO's edge, down 0.5 m in on ATLÁNTICO after 0.55 s (v 8.2, an ordinary landing:
  `last.kind` `'roof'`). Short, he hits ATLÁNTICO's wall and drops into the gap (dust; no fall damage
  anywhere, §1.2).
- **The landing.** `game.onLand(ch, v, y)` calls `roofs.onLand(v, y)` beside the tower's (both are
  called; a splash from either replaces the dust). A fall that ends on a `water` floor (`waterAt`, not
  on a car roof) splashes through `game.waterSplash(x, z, v, bomb)`: a stomp **the cannonball**
  (`'bomb'`), anything else **the belly flop** (`'magplask'`, `flop(flopSecs = 1.6)`). Sprinting
  straight off ATLÁNTICO's west edge (x 71.61) he comes down after 1.13 s at x 61.1 in the pool lot
  next door (its pool x [53.83, 64.83], z [60.75, 67.25]) at v 31.6 m/s; with J 34.4. Elsewhere it is
  `'roof'` or `'dry'` (dust). `roofs.last` ({ kind, x, z, v, t, secs, gap }), `climbs` and `mantras`
  are for tests.
- **The view.** On ATLÁNTICO's roof, standing within `view.r` 2.2 m of `takUtsikt` (80.0, 65.9, y
  21.09, facing the sea), `view.line` "Nu har jag havsutsikt." [N] (his "Kallar ni det här för
  havsutsikt?" at the hotel answered, research-plot.md:252; "Momento." stays the porter's). Once a
  visit: again only after he has stood somewhere off the roofs.
- **A mission start** (any state but `idle`) or the other level: the solids go (above), the fall and
  the out-of-breath pose are dropped, and if he is up there (over a roof's footprint grown by 0.5 m,
  within 1.5 m under its floor) he is `put` at that roof's lobby, so he never falls through a slab. A
  real start finds him at ground level anyway (the giver's talk is on the ground, and the intro
  stands him in its scene). Nothing is saved. Scenario `takhopp` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): `leap` (the tower's arms-out pose) instead of
  `wings` over the gap, so no flag for the pose in the air was needed; no new splash effect (feature
  24's `waterSplash` covers any hard landing in water) but the tower's belly flop and cannonball; a
  third stair door, on ATLÁNTICO's lift room (the idea's "TA TRAPPAN NER" from there), and none in
  ATLÁNTICO's lobby; the roof floors are the slabs' footprints, 0.15 m inside the parapets' visible
  edge; the palms in the gap stop at 8 m between missions (they would have been walls in the air); the
  coins respawn every session (world coins are not saved); the way down by the stairs leaves him 2.8 m
  out of the lobby.

### 10.30 Mikrofonen på scenen – Stig reads Lasse's announcements (free roam; feature 44, 2026-10-17)

`game/mic.js` (`Mic`, owned by Game as `mic`), config `MIKROFON` in content/island.js, the landmark
`mikrofon` and `bathers.scare` (§10.22). The welcome stage at Hotel SunTrip (block (3,2), §6.3) has
had a microphone between its two speakers since Phase 1, and nothing used it. Between missions E there
plays the PA chime, Stig reads the next of Lasse's announcements with a civil servant's gravity, and
the hotel round him does what he says. The lines are Lasse's from the transfer bus and the welcome
meeting (research-plot.md:246–247, :266, :440–441), relocated to Stig ([F*]), the shark warning ours;
the question time is the film's subtitle ("Finns det svenskt kaffe på hotellet?" / "Ja." / "Norsk,
da?" / "Ja.", research-plot.md:247, research-characters.md:180), with Stig answering in Lasse's place.
The microphone's use, the crowd and every reaction are [N] (§1.6).

- **When.** `live`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`. The interactable `mic` at `mikrofon`
  (0, −91.2; block-local (0, −11.2), on the stage, top `stageY` = 0.55, just behind the stand at (0,
  −90.6), facing the lawn), `r` = 1.4 m, so not from the lawn or the step in front of the stage, shows
  `<b>E</b> Läs ett utrop` [N] while `canUse()`: live, not `busy`, no dialogue, on foot and on the
  ground, on the stage (y over `stageY` − 0.1), not carrying, **no SKANDAL pursuit** (no announcements
  with the Guardia at his heels), no bust freeze or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the baggage
  belt or in a talk with the gang. No `inDialog` (a dialogue counts as a scene for the pursuit, §10.28).
- **E.** The next announcement of `order` (`vatten`, `grisfest`, `klocka`, `friskotek`, `hajar`, round
  and round; per session, not saved; `hajar` skipped once the SunTrip pool's fin `fena_suntrip` is
  squashed): `audio.dingdong()` (the PA chime of `cue({ pa })`); the bubbles of the NPCs within `hushR`
  = 14 m taken down (Affe and Gabbe beside him on the stage); Stig turned to the line's audience
  (`face`, block-local: the terrace, the lawn or the pool); the camera eased in behind him, `camOff` =
  0.4 rad to his right so that he does not stand in front of what happens, for `camSecs` = 1.4 s
  (`dampAngle`, k 4; the mouse turning it, a car or a cutaway ends the ease); and
  `dingSecs` = 0.9 s later his line as a bubble. The lines of an announcement follow one another as in
  the gang's talk (each up as long as `game.say` holds it, then `gap` = 0.35 s; a line may wait for a
  condition, `until` with `max` s, or be skipped, `if`), the reactions beside them on a clock
  (`queue`); meanwhile the NPCs within `hushR` keep their chatter back (`chatT`). E again only after
  `cool` = 6 s and once the lines are said (`busy`); a new announcement drops what is left of the last.
  A line of Stig's further on (the question time's "Ja.", his answer to Lasse) is dropped, with the
  rest of the lines, once he is more than `leaveR` = 12 m from the mic, in a car or not `normal`.
- **"Ni bör inte dricka vattnet."** Three guests sit at the terrace's straw-parasol tables
  (`terrace.seats`, block-local: (12.15, −11.5) and (13.85, −11.5) at one table, (17.65, −18) at
  another; on the chair's seat, `y` = 0.61) by day and evening (`hours` = 8–23) while Stig is within
  `r` = 45 m: seeded tourists (`seed`, made once, no Spanish locals), seated with `seatAt` (the plane
  seat's pose), each put on or taken off its chair only out of the camera's view or more than `popR`
  = 40 m from it, or within `cutSecs` = 1.2 s of a cut (free roam again, a warp: the focus 15 m or
  more in a frame), as the bathers (§10.22). At the chime they lift their glasses (`cupHeld`, from
  `sipAt` = 0.3 s, 0.15 s apart), and `spitAt` = 1.3 s after his line goes up (0.3 s apart) they spit:
  the glass down, `yell` for `yellSecs` = 1.2 s, a spray of the drink from the mouth (18 orange and
  white drops, `fx.spawn`), and a line each from `spit`: "Isbitarna!", "Usch!", "Är isen också
  vatten?" [N].
- **"Grisfesten är på torsdag och kostar 800 pesetas. Några frågor?"** The crowd: `crowd.tourists` =
  6 seeded tourists (made at the first grisfest, hidden between) and every free one of `crowd.gang`
  (Fru Storch, Ole, Robban, Berra, Herr Storch, Majsan, Siv; free = standing, shown, in no car or seat,
  not `busy` (at home: nobody's), walked by no module (`steer`), `honk.free`, not `npcPosed`, not the
  waiting mission's giver or extra). Each takes a place of `spots` (14 in three rows on the lawn in
  front of the stage, z −5.6 to −1.2, the gang first) and comes in by one of `entries`: west (the gap
  south of the west wing, past the notice board), east (along the forecourt past the pool deck) or
  south (from the street over the forecourt). He is teleported to the nearest start of that entry that
  is out of view (or more than `popR` from the camera), on the shortest such way; one of the gang
  already in view walks from where he stands. They walk the entry's `via` points at `walk` = 3.4 m/s,
  a little spread (tourists up to `lag` = 1.5 s apart and ±1.2 m across the way, the gang 0.35 s; a
  point that holds one up 1.5 s is skipped), and each cheers on arrival (`anim.cheer` for `cheerSecs`
  = 2.4 s; the applause at the first, `cheer` "Hurra!" and "Grisfest!" [N] from the first two
  tourists). Once nobody is on the way (at most `arriveSecs` = 14 s): Robban's "Ja, herre jävlar, minns
  du Benidorm? Snacka om grisfest!" [F*] if he is there, and if Fru Storch is, the question time: her
  "Finns det svenskt kaffe på hotellet?", Stig's "Ja.", Ole's "Norsk, da?" (if he is there) and Stig's
  "Ja." (all [F*]). The gang in the crowd are ours (`busy`, `spot` `mic`, a `steer` of ours that
  main.js walks), `npcPosed` (no wave, turn, chatter or talk) and out of `honk.free` (so every other
  module leaves them be). Standing, they face the mic; Herr Storch films (`anim.film`). They stay
  `stay` = 30 s after the last has come, then stroll out the way they came at `outWalk` = 2.0 m/s
  (one who walked in from view by the nearest entry), and at its outermost start, out of view or after
  `outSecs` = 12 s, a tourist is hidden and one of the gang put home (`placeNpc` to his place in the
  home set, `busy` off, `spot` null). The grisfest again calls everyone not yet gone back to his place
  and cheers again. The tourists are the module's own `Character`s (`mic.extras`: main.js adds them to
  `allChars` and `areaHit`'s people, so a kick or a car bowls them over as pedestrians, and steps
  them after the bathers). Measured (`utrop`): from each entry's outermost start to a place, west 9.6
  s, east 14.4 s, south 10.8 s; at index 9 the crowd is in place 7–10 s after E.
- **"Klockan är {tid} spansk tid – alltså en timme tidigare än svensk tid."** The hour on the island's
  clock (§10.10) in words, as an official reads it (`hours`, 12-hour; from a quarter past to a quarter
  to `half`, "halv fyra"): at 15:00, where the clock starts and where test mode holds it, the film's
  "tre". Stig does not tell people the wrong time (§1.2). Ole, standing in the crowd or within
  `klocka.r` = 25 m of the mic, answers: with his watch found (pryl `klocka`, which Stig wears, §10.10)
  its line, "Digital, analog, spansk, norsk, svensk tid, kronometer, og så klokke." [F*], else
  `oleLost`, "Og norsk tid? Klokka mi ligger et sted på øya." [N]; without Ole a tourist of the crowd
  or a guest at the terrace says `other`, "Ska man ställa om klockan igen?" [N].
- **"Friskoteket börjar halv tio varje morgon."** 0.6 s after his line the crowd sinks (`anim.slump`),
  stands `slumpSecs` = 1.6 s (and up to 1.2 s more each) and shuffles out slumped at `slumpWalk` = 1.3
  m/s (the film's gym that grows emptier, research-plot.md:282); the terrace's guests slump in their
  chairs for `terrace.slumpSecs` = 4 s. A tourist: "Halv tio? På semestern?" [N]; Berra, if he was
  there: "Halv tio? Då har vi inte ens gått och lagt oss." [N].
- **"Hajar i poolen!"** [N] (Lasse's "Hajar i poolen? Delirium – ring kliniken.", research-plot.md:292,
  turned round). Only while the fin circles, so the warning is true and Stig means it (§1.2). 0.3 s
  after his line `bathers.scare` (§10.22): every bather lying on a lounger within `hajar.r` = 11 m of
  the pool's middle (`at`, block-local (14.5, 9)) jumps up beside it and runs from the pool flailing
  (`anim.flail`) for `flee.secs` = 3.5 s at `flee.speed` = 5.5 m/s, the first two crying "Hjälp!" and
  "En haj!" [N]; their loungers stay empty until the next morning. Lasse, if he can speak (shown,
  standing, not posed) within `lasseR` = 50 m of the pool (his place on the office porch is 32 m off),
  waves it off: "Hajar i poolen igen? Ring kliniken!" [F*] (Lasse's line as the fins' first, §10.1),
  and Stig: "Men den är ju där…" [N]. By night, or with nobody on those loungers, only the lines.
- **A mission start** (any state but idle) or the other level: `reset()` takes it all away at once:
  the queue and the lines, the camera's ease, the crowd (the tourists hidden; the gang home, unless the
  mission's own placement had them first: then where it put them), the guests. So no mission, stage
  kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it, the friskotek balls' pool round this lawn
  included: in a mission the lawn and the terrace hold what they held before. No solid and no random
  draw is added to the world build. Nothing is saved. `mic.last` ({ id, t, text, drinkers, crowd,
  gang, scared }), `said` ([who, text, t] since the last E), `crowd`, `drinkers`, `next`, `nextId()`,
  `clockWords(h)`, `free(key)`, `busy` and `live` are for tests. Scenarios `mikrofon` and `utrop`
  (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the turn order puts the time before friskoteket
  (vatten, grisfest, klocka, friskotek, hajar), so that Ole still stands in the crowd for the time and
  friskoteket is what sends the crowd home; the time is the island's clock's (the film's "tre" at
  three); Ole's answer follows his watch (found: its line; lost: a line about it); six tourists; the
  terrace's guests sit there all day and evening, not only for the announcement (they must be drinking
  when it comes); Lasse answers from where he stands, with no wave-off pose (`syncAll` owns `wave`);
  the camera eases round once at E (the idea had none: the terrace and the pool are off to the side);
  no reward (the idea's optional box and coin: the shark warning cannot be had once the fin is
  squashed, so five of five could be lost for good). The welcome meeting (the idea Välkomstmötet) is
  not built; if it is, the mic should be shut while it plays, and the oath stays there.

### 10.31 Fåglarna som lyfter – the flocks that lift, and the stork in La Charca (free roam; feature 43, 2026-10-17)

`game/birds.js` (`Birds`, owned by Game as `birds`; the looks and motions in its `KINDS`), config
`BIRDS` in content/island.js. Before it nothing on the island moved but people and cars: La Charca's
two herons were statues in the dunes block's merged geometry. Now small flocks peck, step and turn on
four spots and lift when Stig comes at them, and the stork among the herons flies to the Storches.
The film has no bird scene: the herons are the lagoon's setting ("med flyttfåglar som hägrar och
strandpipare", research-setting.md:109, about today's reserve), the pigeons are "(osäkert)"
(research-setting.md:131), the gulls are ours. The stork is the film's running joke on the Storches'
name (Arlanda's PA "Herr Stork ombedes kontakta informationen i avgångshallen.", research-plot.md:167;
the welcome meeting's "Vi heter faktiskt Storch, inte Stork." and the telegram's "…för om nio månader
kommer storken.", :269; "Kolla storken!" at the friskotek, :282), here given a real stork. The birds'
flight, the stork, its trip and the scene are [N] (§1.6). No bird is named after the Arlanda joke's
real people (§1.5).

- **The flocks** (`BIRDS.flocks`; a spot is block-local [lx, lz, y?, yaw?, perch?], y the floor
  there when left out, a perch never steps):
  - `plaza`, 15 pigeons (`duva`) round the fountain of (2,3): six south-east of it, three west and
    three north on the paving ring (r 6.5–9.5 from its column), three on the rim (r 5.2, y 0.55,
    perches);
  - `kiosk`, 8 gulls (`mas`) at HELADOS · GLASS on (3,6): two on the kiosk's roof (y 3.1, perches),
    three on the sand west of it and three east;
  - `piren`, 9 gulls on the marina's pier in (5,6): three on its bollards (y 1.05, perches), six on
    the deck (0.55);
  - `charca`, La Charca's two herons (`hager`) at (0,5)'s (−15, 9.5) and (−9, 19), facing as before
    (yaw 0.971 and −0.829; world (−255, 169.5) and (−249, 179)), and between them the stork at
    (−12.4, 14.2).
  World (nature.js `dyner`): `heron()` and its two calls are gone. It drew into the merged `f.S` with
  no random draw, so the block builds as before otherwise; the herons had no collider and none of the
  birds has one. birds.js draws from its own `mulberry32(BIRDS.seed = 4343)`: the world's, the town's
  and `Math.random`'s streams are untouched.
- **The look.** Four instanced meshes a kind (standing, flying, the left and the right wing; `MAT.toon`
  with an inverted-hull outline on the same matrices, 0.02 for pigeons and gulls, 0.03 for the herons
  and the stork): 16 meshes and 16 outlines for 36 birds. A kind whose every bird is over `drawR` 260 m
  from the camera is hidden (the flight level draws none). Scales: pigeon × 1.45 and gull × 1.3 (drawn
  large, as the chase camera sees them), heron × 1 (the old size), stork × 1.05. The body pitches
  about its `hip`; the wings hinge at the `shoulder` and flap (`flap` Hz: pigeon 7.5, gull 3.4, heron
  and stork 2.0) or glide on spread wings for 0.8–2.4 s (about `glide` of the time: 0.2, 0.55, 0.25,
  0.45). Flying, the herons fold their necks back and trail their legs, the stork stretches its neck
  out; a landing bird puts its legs down for the last `legs` m.
- **On the ground** (between missions): it pecks (1–3 times, `peck.secs`), takes a step within
  `wander` m of its spot (pigeon 1.0, gull 0.8, heron 0.5, stork 0.4), turns, or stands, each pause
  `next` s (pigeon 0.4–1.6, gull 0.8–2.6, heron and stork 2.5–6).
- **The scare.** Only the player: Stig on foot within `foot.base` 1.0 + `foot.perSpeed` 0.5 × his
  speed (a jump's vertical speed counts; a kick at least `foot.kick` 3 m): a walk 3.7 m, a sprint 5.4;
  his car within `car.base` 4 + `car.perSpeed` 0.5 × its speed above `car.minSpeed` 1.5 m/s (standing
  `car.still` 2.5 m): at 20 m/s 14 m; each times the kind's `shy` (pigeon 1, gull 1.1, heron and stork
  1.6), within `dy` 6 m above or below, lifting `react` 0.02–0.14 s later. Standing still he can stand
  among them. The horn (`game.hornAt`, the free-roam press, §10.9) lifts every bird within `horn.r`
  28 m of the car, `horn.lag` 0.015 s a metre later. A lifting bird takes its neighbours on the ground
  within `chain` m (pigeon 2.6, gull 4.5, heron and stork 14) 0.05–0.25 s later, so the near side
  goes first and the far side of the plaza pecks on. Traffic, pedestrians and the cast never scare
  them.
- **The flight.** Away from what scared it (± 0.55 rad) and up for `liftSecs` (`lift` [away, up] m/s),
  then round the flock's `loop` (one way round per take-off, a radius ± 20 % and a height in the band
  per bird, at `cruise` m/s): the plaza r 9.5 at 5–8 m, the kiosk 12 at 7–11, the pier 13 at 6–10,
  La Charca 15 at 7–10. After `loop.secs` (24–34 s, La Charca 26–36) each bird lands on its own spot:
  from its own side of the circle (within 1 rad of its spot's bearing from the centre, or 15 s later),
  down a sinking glide (it aims 0.45 × the distance above the spot), never while Stig stands within his
