  radius + `clear` 1.5 m of the spot (a landing at half that margin turns back up for 3–6 s more).
  Measured by `faglar`: the plaza's last pigeon down 37–42 s after the first take-off. A flock more
  than `farR` 140 m from Stig is put back on its spots and not run.
- **No bird is hurt** (§1.2): at speed the car's radius is 12–18 m, so a bird is up before the car is
  there, and the car passes through where one stood (`faglar`: at 18–26 m/s it never came within
  11.6 m of a gull still on the ground). No feathers, no solid, no SKANDAL.
- **Sounds** within `sound.r` 50 m (by distance): `audio.flap(n, vol)` for the take-offs of each
  0.15 s; `audio.gull(vol)` at a gull flock's take-off and every `sound.cry` 1.2–3.4 s while it
  circles; the herons' croak `audio.gull(vol, sound.croak = 0.32)` (§12.3).
- **Stig's sorry.** The take-offs he caused on foot within `sorry.r` 7 m of him (a pigeon counts 1, a
  gull, heron or the stork 2; the count fades over 1.2 s) reaching `sorry.min` 2: "Oj! Förlåt, förlåt!"
  [N] with his hands up by his head (`anim.placate` 1, the watchdog's pose, §10.21) for
  `sorry.poseSecs` 1.3 s, at most every `sorry.every` 25 s, never over a line of his own or in a
  dialogue; the pose only when it is free (not the dogs').
- **The stork** (`stork`). Scared, or taken along by the herons, while the Storches (`pair`: shown,
  standing, within `pairR` 8 m of `beach` `playa`, posed by no other module) are on the beach and
  `again` 45 s after its last trip, it does not circle: it flies a cubic Bézier from its spot over `via`
  (−212, 236) and (−100, 262) (world) to `side` 1.8 m beyond Fru Storch from her husband, 278 m north of
  the lighthouse and then east along the beach, climbing to `cruise` 16 m over its first fifth and
  down over its last 28 %, at `speed` 11 m/s (slower at both ends): about 27 s. It lands facing her and
  pecks and turns there. With Stig (on foot or in his car) within `sceneR` 11 m of it, no dialogue and
  no gang talk under way: Stig's "Oj, en stork!" [N]; `correctAt` 1.9 s later Fru Storch's "Vi heter
  faktiskt Storch, inte Stork." [F*] (the welcome meeting's, research-plot.md:269, relocated) **the
  first time ever** (`records.stork`, saved at once, §10.5); `filmAt` 2.6 s after that (0.4 s without
  the line) Herr Storch lifts his camera (`anim.film`, `audio.whirr`) and films it for `filmSecs` 5 s,
  turned to it and posed (`npcPosed`: no turn to Stig, no wave, no chatter; the horn's answers leave
  him be); then the stork flies home the same way reversed and lands on its spot. Herr Storch off
  filming one of Stig's tricks (§10.11): no filming (or it stops there). Nobody within `waitSecs` 75 s,
  or the pair gone: home without a word. Without the pair it circles with the herons (at index 6 the
  friskotek holds them; after the end Fru Storch is at the pool fest, §10.13).
- **A mission start** (any state but `idle`) or the other level: every bird is put on its spot at once
  and stands still there through the mission (no pecking, no take-off), the stork home, Herr Storch's
  camera down, Stig's hands down. So no mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool
  changes (the José stage's walk to the fountain meets standing pigeons). Only `records.stork` is
  saved. Scenarios `faglar`, `storken` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the module is `game/birds.js` like the other
  free-roam modules, not `world/birds.js`, and is ticked after `mic.update` (not beside
  `tickProps`), with the horn read from `game.hornAt`; two body meshes a kind (standing and flying)
  besides the wings; no gulls on HOTEL LAS GAVIOTAS's roof (the idea's optional wink: the name is dealt
  to several slabs, and 25 m up nothing scares them); the correction is heard once ever (saved), the
  filming every visit; Stig's sorry also among gulls and herons; in a mission the flocks stand still
  rather than being hidden.

`game/gags.js` (`Gags`, owned by Game as `gags`), config `GAGS` in content/island.js, the landmarks

### 10.33 Strandkyssen i bränningen – Stig's daydream in the surf (free roam; feature 57, 2026-10-17)

`game/beachDream.js` (`BeachDream`, owned by Game as `dream`), config `STRANDKYSSEN` in content/island.js,
the dream's look in hud.js (`dream`, `dreamWash`, `dreamFlash`) and style.css (`body.dream`, `#dream`,
`#dreamwash`), and the lie pose's `roll`, `turn` and given arms (models.js, §14.6). In the film's first
act, in the Stockholm slush after the tow and the talk that ends "Då kanske vi ses.", Stig-Helmer
daydreams of himself and Majsan in the famous beach kiss in the surf (research-plot.md:102, :104). Here
he lies on the beach of the poster, and it is still a dream. The towel, the dream, the wave and the
visitors on the sand are [N] (§1.6). The pose carries the reference: neither the film the kiss is from
nor its actors are named (§1.5), the music is the game's own waltz, and the camera leaves before the
kiss.

- **The towel.** 0.95 × 1.9 m, Majsan's dress's blue (0x4a7fd0) with white dots and a cream fringe at
  both ends (GeoBuilder, `toonMesh` outline 0.012, no shadow), lies at the water's edge below Flamenco,
  its middle at (−30, 300.9) (`towel.at`, world; its length along z, across the foam line at z 300–301.2),
  always, in missions too. No collider and no landmark: the only thing the feature leaves in the world.
- **When.** `live`: on the island, `missions.state === 'idle'`. The interactable `strandkyssen` at the
  towel's middle, `r` = 1.5 m, shows `<b>E</b> Lägg dig i vattenbrynet` [N] while `canUse()`: live, no
  scene under way, no dialogue, on foot and on the ground, not carrying, **no SKANDAL pursuit**, no bust
  freeze or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the baggage belt or in a talk with the gang. By night
  too (the night comes back at the wake).
- **E.** A scene on a clock (`at`, real seconds; 14.4–16.8 s in all): `inDialog`, the letterbox, the
  toasts down; Stig on the towel at once (`lieAt`, his hips `lie.hips` = 0.55 m seaward of its middle,
  his feet to the sea), sitting, then onto his back over `lie.back` = 0.7 s, the camera cut to him
  (`cam.lie`; the cuts are `[dx, y, dz]` in the towel's frame). From `at.wash` = 0.55 s the picture
  washes to white over `washSecs` = 0.8 s (`hud.dreamWash`: `#dreamwash`, over everything).
- **The dream** (`at.dream` = 1.5 s to `at.wake` = 9.6 s): the `sunset` palette (`setSky`; the clock
  writes nothing while the scene holds `inDialog`), the soft picture (`body.dream`: the canvas filtered
  `saturate(1.18) contrast(0.9) brightness(1.07) sepia(0.12) blur(0.5px)`), the white vignette and the
  `title` DAGDRÖM [N] in a pale pink italic serif at the top (`hud.dream`, under the bubbles and the
  letterbox), the `tune` `vals` (§12.1, the grisfest's waltz); the white fades out over `washOutSecs` =
  1 s. Majsan lies beside him: a double, a `Character` of her look as it is now (`npc('majsan').def`),
  built at the first dream and never in the world's lists (no physics, collisions or placements): the
  real Majsan stays where she is, so no giver, placement or other module sees her move. The pose of two
  (`pose`; the lie pose's `roll`, `turn`, `tilt` and [right, left] arm rotations, §14.6): he flat on his
  back and turned 0.6 rad towards her, his head turned 0.5 to her, his right arm over her, his left out
  under her neck; she on her back 0.62 m to his left and 0.12 m landward, her right arm out round his
  neck. The foam washes slowly over their legs (`swash`: the foam's front from z 305.6 in to 302.6 and
  out again every 3.4 s, 0.22 m high). At `at.whisper` = 3.4 s the double whispers "Då kanske vi ses…"
  [F*](t) (the parting line after the tow, research-plot.md:102, its speaker unknown; relocated). The
  camera holds on them from beside her head (`cam.dream`: the sea and the sunset sky behind them) and
  from `at.glide` = 6.4 s glides up and away to the sky over the sea (`cam.away`), so no kiss is seen.
- **The wake** (`at.wake`): a white flash (`hud.dreamFlash`: white at once, out over `flashSecs` = 0.7
  s), and under it the clock's palette (`day.write()`), the picture and the music back (`levelTune()`;
  only if the waltz is still ours), the double hidden, Stig alone on his back with his arms at his sides,
  the camera on the sand (`cam.wake`). At `at.wave` = 9.9 s a real wave (the foam mesh: three rows of
  lumps over a thin sheet, `wave.w` = 10 m wide, `toonMesh` outline 0.02) comes in from z 311.5 to 299.2
  in `inSecs` = 2.1 s (fast, then slowing, its crest from 0.55 m down), over him, and back to 307 in
  `outSecs` = 2.3 s; as its front passes his feet, his chest and his head, `fx.splash` there (the
  chest's the biggest, with `audio.splash(1)` and a camera shake of 0.3). Purely a look: no collider, it
  pushes nobody. At `at.blott` = 12.4 s, still lying: "Blött." [N].
- **Who stands on the sand** (decided at the wake; free: shown, standing, not `busy`, no module's
  `steer`, `honk.free`, not posed, not the waiting mission's giver or extra). After the end (index 13):
  **Majsan** herself (`after`, every dream): he gets up at 13.4 s, her "Vill du dansa med mig?" [F*]
  (she asks him at the grisfest, research-plot.md:346; relocated) at 14.0 s, his "Ja." [N] at 15.9 s,
  and she dances (`anim.dance`) through the scene's end at 16.8 s and `after.stay` = 6 s after it.
  Before the end, by day (`day.isDay()`), on every `siv.every` = 3rd dream of the session from the
  `siv.first` = 2nd (the 2nd, 5th, 8th…): **Siv** (`siv`) at 13.5 s with "Giraffen, då? Fyra." [F*](t)
  (the points scene on the plane, research-plot.md:197; the line is the plane's, §8.1, and the diving
  judges', §10.8, so she comes only now and then), laughing (`anim.laugh`) for `laughSecs` = 2.4 s; he
  gets up at 14.6 s, the scene ends at 16.4 s, and she stays `stay` = 6 s. The visitor is teleported in
  under the flash to `visitor` (1.6 m to the towel's right, 1.2 m landward, on the sand, in the wake's
  shot), facing him; she is ours (`busy`, `spot` `strand`, `posed`: in `npcPosed` and `honk.free`, so
  no wave, turn, chatter, horn answer or talk). Getting up, Stig turns to her and the camera frames the
  two as in a talk (`cam.frame`). After her stay she goes home (`placeNpc` to her place in the home set,
  `busy` back, `spot` null) once out of the camera's view or more than `popR` = 40 m from it, at once at
  a mission start; placed by someone else meanwhile, she is left where she is. With nobody on the sand
  he gets up at 13.6 s facing the land, and the scene ends at 14.4 s.
- **Getting up.** Beside the towel's land end (`stand`: 0.6 m to its left, 1.7 m landward); his clothes
  drip for `dripSecs` = 4 s (blue and white drops from his body, thinning; `fx.spawn`). The scene's end:
  the camera behind him (turned 0.5 rad with a visitor, so she is beside him, not behind him), the
  letterbox off, free roam.
- **A mission start** (any state but idle) or the other level: `reset()` ends it all at once: the
  dream's palette (the level's, the clock re-synced), the picture, the vignette, the wash, the music
  (if still the waltz), the double, the foam, Stig on his feet beside the towel, the visitor home, the
  drips. A mission's start keeps its own dialogue, letterbox and camera (only a level change has them
  given back here). So no mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it. No
  solid and no world random draw is added; nothing is saved (the dream count is per session).
  `dream.last` ({ t, variant, visitor, dream, wake, splash, said, ended }), `sc`, `vis`, `dreams`,
  `double`, `foam`, `towel`, `canUse()`, `free(key)`, `homeOf(key)`, `sivDue(n)` are for tests.
  Scenarios `strandkyssen` and `strandefter` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the dream's Majsan is a double, not the real one
  placed with `placeNpc` (so the real one never moves, whatever holds her); the scene runs on a clock in
  `update`, not as an async method; the pose of two is the bathers' lie pose (`lieAt`, §10.22) with a
  roll, a head turn and given arm rotations, not a new anim flag; Siv comes on every third dream from
  the second, by day; after the end Stig answers "Ja." and she dances; the towel is offered by night
  too; it has no landmark.

### 10.34 Låna Guardia-jeepen – "Ursäkta, är det din bil?" (free roam; feature 51, 2026-10-17)

`game/guardiaJeep.js` (`GuardiaJeep`, owned by Game as `jeep`), config `GUARDIA_JEEP` in
content/island.js, hooks in shame.js (`busted`, `endPursuit`, §7.2), main.js (`enterCar`, the prompt,
H, `updateAudio`) and the traffic's `AIDriver` (drivers.js), `hud.sirenLights` (style.css
`body.siren`). Hit & Run's classic reward, the police car, for the island's most bewildered man: he
does not steal it, he borrows it, says so and is surprised when the traffic lets him through. The film
has no Guardia scene (the pursuit, ¡MULTA! and the jeep chase are the game's, §1.6); the question and
the answer are its first act, at the travel agency's window: the warden Majsan asks Stig-Helmer
"Ursäkta, är det din bil?", he answers "Nej.", and it is Angerud's car she has towed
(research-plot.md:94–97). Here the officer asks [F*], and Stig's "Nej." is just as true. "Land Rover"
is never said: the car is the Guardia jeep.

- **The jeep.** `guardia1`, the west one of the two at the Casa Cuartel (block (5,3), its bay at
  (152.8, 8.1), facing the gate); `guardia2` stays locked. Open (`car.locked` false) when the bodega's
  unlock `grisbil` is in `game.unlocked`, on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'` and no bust
  scene under way; else locked as before ("Den är upptagen!", no prompt). The module sets `locked`
  every frame on the jeep he is not in, so a mission never sees it (`T.anyCar` and every stage skip a
  locked car) and an old save has it with no change to the save. The speedo calls it Guardia-jeepen
  (`NAMED_CARS.guardia1`). After the unlock's first time (not a loaded save's) its own toast `open`
  "Vid Guardia Civils kasern står en jeep olåst…" [N] follows the grisbil's.
- **The loan.** On foot by the open jeep within `loanR` = 20 m of its bay and not his, the car prompt
  is `<b>E</b> Låna jeepen` [N] (else "E Kliv in"). E (`enterCar` → `jeep.onEnter`): he gets in, says
  "Jag lånar den bara en liten stund…" [N], and `shameAt` = 1.2 s later (after his bubble, which the
  banner would hide) `shame.add(shame = 100)`: × `gain` 3, the top, and the ordinary pursuit (§7.2).
  If a pursuit is running then, it is the loan's (`jeep.loan`); if none starts (Herr Storch within
  20 m with his lens cap on, §7.2), the jeep is his at once.
- **His.** The loan's pursuit shaken off by anything but a bust (an escape, the porter, the wardrobe:
  `endPursuit` → `onPursuitEnd`): the jeep is his (`hisCar`, that car object, this session; not
  saved), with the toast `his` "Guardia-jeepen är din – håll H för sirenen." [N]. Getting in again,
  at its bay too, is no loan. A loan cleared by a mission start or the other level (`shame.clear`, the
  reset) makes nothing his.
- **Busted with it** (`shame.busted` → `jeep.onBusted()`, asked before he is pulled out): in it, or in
  the loan's pursuit (on foot too, wherever the jeep is), in free roam: the bust scene instead of the
  officer's `bustLine` and the `bustRadio`: the officer lingers `linger` = 4.4 s (not `bustFreeze`),
  asks "Ursäkta, är det din bil?" [F*] at `askAt` = 1.8 s, Stig answers "Nej." [F*] at `noAt` = 2.9 s,
  and at `towAt` = 3.9 s the jeep is towed back to its bay: with it within `seeR` = 60 m of him behind
  a `fadeSecs` = 0.5 s black fade (`hud.fade`, `inDialog` while it is black, 0.35 s more), else at
  once; a wreck or a jeep gone is replaced by a new one there (`ensureNamedCar`). The toast `towToast`
  "Guardia-jeepen är bärgad – tillbaka vid kasernen." [N]. It is no longer his. The fine, the freeze
  (3 s), the banner and `carBust` are as for any bust. While the scene runs the jeep is locked.
- **Wrecked and cleared away** (`recycleTraffic` removes a dead unlocked car 20 s on, more than 60 m
  from him): a new jeep stands in its bay once he is more than `respawnR` = 80 m from it; not his.
- **The siren.** In the jeep in free roam (`hasSiren`), H is its siren, not the horn: no
  `audio.horn`, no `honk.press` (no hop, no answers, no `hornAt`). While H is held (`sirenOn`, not in
  a dialogue): `main.updateAudio` turns the siren on (`audio.siren`: a pursuit's or this one, the rule
  "on while a pursuit runs or H is held in the jeep"; at full loudness, `sirenNear(0)`); a blinking
  lamp over the merged blue one on the roof (a `MeshBasicMaterial` dome 0.17 m and an additive halo
  sprite 1.7 m, built once per car, on and off every `blink` = 0.225 s); the pursuit's blue screen
  corners (`#sirenlights`, `body.siren`). Let go, out of the jeep or a dialogue: all off.
- **The traffic gives way** (no pursuit only: in a pursuit `game.sirenYield` is null, so its measured
  balance is untouched; the pursuers' sirens never count). Every frame of the held siren the module
  sets `game.sirenYield` { x, z, fx, fz, r, lat, cos, slow, aside, ease }. A `traffic` car in `traffic`
  mode (`AIDriver`) with the jeep behind it, within `r` = 30 m ahead of the jeep's centre and `lat` =
  4 m across its heading, going the same way (headings' dot > `cos` = 0.8), eases `yieldK` to 1 over
  `ease` = 0.5 s (back to 0 as fast once not): its target speed towards `slow` = 4 m/s and its aim
  point `aside` = 1.25 m to its right (not on a turn's curve points), so it slows and keeps to the right
  (measured: about 1.2 m right of its lane's line at 4–5 m/s after 3 s; let go, back in its lane and at
  speed 2.2 s later). The session's first car that gives way: Stig's "Oj… de släpper fram mig!" [N].
- **Angerud** (`angerud`): free (`honk.free`), shown, within `r` = 30 m of the held siren and in sight
  (`honk.sees`), at most every `every` = 40 s: "Hederliga bilister ger ni er på…" or "Förbannade
  förmyndarmentalitet!" [F*] (his outburst at the tow, research-plot.md:99; the other one next), with
  `anim.oath` for `oath` = 1.6 s, turned to the jeep, his chatter clock restarted.
- **A mission start or the other level** (`reset`): the siren, the lamp and the corners off, the
  traffic's way back, Angerud's oath down, a loan forgotten, a bust scene's tow done at once, the jeep
  locked. So no mission, stage kind, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it; no world random
  draw and no solid are added, and nothing new is saved. `jeep.last` ({ t, kind: loan | his | bust |
  tow | respawn, … }), `loan`, `loanT`, `hisCar`, `bust`, `sirenOn`, `car()`, `bay()`, `his(car)`,
  `isLoan(car)`, `open()` are for tests. Scenarios `guardiajeep` and `jeepsiren` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the jeep is unlocked by the same unlock as the
  grisbil (one unlock a mission) and is locked again during missions; the loan's SKANDAL comes 1.2 s
  after the line, not at once; the bust's tow is a fade, not a truck; the porter is not the only way
  out (the wardrobe and an escape count too); "his" lasts the session; pedestrians do not hop aside for
  the siren (the horn's reactions are horn lines); Angerud's line also when the jeep only stands with
  the siren on near him.

### 10.35 Uppför fyren – the mantra 51 m up (free roam; feature 52, 2026-10-17)

`game/lighthouse.js` (`Lighthouse`, owned by Game as `fyren`), config `FYREN` in content/island.js, the
gallery's solids in world/blocks/coast.js (`fyren()`, `LIGHTHOUSE`). Levander's exercise ("Sträck ut
armarna – rakt ut åt sidorna. Slappna av. Slut ögonen." … "Säg efter mig: Jag kan flyga, jag är inte
rädd.", research-characters.md:325, research-plot.md:122–123) moves to the top of the coast's highest
landmark: the man with a fear of flying climbs 51 m of his own accord, gets the vertigo, does as the
doctor said ("Varje gång du känner tendenser till flygrädsla så gör du övningen.", research-plot.md:124)
and stands there until it is night. The lighthouse is the real setting's (Faro de Maspalomas, lit 1890,
research-setting.md:108; §1.5), not a film scene; the climb, the gallery and the vertigo are [N] (§1.6).

- **The tower's solids** (every state; the tower's axis (−240, 232), block (0,6) local (0, −8)):
  - The tower's circle (r 3.4 = `rAt(0)`, kind `'tower'`) now stops at the gallery floor, `deck` =
    `TOP` + 1.3 = **51.3** (the deck's top), not 99: from the plaza and from the keeper's roof terrace
    (4.0) it is a wall as before, up there it is the floor.
  - The lantern: a circle r `lantern` = 1.75 (its base), top 99, kind `'tower'`.
  - The railing: a closed ring of 20 wall boxes (`ramp` with both heights 99, kind `'tower'`), 1.1 m
    along the ring × 0.2 m deep, their middles at r `rail` = 3.12 at the angles (k + ½)/20 · 2π, a
    little longer than a rail bar so no gap is left (`fyren` checks 720 angles).
  - All of them lie inside the tower's old r 3.4 footprint and above 51.3 m in effect: nothing at the
    foot changes (`groundAt`, `spotFree`, `queryBlocks` at street level, the cars, the camera), no
    mission, stage or route uses the lighthouse (`fyren` is only a map label, §11.6), so no stage's
    world, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes, and no random draw is added.
  - `LIGHTHOUSE` = { x, z (the axis), deck, lantern, rail, `rIn` = 2.13 and `rOut` = 2.64 (the walkway
    for a body's centre: an adult's 0.36 + 0.02 off the lantern, and off the railing's inner face),
    `door` = 3π/4 (the gallery door's angle as a yaw), `blocks` [tower, lantern, 20 railing walls] }.
    At the 20-gon's corners a body's centre gets to 2.69; `fyren.update` keeps it inside rOut + 0.05
    whatever pushed it.
- **The look** (static): the railing's bars run along the ring (their yaw was a + π/2, which stood them
  out like spokes: now a), with a middle bar 0.5 m over the deck under the top bar at 1.0 m. On the
  lantern's north-east side (towards the town) the gallery door: a dark frame 0.92 × 1.9, a grey-green
  door 0.74 × 1.76 and a brass knob, just proud of the lantern's base. The keeper's house's arched door
  on its south wall (below `FARO DE MASPALOMAS · 1890`) is the way in.
- **The stairs.** Two interactables (§14.3), `r` = 1.3, held to their own level by the ±2.5 m height
  rule of `bestInteractable`: `fyren:upp` at `fyrDorr` (−240, 241.4, facing the door), `promptUp` "<b>E</b>
  Gå upp i fyren" [N]; `fyren:ner` at `fyrGalleri` (−238.30, 230.30, y 51.3: r 2.4 at the door's
  angle, facing out), `promptDown` "<b>E</b> Gå ner" [N]. Both only when `canUse`: on the island, idle,
  no fade under way, no dialogue, on foot and on the ground, not carrying, no bust freeze or PANIK, not
  in the pool fest's ring or on the baggage belt; up also **no SKANDAL pursuit** (the gallery would be a
  free hideout where the porter's costs 500 pta, §7.2). E: `inDialog`, the watch drawn `over` the fade
  (§10.10), a black fade (`fadeSecs` 0.6 s), the banner `MÅNGA TRAPPSTEG SENARE …` / `… OCH LIKA MÅNGA
  NER.` [N] (`upBanner`, `downBanner`), he is put by hand (`teleport` snaps to ground-level floors only),
  the clock (below), `holdSecs` 1.0 s, the fade back. Up: on the gallery at `fyrGalleri`, facing out
  over the town; `arriveAt` 0.4 s later "Femtio meter … det är ju nästan som att flyga." [N]. Down:
  `outStep` 2.6 m out from the door's E spot, turned away from it (at 1.2 m the chase camera sat at his
  neck against the house).
- **The clock** (§10.10; the gallery follows it, the idea's own note). A climb by day (`day.isDay`,
  07–19) takes the afternoon: the clock spins (`day.spin`, as the nap's) on to `evening` = 19.75, the
  sunset palette (the lantern still dark until the clock's `lit` at 20:00). At any other hour it stays.
  The way down leaves it as it is (the idea's "då är det dag igen" was for a fixed sky). In test mode
  the clock holds at 15:00, so the climb sets 19:45.
- **On the gallery** (`up`, from the climb until he is off it): `game.mantraMode` is on (J is the
  mantra, no kick or stomp), **Space does not jump** (main.js `handleOneShots` asks `fyren.up`), and
  the prompt adds the J hint `S.promptMantra` "<b>J</b> håll: Jag kan flyga!" after whatever E offers
  (`fyren.prompt(base)`, from `updateHud`). **The vertigo**: the camera's sight line rocks slowly (yaw
  ±0.04 rad, pitch ±0.025 rad, the eye bobbing ±0.1 m; `sway`, rate 0.9 rad/s), its weight eased in
  at 0.8/s and out at 1.6/s, 0 while the mantra is held (`mantraOn`, after the wind-up) and for the rest
  of the visit once it has been held `calmSecs` (below). No shaking legs (no such pose). If after
  `remind.after` = 10 s he has not done the exercise (and is not talking): "Varje gång du känner
  tendenser till flygrädsla så gör du övningen…" [F*] (Levander's advice, Stig reciting it), once a visit.
- **The exercise** (J held, the island's mantra, §3): the engine's `wings` pose (it stops him) and its
  mantra bubble; `fyren.update` eases him back against the lantern (to rIn + 0.02, rate 8/s) and turns
  him to face straight out (rate 10/s), and sets `anim.eyesShut` (§14.6). `holdT` counts game seconds
  (`dt × timeScale`, as a mantra stage's bar) while `mantraOn`, from 0 at each new hold: at `calmSecs`
  2.5 the vertigo is gone for the visit; at `nightSecs` 6, if the lantern is still dark (`!day.lit()`)
  and not already this visit, **the long blink**: `inDialog`, black over `blinkSecs` 1.4 s (he keeps
  the pose, arms out and eyes shut), the clock spun on to `night` = 22:00 and written, `holdSecs`, the
  fade back over `fadeSecs`: night, the lantern lit and its beam sweeping round at his head's height
  (the beam's cone starts at the lantern's middle, 52.95 m). Then the pose goes back to the engine
  (`mantraPose` set: kept while J is held, dropped at its next step if not). Measured by `fyren`: held
  from the gallery door, his back at r 2.15, the night after 6 s of the mantra.
- **The cameras** (the chase camera would sit in the lantern: the walkway is 1.3 m wide, §14.5). Up
  there `fyren` sets `cam.cine` every frame (eased by `CamRig`: the eye at 4/s, the look at 5/s; FOV
  50) and `cam.yaw` so W A S D go by the view; a change of view is a cut (`cam.cutTo`):
  - `orbit` (walking, talking): outside the railing at r `orbit.r` = 7.4 at his angle round the axis
    (plus the mouse's turn, `turn` 0.004 rad/px, ±`max` 1.1 rad), `h` 2.6 m over the deck, looking at
    him (deck + 1.2). `cam.yaw` from the eye to him: A and D walk him round the tower, S to the railing,
    W to the lantern.
  - `pose` (J held): straight out in front of him at r 6.0, deck + 1.4, looking at his chest (deck +
    1.5): the lantern behind him, the railing in front.
  - `vista` (standing still, speed under 0.3, facing out within 0.9 rad of his angle, off the lantern
    by 0.15, not posing and not talking, for `still` 0.8 s): the town as he sees it, from over his
    head: the eye at r max(lantern + 0.25, his r − 0.45) at his angle, deck + 3.4 (clear of the
    lantern's roof), looking 34 m out along his yaw (plus the mouse's ±0.6 rad, 0.003 rad/px) and 15 m
    under the deck. Leaning on the railing with W held keeps it. On arrival he talks, so the first
    shot is `orbit` with him in it, and the view follows the line.
- **Off the gallery.** `leave()` (the stairs down, R, anything else that moves him off: `onGallery()`
  is y over deck − 1.5 and r under rail + 0.5): his eyes open, `mantraMode` off, `cam.release()` and
  the chase camera snapped behind him. R (`resetPlayer`) takes him to the nearest road as anywhere.
  **A mission start or the other level** with him up there: a fade under way stops (`abort`), and he is
  put at the door below (`put(false)`), never a fall; a mission start finds no stage running yet, so
  clearing `mantraMode` is safe (a mantra stage sets it again for itself). Nothing is saved (the save
  has no position, §10.5).
- `fyren.last` ({ kind: 'up' | 'down' | 'night', t, from, to }), `up`, `busy`, `view`, `calm`,
  `blinked`, `sway`, `holdT`, `climbs` are for tests. Scenario `fyren`, and two `perf` rows (`island
  fyren view` at the sunset, `island fyren night` with the beam: 60 fps, §16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the sky follows the clock (feature 30 was built):
  the climb and the long blink move the clock (to 19:45 by day, to 22:00), not `setSky`, and the way
  down leaves the time as it is; the gallery's cameras are three views chosen by what he does (round
  the tower with him, in front of him in the exercise, the view as he sees it), not fixed per sector;
  the view is from over his head, without him in it (from behind him on a 1.3 m walkway his head was a
  dark blob over half the frame); the gallery door is on the lantern's north-east side, facing the
  town; one more line, Levander's advice as a reminder [F*]; the vertigo is the camera only (no pose
  for shaking legs); the J hint shares the prompt with "Gå ner" at the door; E at the door down works
  in a pursuit (none can start up there), only the way up is shut.

### 10.36 Garderoben och bergsprängaren i rum 107 (free roam; feature 67, 2026-10-17)

`game/room107.js` (`Room107`, §10.25: two of room 107's E spots), config `RUM107.wardrobe` and
`RUM107.radio` in content/island.js, the hanger's clothes in world/blocks/hotels.js (`wardrobe`,
`WARDROBE.hang`), the free-roam outfit in main.js (`islandOutfit`, `islandWear`). In the film Ole
dresses Stig in room 107: "Du kan ikke gå sånn her nede! Den buksa og det slipset! … Shorts." / "Är
den inte lite skrikig?" / "Du skal ha sterke farger, du som er mørk." (research-characters.md:184;
buss17's outro plays the whole scene) and shows off his boombox on the plane: "Ja… Kvarts og digital.
Level her, input, FM, tape, tape run." / "Hører du? Samba." (:179). Stig's Arlanda look is the cap,
the dark-brown coat and the white mittens (:108), the end's the white dinner jacket with a black bow
tie (:113); Ole dreams of Rio on the plane: "Og så Rio! Stranda, jentene og samba." (:177). Now the
wardrobe dresses him between missions, and the boombox is the pause menu's Musik in the room. The
menu is invented (§1.6); every line is the film's, relocated [F*].

- **Where and when.** Only on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, on foot and free as the
  room's other spots (`room107.canUse()`: no dialogue, car, carry, freeze, PANIK, **no SKANDAL
  pursuit**, not in the pool fest's ring or on the belt). Priority 0.
- **The wardrobe** (`rum107:garderob` at `rum107Garderob` (−19.6, −15.6, −π/2), the Skjortbytet
  hideout's spot, `r` 1.2): `<b>E</b> Byt kläder` [N] while he wears his free-roam outfit
  (`player.outfit === islandOutfit`) and no change is under way. In Skjortbytet's suit (`persist:
  false`, §7.2) the spot is that feature's "Byt till hawaiiskjortan" instead; in a pursuit its "Byt
  till kostymen" (in the shirt) or nothing: the two never show at once.
  - **What hangs there** (`order`, each from `from[o]` = the `missions.index` it hangs there from):
    `kostym` and `arlanda` always, `hawaii` from 6 (after buss17), `rio` from 13 (after the end). E
    takes the next one after the one he wears, round.
  - **The change.** E: Stig on his mark (`mark` [0.45, 0]: 0.45 m to the left of the spot, beside the
    hanger as the shot sees it; a teleport under the cut), facing the wardrobe; it opens with the next
    outfit on the hanger (`worldHooks.wardrobe(to)`), a door sound and the rustle; frozen
    (`frozenT` = `secs` + `show` = 2.4 s); the camera cuts (`cam.cutTo`) to the shot: the eye
    [−2.0, −3.6, 2.0] and the look [0.2, 0.3, 1.15] in the spot's frame ([left, forward, height]
    over the floor), from inside the room south-east of him, Stig and the open wardrobe side by side.
    After `secs` 1.0 s: the white flash, the outfit (`setPlayerOutfit(to)`: `islandOutfit`, and
    `game.save()` at once), what he took off on the hanger, Stig turned to the eye (his front in the
    new clothes), his line, Helan går (`audio.trad('helanGar')`, as when Ole changes him in buss17's
    outro; not over the last change's, which plays about 18 s). `shutSecs` 0.8 s later the doors
    shut; `show` 1.4 s after the flash the shot is let go and the chase camera looks the shot's way
    (`cam.yaw` from the eye to the look), so he still faces it.
  - **The lines** (`lines`): `kostym` Ole on the radio "Du kan ikke gå sånn her nede! Den buksa og det
    slipset! … Shorts." [F*]; `arlanda` Stig "Det måste vara värmen." [F*] (Angerud's excuse after the
    golf, research-plot.md:294; GETUP's line too); `hawaii` Stig "Är den inte lite skrikig?" [F*] and
    Ole "Du skal ha sterke farger, du som er mørk." [F*]; `rio` Ole "Og så Rio! Stranda, jentene og
    samba." [F*]. Ole's `radioAt` 0.7 s after the flash, if the outfit is still on. Ole lives under the
    pergola (§10.25), so he is on the radio.
  - **The hanger** (hotels.js `wardrobe`, meshes of their own, no colliders): besides Skjortbytet's
    suit and shirt, the Arlanda coat (long and dark brown, a shade lighter than his to read against
    the dark inside, the tweed scarf's ends, a white mitten out of a pocket, the flat cap on the hat
    shelf) and the white Rio jacket with the black bow tie and
    trousers. The suit's colours now follow models.js (`shirt` is the jacket: the brown jacket, the
    light shirt front; it hung light before).
  - **Missions wear the story's outfit** (main.js `islandWear()`, §10.4): `islandOutfit` in free roam;
    in a mission `kostym` up to index 5 and `hawaii` after it, whatever he picked. `runner.begin` puts
    it on before the talk (as Skjortbytet's suit), `applyOutfits` uses it at every forced placement,
    and the runner going idle (`placeNpcs(true)`) puts his pick back on. So missions 7–13, their scenes
    and their checks see the shirt as before; buss17's outro cue still sets `hawaii` as his free-roam
    outfit (persisted, so after buss17 he walks out in the shirt Ole gave him). Clothes change colours
    and details only, never size: no route, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it.
  - **SunTrip-butiken's layer** (§10.23) goes over `kostym`, `arlanda` and `hawaii` as before (the
    dotted shirt takes the coat off too), never over `rio`.

    framing is not touched); Ole's queued line dropped.
- **The boombox** (`rum107:radio` at `rum107Radio`, §10.25; `r` 0.8): the pause menu's Musik in the
  room (`setIslandTune`, saved as `tune`).
  - Before the samba unlock: `<b>E</b> Bergsprängaren` [N]. Stig turns to it, Ole on the radio:
    "Kvarts og digital." [F*] (his demonstration, shortened); no tune changes; the next E after `gap`
    1.5 s.
  - After it, while the samba is not playing: `<b>E</b> Spela samba` [N], as §10.25 (the music on if
    it was off), Ole's "Ja, det er fint! Samba!" [F*] and the next time "Hører du? Samba." [F*], in turn
    (`sambas`, this session).
  - While the samba plays: `<b>E</b> Stäng av sambaen` [N]: back to the island's sol tune (saved), a
    click (`audio.tick`), no line. The samba stays the gadgets' reward: before the unlock it is never

- **Saved**: `outfit` (§10.5) is his free-roam outfit and can be `arlanda` or `rio` now; a save from
  before holds `kostym` or `hawaii` as the story had them. `room107.last` ({ what: 'wardrobe', from,

  Scenarios `klader` and `kladshots` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): missions do not wear his pick: the story's outfit
  is put on at a mission start (the idea's alternative; free roam only runs at `idle`, and Skjortbytet's
  suit and SunTrip-butiken's layer come off the same way), so nobody sits in a winter coat at the julfest;
  Skjortbytet (feature 36) has the wardrobe's spot in a pursuit and its way back, and the boombox's
  samba (feature 38) keeps its prompt and line, so the wardrobe is a menu only between them and the

### 10.37 Ringklockan i receptionen – "Och när ska vi lämna rummen?" (free roam; feature 59, 2026-10-17)

`game/receptionBell.js` (`ReceptionBell`, owned by Game as `bell`), config `RINGKLOCKA` in
content/island.js (places block-local to Hotel Flamenco's block (3,3)), the anim flag `tap` (§14.6) and
`audio.phone` (§12.3); the desk bell is the module's mesh, no longer hotels.js's static geometry (§6.3).
The film cuts, while the plane flies south, to the hotel: departing guests ask again and again when the
rooms are to be left, Lasse answers "Klockan 12. Ställ väskorna utanför receptionen", and at once someone
asks again (research-plot.md:229); "Och när ska vi lämna rummen?" is the question in the words of the
same interlude (:231). "Momento." is the porter's in the sea-view scene (:253, :442). All three relocated
[F*] (the question (t): the notes do not say which guest asks); Stig's "Förlåt…", "*pling*" and the
card are ours [N]. Invented (§1.6): the queue in free roam, the bell's ten plings, the call, the card.

- **Where and when.** `live`: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. A mission start or the
  other level (`reset`, once): the queue hidden (its suitcases' solids dead), a call broken off, the bell
  back on the desk, the count 0, the card off; so no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool
  sees any of it, and in a mission the desk is as it always was. Nothing is saved.
- **The queue.** Three departing guests, last week's (not Stig's party): `randomPed` from a seeded
  generator (`queue.seed` 5959, drawn until not `local`, nothing held), made at the first show. Their
  `spots` (block-local) (0.7, −9.8), (−0.35, −9.4), (−1.4, −9.0), along the desk west of the porter at
  `flamencoRecepcion` (2, −10): the first faces the porter, each other the one ahead. A suitcase
  stands `caseOut` 0.8 m to each one's right (0.62 × 0.74 × 0.25, two straps, the handle on top, a yellow
  tag; brown, dark brown, light brown), its broad side out, with a `prop` solid (circle `caseR` 0.32,
  top 0.82 over the floor; the camera ignores it) whose `dead` is `!shown`, so it is a wall only while
  the queue is out. The guests are people (`extras`: `allChars`, `areaHit`): Stig pushes them, a kick
  bowls one over (SKANDAL as any tourist, §7.1), a car knocks one down; `step` walks a guest back to his
  spot (min(`walk` 1.3, 0.4 + 1.6 d) m/s) once he is up, standing he turns to his spot's yaw. Held
  0.5 m off for 3 s, or 30 m off, he is put back when neither he nor his spot is seen. Drawn within
  170 m of the camera.
  - **Out and in.** Out when nobody sees it: the spots' sphere (r 3.2 round the middle one) out of the
    camera's view or 45 m (`popR`) from it, or within 0.5 s of a cut (free roam again after a mission or
    a load, a focus jump over 15 m), with Stig over 1.2 m from every spot and suitcase. In at once when
    not `live`, and at the cut of the Berra job's desk scene (§10.6, `deskScene`: it places Robban among
    the spots); out again unseen after it.
  - **The question.** While the queue is out and Stig (his focus) is within `askR` 9 m of the porter's
    spot: the first `askAt` 2.5–5 s after he comes near, then every `every` 10–16 s, one of the standing
    guests (at random) asks `ask` (2.4 s) and the porter answers `momento` (1.6 s) `replyAt` 1.3 s
    later; not in the call, not within `quietSecs` 6 s of a pling, only with the porter free; a new
    `askAt` after the call. The porter's own chatter ("Momento.", §14.10) keeps back meanwhile
    (`chatT` ≥ 2), so his "Momento." always answers someone. `hush` (a dialogue, or a talk with the gang,
    §10.28): no question and no answer, and `askAt` at least 3 s on.
- **The bell** at (3.0, −10.95) on the counter top (1.28): a black base (r 0.115), a gold dome (0.2 ×
  0.15) and the plunger, which dips 0.018 for 0.14 s on a pling. 0.3 m west of where the static bell was
  (3.3): the G17 toaster at `brodrost_portier` (3.75, −11.2) has the same priority (−1) and the nearer one
  wins, so the split along the counter falls at x ≈ 3.63 and its front (3.75, −10.3) stays the
  toaster's (at 3.3 the bell took it). Its interactable `ringklocka` (r 1.2, priority −1, at the bell,
  y 1.28): `holds()` = Stig free (`stigFree`: live, no dialogue or cutaway, on foot, standing and on the
  ground, on the floor (y under 1.28: not from the pergola above), not carrying, no SKANDAL pursuit, no
  bust freeze or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the belt, in a talk, the nap, the sun cream, a
  toaster's try or a gag) and the porter free (`porterFree`: shown, `normal`, not `busy`, in no car or
  seat, walked by no module, not `npcPosed`, `honk.free`, within `porterR` 1.5 m of his spot); in the
  call Stig free alone. The prompt `<b>E</b> Plinga på klockan` [N] in phase `bell`, none in the call.
  In a pursuit the porter's bribe (priority 100, §7.2) has the desk. Through a pling's `rest` and the
  call E stays the bell's, so a quick second press never starts the toaster beside it.
- **A pling** (`canUse`: phase `bell`, `rest` 0.4 s since the last, `holds`): the count up, Stig turned
  to the bell with his hand on it (`tap`, `tapSecs` 0.45 s), `audio.pling` (the call button's ding),
  "*pling*" over the bell (0.8 s) and the porter's "Momento." `answerAt` 0.35 s on. From the
  `lookFrom` 4th pling on the guests turn to look at Stig for `lookSecs` 1.8 s. Nothing else happens.
  The count is the session's, kept until the `goal`th pling (a mission start clears it); nothing shows
  it.
- **The 10th pling** (`goal`): no "Momento."; phase `call` (the count 0, the porter's bubble down), on
  its own clock from the pling (`call`, held while `hush`): the porter is posed (`npcPosed`: no turn to
  Stig, no chatter; the pool fest and the gang leave him be) and at `turn` 0.5 s turns his back to the
  key board (his spot's yaw + π, 8/s); `ring` 0.7 the desk phone (`audio.phone`); `lasse` 2.3 Lasse in
  the radio box: "Klockan 12. Ställ väskorna utanför receptionen." [F*]; `back` 2.8 the porter turns to
  the guests; `ask` 4.6 the first standing guest: "Och när ska vi lämna rummen?" [F*](t), with the
  radio box still up; `sorry` 6.8 Stig, on foot within `sorryR` 12 m of the bell: "Förlåt…" [N]; `take`
  7.8 the porter turns to the bell and it goes under the desk (`takeSecs` 0.6 s: up 0.16, 0.7 m to his
  side, 0.4 m back and 0.7 down behind the counter's edge, then hidden); `done` 8.8 phase `away`, the
  porter let go. No prompt at the bell then (the toaster's, if it is still to be found).
- **The bell back.** In phase `away`, with Stig `backR` 20 m from the bell and the bell out of view
  (sphere 0.6), it is back on its spot (phase `bell`), and from then on, for the session, the hotel's
  card stands beside it at (2.45, −10.88), turned 0.35 rad towards the bell: a folded tent card (0.56 ×

  stroke of its colour). The card shows only while `live`, and comes back unseen (sphere 1.0) after a
  mission. A mission start with the bell away or on its way counts as its return (`signed`). The ten
  plings work again with the card there.
- **Tests**: `bell.last` ({ n, t, call }), `said` ([who, text, t]: `bell`, `portier`, `lasse`, `gäst`,
