### 10.38 Gatlopp mot pizza-racern – mamma åker med (free roam; feature 69, 2026-10-17)

`game/streetRace.js` (`StreetRace`, owned by Game as `gatlopp`), config `GATLOPP` in
content/island.js, hooks in main.js (the objective card, the target and the markers after the
toasters' and the pigs', `npcPosed`, `update` after the bell's). Hit & Run's street races, with a bet
at the bar, against the man the sisters call "pizza-racern" on the plane (research-plot.md:70, :197):
their points become literal, the Giraffe against the pizza-racer, and the joke is that his mother
rides along ("Hans mamma bevakar hans dygd", research-plot.md:70; she joins the dinner too, :331).
The races, the bet and José as a street racer are ours [N] (§1.6); the sisters' points are the
plane's, relocated [F*](t), and two of the mother's radio lines are her chatter [F*].

- **When.** On the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, from the index after `after` =
  ropavieja (Gamla kläder) on (10 to the end). With a race left (`records.gatlopp.won` < 3) and José
  free at his place (`cita`, within 2 m, not busy, not posed, in no car): a "!" over him (a `Bang` in
  the friend teal `bang` 0x3ad8a0, hidden within 3 m of the camera or of Stig, as the giver's) and
  the minimap's `friend` dot (not at the edge).
- **The challenge.** On foot within `r` = 1.7 m of him (further off, up to the gang's 3 m, his talk,
  §10.28: the sun cream's rule at Majsan, §10.26), no pursuit, no dialogue: `<b>E</b> Gatlopp {i}/3 –
  {name}` [N]. E: the two turned to each other, Stig held (`frozenT`), José's `offer`, Stig's "Jag kör
  bara hyrbil… men okej." [N] at `yesAt` 1.5 s, the black fade at `fadeAt` 2.9 s (`fadeSecs` 0.6) and
  behind it the grid: Stig at the wheel of the hire car (`playerCar` hyrbil, wherever it stood,
  repaired; a wreck or none: a new one, `ensureNamedCar`; the car the races are measured with) and
  the race kind's init. In a car, knocked down or out of free roam then: no race.
- **The race** is the mission stage kind `race` (kinds/core.js, unchanged) on a holder of our own
  (`{ def, cars, items, data }`), never through the runner, so no mission index, saved mission number,
  "Uppdrag i/n" banner or reward is touched. Its options: `who` jose, `type` hatch, `color` 0x2a4fa8,
  `carName` joseBil (Gamla kläder's blue hatch, locked), `oppPassenger` mamma (the front seat),
  `start`, `checkpoints`, `finish`, `radio`, and José's own `cruise` and `oppSpec` per course. So: the
  grid (José on the start lane, Stig to his left, noses level), the countdown 3, 2, 1, KÖR! under
  `freezeCar`, the checkpoints (r 11; José's 13), the closed course (`game.closure`), the rubber band
  at the extremes, the place and checkpoint bar in the objective card (title `Gatlopp {i}/3` [N],
  text `{name} – kom före José! {prize} pta` [N], with a bet `bet.card` `{name} – {prize} pta · vad
  {n} pta` [N]; on foot the kind's "Tillbaka in i bilen!"), the guide to the next checkpoint and José
  on the minimap. José's car is `noExplode` (a wreck steams: his mother is in it). The banner
  `SALIDA · START` [N] across the z −40 road at x `lineX` = 89 on two poles at the kerbs (8.4 m up, the
  GOD JUL banners' height) with a chequered line on the asphalt under it, and on a course with a
  finish of its own `LLEGADA · MÅL` [N] at its `line`: module meshes, shown from the grid to the
  result, no colliders.
- **The courses.** Every one starts from the same grid, westbound on the z −40 road south of Centro
  Nórdico (start lane 5,3 > 4,3 at t 28: José at (92, −42.75), Stig at (92.3, −37.25)), 130 m before
  the first corner:

  | # | `name` [N] | route (nodes [i, j], §6.1) | checkpoints → finish | length | José (`cruise`; `spec`) | prize |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | Ett varv runt centrum | round Hotel Flamenco and the gas station, the town's centre: four lefts, back to the line | 3,3 > 3,4 > 5,4 > 5,3 → (81, −40) | 491 m | 34; maxSpeed 37, accel 10, steer 0.75 | 300 |
  | 2 | Till flygplatsen | right up x −40, right along the z −200 road to the terminal's front | 3,3 > 3,1 > 6,1 → (238, −197.25); MÅL at (232, −200) | 570 m | 33; maxSpeed 37, accel 8, steer 0.75 | 400 |
  | 3 | Till Eslöv-skylten | right up x −40 to the north ring road (the real road past the grisfest farm and the fields), left along it, left down x −200 towards the ESLÖV 3 900 KM sign | 3,3 > 3,0 > 1,0 > 1,1 → (−202.75, −162); MÅL at (−200, −168) | 650 m | 35; maxSpeed 38, accel 8, steer 0.75 | 500 |

  A finish lies straight on from the course's last node (`nearestNode(finish)` is that node), so the
  kind's lane path for José ends with a straight to it: past a corner he cut it over the kerb. The
  offers [N]: "Ett varv runt centrum, Stig? Mamma åker med." · "Till flygplatsen, amigo. Mamma åker
  med." · "Ut på vischan, till den svenska skylten. ¡Vamos! Mamma åker med." The radio (RadioSeq):
  1 mamma "¡Josito! ¡Josito!" [F*] at 3 s; 2 José "Mamma, håll i dig!" at 3 s and mamma "¡Despacio,
  Josito!" 5 s later [N]; 3 mamma "¡Josito! ¡Josito!" [F*] at 4 s, José "Jag ser vägen, mamma!" [N]
  and mamma "Inga svenskor!" [F*], 6 s apart.
- **Balance** (§8 "Races and chases": a clean race is won by a few seconds and one crash loses it).
  AI cars never get PLAYER_BOOST, so each course hands José a spec, as the night bus has. Measured with
  scenario `gatloppkal`: calibrate's autopilot (`installAutopilot`) in the hire car (a sedan, ×1.2)
  from the grid, out of the left lane, at full speed on the course's road route (`ROUTES` in
  tools/scenarios/gatlopp.mjs), clean runs and runs with one crash at 45 % of the route (calibrate's
  race crash: a stop in the left lane, 1 s to recover); the margin is José's road left at his average
  speed (won) or Stig's distance to the finish at 30 m/s (lost). With the hatch's own accel 13 against
  the sedan's 14.4 the two went side by side into the first corner and into each other: at a left,
  every corner of course 1 when it started eastbound 50 m from its first; at a right, José (`avoid:
  false` in the kind) ran into Stig braking for it. So José pulls away slower (accel 10 on course 1, 8
  on the two that start with a right) and runs faster (cruise 33–35, maxSpeed 37–38). On the shipped
  specs (the default run on the final code, 2 + 2 runs a course): course 1 clean won by 1.6 and 1.7 s (21.3 / 21.1 s), one crash lost by 1.5 s ×2; course 2 clean won by 2.1 s ×2 (22.6 s;
  a light touch at the second right, no impact), one crash lost by 3.6 s ×2; course 3 clean won by
  2.1 s ×2 (26.3 s), one crash lost by 2.2 and 2.0 s; no impact in any run. Course 1's crash point (45 %
  of its route) is its second corner, at 19 m/s, so the crash costs about 3.1 s there against 5.7 s
  at speed on course 2: on course 1 a clean win and a crash's loss are both about 1.5 s.
  The raw runs are in `notes/calibration-samples.md` ("Gatlopp", not a timer pool).
- **The result**, at once. Won: the banner `DU VANN!` / `Gatlopp {i}/3 på 0:21,1` [N] ('good',
  3.2 s), the jingle 'complete', the prize and the toast `José gav dig {n} pta.` [N], a bet paid, the
  course won (`records.gatlopp.won` = i, saved at once) and the toast `Nästa gatlopp: {name}. José
  väntar vid Centro Nórdico.` [N], after the third `Alla tre gatloppen vunna! Siv och Majsan vid poolen
  har hört om det.` [N]. Lost: `JOSÉ VANN` / `Gatlopp {i}/3 – försök igen` [N], 'fail'; the same
  course is offered again. José's car wrecked (the kind's 'done' too): no race, nothing won, `Josés
  bil är kvaddad – loppet räknas inte.` [N], the bet handed back. Then, with Stig within `linesR` 40 m
  of José's car, his piece from it: won "Mamma säger att du kör som en spanjor." and Stig's "Tack…
  tror jag." [N]; lost "Mamma säger att du kör som en turist." [N].
- **Home.** The kind's cleanup (the freeze off, the course open), then José drives back by road
  (`AIDriver` route, cruise 12, avoiding) to `via` 5,3 (a U-turn there if he comes the other way) and
  west along the z −40 road to the kerb at `stop` (82, −42.75), slowing over `slowFrom` 28 m. Parked,
  he and his mother step out on the sidewalk side and walk at 1.5 m/s (`posed`: no turn to Stig, no
  chatter) to his place and 1.3 m beside it; there both are free again, and placeNpcs takes his
  mother home to Fataga once Stig is 50 m off. 150 m from Stig, or held up 90 s with Stig 60 m off:
  both home at once. A wreck: they stand where they landed until Stig is away; the wreck is cleared
  80 m off.
- **The bet.** While a race is left, the chalkboard `APUESTAS · VAD / JOSÉ 1 : 2 / STIG-HELMER 1 : 5`
  [N] stands on an easel beside Berra and Robban: at the pool bar (`flamencoBar` −1.7, 1.0), and once
  the bodega's unlock has their home there, at Pepes Bodega (`bodega` −3.2, 0, facing the street); no
  collider. Its E within `bet.r` 1.4 m (at Berra himself his talk), with Berra free within 5 m of it,
  Robban free within 5 m of him, no bet placed and no race on the way: `<b>E</b> Slå vad med Berra`
  [N]. With 100 pta or more: −100, Berra's "Hundra pesetas på spanjoren!" and Robban's "Jag tar
  Stig-Helmer. Fem gånger pengarna!" 1.6 s on [N], the toast `Vadet är slaget: 100 pta på dig själv.
  Vinner du betalar Robban 500 pta.` [N]; with less, Berra's "Inga pesetas, inget vad." [N]. One bet,
  for the next race (this session, not saved): won `Robban betalar ut vadet: 500 pta!` [N], lost
  `Berra vann vadet – dina 100 pta.` [N], a wreck `Berra ger tillbaka vadet: 100 pta.` [N]; a mission
  start keeps it.
- **The sisters' six.** All three won, the first time Stig on foot comes within `sisters.r` 7 m of
  Siv and Majsan standing free together (within 6 m): Siv's "Giraffen, då?", Majsan's "Sex, tycker
  jag." 1.7 s on [F*](t) (the plane's points, research-plot.md:197, relocated, the split ours as in
  landning) and Stig's "…Sex?" at 3.4 s [N] (his "…Fyra?" there); saved at once
  (`records.gatlopp.sex`). "Pizza-racern" is never said: it is only the sisters' word, here the title's.
- **A mission start or the other level** (`reset`): a fade undone, the race's cleanup, José's car
  removed (the hire car stays where it is), José and his mother home at once, the banners down; the
  bet stays. So no mission, stage kind, mission timer, fixture or calibration pool changes, no world
  random draw and no solid is added, and the save gains only `records.gatlopp`.
- **Tests**: `gatlopp.mode` (null | offer | race | home | walk), `k`, `result` ({ k, result: win |
  lose | wreck, t (s from KÖR!), at, bet }), `last`, `bet`, `won`, `next`, `offered()`, `startRace(k)`
  (the grid at once), `homeSpot(key)`, `boardSpot()`, `car`, `st` (the race stage). Scenarios
  `gatlopp`, `gatloppkal` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the start line is 13 m east of the idea's x 76
  and every course starts westbound, 130 m before its first corner; course 1 goes round Hotel Flamenco
  and the gas station (the town's centre) rather than round Centro Nórdico, whose lap began 50 m from
  its first corner; course 3 finishes on x −200, 18 m before the Eslöv sign (a finish must lie
  straight on from a node); Stig always races in the hire car; the bet is a fixed 100 pta on Stig at
  1:5 (no stake to choose, no bet on José), its E at the board beside Berra (his talk keeps him); a
  wreck of José's car is no win; once all three are won there is no rematch (José's E is his talk
  again); the sisters' six is a one-time exchange in bubbles, not a CHATTER line (Siv's chatter is
  the sun cream's after `sjuPoang`).

### 10.39 Låna rullskidorna – åk fort på asfalt (free roam; feature 71, 2026-10-17)

`game/rollerskis.js` (`Rollerskis`, owned by Game as `skis`), config `SKIDOR` in content/island.js,
hooks in main.js (`step` before the player's `Character.step` and `after` after it in `fixedStep`,
`update` after `eslov.update`, the card, target and markers after Eslövloppet's, the interactable
filter, no kick on the skis, `enterCar`), eslov.js (the skier lent, and back to his place when Stig
waits there), glide.js (no glide on the skis) and models.js (Stig's ski poses, the bib, the skis on
a fallen body). The rollerskier (§10.12) lends Stig his skis, poles and an ESLÖV bib, and free roam
gets a way to move that is neither walking nor driving, where the island's surfaces matter: asphalt
is fast, kerbs are dangerous and sand stops him dead. Stig on rollerskis, the falls, his answer and
Eslövrundan are ours [N] (§1.6); the shout "Heja Eslöv!" is Berra's in the film [F*]
(research-plot.md:318), now at the bib; the result line winks at the captain's "Jag kan även
meddela att Stenmark ligger trea efter första åket." (research-plot.md:206, flight.js) without the
name (§1.5). No line is from Snowroller.

- **When.** On the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, from the index after `after` = Pepes
  Bodega (`missions.index` ≥ 9) to the end. The skis are never saved.
- **The loan.** The skier standing at his place (his `rest` between laps, and all night; ours,
  `spot` 'eslov'): the interactable `skidor:lan` at him (r `lend.r` 3, priority 1 over his `eslov`,
  whose rest it is, so at index 9 and on E at his rest is the loan and "Heja Eslöv!" is for him
  skiing; no dialogue, car, carry, pursuit, freeze or PANIK; Stig standing on the ground): `<b>E</b>
  Får jag låna skidorna?` [N]. Stig's "Får jag… låna dem en liten stund?" [N] and 1.3 s later his
  "Ta dem du. Men håll dig på asfalten." [N]; the skis are Stig's at once, and the first loan of a
  session shows the toast `Rullskidor: W stakar, S plogar – broms finns inte. Håll dig på asfalten!`
  [N]. **Waiting for him**: Stig on foot (no skis, no car) within `lend.waitR` 4.5 m of his place
  makes his next stop there due (`restDue`) and, on the north leg, brakes him and turns him back
  (`comeBack`: `turnBack` once stopped), and keeps his rest going while Stig stays (§10.12).
- **Lent** (eslov.js mode `lent`): no skis on him (`anim.ski` off), he walks (1.4 m/s) to `lend.stand`
  [−2.4, 0.4] from his place (the lane's west edge, off the race line) and stands facing the lane;
  not posed, so he turns to Stig, waves and chatters as anyone; no "Heja Eslöv!", offer or race. E at
  him on the skis (`skidor:tillbaka`, r 3): `<b>E</b> Lämna tillbaka skidorna` [N], Stig's "Tack för
  lånet!" [N] and 1.1 s later, by the loan's falls, "Du har ju talang!" (none), "Det tar ett tag att
  få in stavtaget." (a fall) or "Sand är inget för rullskidor." (one on sand) [N]. They go back **by
  themselves** (`keep`), with the toast `Skidorna gick tillbaka till rullskidåkaren.` [N]: Stig gets
  into a car (`enterCar` hands them back before the seat), a mission starts (a giver's E works on
  the skis), a SKANDAL pursuit starts, he sits, lies or is hidden, he carries someone, sits on the
  baggage belt or joins the pool fest's ring, or the level changes. The skier has them on again at
  once (`rest`, walking back to his place first) and skis on.
- **On the skis** (`step`, each 60 Hz step before his `Character.step`, which then only integrates):
  the keys are read as on foot (camera-relative WASD) as a heading he turns to, at most
  `turn.max` 2.4 rad/s, and under way at most `turn.lat` 8 m/s² sideways (13.2 m/s: a 22 m radius,
  0.6 rad/s), × `turn.air` 0.4 in the air. Within `poleArc` 1.2 rad of his heading he poles up to
  the surface's speed at `accel` 3.2 m/s² (0 → 13.2 m/s in 4.1 s); more than `plogArc` 2.2 rad
  against it he ploughs at `plog` 3 m/s² and keeps his heading until he is under 1.5 m/s (no brake);
  between, or with no key, he rolls, slowing at `roll` 0.45 m/s². His facing is the heading
  (`faceWish` off), sprint does nothing, J does not kick (a stomp in the air stays) and the glide is
  off (`glide.allowed`). Frozen (a dialogue, `frozenT`) he stops. While on the skis E reaches only
  their own interactables (`skis: true`), a mission's giver and the cars: no gang talk, no ladder,
  stairs, hideout or shop.
- **The surfaces** (`skiSurface`): **asphalt**, `speed` 13.2 m/s (1.5 × the sprint): the road grid
  (`isRoad` at road height), the Eslöv lane `lane` [−3, −58.5, 3, 10.5] from `eslovVag` (world x
  −215.5…−209.5, z −194.5…−125.5: on over the sidewalk to the roads at both ends, where nature.js now
  draws the lane's asphalt as a kerb cut, no solid) and the west stub. **Kerb** (everything else at
  kerb height, and every floor over 0.45 m: sidewalks, lots, plazas, decks, roofs): he wobbles at
  `kerb.speed` 2.2 m/s with his arms up (slowed to it at `kerb.decel` 9 m/s², turning at
  `kerb.turn` 3 rad/s). **Sand** (the sand round the town and the beach past the outer sidewalk; in
  the beach blocks south of the paseo off the boardwalk; the dunes off theirs; the lighthouse's block
  off its plazas; a solid of kind `sand`, the bygge's pile): he shuffles at `sand.speed` 1 m/s.
- **Falls** (`fall`, `Character.fling`, then 'down' for its 1.6–2.4 s): onto sand faster than
  `sand.fallV` 1.6 m/s (pitched on at 0.35 × his speed: he lands on his back with the skis straight
  up in the air, and says "Jaha… de rullar visst inte på sand." [N] lying there); off the asphalt
  faster than `fall.kerbV` 7 m/s (flung on at 0.6 × his speed); into a wall or a car faster than
  `fall.wallV` 5.5 m/s keeping less than `fall.keep` 0.45 of his speed (flung back; a glancing hit
  slides him on along the wall at what it left him); into a person ahead faster than 5.5 m/s (`after`,
  before the push-apart): a pedestrian or an extra is flung on (+9 SKANDAL, "Aj!"-class ouch, as a
  kick), the cast only barks `kicked`, Stig's sorry follows (§10.14), and he falls back. Up again
  after anything but sand: "Det måste vara värmen." or "Det är kombinationen av sol och…" [F*]
  (Stig's GETUP lines). A teleport (R, a cut) only stops him. Knocked over by a car he gets up on the
  skis, as on foot.
- **"Heja Eslöv!"** (`cheers`): passing at `heja.minV` 5 m/s or more within `heja.r` 9 m of Berra (free,
  not posed, on his feet) or a Swedish tourist (a pedestrian not `local`): his or her "Heja Eslöv!"
  [F*], and `heja.answerAt` 1.1 s later Stig's "Jag är från Stockholm, egentligen…" [N]; one shout
  every `heja.gap` 6 s at most, each shouter every `heja.every` 25 s. "Herre jävlar!" gets no new use.
- **The look** (models.js `skiPose`, §14.6): the skier's red skis and poles on Stig (`anim.ski`) and
  the `skiMode` flag: `pole` double-poles at 1.25 Hz whatever the speed, `glide` rolls leaning in,
  arms back, the tips trailing; `wobble` (off the asphalt, and ploughing) flails both arms up with the
  poles along them. A body without its own `bib` wears `skiBib`: a white ESLÖV race number with a red
  edge on a strip of the torso's cylinder (`m.T`, the torso's size, is kept for it). Flung or down
  on the skis (`skiFallen`), they stay on his feet, level in the hips' frame (on his back: straight
  up), the poles out along his arms; the skier keeps his skis in a fall too.
- **Eslövrundan** (`trial`): on the skis, standing (under 2 m/s), E within `trial.r` 3.5 m of the
  start (`trial.start` [0, −6.5] from `eslovVag`: the lane's middle a metre south of the line at the
  sign): `<b>E</b> Eslövrundan – ett varv på skidor` [N] (`skidor:runda`). A black cut 0.3 s on
  (`fadeSecs` 0.6) puts him there facing north, the camera behind him, `frozenT` through the
  countdown (`count` 3.5: `3`, `2`, `1`, `KÖR!`, as Eslövloppet). Then Eslövloppet's course
  (`eslov.course()`, §10.12: the four checkpoints, radius 6, in order, then the line at z −144 going
  north within 3.6 m of the lane's middle) on the skis, the clock `game.time` from KÖR!. The card:
  `ESLÖVRUNDAN` [N], `Tid {t} · att slå: {a} och {b}` [N] (the time so far and his two times, m:ss,d;
  `· Rekord {t}` once there is one), the bar `KONTROLL i/5` [N] in sun yellow; the guide, the Beacon
  and the minimap star show the next checkpoint, the minimap the one after it. R (any jump over 3 m in
  a frame), the skis off (a car), a mission start or `cap` 120 s end it: `Eslövrundan avbruten.` [N].
- **The result list** (`hud.showResults`, §11.4): a navy board low in the middle for 6.5 s, the
  television's ski results: `ESLÖVRUNDAN · RESULTAT`, three rows ranked by time — "Rullskidåkaren,
  pers" ESLÖV, "Rullskidåkaren, i dag" ESLÖV (his `times`) and "Stig-Helmer" STOCKHOLM (his time, the
  row in sun yellow) [N] — and under it `trial.place[rank]`: "Stig-Helmer leder efter {ord} åket.",
  "Stig-Helmer ligger tvåa efter {ord} åket." or "Stig-Helmer ligger trea efter {ord} åket." [N],
  `{ord}` this session's finished runs ("första" … "tionde", then "11:e"). First: `prize` 100 pta and
  the toast `Rullskidåkaren gav dig {n} pta.` [N]; a new best is saved at once
  (`game.records.eslovSkidor`, s, §10.5) with the toast `Eslövrundan på skidor: {t} – nytt rekord!`
  [N]; the jingle 'complete', 'pryl' (second) or 'fail' (third). 1.2 s on the skier's line: "Där rök
  mitt pers! På mina egna skidor.", "Inte illa för en stockholmare!" or "Nästa åk går bättre." [N].
- **His times are measured** (§8 "Races and chases" and "Timers and difficulty"; scenario
  `eslovrundankal`): a ski autopilot that holds only the keys a player would (a heading for the
  stick) rides a racing line (up the lane, round each crossing's inner corner on an arc of 8 m, into
  and out of the lane, or 9.5 m at the west road, 1–3.5 m from its checkpoint; arcs at √(7.2 × r),
  braking at 2.8 m/s² by ploughing on the straights). Three clean runs 28.62, 28.63, 28.62 s (T_ref
  28.62); three with one fall halfway along the z −200 road 33.52, 32.82, 32.97 (T_1 32.97; the down
  time is random); three with two (and halfway along the z −120 road) 37.95, 37.78, 38.35 (T_2
  37.95). His best is a race's (`times[0]` = ceil((T_ref + T_1) / 2) = **31**: a clean run wins by
  2.4 s, one fall loses first place by 2.0 s), today's a drive's timer (`times[1]` = ceil(1.2 ×
  T_ref) = **35**: a clean run keeps 18 % of it, one fall is second by 2.0 s, two are third by 3.0
  s). The raw runs are in `notes/calibration-samples.md` (pool `eslovRundan`, the clean runs; the
  falls' runs beside it). On this course of four corners the skis are about as fast as running
  (Eslövloppet's walker 28.18 s): they win on the long roads, where 13.2 m/s tells.
- **A mission start or the other level**: the skis back (as above), a trial ended without a result,
  the skier at his place with his skis (§10.12 `reset`). So no mission, stage kind, mission timer,
  fixture or existing calibration pool changes; Eslövloppet (`eslovLopp`) is untouched (its race, walker and
  course are the same; the kerb cuts are paint).
- **Tests**: `skis.on`, `v`, `yaw`, `surf`, `mode`, `fallen`, `falls`, `sandFalls`, `trial`, `runs`,
  `last` ({ kind: 'lend' | 'back' (by: e | car | mission | pursuit | auto, falls, sand) | 'fall'
  (fall: sand | kerb | wall | person, v) | 'heja' (by: berra | ped) | 'trial' (result: done | abort,
  t, place, caption, record, falls, run) }), `auto` (a function returning `{ yaw }` or null in place
  of the keys), `canLend()`, `waiting()`, `startSpot()`, `skiSurface(x, z, y, lane)`. Scenarios
  `skidor`, `eslovrundan`, `eslovrundankal` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the loan is at his rest at his place, not E on
  him anywhere (E on him skiing stays feature 7's "Heja Eslöv!" and its race offer), and he comes back
  there when Stig waits; on sand Stig lands on his back with the skis in the air (the sketch's pose,
  not "framlänges"), and his get-up line there is the sand line; there is a weak plough (S) but no
  brake; people are obstacles at speed (he and they fall); Berra shouts only where he stands near a
  road (between missions he is at the pool bar); the skier's times are two ("pers", "i dag") from the
  measurement, and Eslövrundan has no clock that fails it, only the result list and a 120 s cap; the
  pedestrians do not jump aside for the skis.

### 10.40 Golfbilen – pip-pip! (free roam; feature 74, 2026-10-17)

`game/golfCart.js` (`GolfCarts`, owned by Game as `golf`), config `GOLFBIL` in content/island.js, the
car type `golfbil` in car.js, the two carts in nature.js `golf` (with `GOLF_COURSE`), hooks in main.js
(`enterCar`, `updateHud`'s car prompt, `updateAudio`, `golf.step` after the cars' steps in `fixedStep`,
`golf.update` after `gatlopp.update`, the parked cars' spawn order) and kinds/core.js (`getInCar`,
`retryCar`). The two golf carts by the golf clubhouse, until now boxes in a wall, are real parked cars:
the island's smallest and slowest vehicle, with a horn like a toy's. The golf cart is ours [N] (§1.6:
no golf cart in the notes on the film); the bunker line is the film's golf round's, relocated [F*].

- **The carts** (nature.js `golf`, §6.3): `golfbil1` (white `0xf4f4f0`) at block-local (−14, 14.4) and
  `golfbil2` (cream `0xf2e6c0`) at (−14, 11.6), world (66, −225.6) and (66, −228.4), both facing east
  (yaw π/2) to the fairway; parked cars (`f.car`), named, so a mission's clean-up (`clearSpot`,
  `clearRoute`) and the tow (§10.17) put one back on its spot instead of removing it. They replace the
  two boxes and their wall (`'cart'`, 2.2 × 1.2, top C + 2.2) on the same spots. They spawn after every
  other parked car (main.js), so every other car keeps its id and its place in `game.cars`, and a
  "first free small car" (tests, scans) is never one; their geometry draws no random numbers.
- **The type** (car.js `CAR_TYPES.golfbil`, §6.6): len 2.4, wid 1.3, bodyH 0.45, cabinH 1.48, wheelR
  0.25 with the wheels near the ends (`wheelInset` 0.12), maxSpeed 5.5, accel 6, grip 11, steer 0.75
  (tight turns: about 2.6 m at top speed), mass 450, hp 80, colour `0xf4f4f0`. `governed`: at the
  wheel the pull is max(0, 1 − v/maxSpeed), so the player's golf cart (× 1.2, §6.6) tops out at
  6.4–6.6 m/s and the speedo reads about 23 km/h (`Golfbilen`, NAMED_CARS). `noExplode`: a wreck
  steams and stops. Its `build` (`buildGolfbil`): open sides over sills, a nose narrow below and full
  width over the front wheels with a dash sloping up to the driver, round lamps, a steering column and
  wheel on the left, a bench (base, cushion, a backrest leaning back) with chrome hip rails, a rear well
  with two golf bags leaning back (red with white bands, navy with tan), their clubs' head covers, a
  strap across, four posts, a windscreen between the front ones, and a roof with a red edge. Stig sits
  on the ordinary seat (seatY 0.44) full size under the roof (his head top 2.07, roofY 2.09); his legs go
  out under the dash. Not in `TRAFFIC_MIX`; the paint shop does not take it (a `build` car, §7.2).
- **Never a mission's car.** `golf.open()` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. E at a
  golf cart (`enterCar`) gets in only then; otherwise there is no car prompt at it and E gives the
  toast `Golfbilen är för långsam – ta en riktig bil.` [N] and no seat. So no stage (`getInCar` and
  its four "Hoppa in i en bil", a timed drive, `pickup`, a `retryCar`) can be played in one. Behind
  that: `getInCar` never counts a golf cart as the player's car, `retryCar` never hands one back
  (a spare hatch instead), `golf.update` puts him out of one at once whenever a mission runs (only a
  debug start can find him in one), and at a mission start (`missions.state` leaving 'idle') both go
  back to their spots (a wreck comes back whole). The harness's `anyCar` skips them.
- **The horn and the motor**: H in a golf cart is `audio.pipHorn()`, a short, feeble pip-pip, again
  every `pipEvery` 0.45 s while H is held (`golf.update`; `updateAudio` keeps the two-tone horn off for
  a spec `horn`). The press is a horn press like any other: in free roam the island hears it (§10.9).
  The motor is `audio.engine(…, electric)`: a quiet hum rising to a thin whine (§12.3).
- **The course** (nature.js `GOLF_COURSE`; Stig at the wheel of one, on the ground, on the island): a
  **bunker** (within its sand disc's radius + `sand.edge` 0.15 m) brakes the golf cart at `sand.decel`
  12 m/s² (less the pedal's pull) to `sand.v` 1.6 m/s (`golf.step`, after the cars' steps), and while the
  pedal is down sand flies back and up off both rear wheels (every `sprayEvery` 0.05 s, two grains a
  wheel); `lineAfter` 0.5 s in, Stig says "Jag pliktar ett slag." [F*] (the golf round's line,
  research-plot.md:294; design-A gives it to Angerud), at most every `every` 12 s. The **pond** (within
  its radius − `pond.edge` 0.4 m) splashes on the way in (`fx.splash`, `audio.splash(0)`), brakes it at
  16 m/s² to `pond.v` 0.9 m/s, throws a small wake every `wakeEvery` 0.18 s while it moves, and 0.6 s in
  Stig says "Oj… ett vattenhinder." [N] (at most every 12 s). Other cars cross the course as before.
- **A wreck**: steam, no fire, no SKANDAL (a named car); between missions it comes back on its spot,
  whole, once Stig is `respawnR` 60 m from both the wreck and the spot.
- So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes: no stage plays in the golf block
  (its landmarks are a map label and the fin `fena_golf`), the carts stand about 25 m from the nearest
  road's centre line, on the old boxes' footprints, and in a mission they are parked cars nobody can
  take (notes/calibration-samples.md, "Feature 74").
- **Tests**: `golf.surf`, `inT`, `pips`, `sand`, `pond`, `sprays`, `last` ({ kind: 'refuse' | 'out' |
  'sand' | 'pond' (v) | 'line' (surf, text) | 'home' (names) | 'respawn' (name) }), `course`,
  `surfaceAt(x, z)`, `open()`. Scenario `golfbil` (§16.4); `cars` shows the type beside a hatch.
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): cabinH 1.48, not 1.37 (Stig, 1.51 m from hips
  to cowlick, was scaled to 0.94 under the lower roof); the speedo reads about 23 km/h ("drygt 20");
  the lock is in `enterCar` (no prompt, the toast), with `getInCar` and `retryCar` as a second guard,
  and a mission start puts both carts home; the pond has a line of its own [N]; only a golf cart feels
  the bunkers and the pond; the carts face the fairway. "Angeruds golfrunda" is not built, so Stig keeps
  "Jag pliktar ett slag."; if it is, his bunker line should become his own, e.g. "Oj, förlåt gräset!"
  [N], and the line stays Angerud's.

### 10.41 Båtturen med PALOMA – slutbilden, fast på riktigt (free roam; feature 76, 2026-10-17)

`game/boatTrip.js` (`BoatTrip`, owned by Game as `battur`), config `BATTUR` in content/island.js,
PALOMA broken out of the marina's shared boat mesh in coast.js (`PALOMA`), the landmark `battur`
(landmarks-island.js), the anim flag `point` and `cupHeld: 'low'` (models.js, character.js), hooks in
main.js (the constructor after the golf carts, `battur.update` after `golf.update`). The PASEOS EN BARCO
kiosk at the marina's pier root, until now scenery, sells its boat trip: a short ride on PALOMA in fixed
shots with a white flash between them, as the Rio end card (§11.7). The trip, the kiosk's sale and the
fin are ours [N] (§1.6); the lines are the film's, relocated [F*].

- **PALOMA** (coast.js `hamn`, §6.3): the excursion boat at block-local (16.6, 14), world (176.6, 254),
  yaw 0, is her own mesh (`PALOMA.mesh`, built round her middle by the same `boat()`, outline 0.035), her
  name board a child (so it bobs with her now), bobbing as the shared mesh does (sin(1.15 t) · 0.05)
  unless `PALOMA.away`. Her collider is the same block as before ([174.98, 248.6]–[178.22, 259.4], top
  0.7) and never moves; nothing else in the block changes (no random draws; the other boats, the ropes
  and the order of the colliders as before).
- **The kiosk** (`battur`, block-local (18.5, −0.4), facing it): E within `r` 1.6 m on the island with
  `missions.state === 'idle'`, by day (the clock's `dayHours`, §10.10), on foot and on the ground, with
  no dialogue, cutaway, carry, pursuit, bust, PANIK, pool-fest ring, belt, gang talk, nap, sun cream or
  toaster game under way. The prompt `E Båttur till fyren (300 pta)` [N]; after the end (index 13)
  `E Slutbilden igen – båttur (300 pta)` [N]. E pays `price` 300 (`game.pay`: Ole pays when the purse is
  short, "Jeg spanderer!" and the toast); the toasts and a banner still up are cleared first.
- **The trip** (26 s; `inDialog`, the letterbox): the `clips` in order, each a white flash
  (`hud.flashColor`, 0.6 s the first, 0.4 s the others) and a cut (`cam.cutTo`: the eye and the look in
  PALOMA's frame at the clip's start, every frame with `track`, or world with `world`); in each she
  glides from `from` to `to`, bobbing (at sea a second, slower bob of 0.04).
  1. `hamn` (0 s): she glides 3.6 m out of her berth towards the seawall, the shot from over the water by
     the pier's end; an inflatable shark fin (`COLLECT_KINDS.fena`, the collectible fins' model; decor
     only, no collider, never collected, so the gag works with `fena_hamn` taken) bobs off her port bow.
     Before the end Ole stands at her bow turned to it (`point`) and says "Farlige saker. Der dør det
     mellom to og tre mennesker hver dag. Understrømmer, solstikk og haier." [F*] (his answer to Stig's
     beach, research-plot.md:281, as in CHATTER.ole), while Stig sits on her front bench holding on
     (`hold`).
  2. `playa` (7.6 s): at sea off the beach at z 352 (beyond the sea decor of z 318–338), west from x 58 to
     43, the camera ahead of her bow on the sea side, with her (`track`), the beach and the town behind;
     Ole beside Stig waving to the beach (`wave`), Stig holding on.
  3. `fyren` (13.6 s): the sunset palette; off the lighthouse she turns from west-south-west (yaw
     −1.25) towards the camera (−0.2), the tower standing behind her sun roof. "Tenk å sitte her i
     desember. Det er som i Rio." (Ole, 14.4 s), "Har du varit i Rio?" (Stig, 17.6 s), "Nei, men jeg
     skal reise dit." (Ole, 19.4 s) [F*](t) (the welcome meeting, research-plot.md:268, the speaker
     interpreted). Stig no longer holds on.
  4. `pier` (23.4 s): the clock's palette back (`setSky`, `day.resync`, `day.write`), PALOMA on her
     mooring, everyone standing in a row on the quay at the pier root facing the kiosk (`pier`; out of
     the pier coins' 3.7 m pull), the shot from the quay; at 26 s free roam from there, the camera behind
     him.
- **Who is aboard.** Stig is seated on her by hand (`seatAt`, no physics step, placed every frame where
  she is); Ole (and after the end Majsan and Siv) are doubles, Characters of their looks built at the
  first trip and in no world list, so the real ones stay where they are and no giver, placement or
  module sees them move. Seats are [u (to her port side), v (to her bow)] on her benches, the cushion
  `bench` 1.05 m over her waterline (0.15), Ole standing on her deck (`deck` 0.65). On the quay the
  doubles stay `stay` 6 s, then go once out of the camera's view or `popR` 40 m from it (a new trip
  takes them back at once).
- **After the end** (`rio`): the end card again, on our coast, sold as that: Stig and Ole in their Rio
  suits (`setPlayerOutfit('rio', { persist: false })`; Ole's double `outfitDef('ole', 'rio')`), Majsan
  and Siv behind them on the middle bench in their own clothes, a cup each before the chest (`cupHeld:
  'low'`), the samba from the first shot (`audio.setTune('samba')`); no statistics and no pointing; at
  the lighthouse Ole's "Tenk å sitte her i desember. Det er som i Rio." [F*](t), the cups raised
  (`cheers` 16.4 s) and the end card's banner `RIO…?` / "Svenskarna reser inte till någonting… dom
  reser från någonting." [F] (17.2 s, for 5.4 s); on the quay, under the flash, his own clothes and the
  island's tune (`levelTune`) back, Ole's double in his own look.
- **E skips**: from `skipFrom` 0.8 s E cuts straight to the pier (lines and banner down) and the trip
  ends 2.6 s later; E on the pier ends it at once.
- **A mission start or the other level** (`missions.state` leaving 'idle'; only a debug start can, since
  the trip holds `inDialog`): everything back at once: PALOMA moored, the fin away, the sky, his clothes
  and the music, Stig standing on the quay, the doubles hidden; the mission's start owns the dialogue
  state, the letterbox and the camera.
- So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes: no stage plays in the marina block
  (its landmarks are a map label, `fena_hamn` and `pryl_glasogon` on the pier's end), PALOMA's collider
  and look are as before, and the trip runs only between missions. Nothing is saved.
- **Tests**: `battur.sc` ({ t, variant, clip, boat, cast, pose, said, … }), `doubles`, `ashore`, `fin`,
  `trips`, `last` ({ t, variant, paid, clips, said, banner, ended: 'done' | 'skip' | 'reset' }),
  `canUse()`. Scenarios `battur`, `batturrio` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): PALOMA is exported from coast.js (`PALOMA`, as
  `BELT` and `LIGHTHOUSE` are), not through `worldHooks`; Ole is a double, not the real Ole; the trip is
  by day only (at night its sunset shot would contradict the clock); it ends on the quay at the pier

  fixed shot (the beach shot tracks her) rather than one continuous ride; no Affe in the bow; the Rio

### 10.42 Balkongerna lever – grannar, siesta och ”havsutsikt” (free roam; feature 77, 2026-10-17)

`game/residents.js` (`Residents`, owned by Game as `residents`), config `BALKONG` in content/island.js,
the balcony spots in town.js `slabLot` (`balconyLots`), hooks in main.js (the constructor after the boat
trip, `residents.update` after `battur.update`, `residents.onPropBroken` in `onPropBroken`). The
apartment hotels' balcony rows, until now empty, have people on them between missions: Swedes who wave
and call down, a guest holding a hand mirror out for the sea view, and here and there a señora sweeping
her balcony who, at siesta, answers his horn with a slipper. The residents, the slipper and their
reactions are ours [N] (§1.6); the mirror trick is the porter's in room 107 and the sea-view and
parking lines are the film's, relocated [F*].

- **The balconies** (town.js `balconyLots`, §6.3): one entry a slab, 52 in all, each with a standing spot
  a balcony unit and floor (floors 1 to floors − 1; 963 spots): lot-local (−w/2 + (u + 0.64) · uw,
  front − 0.95), so on the floor's top (CURB + fl · 2.9 + 0.02), 0.35 m behind the railing's inner face
  (a body turned to the street, its apron and its broom stay behind it), 0.36 uw from the fins and clear
  of the potted plant; the lot's `yaw` is f.yaw + π, to the street. Filled with no random draw: the
  world builds as before.
- **Who lives where**: per slab, from its own `seed` (mulberry32(7707 + slab · 7919); never the town's
  draws): `perLot` 2–4 occupied balconies on random spots, the first a señora (at `senora` 0.7), the
  second the mirror tourist (at `mirror` 0.4), the rest Swedes: 163 residents (38 señoras, 24 mirror
  tourists, 101 Swedes), the same every session. Their looks are pedestrians' (`randomPed`, from the
  resident's seed): a local woman for a señora, with `held: 'broom'`, her hair in a bun, long sleeves and
  an apron in one of four colours (not Städerskan's headscarf and pink apron); a tourist otherwise; the
  mirror tourist with `held: 'mirror'` and the `mirror` pose (the porter's in buss17's outro), but never
  the porter's look (no moustache, no white shirt).
- **Bodies**: at most `max` 10 Characters, on the occupied balconies nearest Stig (the focus: him or
  his car) within `r` 55 m (the list refreshed every `pickEvery` 0.25 s, one body placed a frame); a
  body goes past `out` 62 m, and with none spare a balcony `swap` 6 m nearer takes the furthest body. A
  body comes or goes only out of the camera's view, beyond `seenR` 32 m or within `cutSecs` 1.2 s of a
  cut (the bathers' rule, §10.22). A spare body that last wore a resident's look takes it again; else one
  is rebuilt (`setDef`, its own geometries disposed, the props' shared ones kept). A body is placed by
  hand on its spot (x, y, z, yaw) and only `sync`ed: never stepped (no gravity, no `groundAt`: the
  balcony is outside the slab's solid), not in `allChars` or `areaHit` (no car hit, kick, stomp or
  fling). They are out from 07:00 to 23:00 on the island's clock (`hours`, §10.10) and go, unseen, at
  night.
- **Stig coming by**: "in front of" a balcony is the street side of its line, or under it up to `back`
  3 m behind it (its forecourt; the back yards are 10 m and more behind). Within `turnR` 30 m in front
  the Swedes and the señora turn to him, at most `turnMax` 0.8 rad off the façade (the mirror tourist
  keeps to his mirror). Within `waveR` 20 m each Swede waves once an approach (`waveSecs` 2.2 s; again
  once he has been `awayR` 34 m off), and within `callR` 16 m a Swede calls "Hallå där nere! Är du också
  från Sverige?" [N] and the mirror tourist asks "Kallar ni det här för havsutsikt?" [F*] (the sea-view
  line at the hotel, research-plot.md:253; Stig's in buss17's outro, where the porter holds up his
  mirror): the session's first of each always, later ones at `callChance` 0.5, and never within
  `callEvery` 10 s of any resident's line.
- **The horn**: a new free-roam press (`game.hornAt`, §10.9: any car's horn, a golf cart's pip-pip too)
  waves the Swedes within `hornR` 25 m in front.
- **Parking**: the car he has just got out of (within 3 s; still under `park.still` 0.6 m/s) with
  `park.wheels` 2 or more wheels on the sidewalk (`lapp.wheelsOn`, §10.17) gets "Här nere parkerar de
  hursomhelst." [F*] (Majsan's on the sisters' balcony, research-plot.md:256, relocated to a neighbour)
  from the nearest Swede in front within `park.r` 18 m (else the mirror tourist), at most every
  `park.every` 20 s. Majsan's ticket for it (§10.17) comes as before.
- **Siesta** is 13:00–17:00 on the island's clock (`siesta`; the held test clock's 15:00 is siesta). A
  new horn press, or a prop smashed within `mineR` 6 m of Stig (main.onPropBroken: on foot or under his
  car), within `siestaR` 24 m of a señora's balcony and in front of it: the nearest señora (each at most
  every `every` 6 s) yells "¡Silencio! ¡Siesta!" [N] (`yellSecs` 1.8 s, the mouth wide and the `oath`
  arm up, her broom with it) and `throwAt` 0.55 s in throws a slipper. Outside siesta she says nothing.
- **The slipper**: a pink terry slipper with a white pom-pom (`shoe`, 1.5 × a real one: it reads 15 m
  up), from her hand (1.45 m over her floor, 0.45 m out, over the railing) to his head top on foot or the
  middle of his car's roof, homing (the arc's end is where he is now): `secs` 0.75 s + `perM` 0.025 s a
  metre, peaking `up` 1.6 m over its line, end over end. At its end: on his head `audio.slap()` and his
  squash, on the roof `audio.thud()`; it bounces off (`bounce`: 3.4 m/s up, 1.6 m/s out from her; off a
  roof 1.5 × that to the car's side, so it falls beside it; gravity `g` 22), lands and lies `rest` 12 s,
  then goes once unseen (past `out` m at once). `sorryAt` 0.3 s after the hit Stig says "Förlåt!" [N] to
  the balcony, and the Swedes within `laughR` 25 m laugh (`laughSecs` 1.6 s). No fling, no SKANDAL, no
  Guardia, no coins: he is never knocked over.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'` (with pedestrians:
  never the flight level); otherwise `reset()` hides every body, takes the slippers away and drops the
  queue, so a mission's world is as before. Lines and reactions only outside a dialogue (`talk`; in one
  the queue goes). So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes, and the residents
  draw none of the town's random numbers (notes/calibration-samples.md, "Feature 77").
- **Beside the other features**: Stig's "Förlåt!" is a line of his like any other, so a StigSorry line
  due while it is up is dropped by that module's own rule (§10.14: never over a line of his own); a
  smash may bring both his prop sorry and the slipper's. `artig` (§16.4) sets the clock to 10:00, as its
  street steps play before (4,4)'s slabs.
- **A held broom** (models.js `heldPose`, §14.6): lifted so that its bristles stop at his soles, the
  hand sliding down the handle; hanging from the hand they went 0.2 m into the floor, through a
  balcony's slab. Städerskan's broom stands on the ground too.
- **Tests**: `residents.recs`, `bodies`, `spare`, `made`, `counts` (`call`, `sea`, `park`, `wave`,
  `yell`, `hit`, `sorry`, `laugh`), `last` ({ kind: 'call' | 'sea' | 'park' (wheels) | 'yell' (why:
  'horn' | 'smash', what, d) | 'throw' (T) | 'hit' (car) | 'sorry', t, i, … }), `shoes`, `snapshot()`.
  Scenarios `balkong`, `balkongshots`, and the `perf` row `island balkonger` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the module is `game/residents.js`, not
  `world/residents.js` (every free-roam module is in game/); siesta is 13–17 on the island's clock
  (§10.10 came after the idea, which defined it as the day sky); bodies come and go unseen and the list
  is refreshed every 0.25 s, not once a second; the señora turns to him too, the mirror tourist does
  not; the slipper is a new pink slipper, not the `shoe` prop (a man's brown shoe). The strongest
  variant, Majsan and Siv on Hotel Flamenco's balcony row, is left to feature 117 ("Systrarnas
  balkong"), and so is Siv's "Vi är väl inte på nåt jäkla vernissage?"; Angerud's "Måtte djävulen ta
  alla fruntimmer!" stays at the grisfest.

### 10.43 Hytt två! – ring efter en bil (free roam; feature 80, 2026-10-17)

`game/phoneBooth.js` (`PhoneBooth`, owned by Game as `hytt`), config `HYTT_TVA` in content/island.js, the
landmarks `hyttBil1–3` in landmarks-island.js, the choice menu `hud.menu` (`#menu` in style.css, §11.4),
the menu's keys `menuUp`, `menuDown`, `hangUp` in input.js (§3), hooks in main.js (built after the
residents, `hytt.update` after `residents.update`). Booth 2 of the phone pavilion TELÉFONOS · HYTT 1·2·3
in Centro Nórdico (block (4,2), until now scenery) is Hit & Run's phone booth: Stig rings for a named car
he may drive, and it waits for him in the car park behind him. The car call, the menu and the spots are
ours [N] (§1.6); "Hytt två!" and "Señor, betala!" are the phone station's in 7.12 (research-plot.md:322,
the notes name neither speaker), given to the telefonist, a radio voice (`RADIO_ONLY`, as in the
bodega's outro), and tagged [F*](t).

- **The booth**: E within `r` 1.6 m of `stand` (2.5 m forward of the `telefon` landmark, before booth
  2's door; world (80, −74.5)), prompt "E Ring efter bil" [N]. Only on the island with
  `missions.state === 'idle'`, Stig on foot and on the ground, with no dialogue, cutaway, car, carry,
  pursuit, bust or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the belt, in the gang's talk, the nap, the
  SOLKRÄM scene or a toaster's game, not on the rollerskis or in a street race (`gatlopp.mode`), and
  with a row to show. So running, intro, outro and failed are all closed, and no mission, stage, timer
  or calibration pool sees it.
- **The menu**: Stig stands at `stand` facing the door (`inDialog`: no walking, no look, no prompt), the
  camera cuts over his shoulder (`eye` [1.0, −3.4, 2.8] → `look` [−0.5, 3.0, 1.7], [left, forward,
  height] from `telefon`), and the telefonist's radio says "Hytt två!". `hud.menu` shows HYTT TVÅ ·
  VILKEN BIL? [N] on the left under Ole's watch: one row a car (its NAMED_CARS name, "25 pta"), the chosen
  one in sun yellow, then "Bilen väntar på parkeringen." [N] and "W/S välj · E ring · Q lägg på" [N]. The
  rows are the `cars` (`hyrbil`, `buss17`, `grisbil`) that are in `parkedCars` and not locked: the hire
  car and bus 17 always, the grisbil once unlocked (UNLOCKS.grisbil, saved). Never the Guardia jeep
  (§15.5 P2; its loan is §10.34), the night bus, José's car or a golf cart. W/S (↑/↓, the d-pad) choose
  and wrap, with a tick; the menu opens on the last car rung for. Q (Backspace, the pad's B) hangs up:
  a click, nothing paid, nothing moved, free roam.
- **The call** (E): the Spanish ring tone twice (425 Hz); `ringSecs` 1.0 s later Stig orders "Ja, hej.
  {name}, tack." [N]; at `moveAt` 1.9 s the car is moved to the first free spot while the camera is
  still on the booth; at `payAt` 2.6 s the telefonist's "Señor, betala!", `game.pay(25)` (Ole pays when
  the purse is short: "Jeg spanderer!") and Stig's "Tack så mycket!" [N]; at `endAt` 4.4 s Stig has
  stepped back from the booth (`after`, 2.5 m behind the `telefon` landmark: from the door the chase eye
  went up over his head against the pavilion) and turned to the car, the camera is behind him again (a
  cut), so the car stands in the shot, and the toast says "{name} står på parkeringen vid Centro
  Nórdico." [N]. At the grisbil, `pigAt` 0.9 s later, "Den luktar lite." [N] (its unlock toast says
  "Den luktar." [N]).
- **The spots** (landmarks, block-local): `hyttBil1` (11, 18.6) and `hyttBil2` (11, 22.4) facing east
  (π/2), `hyttBil3` (−11, 18.6) facing west, in the car park's aisle north of the bays (z 25.7), clear
  of the lamp posts at (±14, 24.6) and of José's place (0, 22), each facing a street end. All three lie
  behind the booth shot's eye (local z 11.4), so a car is never moved in the camera's view. A spot is
  free when the car's footprint, `pad` 0.5 m round, clears every solid over 0.75 m, every other car (the
  called car may stand on it), every visible person on foot and every loose pig. None free: the
  telefonist's "Ingen plats på parkeringen, señor!" [N], nothing paid, Stig left at the booth.
- **The car** is always the named car itself (`game.named[name]`), moved with `car.place`, its AI off,
  parked. A dent is repaired (`car.repair()`); a wreck, or a car gone (a named wreck is removed 20 s
  after, 60 m off), comes back through `game.ensureNamedCar` as one new car of that name, the wreck
  removed: until now a wrecked grisbil was gone until a reload. A new grisbil whose pigs were delivered
  (§10.15 `pigs.delivered`) comes with an empty bed, so the delivery is not paid twice; a grisbil
  that is not a wreck keeps its bed, and its loose pigs stay where they fell. Its `home` is unchanged:
  the tow (§10.17) and a mission's `getInCar` `atHome` (buss17's bus, grisfest's hire car) put it back
  in its bay, so a call is no shortcut in a mission (the grisbil could always be fetched at Flamenco
  after the bodega, and the hire car and the bus driven anywhere). Majsan's ticket for a car called away
  gives up by itself (§10.17: the car is over 3 m from where she found it). Nothing is saved: a reload
  puts the named cars in their bays, as before.
- **Tests**: `hytt.menu` ({ rows, sel, frame }), `call`, `sel`, `calls`, `last` ({ kind: 'open' (rows) |
  'hangup' | 'gone' (free roam ended with it open) | 'ring' | 'full' | 'moved' (spot, fresh, repaired)
  | 'paid' (paid), t, name, ended }), `busy`, `rows()`, `canUse()`, `stand()`, `freeSpot(name)`,
  `fetch(name, spot)`, `open()`, `ring()`, `hangUp(kind)`. Scenario `hytt` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): three spots of our own in the aisle instead of one
  at about (87, −63); the cut is an over-the-shoulder shot of its own, not `cutTo('telefon')` (whose eye,
  9 m back, stands on the car park); Stig orders aloud, and "Tack så mycket! … Den luktar lite." is two
  lines (the thanks to the telefonist, the smell once he has turned to the grisbil); he steps back from
  the booth before he turns; a full car park is a case of its own. "Hytt två! – Stig ringer hem" is not
  built; with it the menu would get a first level (Ring hem, Ring efter bil), and "Señor, betala!" would
  be shared.
### 10.44 Poolbaren öppnar – svenskt kaffe ger fart (free roam; feature 84, 2026-10-17)

`game/poolBar.js` (`PoolBar`, owned by Game as `bar`), config `KAFFE` in content/island.js, the cast key
`camarero` (models.js; `HOMES_ISLAND`, `LOCAL_CAST`, `CHATTER`), the landmarks `camarero` and
`poolbarKaffe` (landmarks-island.js), the HUD box `#kaffe` (`hud.setKaffe`, style.css), hooks in main.js
(the constructor after the phone booth, `bar.update` after `hytt.update`, the sprint's factor in
`fixedStep`, `placeNpcs` (`bar.hides`), `npcPosed`) and honk.js (`free`). BAR PISCINA at Hotel
Flamenco's pool, shut with nobody behind it until now, opens after friskoteket: a bartender, a cup of
Swedish coffee for 40 pta and a sprint that holds 30 s. The bar's opening, the bartender, the coffee's
sprint, the refill and the cup for Fru Storch are ours [N] (§1.6); the men's-room exchange and the
subtitle's question and answer are the film's, relocated [F*].

- **Shut until friskoteket is done.** Before index 7 (`after: 'friskotek'`; the friskotek outro's "Fan…
  Herr Ober? De har inte öppnat än. Klockan är ju snart tio." [F] still sees a shut bar) `placeNpcs`
  gives `camarero` no place (`bar.hides`: hidden) and there is no prompt. From index 7 on, in missions
  too (he stands in the bodega's intro and julafton's gathering by the bar), Bartendern stands at
  `camarero`, block-local (19.1, 9.4), behind the counter in the aisle (x [18.5, 20], outside the
  kiosk's footprint) by the percolator, facing the pool: skin ES, `wide` 1.1, balding with sideburns, a
  big mustache, a white shirt, a red waistcoat `0xc8202a`, a black bow tie and a white bar apron (not
  the porter in another colour), voice 265, ring `#d8321e`; in `LOCAL_CAST` (Spanish barks); his
  chatter "¡Café!" / "¡Café sueco!" [N].
- **The coffee**: E at `poolbarKaffe`, block-local (17.05, 8.6), before the counter's north end facing
  it, within `r` 1.3 m (3.56 m from `flamencoBar`, out of a giver's 3.4 m: at index 8, where Berra waits
  as the bodega's giver, E there buys), on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, the bar open, on
  foot and on the ground, with no dialogue, cutaway, carry, pursuit, bust, PANIK, pool-fest ring, belt,
  gang talk, nap, sun cream, toaster game, rollerskis or Eslövloppet under way, and the bartender free
  (normal, shown, held by no module) within `barmanR` 6 m of his place. The prompt `E Köp svenskt kaffe
  (40 pta)` [N]; with coffee left `E Påtår (40 pta)` [N]. E pays `price` 40 pta (`addCoins`: the purse
  must hold it, Ole does not pay; the price of SVENSKT KAFFE on Bar Svenska's board): Stig turns to the
  bartender, who turns to him holding a cup out with "¡Gracias, señor!" [N] and hands it over at
  `handAt` 0.6 s (also if Stig walks off first: paid is paid); at 0.9 s Stig says "Äntligen riktigt
  bryggkaffe." [N] (the Swedes' missed bryggkaffe, research-setting.md:211), a refill "Påtår. Precis
  som hemma." [N].
- **The sprint**: for `secs` 30 s from the hand-over the sprint is `sprint` 1.2 × 8.8 = 10.56 m/s
  (main.fixedStep: `def.speeds.sprint × bar.sprintK()`); the walk 5.4 and a `speedCap` as before. A new
  cup starts the 30 s again, never more speed. Stig holds the cup before his chest (`cupHeld: 'low'`)
  while it lasts, on foot with his arms free: not in a car or a seat, in a dialogue or under another
  pose of the arms (the mantra's wings, a cheer, the giraffe, …), and only the cup flag the module set
  is taken off. The box under the meter (`#kaffe`, §11.4: a cup icon and `SVENSKT KAFFE · SPRINT +20 % ·
  0:27` [N], whole seconds rounded up) pulses for the last `lowSecs` 5 s; at 0 the box and the cup go.
- **Short of the price**: the bartender shakes his head (`anim.look`, `shakeSecs` 1.4 s) with "¡No,
  señor!" [N], and at 1.3 s Stig mumbles "Jag har bara kronor…" [N]; nothing is paid.
- **Berra at the bar**: when Stig buys with Berra standing free within `berra.r` 4.5 m of the spot (at
  his place at `flamencoBar`, 3.56 m off: as the bodega's giver at index 8 and from the bodega on; at
  index 7 he is asleep on a lounger, §10.22) and the men's room has not played for `every` 120 s: at
  3.5 s Berra turns to Stig holding his glass out (`cupHeld`) with "Ska du ha?", Stig (turned to him if
  he stands still) "Nej tack, jag tål inte starksprit." at 5.4 s, Berra "Nej, vem fan gör det?" at 8.3 s
  [F*] (the Arlanda men's room, research-characters.md:118–121, the film's fifth best-known quote; also
  at the gate, §8.1, and in the gang's talk at the bodega after the end, §10.28); the glass down at 10.8
  s.
- **The cup for Fru Storch**: with coffee left, E at Fru Storch (free, within `storch.r` 2.2 m;
  `priority` 1, over Herr Storch's look 1.4 m off; the prompt `E Ge fru Storch kaffet` [N]): her
  "Finns det svenskt kaffe på hotellet?" [F*] (her question at the welcome meeting, research-plot.md:247,
  the film's subtitle), Stig holding the cup out at `offerAt` 2.5 s with "Ja." [F*] (the answer
  there), the cup in her hands at `handAt` 3.1 s (`cupHeld: 'low'`, kept `holdSecs` 14 s), `pay` 50 pta
  (40 and 10 over) with the toast `Fru Storch betalar kaffet: 50 pta.` [N], and "Tack, snälla du! Och
  det är fortfarande varmt." [N]. The coffee goes with the cup: the sprint ends. The countdown stands
  still from E to the hand-over. She stands on the beach at `playa` until the end; after it on
  Flamenco's pool deck (§2.3), a few steps from the bar, and not while the pool fest holds her.
- **The way there**, measured as an on-foot stage is (§8 "Timers and difficulty"): calibrate's walker
  from the cup in his hand at the counter to her E on the beach, sprinting with the coffee, 23.00, 23.07
  and 23.00 s (241–242 m, no falls; notes/calibration-samples.md, "Feature 84"): T_ref = 23.00 + 0.5 =
  23.5 s and ceil(1.25 × 23.5) = 30 s, the coffee's `secs`. So a cup carried on a sensible route gets
  there with about a fifth of the time left; the 30 s is the idea's, and no timer was changed or padded.
- **Scenes** (bubbles; free roam goes on): while one plays the people within `hushR` 9 m keep their
  chatter until `hushAfter` 3 s after it, and the people in it are held (`bar.posed`, asked by
  main.npcPosed and honk.free: no wave, turn, chatter or other module's scene), turned to Stig. It breaks
  off when Stig is `leaveR` 10 m from where it started, gets into a car or a dialogue starts: the held
  people's bubbles come down, and only a paid cup's hand-over still happens.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`; a mission start or
  the other level (`reset`) ends the coffee at once (no factor, no cup, no box, nobody held, Fru Storch's
  cup down), and in a mission the sprint is 8.8 and there is no prompt. Eslövloppet (§10.12) is
  measured too: its start ends the coffee and `sprintK()` is 1 while it runs; the rollerskis (§10.39) do
  not use the sprint. In a SKANDAL pursuit there is no prompt (the idea's option), but a cup bought
  before goes on (the sprint already outruns the officer's 7.0, §7.1). Nothing is saved. So no mission,
  stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes.
- **Tests**: `bar.t`, `sprintK()`, `scene` ({ kind: 'buy' | 'short' | 'give', t, … }), `held`,
  `bought`, `refills`, `refused`, `delivered`, `berraTalks`, `last` ({ kind, t, refill, berra, coins,
  berraLines, left, lines, paid, broke }), `ended` ({ why: 'cold' | 'given' | 'race' | 'mission' |
  'level', t }), `hides(key)`, `posed(key)`, `canBuy()`, `canGive()`. Scenarios `kaffe`, `kaffestorch`
  (§16.4); `castsheet` counts 35 `CHARS` keys.
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the coffee's spot is the counter's north end by the
  percolator, (17.05, 8.6), not its south end at (17.1, 15.5), where the G17 toaster stands (feature 33,
  §10.24) and would have lost its E; the bartender stands by the percolator at (19.1, 9.4), not at
  (19.1, 12); he is balding with sideburns and wears an apron, so he is not the porter in a red
  waistcoat; "¡Gracias, señor!" is his word at a sale, not chatter; Ole has no coffee line; a refill
  has Stig's own line; no purchase in a pursuit; the delivery is built (the idea's M part), with the
  coffee's own 30 s as its limit (measured above), Fru Storch paying 50 pta, and the sprint ending
  with the cup.

### 10.45 Meta från piren (free roam; feature 107, 2026-10-17)

`game/fishing.js` (`Fishing`, owned by Game as `fiske`), config `FISKE` in content/island.js, the landmark
`fiske` in landmarks-island.js, the rod `fishingRod`/`ROD_LEN`, the prop `metspo` and the `fish` pose in
models.js (§14.6), the FÅNGST card `hud.setFangst` (`#fangst` in style.css, §11.4), hooks in main.js
(built after the pool bar, `fiske.update` after `bar.update`, `fiske.hint()` in updateHud). The pier's
end at the marina (block (5,6), the green harbour light at block-local (14.4, 29.0), until now only Ole's
glasses and the gulls) gets a quiet minigame: Stig fishes, and among the catches is the film's whole plot,
the SPORT-KNÄCKE pack, which he hands straight back with the customs' line. The fishing, the rod, the
catches and the card are ours [N] (§1.6).

- **The rod**: a 1979 rod (`fishingRod`: cork grip, a fixed-spool reel under it, a two-section blank, three
  guides, the tip ring `ROD_LEN` 2.1 above the grip; × 1.12, Stig's scale) stands in a holder on the
  harbour light's post, `rodOff` 0.46 m from its axis towards the spot and leaning `rodLean` 0.12 rad out,
  with a tin bucket at `bucket` [−1.45, −0.5] ([left, forward] from `fiske`, world (173.75, 268.85)).
  Meshes of fishing.js, no collider (the bucket is 0.29 high, a floor; the rod is thin). The rod in the
  holder hides while Stig holds his (the `metspo` prop, the same geometry).
- **The spot**: E within `r` 1.6 m of `fiske` (block-local (14.2, 27.4), world (174.2, 267.4), facing the
  basin, π/2; 0.6 m inside the end platform's east edge, 1.6 m north of the light, 2.3 m from
  `pryl_glasogon`, 4.3 m from the last pier coin, out of the coin pull's 3.7 m), prompt "E Meta" [N]. Only
  on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, Stig on foot and on the ground, with no dialogue,
  cutaway, car, carry, pursuit, bust or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the belt, in the gang's
  talk, the nap, the SOLKRÄM scene or a toaster's game, not on the rollerskis or in a street race. By day
  and by night (the light is lit after dark).
- **The cast** (E): Stig stands on the spot facing the basin (`inDialog`: no walking, no look; the day
  clock stands still, as in every scene), the rod in his right hand (`anim.fish`), and the camera cuts
  behind his left shoulder (`shots.fish`: `eye` [3.0, −3.2, 3.1] → `look` [0.0, 3.3, 0.3], [left,
  forward, height] from `fiske` at deck height 0.55), the light and the float both in the shot. `cast`
  (`castSecs` 0.9 s): both arms up and the rod back over his shoulder, the whip forward past level, the
  settle; at `release` 0.5 of it the float (red over white, × 1.35 so it reads from the shot) leaves the
  tip and flies `flySecs` 0.55 s in an arc to `float` [0, 4.6] (4.6 m out over the basin, 2.1 m north
  of the seawall, clear of the moored boats), on the water at `water` 0.19, with a plop and a little
  spray. The line (a `THREE.Line`, 14 points) runs from the rod's tip to the float, sagging 0.45 m when
  slack.
- **The wait**: the float bobs for `waitSecs` 2.2–5.5 s (random), with up to `nibbles` 2 quick dips
  (0.05 m, a tiny plip), none in the last 0.6 s. The prompt line shows "Vänta tills flötet dyker… Q Lägg
  ner spöt" [N]. Q (Backspace, the pad's B; `hangUp`, §3) puts the rod down: the hook comes in, nothing
  said. E now is too early (below).
- **The dive**: the float goes under (0.15 m, quivering), a bloop and spray, the rod's tip pulled down,
  and the prompt "E Dra upp!" [N]. E within `window` 0.5 s hooks the catch; none in the window is too
  late. Both empty ends (`early`, `late`): a splash, the float yanked in to hang under the tip, Stig's
  "För tidigt…" [N] or "Den slapp." [N] and the toast "Tom krok." [N], `emptySecs` 1.8 s, then free.
  Nothing is counted.
- **The catch**: a fish, an old shoe (a strand of weed on it), the inflatable shark fin on its float ring
  (the Hajfenor set's look, × 0.4) or the SPORT-KNÄCKE pack (the money's pack, `COLLECT_KINDS.knacke`, ×
  0.6: its own label on both faces, no picture of anyone, §1.5; wet, dripping, and empty). Drawn from
  `weights` (fish 0.55, shoe 0.25, fin 0.14, pack 0.06), except that while the pack is not on the card
  it comes at the latest on the `pity` 12th hook of a session without it (`since`). On E: a splash and
  the reel's click; the catch comes up out of the water on the line in `reelSecs` 0.85 s (the yank, the
  rod up high) to hang under the tip, then into his left hand. The camera cuts to his face
  (`shots.show`: `eye` [2.0, 3.3, 1.7] → `look` [0.25, 0, 1.3], over the water before him) and he shows
  it for `show` s (fish and shoe 2.6, fin 2.8, pack 3.4), broadside to the camera (the pack's label to
  it), saying the next of his `lines` for that kind in turn, with the toast "Fångst: …" [N]:
  - the fish: "Det är ungefär så här stort." [F*](t) (the knäckebröd hunt in the shops, research-plot.md
    :301, no speaker named) with both arms spread wide, the tiny fish dangling from his left hand; then
    "Simma hem nu, lilla vän." [N] and "Ole kommer aldrig att tro mig." [N]; toast "Fångst: en fisk!";
  - the shoe: "Någon har visst fått ta av sig skon." [N] (a wink at the security check's "Vill ni vara
    vänlig och ta av er skon.", research-plot.md:166) and "En sko till. Fortfarande inte min." [N];
    toast "Fångst: en gammal sko.";
  - the fin: "Haj!… Nej. Plast." [N] and "Ole sa ju att det fanns hajar." [N] (his statistics,
    research-characters.md:186); toast "Fångst: en hajfena… av plast.". Only shown: never
    `game.collect`, so the Hajfenor set (§10.1, `fena_hamn` in the same block) is untouched;
  - the pack: always "En julklapp. Den är inte till mig." [F*] (the customs at Arlanda, research-plot.md
    :162, Stig's per design-A-film.md:520–522; relocated to the pier, said by reflex); toast "Fångst: ett
    blött SPORT-KNÄCKE-paket. Tomt.". The money is never in it (it turns up in the suitcase on julafton,
    mission 13).
  Then `tossSecs` 0.7 s: the fish is thrown back into the water (a plop), the rest go into the bucket
  (a clunk). Stig is free on the spot, the rod back in its holder, the camera behind him (a cut), and E
  casts again.
- **The FÅNGST card** (`hud.setFangst`): top left under Ole's watch (where Hytt två!'s menu sits at
  Centro Nórdico), shown while he fishes and between missions on foot within `cardR` 14 m of the spot:
  FÅNGST and n/4, one row a kind in the order fish, shoe, fin, pack ("Fisk ×2"; one not caught yet
  "???", greyed), and ALLA FYRA! in red once all four are caught. Every catch counts in `records.fiske`
  ({ fisk, sko, fena, knacke }, saved with the records, §10.5). The first time the fourth kind comes up:
  the toast "Alla fyra! Fisk, sko, hajfena och knäckebröd." [N], a chime, and after his own line
  Stig's "Nu finns det inget mer kvar i hela hamnen." [N] (the show `allAt` 1.6 s longer). No money:
  the hunt is the card.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. A mission start or
  the other level ends a cast at once (`last.kind` 'gone'): the rod back in its holder, the float, the
  line and the catch gone, the pose off; the camera and `inDialog` are left to the mission. No card in a
  mission. So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes; the story never comes near.
  The rod, its holder and the bucket change only the harbour's images (`views`, `islandtour`).
- **Tests**: `fiske.sc` ({ phase: 'cast' | 'wait' | 'bite' | 'reel' | 'show' | 'toss' | 'empty', t, land,
  kind, result, … }), `next` (the next catch's kind), `since`, `casts`, `last` ({ kind: 'fisk' | 'sko' |

  (`records.fiske`), `rod`, `float`, `line`, `catches`, `canUse()`, `start()`, `pick()`, `hint()`.
  Scenario `meta` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the spot is 1.6 m north of the light, at the end
  platform's east edge, not the light itself (its post is a solid), and he casts east over the basin (to

### 10.46 Pesetas på marknadstaken – myntspåret över markiserna (free roam; feature 92, 2026-10-17)

`game/marketRoofs.js` (`MarketRoofs`, owned by Game as `awnings`), config `MARKNADSTAK` in
content/island.js, the shade, the trail and the roof in world/blocks/centre.js (`MARKET`; `stall` returns
its solid), a coin's `tag` and `minY` in actors/pickups.js (`placeCoin`), hooks in main.js (the
constructor after the pool bar, `awnings.update` after `bar.update`, `awnings.onCoin` in `collectCoin`).
The market's awnings were walkable floors (2.55) that nothing led up to; now a second ¡SALTA! shade shows
the way up, a trail of pesetas leads over the market to the souvenir stand's roof, and the seller minds
his roof. The shade, the trail and the seller's reactions are ours [N] (§1.6); "Jävla smålänningar!" is
his in the film when Ole haggles the donkey down (research-plot.md:302–304), relocated [F*].

- **The shade** (centre.js `marknad`, block (2,1), local coordinates): a smaller copy of the ¡SALTA!
  pottery shade, 3 × 2.8 m, top 1.45, kind `bounce` (`MARKET.pad`), in the gravel lane between rad A and
  rad A2 at its west end (−24.5, −21), with a 1.1 m way past it on either side: red and white canvas, a
  blue rim, four pots under it, and its `¡SALTA!` [N] board on the east edge, turned down the lane to the
  middle aisle. A hop onto it throws Stig 5 m up (vy 15.5, as every bounce block, character.js), over
  both rows' awnings. It draws no random number: the rest of the world builds as before.
- **The trail** (`MARKET.coins`, 26 fixed coins placed once by `awnings` at the start: world coins like
  the sidewalks', not saved, there again every session): three over the shade (3.0, 4.0, 5.0); rad A's
  awnings west to east every 3 m from −24.5 to −6.5 at 3.3 (0.75 m over the awning, also over the 1 m
  gaps between stalls); an arc of three over the 8 m middle aisle (up to 4.5); rad A at 6.5, 9.5 and 12.5;
  two over the 5 m lane to rad A2's fruit stall at 12.5 (3.9); A2 at 12.5, 15.5 and 18.5; two over the
  gap to the lone fruit stall (18.5, −7.75; 3.9) and one on it; two in an arc towards the souvenir stand
  (4.0). The route as a player runs it (scenario `marknadstak`): a hop onto the shade and the bounce, rad
  A at a sprint (walking, a 1 m gap drops him through: a sprint or a hop crosses it), a double jump over
  the middle aisle, a sprint jump over the lane, a hop over A2's gap, a sprint jump to the lone fruit
  stall and a double jump to the souvenir stand's roof.
- **The roof** (`MARKET.roof`: the souvenir stand's `stall` solid, its awning the floor at 2.9, 0.35 m
  over the others; x 1.5 to 10.5, z −3.5 to 0). Its own four coins (`MARKET.roofCoins`, 3.65, before the
  `SOUVENIRS · RECUERDOS` board, tag `asnetak`) are placed from missions index `from` 8 (after asnan),
  on the island with no mission running and Stig `placeR` 25 m or more from the roof's middle, once a
  session.
- **Only from up there**: every coin of the trail and the roof is placed with `minY` 2.5
  (`placeCoin`): the magnet pulls and takes it only with the collector (Stig's feet, or his car) 2.5 m up
  or higher. Walking or driving under the trail takes nothing, nor does a jump from the ground (his feet
  1.69 m up at its top); a double jump from the ground (3.02) reaches the awnings' height and can take a
  coin within the magnet's reach, as on any roof.
- **On his roof**: on the island with no mission running and outside a dialogue, Stig on his feet on the
  roof (the floor under him is `MARKET.roof`; in the air the visit goes on; on anything else, a car's
  roof, in a car or knocked over it ends). The first time in a visit, with the souvenir seller at his
  stand and free (`honk.free`, not `npcPosed`) within `noR` 12 m and the roof's coins not up: the
  seller's `no` "¡No, no, no!" [N] (his word in asnan's haggle; `noSecs` 1.8; over his chatter, which
  then waits 7–13 s), at most every `noGap` 8 s. Before asnan this is all there is.
- **The swear**: the last of the roof's four taken (`collectCoin` → `awnings.onCoin`) with Stig over
  `highY` 2 m, on the island with no mission running, outside a dialogue and the seller free within
  `swearR` 12 m: `swearAt` 0.5 s later his `swearLine` "Jävla smålänningar!" [F*] (`swearSecs` 2.4, the
  `yell` pose as long; his chatter waits 7–13 s), and `sorryAt` 1.3 s after it Stig's `sorry` "Förlåt,
  förlåt…" [N] (`sorrySecs` 2.2; not over a line of his own). One swear a session: the roof's coins do
  not come back.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`; otherwise `reset()`
  drops what is queued and the yell (the coins stay where they are, as world coins do). No stage needs
  the awnings, and the shade stands in a lane no stage, route, spawn or autopilot uses (asnan's walk is
  on the middle aisle; no pooled stage plays in the market, notes/calibration-samples.md "Feature 92"),
  so no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes.
- **Tests**: `awnings.roofCoins`, `left`, `on`, `noT`, `counts` (`visits`, `no`, `swear`, `sorry`),
  `last` ({ kind: 'no' | 'lastCoin' | 'swear' | 'sorry', t, … }), `seller(r)`, `under()`. Scenarios
  `marknadstak`, `marknadstakFore` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the coins sit 0.75 m over the awnings (3.3) like
  every coin over a floor, not 2 m (4.5): the new `minY` keeps the magnet from reaching them from the
  ground, which the height alone could not (a jump from the ground came within its 3.5 m), and so the
  roof's coins sit before the board as in the sketch; the trail runs along rad A, over the lane to A2
  and along A2's east end (the sketch had it on A2 only); the roof's coins come only after asnan (before
  it the roof has the "¡No, no, no!" and nothing to take), so the swear always has its coins; the arrival
  on the roof is the floor under his feet, not `onLand` (a double jump from the ground lands on it too
