  double jump from the lone fruit stall reaches the roof.

### 10.47 Vi liftar – tummen upp på vischan (free roam; feature 106, 2026-10-17)

`game/hitch.js` (`Hitch`, owned by Game as `hitch`), config `LIFTA` in content/island.js, the landmarks
`liftaVischan` and `liftaPackhus` in landmarks-island.js, the anim flags `thumb` and `ride` (with the
number `rideLean`) in character.js and their poses in models.js (§14.6), hooks in main.js (the
constructor after the market's awnings, `hitch.update` after `awnings.update`, the camera's focus
`hitch.camFocus(f)`, R blocked while `hitch.onTruck`, `hitch.onImpact` from `onCarImpact` and
`onCarLanded`, the card last in `updateHud`'s free-roam chain, `hitch.hint()` after `fiske.hint()` as
the prompt line, the truck's engine in `updateAudio`, `hitch.reset('warp')` in `debugWarp`). In the
film Berra and Robban, lost on vischan, hitch a ride: "Jag går inte en meter till. Vi liftar." and
"Fan, de luktar." on the back of a truck (research-plot.md:318–319; research-characters.md:336 says
a grisbil); in bodega Stig only drives after it. Now Stig hitch-hikes himself, standing in the bed
among the pigs, and has to keep his balance. The hitch, the farmer stopping, the ride, the lean and
the fall are ours [N] (§1.6).

- **The spots** (`LIFTA.spots`): `liftaVischan` on the north sidewalk of the z −120 road at the
  vischan track's mouth (block (0,1) local (7, 33.2), world (−233, −126.8)), the CAMINO SIN ASFALTAR
  sign 5.6 m to his right; `liftaPackhus` on the north sidewalk of the z −200 road before the packing
  shed's yard (block (3,0) local (6, 33.2), world (6, −206.8)). Both face the road (yaw 0, south), the
  westbound lane's traffic coming from his left. E within `r` 1.6 m: the prompt "E Lifta" [N]. Only on
  the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, Stig on foot and on the ground, with no dialogue,
  cutaway, car, carry, pursuit, bust or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the belt, in the gang's
  talk, the nap, the SOLKRÄM scene or a toaster's game, not on the rollerskis or in a street race. By
  day and by night.
- **The wait** (E): Stig on the spot facing the road with his thumb out (`thumb`: the left arm out to
  the traffic, the fist wagging, his head turned up the road), the camera behind him turned `lookUp`
  0.5 rad up the road, and the card "LIFTA · Tummen upp – vänta på en bil." [N]. A grisbil (`new
  Car('grisbil')`: the three pigs in its bed, §10.15's models) sets off up the road, out of the shot:
  vischan from lane (2,2)→(1,2) at 30 m (world (−150, −122.75), 83 m off), the packing shed from lane
  (5,1)→(4,1) at 20 m (world (100, −202.75), 94 m off), 12 m further, 8 m nearer or 24 m further if a
  car stands within 9 m. It is `locked`, `noEnter`, `invulnerable` and `hitch`, with the grisbonde's
  bust at the wheel (`driver`; no name is shown: his lines are bubbles), driven by an `AIDriver` in
  `route` mode at `cruise` 13 m/s with `wobble` 0.06 along `via` (vischan [(0,2)], the shed [(3,1)]).
  On its lane and heading its way, from `approach` 30 m before its stop the cruise eases to 0.55 × the
  distance (at least `creep` 2.2 m/s), and 0.5 m before it the farmer lets go (`ai` null, `park`): the
  truck stops with its tail `tailPast` 0.6 m past Stig (the stop: his spot projected on the lane of
  `stop`, 0.6 m plus half the truck's length on). The wait is about 9.5 s. Walking `leaveR` 1.2 m off
  the spot, knocked over, in a car, carrying or in a dialogue: no hitch (`cancel` 'walk'), the truck
  drives on by; none stopped within `waitMax` 30 s: the toast "Ingen stannade." [N] ('nobody').
- **The stop**: Stig held (`inDialog`), turned to the bed, the camera cut across the road (`shot`:
  `eye` [3.5, 10.5, 2.2] → `look` [−1.8, 3.4, 1.4], [left, forward, height] from the spot at its
  ground): the truck broadside, Stig beside its tail, the cab to his right. At `askAt` 0.3 s Stig's
  "Ursäkta… skulle jag möjligen kunna få åka med en bit?" [N], at `answerAt` 1.9 s over the cab the
  farmer's "Till stan, señor? Hoppa upp bak!" [N], and at `climbAt` 4.4 s the hop up: `climbSecs` 0.7
  s in an arc 0.4 m over the bed, turning to the truck's heading, onto the bed's middle (`bed` 0.3 × the
  length behind the truck's middle, on its floor 1.15 m up: the place the pigs' slots left free).
- **The ride**: Stig 'seated' (no physics, no interactables, no kick or jump), standing in the `ride`
  pose (feet apart, arms out over the rack), his root a child of the truck's tilt group, so he pitches,
  rolls and bumps with it. The camera is the chase camera on the truck (`camFocus`: camera.js's car
  branch; mouse look works), the card "LIFTA TILL STAN · Håll dig kvar på flaket!" [N] with the
  ÅKSJUKA bar (the buss17 bar's label and colours: green, red over 70 %), the prompt line "A/D Luta dig
  · E Hoppa av" [N], a pig's "NÖFF!" with the grunt as he lands, the truck's engine, and `stinkAt` 2.5 s
  in Stig's "Det luktar lite… lantligt." [N]. The truck drives its `route` into town at 13 m/s:
  vischan west to (0,2), left down x −280 to (0,3), left along z −40 (about 35 s); the packing shed
  west to (3,1), left down x −40 to (3,3), left along z −40 (about 23.5 s). Both stop as above with the
  bed's middle beside `flamencoBack`, the sidewalk behind Hotel Flamenco.
- **The balance** (every frame): the pull on him is the truck's forward speed × its turn rate (m/s²,
  + to his right: a left turn throws him right; the turns reach 6–7 m/s², the weave about 1–1.5); his lean
  follows A/D (`input.steer`: D +1, A −1, the pad's stick) at `lean.k` 7 1/s; the imbalance e = pull /
  `aRef` 4.25 + lean (clamped ±2), his tip `rideLean` = e × `tip` 0.3 rad (and a 0.012 shiver).
  ÅKSJUKA (0–100): over `dead` 0.3 it rises `rise` 42/s per unit of |e| over it (a lean of his own,
  against the pull or with under 1.3 m/s² of it, costs `over` 0.35 × that), within it it falls `decay`
  5/s; braking over `brake` 4 m/s² adds `brakeK` 1.5/s per m/s² over it, and a knock or a landing of
  the truck (`onImpact`) `jolt` 3 per m/s of the impact (a traffic car into its side at 14 m/s: + 42).
  At `sickAt` 50 % Stig's "Jag har lite anlag för åksjuka." [F*](t) (his line from the bus,
  research-plot.md:248; once a ride, not over a line of his own). Measured with the probe's leans (two
  rides from each spot): no lean, 81–87 % after the first turn and off in the second; the turn's key
  0.4 s after the pull, 7–15 % at most (61 % once, with a traffic knock); 0.65 s after it 19–23 %; the key
  against his visible tip 0.4 s late 35–41 %; the exact lean 3–6 %; A held all the way, off on a
  straight.
- **The fall**: ÅKSJUKA full: off the truck (the root back in the scene, full size, 'normal') and
  flung (`fling`: `keep` 0.55 × the truck's velocity, `out` 3.6 m/s to the side he tips (else the
  pull's, else his right), `up` 4.8 m/s) with an ouch: he tumbles onto the road or the verge, lies and
  gets up as from any fall. The truck drives on (its path wanders on), the farmer's "¡Adiós, señor!"
  [N] `adiosAt` 0.8 s later. `falls` counts. The routes turn left only, so a fall in a turn goes to the
  kerb side.
- **E in the bed**: under `hopSpeed` 3 m/s Stig steps down (`hopSecs` 0.55 s) to the kerb side
  (`exitSpot(truck, −1)`), says his thanks and the truck drives on ('step'); faster he jumps: the
  fall's tumble to his right ('jump'). R does nothing from the stop to the step down (`onTruck`), nor
  does H. After `rideMax` 120 s he steps down (a safety net).
- **All the way**: at the drop (parked) Stig steps down (`hopSecs`, held) onto `flamencoBack`, facing
  the truck, and says "Jättefint! Tack." [F*](t) (his thanks for Ole's tablets on the bus,
  research-plot.md:248); `byeAt` 1.4 s later the farmer's "¡Adiós, señor!", and at `departAt` 2.6 s
  the truck drives off. `rides` counts. No pay and no SKANDAL: the reward is the ride home without a
  car, which until now only a carjacking gave (+8 SKANDAL, §7.2).
- **The truck afterwards**: a truck done with him wanders on and is taken away `awayR` 60 m from the
  camera and out of its view, or `awayFar` 160 m off; one that never stopped and is out of sight goes
  at once. It is never wrecked (`invulnerable`), never his to take (`noEnter`, `locked`), and AI traffic
  brakes behind it like any car.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. A mission start
  (or the other level) takes him off at once (`reset('gone')`): the root back in the scene; still
  'seated', he stands on the kerb side of the truck; the cut and the hold are released only if no
  mission has taken over; every hitch truck is removed. A debug warp (`debugWarp`) does the same
  ('warp'). In a mission there is no prompt and `start()` refuses. The hitch trucks are gone before
  bodega's `grisbilFollow` drives the vischan lane; no stage, route, spawn or autopilot meets them, so
  no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes.
- **Tests**: `hitch.sc` ({ phase: 'wait' | 'stop' | 'climb' | 'ride' | 'off', spot, car, t, t0, stop,
  meter, lean, push, e, peak, said, hop, arrived }), `away`, `queue`, `rides`, `falls`, `last` ({ kind:
  'wait' | 'stop' | 'ride' | 'fall' | 'jump' | 'step' | 'off' | 'cancel' | 'gone' | 'warp' | 'test', t,
  spot, … }), `car`, `riding`, `onTruck`, `canUse()`, `start(spot)`, `bedWorld(car)`, `inView(car)`,
  `reset(kind)`. Scenarios `lifta`, `liftaFall` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): two spots, the sign's and the packing shed's road
  (the Eslöv lane meets the same road 26 m east of the sign, so it has none of its own); the farmer is the
  grisbonde's bust, nameless in his bubbles; the truck stops with its tail just past him, as in the
  sketch, and he hops into the bed's middle; ÅKSJUKA here is the hitch's own balance, with the mission
  bar's look: `RideMeter` (§9.2) is unchanged, so buss17's ÅKSJUKA is too; both rides end behind Hotel
  Flamenco; E steps him off on the way, and R does nothing on the truck; no piglet falls with him (a
  loose pig is §10.15's, tied to the unlocked grisbil and its pen).

### 10.48 Livräddarens kikare (free roam; feature 108, 2026-10-18)

`game/binoculars.js` (`Binoculars`, owned by Game as `kikare`), config `KIKARE` in content/island.js, the

  holds his (the `kikare` prop, the same geometry).

  still, as in every scene), the binoculars at his eyes (`anim.kikare` 'eyes'), his body hidden, and the
  camera's `scope` takes over: the eye `eye` 2.3 m over his feet (his eyes) and `ahead` 0.45 m before his
  face (the binoculars), `fov` 12° high (about × 5.7 the chase view's 62°), no easing. It starts the way
  the chase camera looked, `pitch0` −0.03 rad. The mouse turns it by `turn` 0.0006 rad a pixel (a quarter

  down, A/D round; the pad's sticks too), all round the horizon, the pitch within `pitch` [−0.62, 0.32]

- **Finding one**: the unfound target whose middle (or any of its points) is nearest the middle of the
  view, within `aim` 2° widened by the angle its `size` m takes at its distance (at most `aimMax` 4.5°),
  fills the aim ring in the middle (`hud.kikareRing`); held `hold` 1 s it is found (off it, the ring
  empties at twice the rate; another target starts over). Found: checked on the list, `pay` 25 pta, a
  three-note pickup, Stig's line under the picture for `lineSecs` 3.4 s and the target's name in red on
  the bar for `newSecs` 2.6 s, `records.kikare` saved. No occlusion test: the targets were checked from
  the spot (every one visible; the fishing boat beside a palm trunk, the far pedal boats behind the
  roof's south-east post).
- **All eight**: the bar says ALLA ÅTTA!, a chime, and `allAfter` 2.6 s later Stig lowers the
  binoculars: the view cuts to `shot` (from the sand south-east of the tower, `eye` [−3.0, 6.8] at 4.1,
  `look` [0, 0] at 4.55, at 50° at once), Stig facing the sea with them at his chest (`anim.kikare`
  'low') says "Inga hajar. Bara svenskar." [N], the toast "Kikaren: alla åtta hittade!" [N], and
  `outSecs` 3.6 s later he is free. Total pay 200 pta; no bonus.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`; a pursuit ends a
  look too. A mission start or the other level ends a look at once (`last.kind` 'gone'): the scope, the
  overlay, the pose and Herr Storch's filming off, the pair back on the railing; the camera and
  `inDialog` are left to the mission (its cut at its own 50° at once). In a mission there is no prompt
  and `start()` refuses. Nothing in a mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes, and the
  SKANDAL officer's stuck rule (shame.js, which reads the camera's view width) never meets the narrow
  view: there is no look in a pursuit.
- **Tests**: `kikare.sc` ({ t, frame, yaw, pitch, aim, k, line, lineT, news, newT, allAt, out }), `found`
  (`records.kikare`), `has(id)`, `all`, `up`, `busy`, `looks`, `lastAim` (the aimed target's angle, °),
  `last` ({ kind: id | 'down' | 'done' | 'gone', t, n, all, ended, yaw }), `rest`, `points(t)`,
  `aimed()`, `place()`, `canUse()`, `start()`, `end(kind)`, `cfg` (KIKARE). Scenarios `kikare`,
  `kikareshots` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the tower's roof is raised (the idea's picture 1 was
  Stig's head through it, not only the camera), as well as the ceiling it asked for; Stig always stands in
  the middle of the platform (clear of the posts) and looks the way the camera looked; Q lowers the
  binoculars, not Esc (Esc pauses the game, and its pointer unlock cannot be caught); the view is 12°;
  the towels' target is the RESERVADO sign and its row (the loungers 8.5 m below fill the view alone,
  and bathers lie on some); every target's line is Stig's own under the picture, not a bubble (his head is
  the camera); Herr Storch films the tower while he is watched, so his lens cap faces the binoculars.

### 10.49 Stig på löpande band – sortera tomater i packhuset (free roam; feature 109, 2026-10-18)

`game/packhus.js` (`Packhus`, owned by Game as `packhus`), config `LOPANDE_BAND` in content/island.js, the
input actions `sortRed`, `sortRotten`, `sortGreen` in input.js (§3), the `sort` pose in models.js and the
anim flag `sort` in character.js (§14.6), and hooks in main.js (built after the binoculars, `packhus.step`
after `bell.step`, `packhus.update` after `kikare.update`, `packhus.extras` in `allChars` and `areaHit`,
the objective last and `packhus.hint()` after `hitch.hint()` in `updateHud`, `debugWarp` ends a shift).
Stig-Helmer checks toasters for a living ("Om du köper en brödrost, och det står: 'Kontrollerad av G17',
så är det jag", research-characters.md:94-95; fataga's intro has it, §8.11), and the island's tomatoes go
by truck to the packing sheds (*empaquetados*, research-setting.md:123). Here the quality inspector takes
an extra shift at a sorting belt on the yard of the packing shed in block (3,0) and cannot keep up with
the Canarian pace. The shift, the belt, the foreman and the workers are ours [N] (§1.6).

- **The foreman** (Förmannen, §6.7; a module-owned Character, not in `CHARS`): on his spot `boss.at` (0,
  12.6) block-local (world (0, −227.4)), facing the road (yaw 0), between missions on the island **by day**
  (`day.isDay()`); hidden at night, in a mission and in the other level. He comes and goes where nobody
  sees it (his spot and he out of the camera's view or over 70 m off; a mission or the other level takes
  him at once). Within `waveR` 14 m of Stig on foot (over 2.6 m) he turns to him and waves; coming within
  `callR` 10 m he calls "¡Señor! Vi behöver folk till skiftet!" [N] (after a shift this session "¡Señor!
  Ett skift till?" [N]), at most every `callGap` 30 s. He is a person (`extras`): a kick or a car bowls him
  over (SKANDAL as for a pedestrian, a local's barks, Stig's sorry), and he walks back to his spot (a
  teleport back from over 25 m when unseen).
- **The prompt**: within `r` 2.2 m of his spot, with him standing there (normal, within 1 m), "E Ta ett
  skift" [N]. Only on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, by day, Stig on foot and on the ground,
  with no dialogue, cutaway, car, carry, pursuit, bust or PANIK, not in the pool fest's ring, on the belt,
  in the gang's talk, the nap, the SOLKRÄM scene, a toaster's game, on the rollerskis, in a street race, a
  cast at the pier, the binoculars or a hitch truck's bed.
- **The shift** (E): `inDialog` (no walking; the clock stands still, as in every scene) and a `fadeSecs`
  0.5 s black fade; behind it the belt and its things are made visible (built at the first shift, no solid
  or collider, a group at the block's centre; hidden again after the shift), Stig stands at `stig` (0,
  7.95), 1.45 m before the loading dock, behind the belt facing south (yaw 0), the foreman at `shiftAt`
  (2.75, 8.0) behind the belt by its end, turned to Stig, the two workers at (−5.0, 8.0) and (−2.7, 8.0),
  and the camera cuts to `shot` (eye (0, 15.2) at 2.85 m, looking at (0, 9.4) at 0.75 m: the belt across
  the middle of the screen, the bins under it, Stig's head under the objective card, the bins above the
  prompt line). The belt: a dark rubber band from `x0` −5.8 to `x1` 3.2 at z 9.15, its top 0.92 over the
  yard's dirt, 0.72 wide, with steel rails and legs, rollers at the ends, grey cleats riding round with it,
  a blue motor box at its end and a crate of tomatoes at its head (off the left edge of the shot); the
  `zone` x [−0.6, 0.6] before Stig yellow on both rails, with a short yellow post at each end on the front
  rail. Before the belt the bins (`bins`): an open crate on ROJOS (−1.55, 10.25) on Stig's right (the
  screen's left), the tin bucket (0, 10.2) before him, a crate on VERDES (1.55, 10.25) on his left, their
  signs ROJOS (red) and VERDES (green) on two posts behind each crate (Spanish, §1.3). After `introSecs`
  2.6 s, the foreman's "Röda i ROJOS, gröna i VERDES, ruttna i hinken. ¡Vamos!" [N] (pointing) and Stig's
  "Jag är van vid kvalitetskontroll." [N], the belt starts.
- **The tomatoes**: `count` 40 a shift, oversized (r 0.13) so they read from the camera: red (`rojo`, 45 %),
  green (`verde`, 35 %, a little smaller and paler) and rotten (`podrido`, 20 %, squat, brown, spotted, a
  grey bloom of mould), drawn from a seeded draw a shift (`seed` 109 on, one up a shift); three instanced
  meshes with outlines. They come on at the belt's head, each `gap` m behind the last (1.9 m at the start,
  1.15 m at the end, by the share come on), and the belt's speed rises the same way from `speed` 0.75 to
  1.9 m/s: a tomato every 2.5 s at the start, every 0.6 s at the end; 1.6 s in the zone at the start, 0.63
  s at the end. The foreman hurries him on at `fasterAt` 35 % and 70 % of them come on: "¡Más rápido,
  señor!" [N] and "Fortare, señor! ¡Rápido!" [N] (pointing), with a rising hum.
- **Sorting**: A (←, the pad's d-pad ←) throws the frontmost tomato inside the zone (the one furthest
  along) into ROJOS, S (↓) into the bucket, D (→) into VERDES; at most one every `cool` 0.14 s. Stig's `sort`
  pose plays 0.3 s ('R', 'C', 'L'), also when the zone is empty (then nothing happens, a soft tick). The
  right bin: the tomato flies there in `flySecs` 0.32 s and lies in the crate (five places, three and two
  on top) or goes into the bucket. The wrong bin: it flies to that bin's rim and bounces out onto the ground
  before it, one **dropped**; the foreman says "Den är röd, señor!", "Den är grön, señor!" or "Den är
  rutten, señor!" [N] for the tomato's kind, at most every `wrongGap` 1.6 s. A tomato that rides past the
  zone and off the belt's end drops onto the **pile** at (3.95, 8.95) (a heap, the first ones in the middle
  and on top), one dropped too. The card's bar TAPPADE counts them (§11.4).
- **The crates**: `perBox` 5 tomatoes fill one. When the fifth has landed, Stig stamps it (the `tap` pose
  `stampSecs` 0.3 s, the stamp's thump) and the label KONTROLLERAD AV G17 [F*] (yellow, as the toasters',
  §10.24) shows on its front; the shift's first is said too, "Kontrollerad av G17." [F*]. The crate swings
  onto its stack beside its bin (`stacks`: ROJOS's at −2.9, VERDES's at 2.9; four high, then a second stack
  outside), and a new empty crate pops onto the bin once the full one is away (a tomato thrown at it before
  lands where it will stand).
- **The end**:
  - **A whole shift**: every tomato handled with fewer than `pileMax` 8 dropped. The belt stops, the stamp
    KONTROLLERAD AV G17 (`stamp`, the stunt jumps' banner, §10.27), `pay` 100 pta, the foreman's "¡Muy
    bien, señor! Hundra pesetas." [N], Stig cheering and, 1.3 s on, "Om det står 'Kontrollerad av G17' på
    lådan, så är det jag." [F*] (his line at the pool, turned to the boxes).
  - **TOMATRAS**: the eighth dropped. The belt stops, every tomato on it and on the pile rolls off across
    the yard (bouncing, slowing, never into the dock's face), the camera shakes with a rumble and splats,
    and Stig stands with his arms out (`placate` 2) and a red and a green tomato in his hands: "Ursäkta…
    ett ögonblick bara…" [N]; 0.7 s on the foreman scratches his head, "¡Ay, ay, ay! Tomaterna, señor!"
    [N], and at 2.3 s, warm, "Ingen fara, señor. Mañana igen?" [N]. No pay. (The idea's TOMATRAS banner
    is only the card's: a banner over the middle of the screen covered Stig's arms, the moment's gag.)
  - **Q** (Backspace, the pad's B), in the intro or on the belt: the foreman's "Redan trött, señor?" [N]; no
    pay.
  - The card (`hud.showScore`, §11.4): `SKIFTET KLART · n LÅDOR · 100 PTA`, `TOMATRAS · n LÅDOR` or (with a
    crate filled) `SKIFTET SLUT · n LÅDOR`, under it `NYTT REKORD!` or `REKORD: n LÅDOR`. The crates filled
    count in any end; the most in one shift is `records.packhus`, saved at once when beaten (§10.5).
  - `doneSecs` 3.6 s (`rasSecs` 3.6, 1.6 after Q) later a black fade: behind it the belt, the crates, the
    tomatoes and the workers go, the foreman back on his spot facing the road, Stig at `after` (−1.5, 13.6)
    facing the shed (π) with the foreman on his right within reach (the prompt again), the camera behind
    him, free.
- **Siv**: after a shift with `sivAfter` 5 or more tomatoes sorted, the next time Stig on foot comes within
  `sivR` 4.5 m of Siv (free, not saying anything, no gang talk, not in a car), she says "Spänn av,
  Stig-Helmer. Du är ledig." [F*](t) (the film's "Spänn av, Majsan. Du är ledig.", research-characters.md:
  212-213, turned to Stig), once; another shift brings it again.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. A mission start or the
  other level ends a shift at once (`last.kind` 'gone'): the belt and everything on it, the workers and the
  poses gone, the fade off, the foreman hidden; the camera and `inDialog` are left to the mission. A debug
  warp ends it too. In a mission nobody stands on the yard, there is no prompt and `start()` refuses. Nothing
  of it is a solid or a collider and nothing is there in a mission, so no mission, stage, timer, fixture or
  calibration pool changes (no random stage is near block (3,0); the hitch-hiking spot `liftaPackhus` is
  on the road's sidewalk, 21 m south of the foreman).
- **Balance** (modelled, `packhusbalans`: the autopilot sorts the frontmost tomato in the zone `react` s
  after it became the front one, with a share `wrong` of wrong keys; 3 shifts a model): a quick clean
  player (0.3 s, no wrong key) finished 3 of 3 with nothing dropped (5 crates each); a slow clean one (0.55
  s) 3 of 3, dropping 2–3 at the end where two tomatoes share the zone (4–6 crates); 0.45 s with 15 % wrong
  keys 2 of 3 (3, 8 and 7 dropped: the second came down on the last tomatoes); 30 % wrong keys came down 3
  of 3 after 17–26 tomatoes; a reaction of 0.75 s came down 3 of 3 at the 31st, where the belt passes 1.6
  m/s. A human sees the colour coming about 4 m before the zone (the shot's left edge) and can press as it
  enters, but tires and fumbles at the end; the whole shift is meant to be within reach and the collapse common at a first try. Not a mission
  timer (§8's rule does not apply); only hand play can judge the feel (HANDOFF §4.7).
- **Tests**: `packhus.sc` ({ phase 'in' | 'intro' | 'run' | 'end' | 'out', t, T, toms [{ kind, st
  'belt' | 'fly' | 'box' | 'ground' | 'pile' | 'roll' | 'held' | 'gone', x, y, z, crate, slot, id }], v,
  spawned, sorted, dropped, wrong, filled, bins, done, hold (the belt stopped), next (the next kinds),
  result, … }), `auto` ({ react, wrong }), `seed`, `shifts`, `sivDue`, `shown`, `boss`, `workers`,
  `crates`, `built`, `last` ({ kind: 'done' | 'ras' | 'quit' | 'gone', t, boxes, dropped, sorted, wrong,
  spawned, pay, record, best, ended }), `speedAt(k)`, `gapAt(k)`, `inZone()`, `sort(kind)`, `bossSpot()`,
  `at([x, z], y)`, `canUse()`, `start()`, `end(kind)`, `cfg` (LOPANDE_BAND). Scenarios `packhus`,
  `packhusbalans` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the yard variant (M): the shed's middle gate stays
  shut and the shed a solid box; the belt, the bins and the workers exist only during a shift (as the idea
  asks). The foreman stands behind the belt by its end during a shift (in front he stood off the frame's
  edge or before the pile). There is no TOMATRAS banner (see above). A wrong key throws the tomato into the
  wrong bin and out onto the ground (the idea did not say), so the pile's limit counts tomatoes on the ground
  of both kinds (TAPPADE). The foreman is there by day only. The pay is for a whole shift only; a collapsed
  shift's crates still count for the record. The "Moderna tider" thought stays out of the game's text.

### 10.50 Strandvolley mot Berra och Robban (free roam; feature 111, 2026-10-18)

`game/volley.js` (`Volley`, owned by Game as `volley`), config `VOLLEY` in content/island.js, the landmark
`volley` in landmarks-island.js, the anim flag `volley` in character.js and its poses in models.js (§14.6),
the scoreboard `hud.setVolley` (`#volley` in style.css, §11.4), hooks in main.js (built after the
packing shed, `volley.update` after `packhus.update`, `volley.step` in fixedStep after `packhus.step`, `swing()`
when a kick starts, `ate()` before the kick's areaHit, E off in a match, `hint()` for the keys, `posed`,
`debugWarp` ends a match), `honk.free` (no horn answer from a player in a match), and the court in coast.js
(block (4,6), `playaBoats`). The film has no volleyball: the match is ours [N] (§1.6). Its opponents and
their thirst are the film's: Robban "trögare och mer stillsam än Berra, men lika törstig"
(research-characters.md:375), their lines between the points relocated from the walk to the bodega and the
pool [F*].

- **The court**: the landmark `volley` is the net's middle on the sand (block-local (−16, 4), world (64,
  244)), facing the sea. Court places are [u, v]: u metres to its left (+x), v forward (+z, the sea); Stig's
  half is v < 0, the land side, so the chase camera behind him looks over the net at the sea. The lines
  `court` [4.5, 4.0] (9 × 8 m, as painted), the net along u over v 0 from `net` [1.45, 2.45] m over the
  sand (its posts are the only solids, as before; nobody walks into the mesh). The court's fixed white
  ball is gone from the merged geometry, and the boardwalk on (4,6) now ends 1.5 m short of the court's
  north line (local z −1.5; it ran over the court's east part). No other world change; no collider added.
- **The ball** (`ball`): `r` 0.24 m, red and white gores (one toon mesh), a blob shadow on the sand under it
  (smaller and fainter with height) and, while a ball comes down on Stig's half in a rally, a cream ring with
  a dot where it will land. Gravity `g` 12 m/s², no drag (so its landing is predicted exactly); on the
  sand it bounces with `bounce` 0.42 (and 0.62 of its speed along) above `stopV` 1.3 m/s, then rolls,
  slowing by `roll` 2.4/s. Off walls, posts and props taller than its bottom (×1.55 of the speed into
  them back out), off the net (the tape bumps it up and on, the mesh drops it back on its side) and off
  bodies: Stig's always (walking into it pushes it along, a hop at a walk), Ole's, Berra's and Robban's in a
  match (never the one who touched it within 0.4 s, nor the ball waiting for Stig's serve). A car knocks it
  on (× 1.3 of its velocity and up); it is never an obstacle to one. Its physics runs only on the island
  with no mission running; in a mission it lies at `rest` and nothing moves it.
- **Free roam, no match**: the ball lies at `rest` [1.2, −1.6] on Stig's half. J with it in reach (below)
  kicks it `free.dist` 7 m along his facing, its arc `free.apex` 3.0 m up, and a kick that meets it does no
  areaHit. Off the court and Stig (on foot or driving) over `homeR` 35 m from both it and its rest spot,
  it is back at `rest`; a mission start or the other level puts it back at once.
- **The start**: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, the ball on the court (within 1.5 m of the
  lines), Stig on foot, on the ground and in no other hold (no dialogue, cutaway, car, carry, pursuit, bust,
  PANIK, pool-fest ring, belt, gang talk, nap, SOLKRÄM, toaster game, rollerskis, street race, cast, look
  through the binoculars, hitch, daydream, boat trip or phone call), and Ole, Berra and Robban each free
  (shown, standing, not busy, in no car or seat, not walked by a module, not posed, free for the horn) and
  none of them the idle mission's giver or extra (so not at asnan, the bodega, grisfest or julafton; always
  after the end): E within `r` 1.6 m of the ball, "E Spela volley" [N]. Stig is held through a black fade
  (`fadeSecs` 0.7 s; `hud.fade`, the 0.6 s CSS one) and the three are ours from the press (busy, `steer`,
  posed). Behind the black: Stig on `marks.stig` [1.0, −2.8], Ole on [−2.2, −2.0], both facing the sea,
  Berra on [1.9, 2.3] and Robban on [−2.0, 2.6] facing them; the ball on the sand 0.9 m before Stig; the
  camera behind him, snapped. The banner STRANDVOLLEY · Först till fem [N] (2.2 s), the board, Berra's "En
  match. Sen går vi till baren." [N] and Ole's "Nå tar vi dem, Stig!" [N]. Stig serves first.
- **Stig's kick** (J on the ground: the engine's kick, `swing()` opens a window of `kick.window` 0.4 s): the
  first step in it with the ball within `reach` 1.05 m of the point `ahead` 0.55 m before him, its bottom
  −0.3 to `high` 1.6 m over his feet, and him on his feet (as the kick's own test). The ball goes over the net
  to a spot `depth` [1.3, 3.3] m into their half, sideways by his facing's sideways part × `side` 0.5
  (clamped at ±1.2 of the depth to go), ± `spread` 0.35 m (± 0.21 deep), its arc `apex` 4.4 m over the sand,
  raised by 0.4 m at a time while it would touch the net (checked over the net's slab, its radius either
  side). The facing is his; when it points less than `minFwd` 0.3 towards the net (he walked back or
  sideways to the ball), the camera's, and when that does too, straight over. He turns to the kick. A
  kick that meets the ball does no areaHit, and in a match no kick does (nobody is bowled, nothing breaks).
  Never from their half (Stig over v 0.5) nor at a ball over the net (v over 0.15). The stomp and the glide
  in the air are as ever.
- **The header**: Stig in the air (a jump) with the ball's middle within `header.r` 0.62 m of his head
  (0.25 m under his top) heads it: as a kick, the arc `apex` 3.6 m (quicker), and their miss chance on it
  `harder` +0.15. Not twice running.
- **Ole** takes a ball coming down on his side over `ole.take` 2.3 m from Stig and nearer Ole (judged at the
  touch, never his own twice running), `react` 0.15 s after it, at `speed` 4.2 m/s, and bumps it up for
  Stig (`anim.volley` 'bump'): to `ahead` 0.9 m before Stig, inside the lines and 0.7–3.6 m from the net,
  arc `apex` 4.6 m; `bad` 0.08 of them go astray (3.5–6 m to a side, 2.5–5 m back). Otherwise he stands at
  `base` [±2.2, −2.0], on the other side from Stig. A ball he sees going out he leaves (`leaveOut` 0.9),
  calling "Ute!" [N] (the word is the same in bokmål).
- **Berra and Robban**: the one who gets to where their ball will be `hitH` 1.2 m over the sand sooner
  goes for it, `react` 0.35 s after the touch, at `speed` (Berra 2.5, Robban 2.0 m/s: he is the slower),
  × (1 − `slow` 0.04 × the thirst), the points played. In reach (within `reach` 0.95 m, the ball `low` 0.35 to
  `high` 2.3 m over his feet, coming down) he bumps it: a miss with `miss` [0.08 + 0.06 × the thirst + `tire`
  0.04 × their touches in this rally, at most 0.6] (+0.15 on a header): 0.45 of them low into the net's
  mesh, the rest out to a side (1.1–3.5 m out, up to 1.5 m behind Stig's line). Otherwise a lob into Stig's
  half, `to` u ±3.8, v −3.5 to −0.9, each off by `err` 0.3 + 0.12 × the thirst m, arc `apex` 4.0–5.0 m;
  with `smash.p` 0.3 − 0.04 × the thirst a hard low one (arc 3.1 m) into a back corner (u ±2.4–4.1, v
  −3.7 to −2.4). A ball they see going out they leave (`leaveOut` 0.75), Berra calling "Ute!" [N].
  Standing, they and Ole watch the ball.
- **Their serve** (they serve when they won the last point, taking turns from Berra): the server walks to his
  `serveSpot` (Berra [1.3, 3.5], Robban [−1.3, 3.5]) with the ball tossed to him, holds it up over his head
  (`anim.volley` 'up') and after `serveHold` 1.3 s there (or 5.3 s on the way) serves: a fault into the
  net with `fault` 0.08 + 0.03 × the thirst (at most 0.3), else a lob to v −3.6 to −1.6. Stig's serve: the
  ball tossed onto the sand 0.9 m before him (if he is on his half, else before his mark), still until he
  kicks it (pushed or knocked off his half, it is put back there); after `serveHintSecs` 8 s without a
  kick, once a match, the toast "J Sparka bollen över nätet!". The toss to either server flies clear of
  posts, the net and bodies (a post once sent it back onto their side).
- **A point**: the ball's first touch of the ground after a hit. In the lines (with half its radius over
  them): the other side's point if it came down on its own side of the net, else a point against the
  hitter's side ("Inne!" for the former; "I nätet!" if it touched the net, "Fel serve!" for a serve fault,
  "Miss!" otherwise). Out: a point against the hitter's side ("Ute!", or the net's or the fault's). A rally
  with no touch for `stall` 12 s, or the ball over `farR` 30 m off: out. The whistle, the point on the
  board (its number bumps) and the reason in red under it for the `pointSecs` 2.6 s pause; `tossAt` 1.1 s in
  the ball flies to the next server. Ole after Stig's side's point: "Heia Norge!" [F*] (his solo dance at
  the grisfest, research-characters.md:192) then "Bra, Stig!" [N] in turn; after theirs, 0.6 of the time,
  "Kom igjen, Stig!" or "Det var nære på." [N]. After the 2nd, 4th and 6th point played the thirst:
  Robban's "Jag är törstig, Berra." and Berra's "Du har ingen karaktär alls, Robban." [F*]
  (research-plot.md:316); "Ska vi ta Pepes Bodega i dag?" / "Vi kan väl ta det lite lugnt?" [F*](t)
  (research-plot.md:285, the speakers ours); Robban's "Fan, vad jag är törstig." [F*] (research-plot.md:318).
- **The board** (`hud.setVolley`, §11.4): top in the middle while a match is under way and through its end:
  STIG & OLE n – m BERRA & ROBBAN [N], under it FÖRST TILL 5, or a point's reason in red. The keys (the
  prompt, `hint()`): "J Sparka · SPACE Hoppa och nicka · Q Ge upp" [N]. E does nothing in a match.
- **The end** (`winTo` 5): the banner MATCHEN VUNNEN! or MATCHEN FÖRLORAD with the score (Stig & Ole a–b
  Berra & Robban) [N], the jingle (and applause for a win), `records.volley` { won, lost } saved at once.
  Won: Ole's "Heia Norge!", Berra's "Nu går vi till baren, Robban." and Robban's "Äntligen." [N]; after
  `endSecs` 4.2 s Berra and Robban walk off along `walkOff.path` ([1.5, −14], then up to the paseo [1.5, −33])
  at 1.6 m/s and are free there (or after `secs` 24 s), Ole free at once; `placeNpcs` puts them home once
  Stig is 50 m off. Lost: Berra's "Fem! Nu tar vi en öl." and Ole's "Vi må ha revansj, Stig!" [N]; for
  `rematchSecs` 14 s they stay on the court and E anywhere within 2 m of the lines is "E Revansch!" [N]: the
  fade and a new match at 0–0 (the thirst back to 0); after it, or Stig over `leaveR` 7 m off the lines, in a
  car or in a pursuit, they walk off as above. No pay either way.
- **Balance** (no timer: nothing is timed or paid; modelled with an autopilot in Stig's place that walks at
  5.4 m/s 0.35 s after each touch to where the ball comes down, kicks in time with a given share of the
  balls and aims up to 25° off straight): at 0.75 of the kicks in time it won 5–4, 5–2 and 5–3, Berra and
  Robban winning points with their corners and Stig's outs and losing them with their nets and outs as
  they tire; the scenario's 0.92 won 5–0, 5–2 and 5–1; Stig idle lost 0–5 twice. Before the last tuning
  (their misses 0.1 + 0.04 × the thirst, `tire` 0.05, a 0.32 s window) 0.85 won 5–3, 5–1, 5–1 with most of
  its points their own errors and 0.7 lost 1–5 and 2–5; now they start surer and tire faster.
- **Off**: Q (Backspace, the pad's B) gives a match up; Stig over `leaveR` 7 m outside the lines (or in a
  car) for `leaveSecs` 1.5 s, a pursuit or a debug warp ends it the same way: Berra's "Då går vi till baren
  då." [N] (not on a warp), the walk off, Ole free, the board off, the ball where it is. A mission start or
  the other level ends it at once (`last.kind` 'gone'): everyone home (as `placeNpcs` puts them), the
  ball back at `rest`, the board off, a fade undone. So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration
  pool sees any of it, and nothing is paid.
- **Tests**: `volley.mode` (null | 'fade' | 'serve' | 'rally' | 'point' | 'end' | 'rematch'), `playing`,
  `score`, `thirst`, `next`, `server`, `touch` ({ team, who, kind, t }), `plan` ({ side, chaser, leave, land,
  hit, out, go }), `b` (the ball: x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, held, landed), `log` (the points: { team, why, score
  }), `last`, `walk`, `held`, `won`, `lost`, `F` (the court's frame), `w(u, v)`, `c(x, z)`, `predict(y)`,
  `launch(u, v, apex, o)`, `home()`, `atRest()`, `canStart()`, `start()`, `rematch()`, `giveUp()`,
  `end(kind)`, `swing()`, `cfg` (VOLLEY). Scenarios `volley`, `volleyfree`, `volleyshots` (§16.4).
- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): no rematch against the Storches (the idea's maybe);

  up, never plays it over; a point is decided by where the ball first lands (no touch count, no rotation),

### 10.51 "Kan du ta ett kort på oss?" – turistparet vid fyren (free roam; feature 110, 2026-10-18)

`game/touristPhoto.js` (`TouristPhoto`, owned by Game as `kort`), config `KORT` in content/island.js, the
landmarks `kortFyren`, `kortDyner`, `kortMedina` in landmarks-island.js, the anim flag `foto` in
character.js and its poses and the props `fotokamera` and `fotorem` in models.js (§14.6), the input actions
`snap` and `turnCam` in input.js (§3), the camera's `scope` (§14.5, as the binoculars'), the viewfinder
`hud.setKort` (`#kort` in style.css, §11.4), hooks in main.js (built after the volleyball, `kort.update`
after `volley.update`, `kort.step` in fixedStep after `volley.step`, Stig's walk in the view from
`kort.wish()` in fixedStep's frozen branch, `grab()` after the render when `grabNow` is set, the couple in
`allChars` and in areaHit's people, `debugWarp` ends a view). A sunburnt Swedish couple asks Stig to take
their picture, and shy Stig, who cannot say no, says Ole's words and cuts the lighthouse off at its foot.
The couples, the viewfinder and the tips are ours [N]; "Säg… omelett." is the film's: Ole photographs
Stig in the gift hunt with "Säg omelett." (research-plot.md:300; the subtitle names no speaker), here
Stig's [F*]. Ole's own camera talk ("Kamera två – japansk, liten, motor…", research-plot.md:255) is the
man's "Den har motor!"; the couple is the notes' Swedish charter tourists in the streets, sunburnt, in
flowered shirts, "kamera på magen" (research-setting.md:322). The Storches stay out (their lens cap is the
julfest's and the witness box's).

- **When and where**: from `from` 8 (asnan, "Caballo folklorístico", done), on the island with
  `missions.state === 'idle'`, by day (`day.isDay()`): one couple at a time waits at one of three
  `spots`, in turn: `kortFyren` on the lighthouse's plaza (block (0,6), local (−1.6, 4.4), left of the
  keeper's door, 3.4 m from `fyrDorr`, facing the compass rose 12 m south), `kortDyner` on the dunes'
  boardwalk (block (0,4), local (0, −1.6), before the DUNAS DE MASPALOMAS sign, the two big north dunes
  behind it) and `kortMedina` before the gate of LA MEDINA (block (1,2), local (0, 16.5), its pylons and
  sign behind). Each landmark is the middle between the two (`apart` 0.95 m), facing the way the picture
  is to be taken. A new couple comes only where nobody sees it (out of the camera's view or over `popR`
  70 m from it, or within 0.5 s of a cut) and with Stig over `showR` 4 m from its place; in the evening a
  waiting couple goes the same way. The next spot is `records.kort.next`. None of the three is on a
  mission's route, and a mission never sees them (below).
- **The couple**: two Characters made at the first show (later couples by `setDef`), faces from
  randomPed's tourists (drawn from `seed` + 131 n), the trip's clothes: he sunburnt (`skin`), in a
  flowered short-sleeved shirt, light shorts, a straw sun hat and dark glasses, the camera on its strap on
  his belly (`foto` 'belly', the props `fotokamera` and `fotorem`); she in a sun dress with white dots and a
  white cotton hat. The first couple is the idea's picture (an orange shirt, a turquoise dress), later ones
  draw from `shirts`, `prints` and `dresses`. They are people (`extras`): a kick or a car bowls them over
  (SKANDAL, the barks, Stig's sorry), and they walk back to their places (stuck 3 s or 30 m off, put back
  where nobody sees it). He waves Stig over within `waveR` 12 m (not within 3 m); both face him within it.
  She asks, within `askR` 9 m on foot, at most every `askGap` 14 s: "Ursäkta… kan du ta ett kort på oss?
  Fyren ska vara med!" / "… Båda dynerna ska vara med!" / "… Hela porten ska vara med!" [N].
- **The prompt**: "E Ta ett kort" [N] within `r` 2.6 m of their place, both on their places, by day,
  Stig on foot and on the ground, with no dialogue, cutaway, car, carry, pursuit, bust or PANIK, not in
  the pool fest's ring, on the belt, in the gang's talk, the nap, the SOLKRÄM scene, a toaster's game, on
  the rollerskis, in a street race, fishing, at the binoculars, on a hitch truck, at the packing shed's
  belt or in a volleyball match. The keeper's door keeps its own prompt (its 1.3 m round `fyrDorr`).
- **The hand-over** (E, `inDialog`): Stig turns to them and the chase camera behind him; the man holds the
  camera out (`foto` 'give') with "Bara att knäppa. Den har motor!" [N], at `giveAt` 0.55 s it is in
  Stig's hands, up at his eye (`foto` 'eye'), and at `handSecs` 1.4 s the screen is its viewfinder (their
  bubbles taken down).
- **The viewfinder**: the camera's `scope` at Stig's eye (`eye` 2.2 m over his feet, `ahead` 0.3 m before
  his face), no easing; Stig unseen (his raised arms were in the picture). The lens (`lens`) takes `long`
  76° along a 3:2 frame's long side (55.0° along the short one): lying the frame is `land` 0.72 of the
  screen's height and 1.5 × as wide, on end `hog` 0.82 of it and 1.5 × as tall (at most `maxW` 0.92 of the
  screen's width), and the scope's vertical view is set so the frame holds the lens (71.8° lying, 87.2° on
  end at 16:9). The mouse turns it (`turn` 0.0022 rad a pixel, the chase camera's sensitivity; the pitch
  within `pitch` [−0.9, 1.35] rad, from `pitch0` −0.04); W/A/S/D walk Stig at `walk` 2 m/s along and
  across the view (no sprint), never over `leash` 48 m from the couple's place (the lighthouse's water
  edge is 36 m); the right mouse button or V turns it on end and back (a click); Space or the left button
  snaps; E or Q gives it back unused. The overlay (`hud.setKort`, §11.4): the camera's black round the
  frame, its corners and the focus ring, the keys over it ("MUS Sikta · W/S Fram/bak · HÖGERKLICK/V
  Högkant (Liggande) · SPACE Knäpp · E Ge tillbaka" [N]) and the reading under it, live: the couple
  ("Paret ✓", "Paret: kapat" with one head in the frame, "Paret: saknas", "Paret: pyttesmått") and the
  spot's `subject` ("Fyren ✓", "Fyren: bara foten", "Fyren: saknas"; "Dynerna …: bara en dyn"; "Porten
  …: halva porten") [N], green when right, red when not. A spoken line stands in the keys' place while it
  is up, never over the picture.
- **The reading** (`judge()`, the frame's NDC box on a camera like the scope's): the couple is in when both
  heads' middles are in the frame, and a speck (`liten`) when one of them takes less than `minDeg` 5.5°
  from the feet to the top of the head at the eye (about 22 m off). The subject is whole when every one of
  its `pts` is in the frame, and `part` when one of them or of its `base` is: the lighthouse's lantern top
  (0, 56.3, −8), its base the tower over the keeper's roof; the dunes' two north crests (∓16.5, 2.75,
  −17/−17.5), no base; the gate's two dome finials (∓8, 10.75, 11.5), its base the sign's middle (block-local,
  y absolute). No occlusion test (a palm or the FARO DE MASPALOMAS board may stand in front). The kind of
  a picture: `miss` (a head out), `liten`, `bra` (the subject whole) or `kapad`. At the lighthouse lying
  never makes `bra`: the lantern and the couple fit only from 40 m of the tower (28 m from them: a speck);
  on end from the compass rose's middle (the couple 11.6 m off, the lantern 66° up) a window of about 6° of
  pitch does. The dunes want a step back lying (their crests 32° to each side 11 m off); the gate the same
  (its domes 16 m apart and 10.75 m up).
- **The snap**: Space puts Stig's "Säg… omelett." [F*] in the overlay and `sayAt` 0.8 s later the
  shutter (`audio.shutter`, the white flash) takes the picture as judged then: the frame's part of the
  canvas grabbed after that frame's render (`grab()`, a 540 × 360 jpeg, 360 × 540 on end) frozen in the
  frame for `stillSecs` 2 s with its stamp: "Bra kort!" (green), "Bara foten!" / "Bara en dyn!" / "Halva
  porten!" (`kapad`), "Pyttesmått par!", "Paret kom inte med!" [N]. A `miss` is no picture: her "Men… vi
  kom ju inte med!" [N] in the overlay and the view goes on.
- **The thanks**: otherwise the camera comes down (the chase camera behind Stig, at its own view at once),
  Stig holds it out (`foto` 'give') and they come for it at `fetch.speed` 3 m/s; if he is not reached in
  `fetch.secs` 4 s, a black fade (`fetch.fadeSecs` 0.65 s each way) puts them before him. Then the
  camera is back on his belly and the line and the tip (`pay`, the coin and the toast "Dricks från
  turistparet: n pta" [N]): `bra` 100 pta, "Å, vad fint det blir i albumet!" (she); `kapad` 10 pta, "Jaa…
  tack ska du ha." (she); `liten` 10 pta, "Jaha… vi syns väl. Någonstans där nere." (he) [N].
  `thanksSecs` 2.8 s on Stig is free, they walk off along the spot's `exit` path (`leaveWalk` 1.4 m/s: east
  along the plaza to the beach promenade, north up the boardwalk, in through the gate to the courtyard)
  and are gone at its end (or 40 m from him) where nobody sees it, `records.kort` is saved ({ next, bra,
  kort }) and the toast "Ett nytt par vill ha ett kort vid dynerna." (… vid porten till LA MEDINA, … vid
  fyren) [N] says where the next couple waits. Given back unused (E or Q): they come for it the same way,
  "Ingen bild? Nåja." [N] (he), no pay, and they go back to their places and wait on.
- **Off at once**: a knock (a car) ends a view where it is (`last.kind` 'knock'), a debug warp ('warp'),
  a pursuit or a mission start or the other level ('gone'): the scope and the overlay off, a fade undone,
  Stig seen with nothing in his hands, the camera on the man's belly. In a mission (or the other level)
  the couple is hidden at once (no body, no collider) and no prompt shows; the camera and `inDialog` are
  then the mission's. So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool sees any of it.
- **Tests**: `kort.sc` ({ phase: 'hand' | 'view' | 'still' | 'back' | 'thanks', t, frame, yaw, pitch, hog,

  'leave'), `at`, `pair`, `extras`, `rec` (`records.kort`), `last` ({ kind: 'bra' | 'kapad' | 'liten' |

### 10.52 Hittelön – de borttappade väskorna (free roam; feature 116, 2026-10-18)

`game/lostBags.js` (`LostBags`, owned by Game as `bags`), config `HITTELON` and the set `COLLECTIBLES.vaskor`
in content/island.js (§10.1), the kind `hittevaska` (`lostBag`, `LOST_BAG`) in actors/pickups.js, the
landmarks `vaska_hangar`, `vaska_bygge`, `vaska_packhus`, `vaska_tomater`, `vaska_grisfest`, `vaska_golf`,
`hittegodsLamna`, `hittegodsDisk`, `hittegodsCam` in landmarks-island.js, the minimap marker `vaska` (hud.js)
and `.vaska-icon`/`.lg-vaska` (style.css), hooks in main.js (built after the toasters, `bags.update` after
`toasters.update`; `target()` last in the target chains of updateMarkers and mapMarkers, `objective()` last in
updateHud's card; `collect` pays the set's `pay`; mapMarkers skips a `held` collectible; the idle mission's
giver can be talked to with a suitcase on his head). A fourth collectible set whose last act is a delivery:
six strangers' suitcases lie about inland, Stig carries them on his head to the lost-and-found counter at
Gando and for once gets a finder's fee himself. In the film it is Stig's own suitcase that never comes ("Min
väska har inte kommit."), goes round the world ("Den här väskan ska till Las Palmas", research-plot.md:238)
and comes back on Christmas Eve with a man from the airport who reads "Hammarby…?" off it: "Hittelön." /
"Tack så mycket." (research-plot.md:362; the game has the man take Stig's 25 pta, §8.12). By the pool
Angerud tips Stig: "För om man hittar något, så kan man få hittelön. Tänk på det." (research-plot.md:326), a
veiled hint at stealing; here Stig takes it literally. The bags, their spots, the carry and the pay are ours
(§1.6).

- **The bags** (`kind: 'hittevaska'`, `motion: 'none'`, `beam`, `pickup: 'carry'`, `idle`, `pay` 0, `jingle`
  `chime`, `bonus` 1000, label `Borttappade väskor` [N], marker `vaska`, icon `vaska-icon`): Stig's suitcase

  `color`, with a cream label on both faces naming where it was going (`tag`: `LAS PALMAS`, one `AKUREYRI`

  its `yaw` (the label):
  - `vaska_hangar` (6,1) (18, −14.6), y 0.19: before HANGAR 2's door, behind the dream plane; blue
  - `vaska_bygge` (5,1) (−24.2, 23.3): by the site hut's OBRA sign; grey
  - `vaska_packhus` (3,0) (8.6, 5.1), y 1.1: on the packing shed's dock before the east bay, clear of the
    shift's belt (x ≤ 3.2, §10.49); red
  - `vaska_tomater` (0,1) (14.4, 8): in a furrow of the field east of the vischan track; cream, AKUREYRI
  - `vaska_grisfest` (2,0) (−22, −10.5): before the farmhouse, between its doors; green
  - `vaska_golf` (4,0) (−18.6, −22.4): on the 18th green beside the flag; pink

  Ole's gadgets already have the dream plane's wing (`pryl_kamera`) and the bygge's top deck

- **When**: on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'` (`live`). Otherwise every bag is hidden (none

  här har flugit utan sin ägare." / "Full med cement, känns det som." / "Den ska inte på export. Den ska
  till hittegods." / "AKUREYRI? Då har den kommit lite fel." / "Den har varit på grisfest, den också." /
  "Det är i alla fall ingen golfbag.".
- **Carried**: over his head between his raised hands, lying on its back (the label up), its length across
  his shoulders, the handle behind him (`place`: 0.28 m forward, the head's top + 0.14). The card (`title`
  "Hittelön" [F*], `text` "Bär väskan till hittegods på Gando" [N]), the beacon (r `r` 1.6), the guide
  arrow and the minimap star point at `hittegodsLamna`. In a car (a golf cart too) the bag rides along

  turning upright, the thud) and lies where it fell, its beam and marker with it, to be lifted again; so

  foot spills it where he stood the frame before ("a reset spills a carry", §14.3); R in a car keeps it in

- **The counter** (Gando's lost and found, coast.js; the clerk `hittegods` at his post (−14, 6)):

  letterbox, and plays `lines`:
  - hittegods: "Hammarby…?" [F*] (julafton's, at every bag; he scratches his head, `scratch` 1.6 s)
  - stig: "Nej, inte min." [N]
  - hittegods: "Hittelön." [F*](t), `pays`: + `pay` 100 pta (`coins`), the coin and the toast "Hittelön:
    +100 pta" [N]
  - stig: "Tack så mycket." [F*](t)

  The julafton morning's two lines with the money going the other way. Then `game.collect('vaskor', bag)`:

`updateAudio`, `guagua.reset('warp')` in `debugWarp`). In the film Ole talks football with the driver of
the transfer bus: "Las Palmas! … bra fotbollslag… Högsta divisionen!" / "Hammarby är också ett bra lag." /
"Bajen… Hammarby… Bajen…" (research-plot.md:244; the notes name neither speaker). The game's buss17 never
had the exchange. Now the town's 13 PARADA GUAGUA stops, which had a shelter, a bench and a sign and did
nothing, call a green guagua of the module's own, and the first ride plays the film's talk. The ride, the
stops' button, the driver's other lines, the fare and the stops' names are ours [N] (§1.6).

- **The stops** (`busStops`, filled by town.js `streetFurniture` with no random draws of its own: the
  world builds as before): { key 'i,j,side', i, j, side, x, z, yaw } for each stop `busStop` builds (the
  bench's middle, 2.95 m in from the kerb, yaw facing the road). The module keeps them in the loop's
  `order` with their `names` [N]: Plaza (2,3,2), Casa Lola (2,4,0), Avenida del Mar (3,5,2), Playa (3,6,0),
  Playa del Este (6,6,1), Puerto (6,5,3), Sol de Invierno (5,4,1), Gasolina (5,3,3), Centro Nórdico (4,2,1),
  Templo Ecuménico (4,1,3), Calle Norte (1,1,2), La Medina (1,2,0), El Faro (1,6,3). Each stop's frame:
  `d` the bus's way (the bench's right as he faces the road: right-hand traffic, the near lane), `f`
  towards the road, `lane` the near lane's offset out from the bench (5.7 m); a point is [along d, out f].
- **The prompt**: on foot within `r` 2.6 m of the place he waits (`wait` [0.6, 1.8]: by the kerb in front
  of the shelter), "E Vänta på guaguan" [N]. Only on the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`, on the
  ground, with no dialogue, cutaway, car, carry (Berra, a pig or a lost suitcase), pursuit, bust or PANIK,
  not in the pool fest's ring, on the belt, in the gang's talk, the nap, the SOLKRÄM scene, a toaster's
  game, on the rollerskis, in a street race or on a hitch; not at a stop while a bus done with him stands
  within 30 m of it (`leaving`). By day and by night.
- **The wait** (E): a car standing on the bus's spot at the stop (its footprint, 0.4 m round; a car
  driving through does not count): the toast "Det står en bil på hållplatsen." [N] and no wait. Else
  Stig on `wait` looking up the road (the way the bus comes), held (`inDialog`), the camera cut to
  `shot` (`eye` [−11, 1.6, 1.9] → `look` [1.5, 1.4, 1.25], [along, out, height] from the bench at its
  ground: on the sidewalk behind the shelter's end, looking the bus's way at him), the card "GUAGUAN ·
  Vänta vid hållplatsen." [N] and the prompt line "Q Sluta vänta" [N]. A `new Car('guagua')` (the BUS spec
  and the green livery, car.js) sets off on the near lane behind its stop, the first of `spawn` [48, 56,
  40, 64, 34] m back that is on the town's grid (`edge` 3 m in) with no car within 9 m, at `spawnV` 10
  m/s: behind the camera (46–55 m from its stop at 12 stops, 32.5 m at El Faro, whose road starts 46 m
  behind it; every one out of the camera's view). It is `locked`, `noEnter` and `invulnerable` (never
  his to take, never wrecked), `guagua`, with the driver's bust at the wheel (`driver`: a def of the
  module's own, the local skin, a green cap, a pale-blue shirt, a moustache; no name is shown: his lines
  are bubbles), two `riders` (`randomPed` busts) at windows 3 and 6, and on the film's ride Ole's bust at
  `oleSlot` window 2 (game.addRider, in the outfit he wears now) unless the real Ole is within `oleR` 70 m
  of the stop or of the ride's first `oleRoute` 140 m (from Casa Lola the ride passes Hotel Flamenco). An
  `AIDriver` in `route` mode at `cruise` 11 m/s drives it on: straight on, left at the town's edge, right
  only at its corners (`extend`; buses cannot turn right, §6.6, and only a corner has neither). On its lane
  and heading its way, from `approach` 40 m before its spot it brakes at `brake` 3 m/s² (the cruise
  √(2·3·(d − 0.4)), at least `creep` 1.5 m/s), and 0.4 m before it the driver parks: the door (`door`
  3.95 m ahead of its middle, car.js `busBody`'s, on the right) beside the bench, measured within 0.03 m
  at all 13 stops. The wait is about 5.5 s. Held up short of the stop (a car standing in its lane, a
  queue): the driver waits behind it (never the AI's shove on after 3.5 s) and, stood still `heldSecs` 4
  s within `heldR` 32 m of its spot, opens the door where he is. Q (Backspace, the pad's B): no wait
  ('quit'), the camera back on him, the bus drives on by; none there within `waitMax` 25 s: "Guaguan kom
  aldrig." [N] ('nobody').
- **At the door**: Stig turned to the road, the chase camera back behind him turned `doorCam` 0.25 rad
  off the bus's way (the bus beside him, the shelter on his other side), the driver's "¡Buenas! Ska señor
  med?" [N], and at the door's kerb side (`boardR` 3 m) "E Kliv på guaguan" [N] (priority 5); a traffic
  guagua's prompt is still "E Ta bilen" (+8 SKANDAL, §7.2). He walks `leaveR` 14 m off the door (or 6 m
  further than he stood from it when it stopped), is kept waiting `doorWait` 20 s, gets into a car or a
  pursuit starts: the driver's "¡Vámonos!" [N] and the bus drives on without him ('leave').
- **Aboard** (E): Stig held, in through the door (`boardSecs` 0.55 s, a small step up, turning to the
  bus's heading), then the passenger seat beside the driver (`game.seat(player, bus, −1)`: 'seated', the
  bus never `playerCar`), the door's clack, `fare` 10 pesetas (`game.pay`: Ole pays when the purse is
  short) and the driver's "Diez pesetas, señor." [N]. The chase camera on the bus (`camFocus`: camera.js's
  car branch; mouse look works), the card "GUAGUAN · Nästa hållplats: {name}" [N] and the prompt line
  "W/S Välj hållplats · E Kliv av där" [N]; `departAt` 0.5 s on the bus drives off (`extend` from where it
  stands), at 11 m/s, 87–96 m in 10 s (56 m from Playa del Este, round the town's south-east corner). R
  does nothing from the step in to the fade (`onBus`), nor does H; he picks up no coin (out of reach) or
  collectible on the way. The destination is the next stop in `order`; W and S (`menuUp`, `menuDown`, the
  d-pad) step it back and on (never the stop he got on at), with a tick.
- **The talk**: the film's ride (`film`, end 12 s) until a ride has heard it through: at 1.2 s Ole's "Las
  Palmas! Bra fotballag… Øverste divisjon!" [F*](t) (design-A-film.md:767's bokmål) over his bust, without
  it the driver's "¡Las Palmas! Bra fotbollslag… Högsta divisionen!" [F*](t); at 4.6 s Stig's "Hammarby är
  också ett bra lag." [F*](t); at 8.0 s the driver's "Bajen… Hammarby… Bajen…" [F*](t) (the speakers are
  ours: the notes name neither, research-characters.md:596–597 puts the comparison at the lost and found).
  Later rides (`rides`, end 10 s, in turn by `records.guagua`): the driver's [N] line at 1.4 s and Stig's
  answer at about 5.4 s ("Guaguan går när den går, señor. Mañana också." / "Jättefint." [N]; "¡Ojo! Turister
  på gatan. Alltid turister på gatan." / "Förlåt." [N]; "Svenskarna sitter alltid längst fram. ¿Por qué?"
  [N] / "Jag har lite anlag för åksjuka." [F*](t) (research-plot.md:248); "Sol i dag, señor. Sol i morgon.
  Sol i hela december." [N] / "Det är kombinationen av sol och…" [F*] (GETUP's)). Hammarby, Bajen and Las
  Palmas occur only in the film's three lines (§1.5): no badge, scarf or sign, and no new line about a
  real club.
- **Off** (the ride's `end`, or E: 'skip'): the picture fades out (`hud.fade`, `fadeSecs` 0.8 s), held. In
  the dark Stig is off the bus on his feet at the chosen stop's `wait`, facing the bus's way, the chase
  camera behind him, and the bus at that stop (its door by the bench), or 8 or 16 m short of it when a
  car is there (`backOff`), else gone; the picture fades in after `holdSecs` 0.4 s and he is free when
  it has. `byeAt` 0.5 s after the hold the driver's "¡Hasta luego, señor!" [N], at `thanksAt` 1.6 s Stig's
  "Tack så mycket!" [N] (HYTT_TVA's), and at `goAt` 2.4 s the bus drives off; a bus done with him is taken
  away `awayR` 60 m from the camera and out of its view, or `awayFar` 160 m off. `rides` counts; a ride
  whose last line was said adds one to `records.guagua` (saved), so the film's talk plays until it has
  been heard through. No SKANDAL.
- **Only between missions**: `live` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. A mission start (or
  the other level) takes him off at once (`reset('gone')`): seated in the bus he is unseated on its kerb
  side (`exitSpot`), the cut and the hold are released only if no mission has taken over, a fade under way
  is lifted, every guagua of the module's is removed. A debug warp does the same ('warp'). In a mission
  there is no prompt and `start()` refuses. The buses are the module's own and exist only in free roam
  (traffic's guaguas are unchanged; `recycleTraffic` skips `locked` cars); no stage, route, spawn or
  autopilot meets them, so no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes.
- **Tests**: `guagua.sc` ({ phase: 'wait' | 'door' | 'board' | 'ride' | 'fade', stop, car, t, t0, s (the
  bus's spot), film, ole (the bust), seen, dest, said, done, end, held, leaveR, hop, why }), `stops`,

  'arrive' | 'cancel' | 'leave' | 'gone' | 'warp' | 'test', t, stop, … }), `car`, `riding`, `onBus`,

  `doorSpot()`, `inView(car)`, `reset(kind)`. Scenarios `guagua`, `guaguaKant`, `guaguaLinje` (§16.4).

### 10.54 Traktorn med släpkärran (free roam; feature 121, 2026-10-18)

`game/traktor.js` (`Traktor`, owned by Game as `traktor`), config `TRAKTORN` in content/island.js, the car
type `traktor` in car.js (with the new spec fields `wheels`, `seat`, `open`, `height`, `wb`, `diesel`, §6.6),
the tractor in nature.js `tomatFields` (and `TOMATO_ROWS`), the landmark `traktorBod`, `audio.engine`'s
`diesel`, hooks in main.js (`enterCar`, `updateHud`'s car prompt, `updateAudio`, `onHonk`, `allChars`,
`traktor.step` after `kort.step` in `fixedStep`, `traktor.update` after `guagua.update`; `seat` and
`addBust` place by `car.seatAt`), golfCart.js (its `mine()` and its mission check take golf carts only)
and kinds/core.js (a comment). By the tool hut in the tomato fields on (1,0), which until now stood
still, the farmer's small red tractor with a trailer of tomato boxes: Stig borrows it, the farmer runs
after it, and at 18 km/h the traffic queues and honks behind it. The tractor, its trailer and the farmer
are ours [N] (§1.6: the film has no tractor); the åksjuka line is Stig's from the bus, relocated [F*](t).

- **The tractor** (nature.js `tomatFields`, §6.3): `traktor` (red `0xc8281e`) at block-local (0.2, −16),
  world (−159.8, −256), facing south (yaw 0) down the dirt track to the z −200 road, the trailer's tail
  3.15 m before the hut's south wall, clear of the track's crates (`tomatlada` at (2.6, −8) and
  (−2.5, −14)) and the gas bottle (1.6, −21.6). A named parked car (`f.car`), so a mission's clean-up
  and the tow (§10.17) put it back on its spot; a toy, so it spawns with the golf carts after every
  other parked car (main.js). Its geometry draws no random numbers.
- **The type** (car.js `CAR_TYPES.traktor`, §6.6): len 6.3 (the tractor and its fixed trailer: one rigid
  body), wid 1.9, bodyH 0.36, cabinH 0, wheelR 0.4, maxSpeed 4.2, accel 3, grip 10, steer 0.62, mass 2200,
  hp 140. `governed`, so the player's tractor (× 1.2) tops out at 5.04 m/s and the speedo reads 18 km/h
  (`Traktorn`, NAMED_CARS); `wb` 2.4: it turns in about 5 m at speed. `noExplode`: a wreck steams and
  stops. Its `build` (`buildTraktor`), red with no badge (§1.5): a narrow bonnet with a lighter top and
  vent slots, a grille with chrome bars, a front weight, round lamps on brackets, the exhaust stack
  before the driver (its top at 1.85) and an air intake, the gearbox, the rear axle's housing,
  footplates, round fenders over the big rear wheels, a pan seat on its spring over the rear axle with a
  small back, a raked column and the wheel; a drawbar and the trailer's A-frame; the trailer: beams, a
  plank floor (its top the `bed`, 0.74), red sides with a lighter rail, corner stakes, a front board and a
  tailgate, mudguards, tail lamps and ten tomato boxes (two stacked at the back, the front left one
  upturned: the passenger's seat). `wheels`: the front pair r 0.34 at z 2.5 (half track 0.62, steered),
  the rear pair r 0.64 at z 0.7 (0.72, wide, lugged), both on yellow rims, the trailer's pair r 0.34 at
  z −2.1 (0.84). `seat`: Stig sits full size high up in the middle (seatY 1.0, his hips at 1.12 and z
  0.62, his head top 2.63; `open`); a passenger on the upturned box at the trailer's front (−0.36,
  −0.95). `height` 1.6. Not in `TRAFFIC_MIX`; the paint shop does not take it (a `build` car, §7.2).
- **Borrowing it**: `traktor.open()` is the island with `missions.state === 'idle'`. On foot at it the
  prompt is `<b>E</b> Låna traktorn` [N] (`traktor.prompt(car)`, after the jeep's); E gets in
  (`enterCar`) and Stig says "Jag lånar den bara en liten stund!" [N]. No SKANDAL (nobody is thrown out).
- **The farmer** (`TRAKTORN.farmer`, ours: an old local in a straw hat, a waistcoat over a faded blue
  shirt, a grey walrus moustache; not the grisbonde, the bodega's mission actor): `outAfter` 0.9 s after
  the take, if the tractor is within `seeR` 40 m of the hut's door (`traktorBod`, block-local (2.1, −24),
  facing east out of the door on the hut's east face), he is shown there (`extras`) and shouts "¡Mi
  tractor! ¡Señor!" [N]. He runs after it at `run` 4.5 m/s (the tractor's top is 5.04) towards a point
  0.4 m behind the trailer's tail, never nearer than `keep` 3.2 m to it: his speed is min(run, the
  tractor's speed + 1.5 × (distance − keep)), 0 within keep, so behind a moving tractor he falls back
  slowly and behind a stopped one he stops 3.2 m off. Every `shoutEvery` 3.4 s a shout in turn: "¡Mi
  tractor! ¡Señor!", "¡Pare, señor! ¡Pare!", "¡Es mi tractor!", "¡Señor, por favor!" [N] (plain Spanish,
  §1.2), his right fist up while he shouts (`oath`); `answerAfter` 1.5 s after each of his first two (once
  Stig's own line is over, at most 2 s more) Stig answers "Jag ställer tillbaka den sen!", "Förlåt! Bara
  en liten bit!" [N]. He gives up `giveUpR` 50 m from the door, `loseR` 26 m behind the tail, `maxSecs`
  20 s into the chase, stuck for 3 s, or knocked down (once up): "¡Ay… suecos!" [N], fist up, facing it,
  for `sulkSecs` 2.4 s; then he walks home at `walk` 1.4 m/s and in at the door (hidden within 0.5 m of
  it), or is popped in where nobody sees him or the door (off the camera's view or 70 m off) when stuck or
  more than 25 m out. Stig out of the tractor with him chasing within `thanksR` 16 m: he runs to its side
  towards his door, 1.6 m out by the seat, says "¡Mi tractor! ¡Por fin!" [N], 1.3 s later Stig says "Tack
  för lånet!" [N], and he walks home; further off he gives up. Taken again while he sulks or walks home,
  the chase starts again from where he is. He is a person for the cars and the kicks, with the local
  barks (`local`).
- **At the wheel**: the motor is `audio.engine(…, diesel)`, a low, dark putt-putt (§12.3). The stack
  puffs every `smokeEvery` 0.22 s (0.11 s and darker at full throttle). A **bush row** (`TOMATO_ROWS`, the
  fields nature.js's `tomatoRows` lays in all three tomato blocks) crossed at more than 0.6 m/s by the
  tractor's front axle (z 2.5), its rear axle (0.7) or the trailer's (−2.1) is a jolt: a kick to three
  damped springs (k 160, damping 9; `jolt`: 1.1 m/s up, 0.9 rad/s of pitch (the front's nose up, the
  rear's down), 0.6 rad/s of roll; the rear axle's 0.8 and the trailer's 0.5 of it; × min(1, v / 4)),
  drawn on top of the car's synced tilt, with leaves and tomatoes flying off both sides. `sickBumps` 4
  jolts of the tractor's axles within `sickWindow` 3 s give Stig's line in turn — "Jag har lite anlag för
  åksjuka." [F*](t) (the bus's line, research-plot.md:248), "Oj… fårorna.", "Det här är inte bra för
  magen." [N] — at most every `sickGap` 14 s. Off the asphalt and out of the rows at more than 1 m/s a
  smaller random jolt every 0.25–0.6 s (`rough` 0.45); with Stig at the wheel the engine shakes it (8 mm,
  0.004 rad). A knock that takes `spill` 3 m/s off its speed in a frame throws ten tomatoes and
  splinters off the trailer (`spawnDebris`).
- **The queue**: drivers.js honks only at a car it is blocked by for 1.2 s on end, and a car that follows
  the tractor at its speed keeps slipping in and out of its look-ahead (measured: no honk in 9 s behind
  it). So `traktor.queueUp`, with Stig at the wheel: a traffic car within `queue.r` 26 m of the
  tractor's tail, `queue.lat` 2.2 m of its line, going its way (cos > 0.8) and held up (2 m/s under its
  cruise) for `queue.after` 1.2 s honks (`game.onHonk`: the sound), again every `queue.every` 3 s and up
  to 1.2 s more. A honk at the tractor (that one or drivers.js's) gets Stig's line in turn, at most every
  `honkGap` 9 s: "Förlåt! Den går inte fortare.", "Ja, ja… jag kör så fort jag kan!", "Det är en
  traktor!" [N]. The traffic is otherwise unchanged.
- **Never a mission's car.** In a mission or in the other level there is no car prompt at it and E gives
  the toast "Traktorn går bara i 18 km/h – ta en riktig bil." [N] and no seat (`enterCar` asks
  `golf.open()`, the same test, and `traktor.refuse()`); `traktor.update` puts him out of it at once
  (only a debug start can find him in it); `getInCar` never counts it and `retryCar` never hands it back
  (toys, §10.40). At a mission start (`missions.state` leaving 'idle', or the other level) it goes back
  to its spot (a wreck comes back whole) and the farmer in.
- **Fetched home**: between missions a tractor left elsewhere (not his, nobody in it) is back on its spot
  once Stig is `homeR` 50 m from it and from the spot and neither is in view (off the camera's view or
  70 m off): the farmer fetched it. A wreck (steam, no fire, no SKANDAL: a named car) comes back whole the
  same way.
- So no mission, stage, timer, fixture or calibration pool changes: no stage plays in block (1,0), the
  tractor stands inside it 24 m from the north ring road's centre line and 56 m from the south road's,
  and in a mission it is a parked car nobody can take (the AI drives only on the road network)
  (notes/calibration-samples.md, "Feature 121").
- **Tests**: `traktor.mode` (null | 'out' | 'chase' | 'sulk' | 'back' | 'home'), `t`, `near` (the
  farmer's least distance to the tail in the chase), `bumps`, `honks`, `spills`, `fetched`, `takes`,
  `chases`, `puffs`, `joltMax`, `last` and `log` ({ kind: 'take' | 'door' (x, z) | 'shout' | 'answer' |
  'giveUp' | 'back' | 'in' (pop) | 'refuse' | 'out' | 'fetch' (wreck) | 'home' (moved) | 'sick' | 'honk'
  | 'spill' (dv), text? }), `farmer`, `extras`, `queue`, `open()`, `mine()`, `prompt(car)`, `tail(car,
  back)`, `backSpot(car)`, `home()`; `rowCell(x, z)` (exported). Scenarios `traktor`, `traktorshots`

- **Not done / changed** (deviations from the idea): the tractor stands at (0.2, −16) on the track, not

  is over its top speed); the trailer is fixed (the idea's first version); no tomato boxes fall off (no

`<b>E</b> Revansch!` after a lost match; in a match the prompt line is `<b>J</b> Sparka · <b>SPACE</b> Hoppa och nicka · <b>Q</b> Ge upp`, `volley.hint()`) · `<b>E</b> Ta ett kort` (a waiting tourist couple, §10.51;
